tei:div.tei:p: ra༅༅//bongak+ki nang saza sdape thu+ogasardzib//rwadzi2ca ༵ khuXs 1rde ji 5 rdo 0 7dīdzikhurwa rngu py-i2 tshitharngu/༵༵༵༵sdusdu~Xsduchipyi 5821 bodikyilorgyusarigaganasadapyadagazhi'irgyuchagadamasabasgrigs khu /spyi'i 'ar+pā thengs 21wawawawawa wawawawawawa0khro'i0spyo waXwa ༷waXwawashe 9wawawabyeXwawawa
gyi — shā — dzha ske — —na waskrerdobye wa 4rī —sdu k+ṣe sgyu tswab snyidzo+ozu sh+tsa— ni ༷ ji4 dzādi ṅka —tswadze+e dhe+o

sno' la sa sprophe da wad ker+sha/ ( pasgospu(kata5/lta/(nag (spyo/ma5zhuninadzi(/zhusketso d+ngha6phubispyi'i 'don thengs 2pa/bod rang skyor+sha drongs srid ༵sa lo rgyus shi gnas dpyad gartsokā d+dhi r+sha sbyi sa nā /lhan khang sa mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
bsam gling tshe ring pal

dkar mdzes dpon khag khang gsar tshang gi lo rgyus rags bsdus/khang gsar yerdor gyisabartsams/bcings 'grol ma btang gong la khams khul du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi yul dpon dang / 'go pa che chung gis bcad bzung byas pa'i 'og thun mong ma yin pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs shig chags yod pa red/ spyi tshogs de rigs byang phyogs khams rgyud du de bas mngon gsal dod po yod pa de'i nang dkar mdzes kyi 'go dpon gras khang gsar ni chab srid dang chos lugs gang thad nas shugs rkyen che tsam yod pa'i khyim rgyud cig red/ chab srid thog cung cha tshang ba'i rgyud 'dzin dbang bsgyur gyi lam lugs yod pa des dkar mdzes sa khul gyi chab srid stobs shugs che shos shig chags shing da dung shugs rkyen che tsam byung ba'i ‘‘dkar mdzes don rkyen ’’zhes pa yang thon myong yod pa red/ chos lugs thog bcings 'grol ma btang gong khams byang rgyud sa khul du mtshan gnas mtho shos kyi bla ma ste dkar mdzes dgon pa'i skyabs mgon sku 'phreng gnyis pa de yang khang gsar tshang nas yin zhing (da lta'i sku phreng gsum pa thub bstan dge legs ni khang gsar bde chen dbang mo'i bu tshab yin pa ) chos srid zung 'brel gyi rnam pa de dag la brten nas khang gsar dpon khag gis chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha skyong gi yod pa red/ 'dir khang gsar tshang gi 'byung khungs dang / rgyud pa 1

'dzin stangs/ de bzhin khyim rgyud kyi lo rgyus rags bsdus sogs bkod yod pas lo rgyus mkhas dbang rnam pas dpyad zhib yod pa zhu/khang gsar tshang gi 'byung khungs/'go dpon khang gsar tshang gi 'byung khungs thad lo rgyus deb ther dang dmangs khrod kyi bshad srol 'dra min mang po deb thog tu bkod yod pa red/〈dkar mdzes rdzong gi lo rgyus 〉nang 'khod par gzhigs na/ ming rgyal rabs kyi lo mjug ma'i dus su ‘‘dkar mdzes be ri yul dpon gyis bon chos kyi phyogs su langs nas dge lugs par mnar gcod byed pa'i rlung yan de mtsho sngon gu shi han gyis dmag mi btang nas rtsa med bzos pa red/ de nas sog po'i hor rigs pas khag bgos nas sa de skyong bar byas/’’ ching rgyal rabs chan lung lnga bcu nga bdun (spyi lo 1792) lor phu'u khang an gyis bod la btsan 'dzul byed mkhan gor dmag lhing 'jags gtong ba'i lam bar du dpung dmag dang mnyam bskyod byed mkhan gyi yul dpon tshor gong ma'i bka' yig gzhir bzungu yul dpon hor khang gsar kra'o tho'o yul dpon la bsko bzhag dang de bzhin hor krang ku'u/ hor be+e ri/ hor kru'u an/ hor ma srung bcas so sor an phu'u krang kon gyi yul dpon du bsko bzhag byas par hor sras lnga zhes shod srol yod/ming rgyal rabs kyi lo mjug mar mtsho sngon rgyud kyi sog po'i 'go gtso gu shi han gyis khams bod dbang du bsgyur rjes kho pa'i sras bdun pos rang skyong kro'u yi byang ngos khul dkar mdzes sogs bcad bzung byas par hor tsho khag bdun zhes bshad srol yod/ yang 〈dar rtse mdo'i lo rgyus 〉nang 'khod par gzhegs na ‘‘hor khang gsar yul dpon dkar mdzes shar mtshams su bca' 2

sdod byas shing pha mes ni su'u har tha yi mi rabs rjes ma lhag po brtan gyis ching gong ma yung kren khri lo drug pa (spyi lo 172ṭ+wāṃ) lor gong mar mgo btags te 'gan dbang zhus par tham ka bka' yig stsal ’ zhes dang /gzhan yang dmangs khrod du shod srol ltar deb 'di'i nang brjod pa'i khang gsar yul dpon dpon thog bzhi pa bsod nams chos ldan dang mi rabs gcig mtshungs dkar mdzes dgon gyi lam grags bla ma skal bzang rnam rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈hor tsho dpon khag dang dgon pa bcu gsum gyi chags lugs 〉zhes pa'i deb nang 'khod par yon hre tsu'u hu'u pe li (bod kyi yig lam du se chen rgyal por grags ) yis sa skya'i bla ma 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyan mtshan pe cin du chos 'chad par gdan grangs pa'i lam bar dkar mdzes sa khul brgyud nas phebs skabs khul de bzhin sa rgya che la sa rgyu gshin po zhig yod kyang nang pa'i chos dar med pa gzigs/ khong pe cin la phebs 'byor zin rjes se chen rgyal por khams byang rgyud la dgon pa zhig 'debs rgyu'i re ba zhus/ se chen rgyal pos chab srid kyi dgos par dmigs nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i re bar mos pa gnang ba ma zad rang gi bu hor sras rgyal po 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dge phrug phyag na dang mnyam du khams byang rgyud du dgon pa 'debs par mngags/ bshad srol la khong tsho thonakhar 'gro mgon 'phags pa sku ngo mas kho tshor chos rdzas 'gel byed drel dkar po zhig stsal ba ma zad/ drel de yul ga ge mo zhig tu slebs nas mi 'gro ba'i skabs sa der dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i mngags gdams mdzad/ de rjes drel de ‘‘krang zhe ’mizhes pa'i sde zhig gi khron pa'i (da lta'i dkar mdzes )mdun du bsdad nas ma phyin pas sde de gar se chen rgyal po'i srung ma'i sku brnyan yod pa'i ‘‘sde mgon po ’zhes pa'i lha khang zhig phyag btab/ rjes su mi 3

'ga' res dgon pa de ni pe cin gyi rgyal po khu'u khon gyis btab pa'i ngos 'dzin byas nas ‘‘rgya mi'i dgon pa ’’zhes kyang brjod srol yod pa red/dgon pa bzhengs pa'i skabs su hor sras rgyal po dang thon be khul gyi bu mo zhig phan tshun dga' po byas nas bu zhig btsas pa der hor rnam rgyal zhes pa'i ming btags/ hor sras nas dgon pa phyag btab zin rjes pe cin du phyir log byed mtshams su chung ma dang bu de ‘‘rag 'e dgon ’ (skabs der khrung gsar dgon pa'i kha sprod du ri bo'i rtse la brag gur nag po rgyab pa'i bon gyi dgon pa zhig yod ) gyi ral pa rin po cher 'tsho skyong bya rgyur mngags/hor rnam rgyal 'tshar longs byung ba'i rjes ral pa rin po ches khong la khral pa mi ser dud tshang kha shas sprad pas khong yang 'go par gyur/ skabs de dus dkar mdzes khul du tsho dpon dang 'go pa mang po yod pa red/ dper na khar rtse khrung dkar tshang / na rdo a ru tshang / ka lags dkar bkra tshang /grong byang gi zhang rtse tshang sogs so/ hor rnam rgyal ni dpa' jus gnyis ldan zhig yin pas rim bzhin tsho khag rnams dbang du 'dus/ de nas mi rabs drug pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dus su dbang sgyur gyi khyab khongs nub dkar mdzes khra go nas shar brag mgo/ rta'u sogs sa khongs mang che bar rgya bskyed btang /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis mna' ma gsum blangs/ mna' ma re la bu gnyis re btsas par ma gsum bu drug ces grags/ bu rgan pa rta bzhon nas ri rtser sangs gsol la phyin pa rtas dbyugs nas grongs pa der ri lha la ngos 'dzin byas nas shar phyogs dgra lha zhes 'bod/ bu gnyis pa khyim du nyar nas a mar blta skyong byed mkhan du bzhag pas ma srung (ma srung skyob byed mkhan gyi don )zhes grags/ bu gsum pa zur du bzhag nas khang pa gsar rgyag byas 4

pas khang gsar zhes brjod/ bu bzhi pa hor 'od tsho dpon byas/ bu lnga pa krang ko tsho dpon byas te so sor mnga' khongs bgos nas phan tshun gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus par dkar mdzes khul gyi skad grags yod pa'i hor dpon tshang che khag lnga chags/ hor dpon tshang che khag lnga po'i mes po ni hor sras rgyal po yin pas dkar mdzes dang / brag mgo/ rta'u brgyud dpon tshang lnga po'i mnga' khongs yin tsang de dag tshang mar hor zhes brjod/khang gsar tshang khrim rgyud kyi gnas tshul rags bsdus/(dmangasakhrod kyi bshad srolagazhir bzung nasasgrig pa/)hor rnam rgyal/ (mi rabs dang po/)hor a ce/ (mi rabs gnyis pa/)bu dge rgyas/ (mi rabs gsum pa/)bla mas skyabs/ (mi rabs bzhi pa/)nam mkha' blo bzang / (mi rabs lnga pa/)nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ (mi rabs drug pa/)rdo rje rab brtan/ (khang gsar dpon thog dang po/)bstan 'dzin/ (khang gsar dpon thog gnyis pa/)rgyal mtshan rab brtan/ (khang gsar dpon thog gsum pa/)bsod nams chos ldan/ (khang gsar dpon thog bzhi pa/)skal bzang dar rgyas/ (khang gsar dpon thog lnga pa/)rab blo bstan pa'i dngos grub/ (brag mkhar sprul sku/)blo bzang tshul khrims/ (khang gsar skyabs mgon sku phreng dang po chos ming blo bzang mkhas grub/)5

dngos grub phun tshogs/ (khang gsar dpon thog drug pa/)dbyang can mkha' 'gro/ (bud med/ khang gsar dpon thog bdun pa/ 1rdo54lo nas 1925lo/)dngos grub bstan 'dzin (khang gsar dpon thog brgyad pa/'jigs med/ 1ṭ+wāṃrdo7lo nas 1924lo/)blo bzang rgya mtsho/ (khang gsar skyabs mgon sku phreng gnyis pa/ chos ming la thub bstan blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho/)bde chen dbang mo/ (bud med/ khang gsar dpon thog dgu pa 1917lo nas 1951lo bar/)thub bstan dge legs/ (khang gsar skyabs mgon sku phreng gsum pa 1944lor 'khrungs/)khang gsar tshang gi dpon thog dang po rdo rje rab brtan nas dang thog 'bad brtson chen pos rang nyid kyi stobs shugs rgya bskyed gtong rgyu'i ched du 'go pa'i lam lugs 'thus tshang zhig btsugs pa dang de nas rang ngos kyi gnas bab mtho ru gtong ched bod ljongs su tā la'i sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho mjal bar bskyod pas tā la'i slob mar grags shing khong gis da dung rwa sgrong rin po che ngag dbang chos ldan dkar mdzes su gsungs chos gnang bar gdan drangs par brten khong gi ming grags sngar bas shugs cher 'gro thub pa byung ba red/khang gsar tshang gi dpon thog bzhi pa bsod nams chos ldan gyi dus su khong gi chung mar phru gu btsas ma thub par grongs pa'i rjes g.yog mo blo rdo dang mnyam du bsdad nas phru gu bu zhig skyes pa red/ bsod nams chos ldan nad 6

las ma thar bar grongs/ khong 'das dus phru gu de chung chung yin pas dkar mdzes dgon pa'i lam grags rin po che skal bzang rnam rgyal nas 'tsho skyong gnang ba dang ming la skal bzang dar rgyas zhes btags/ skal bzang dar rgyas 'tshar longs byung rjes khang gsar tshang gi dpon thog lnga pa'i go gnas rgyud 'dzin byas/ khong ni bod dang bal yul sogs su chos mjal tu phebs myong yod pa dang / dkar mdzes su phebs rjes dkar mdzes dgon pa rgya bskyed btang ba dang / rten gtsor spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong bzhengs gnang ba red/ (dkar mdzes dgon pa ni skad grags yod pa'i hor zhwa ser dge lugs dgon pa bcu gsum nang nas phyag btab snga shos kyi gras yin/) der rkang 'dzin zhes ming du grags pa de ni (gzhi rkang 'dzin mkhan )gyi don no/ rjes su dkar mdzes zhes ming bsgyur pa red/ lo mang nang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas btang ba brgyud dkar mdzes dgon pa de khams khul gyi zhwa ser dge lugs pa'i dgon pa che shos kyi gras su gyur/skal bzang dar rgyas kyi chung ma sgron ma lha mtshor phru gu gsum skyes shing bu rgan pa rab blo brtan pa'i dngos grub brag kha sprul skur ngos 'dzin zhus/ bu gnyis pa blo bzang tshul khrims tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i 'o sa sprul gras su ngos 'dzin gyis lha sar gdan drangs kyang gser bum dkrugs par ma thon/ paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi mas khong ni spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i sprul pa red ces gsungs shing dge slong gi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i chos ming la blo bzang mkhas grub gsol ba ma zad skyabs mgon gyi mtshan yang gsol zhing / mtsho sngon 'go log dang / skye rgu mdo/hor rgyud sa khul bcas kyi chos dad pa tsho'i skyabs mgon tu grags pas tā la'i paṇa chen phud pa'i mtshan snyan mtho gras su son zhing khong 1rdo5rdolo'i zla ba 7

10tshes 5nyin dkar mdzes su phebs/ khong la khams byang rgyud du khang gsar skyabs mgon sku phreng dang por grags/ bu gsum pa dngos grub phun tshogs nas yul dpon gyi go gnas rgyud 'dzin gnang zhing gcen po gnyis ka bla ma yin pa dang chos phyogs mtshan snyan chen po yod par brten khang gsar dpon khag gi chos srid zung 'brel gyi la ma lugs de bas rim bzhin sra brtan dang 'thus tshang du song ste stobs shugs nyin bzhin che ru song ba red/khang gsar tshang dpon thog drug pa dngos grub phun tshogs kyi chung ma sde dge dpon tshang gi bu mo yin pa dang bu mo der phru gu ma skyes stabs dngos grub phun tshogs nas chung ma zhig bsus pa de'i mnyam du ster ba'i sde dge shis mo tshang gi bu mo zhig yod pa de dang 'gab mthun gyis bu mo zhig skyes pa de ni khang ga/sar tshang gi dpon thog bdun pa dpon mo dbyangs can mkha' 'gro zhes pa de yin/ dbyangs can mkha' 'gro dang rang gi khyo bo a mdo tshe dbang gnyis 'cham mthun ma byung bar kha gyes/ dbyang can mkha' 'gro 1925lor grongs rjes a rmedo tshe dbang phun tshogs nas 192rdolor kho pa'i bu bzhi pa brag g.yab rin po che khrid nas dkar mdzes su spun thug par yong ba de yang khong dang dbyangs can mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi phru gu gnyis pa ste/ khang gsar skyabs mgon sku phreng gnyis pa dang tsha mo bde chen dbang mo thug 'phrad la slebs/ khong gi phru gu gsum pa karma pa ni bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma yin zhing /1954lo'i zla ba brgyad par karma pa dkar mdzes brgyud nas pe cin du phebs skabs ngos (khang gsar ye rdor )dang bde chen dbang mo'i phru gu lnga po mjal 'phrad gnang 'dug ngos ni pe cin du khong dang mjal 'phrad byung /19rdo0lor bu rgan pa ched mngags rgya gar la khu bo gsum pa karma pa mjal 8

bar bskyod kyang lam thag ring ba'i rkyen gyis phru gu rgya gar du ma 'byor gong karma pa snyun gzhis mnar te sku mya ngan las 'das gshis phru gu 'das mchod kyi byed sgor zhugs thub tsam las dngos mjal ma thub/ phru gus da dung rgya gar du khu bo bzhi pa brag g.yab rin po che'i lha lcam phun tshogs dbang mo lags dang de bzhin khong gi bu bla ma zhwa dmar ba (bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma ) dang karma pa'i tsha bo rdo dga' ('brug rgyal po'i go mag ) bcas dang mjal 'phrad byung 'dugaphun tshogs dbang mo ni sde dge shis mo tshang gi mi brgyud ('di khang gsar tshang gi dpon thog bdun pa khang gsar dpon mo dbyangs can mkha' 'gro'i a ma'i mi rgyud )khong ni rgya gar 'bras ljongs khul du gnas sdod gnang zhing khong la bu gsum dang bu mo gnyis yod pa red/ bu gcig ni bka' brgyud pa'i gtso 'dzin zhwa dmar bar ngos 'dzin byung zhing da cha bal yul du bzhugs mus dang bu gcig ni 'jar man du bzhugs yod pa de'ang bla ma red/bu chung shos chos rgyal lags ni bal yul du tshong gnyer gnang ste bzhugs yod pa dang bu mo gnyis po yang mna' mar ster tshar 'dug 1khardo4lo'i dbyar dus su phun tshogs dbang mo lags rgyal nang du sku mched thug 'phrad la phebs pa red/ de dus bu chos rgyal lags dang tsha mo rdo rje g.yu sgron lags mnyam du 'dug pas/ nga tsho dang mjal 'phrad byung /khang gsar dpon mnga' khongs kyi 'gyur ldog〈dar rtse mdo'i lo rgyus 〉nang 'khod par gzhigs na shar mtshams le dbar brgya dang bzhi bcu'i sa nas brag mgo 'od bar dang / nub mtshams le dbar bdun cu'i sa nas dpal ri bar/ lho mtshams le dbar sum brgya lnga 9

bcu'i sa nas wa zur rdzong bar/ byang ngos su le dbar sum brgya lnga bca tsam ༄nas dga' phan bar/ zhing 'brog dud tshang dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam mnga' 'og tu 'dus/ ching rgyal rabs yung kren khri lo drug par (172rdolo )gong ma'i cho lo rtags tham stsal rjes lo ltar ching srid gzhung la 'bru khral dngul bsgyur gyis srang bdun cu sprod dgos kyi yod/ 〈dkar mdzes lo rgyus 〉nang 'khod par gzhigs na dngul srang brgyad cu gya bzhi sprod dgos/ de'ang pe cin du gong ma mjal bar 'gro rim bzhin sprod dgos/spyi lo 1901lo (ching kong zhu'i nyi shu rtsa bdun lor ) ma srung tsho dpon bkra shis rnam rgyal chang btung nas ra bzi shod skabs mi gzhan gyis lkog gsod byas rjes kho pa'i bu mo gcig rang las med pa de khang gsar dpon thog brgyad pa dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs med gyi mna' mar ster ba red/si khron tsung tu'u shi'i len chin nas gong mar snyan zhu chog mchan zhus rjes de snga'i ma srung chos dpon gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i shar phyogs le dbar nyis brgya brgyad cu'i sa nas bkra pad bar dang / nub phyogs le dbar nyis brgya lnga bcu'i sa nas thug kan man bstod bar/ lho phyogs le dbar sum brgya lnga bcu'i sa nas wa hru'u yul khe bar/ byang phyogs le dbar nyis brgya lnga bcu'i sa nas zung 'phan gyi sa cha mang che ba dang dud tshang drug brgya drug cu re lnga bcas tshang ma khang gsar tshang gi mnga' 'og tu 'dus par byas/1911lo'i zla 2pa dang 4par kra'o 'ar h+phung gis sa zhing bcos bsgyur byas nas kon 'gro (hran shi'i mi yin pa ) zhes pa dkar mdzes kyi u yon du bsko bzhag byas/ kra'o 'ar h+phung gis li thang dang 'ba' thang bcas par sa zhing bcos bsgyur byed 'go btsugs/ tsho dpon gyi tham ka bka' yig dang bcas pa bsdu lugs dpon thog bdun pa khang gsar dpon mo dbyangs can /0

mkha' 'gros thos 'phral bod la chos mjal du 'gro rgyur kha g.yar te bu dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs med (dpon thog brgyad pa ) dang blo bzang rgya mtsho (skyabs mgon khri thog gnyis pa )sku 'khor dang bcas khyon bsdoms mi sum brgya lhag tsam zhig mtshan thog thag bros phyin par kra'o 'ar h+phung gis dmag mi mngags nas rjes 'ded btang mthar 'dzin bzung byas pa red/zla ba 4pa'i tshes khanyin kra'o 'ar h+phung dkar mdzes su yong nas ching ka spang steng du mang tshogs tshogs chen bskongs te khang gsar dpon gyi cho lo med pa bzo rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas pa dang de bzhin khang gsar tshang nas nyar tshags byas pa'i bka' tham dang bka' yig tshang ma phyir bsdu byas/ ( (dkar mdzesardzong gi lo rgyus 〉nang 'khod par gzhigs na chan yig ang 620hor dkar mdzes khang gsar dpon an phu'u se'i zangs kyi dam kha gcig dang /chan yig ang 16147hor dkar mdzes ma srung an phu'u se'i zangs kyi tham kha gcig de bzhin kong zhu'i sum cu so gcig (spyi lo 1905lo )khang gsar dpon nas ma srung an phu'u se gcig lcogs skyongs chog pa'i tham yig gcig )bcas tshang ma gzhung bzhes btang ba dang / skyabs mgon ho thog thu'i go ming med par bzos pa ma zad dbyangs can mkha' 'gro dang bu rgan pa khang gsar tsho dpon/ de bzhin bu gnyis pa skyabs mgon rin po che bcas rdo mtho grong du gnas spo byed du bcug pa/ de bzhin sger gnyer sa zhing yongs rdzogs nas srid gzhung la dpya khral 'jal dgos pa'i bka' btang ba dang de snga'i mnga' 'og gi sa zhing dang khyim dud rnams mang tshogs kyi 'dems thon byas pa'i khag theg 'gan 'khur bar do dam byed du bcug khag theg 'gan 'khur ba dang po de skyabs ri 'go pa mgon po tshe ring dang sha sha'i 'go pa 'jam tshe gnyis nas byas pa red/ khag theg pa'i las shag ni khang gsar tshang 11

du btsugs yod pa dang / las don byed phyogs skor tsho dpon la snyan seng zhu ma dgos par u yon la snyan seng zhus te las don sgrub na 'grig sa gnas so so'i de snga'i mdun skor ('go pa )dang 'go pa chung ba sogs sngar rgyun ltar rang sor bzhag yod/ khag theg 'gan 'khur ba'i 'gan khri'i yun tshad lo gcig gtan 'bebs byas yod pa de'i nang ‘‘tā han mi gyi go ming yod pa de tshor yang dpya khral med pa bzos med/ de nas rgyun ring ma song bar khang gsar tsho dpon gyi a ce (ma bsrung dpon gyi bu mo ) grongs rjes khong dang dpal ri'i tsho dpon gyi bu mo dpal ldan sgrol ma dang gnyen sgrig byas te khyim mi yongs rdzogs dpal ri la gnas spos/ sa zhing bcos bsgyur phyogs bsdus byas rjes khang gsar dang ma srung khongs gtogs kyi sa cha rnams shang nyi shu dang grong tsho gnyis su bsdus pa ma zad gru kha khag lnga yang btsugs pa red/khang gsar dpon gyi dpon gnas slar gso byas pa/spyi lo 1911lo'i zla ba 10par lcags phag lo'i gsar brjer rgyal kha thob/ kra'o 'ar h+phung khren tur bsad pas kho pas bton pa'i sa zhing bcos bsgyur phyogs bsdus ces pa de yang chabs cig tu med par chags/ tsho dpon gyi cho lo med pa bzos pa rnams tshang ma slar gso byas/ skabs der chags sa brten sa med pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung de yang gzhan gyi re bar thag gcod byed rgyu las med tsang khang gsar dpon dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs med la khag theg spyi khyab pa'i go gnas sprad pa ma zad khang gsar dpon gyi sngar yod kyi dbang cha yod tshad slar gso byas pa dang srid gzhung nas btsugs pa'i khag theg de tsho tsho dpon gyi mnga' khongs 'go par gyur pa red/min go'i lo bdun pa'i (191ṭ+wāṃlo )zla ba /par bka' blon byams pa 12

bstan dar gyis bod dmag khrid nas zi khron mtha' srung gran zhwa ling gi dmag dpung dang rong pad h+phun du phan tshun nyin nyi shu lhag tsam dmar 'dzing byas pa red/ de'i rjes su rong pad h+phun gyi dmag mtshams 'jog rgyu'i chod yig don tshan bzhi zhes pa bzhag bod dmag sde dger 'then srung byas pa dang khron dmag dkar mdzes su 'then srung byas nas phan tshun 'khrug rtsod kyi don rkyen mtshams 'jog byed thub pa byung ba red/min go'i lo brgyad par (191khalo ) gran zhwa ling gis tsho dpon la ngo dga' byas pa de yang bod nas sa cha de ga'i tsho dpon gyi stobs shugs bed spyod byas te don rkyen bzo rgyur sngon 'gog byed rgyu'i ched du yin pa red/ de nas rim bzhin de sngon kra'o 'ar h+phung gis gzhung bzhes btang ba'i tham ka dang bka' yig de bzhin sa zhing dang rgyu dngos tshang ma dngos su tsho dpon la rang 'jags sprad de mu mthud rgyud 'dzin byed chog pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog dmag mi'i ying btsugs pa dang khang gsar tshodapon dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs med dkar mdzes dmag sgar ying gi ying krang la bsko bzhag byas/min go'i lo nyi shu rtsa drug (1927lo ) dkar mdzes sa gnas dmag sgar ying de khams rgyud yul dmag ying gnyis par bsgyur pa dang ying krang bde chen dbang mor bsko bzhag byas/1926lor krung go'i bzo zhing dmar dmag cun bzhi pa dkar mdzes rdzong du bca' sdod byas shing zla 4pa'i tshes 15nyin dkar mdzes rdzong bod pa srid gzhung dbu brnyes pa red/ dmar dmag nas tang gi mi rigs srid jus lag bstar byas nas ‘‘bod dar rgyas gtong rgyu dang cang ce hre rtsa med bzo rgyu'i ’’kha phyogs gsal ston byas par bod rigs mi dmangs tsho'i brtsi bkur thob pa red/ srid gzhung de khang gsar tshang du btsugs pa dang khang gsar 13

dpon mo bde chen dbang mor kru'u zhi gzhon pa bsko bzhag byas pa dang khang gsar skyabs mgon blo bzang rgya mtsho drung yig chen mor bsko bzhag byas pa red/dbang bsgrur gyi sgrig gzhi gsar pa dang de bzhin dpya khrul lam lugs sra brtan du btang ba/192rkyalor khang gsar dpon nas rang ngos kyi dpal 'byor stobs shugs rgya skyed dang 'phel rgyas gtong ched sgrig gzhi gsar pa ste ‘‘spyi sger gnyer pa ’’zhes pa btsugs pa ma zad sgrig gzhi de dag yar lung gtsang po'i gru kha chen po tā cing gru khar btsugs pa de bzhin gtsang po sgrol mkhan gyi dngos rdzas nyar tshags bya yul khang pa gsar rgyag byas shing 'grul pa'i sa nas dpya khral bsdu ba de'ang ja do po brgya tham par dngul sgor 20bsdu rgyu gtan 'bebs byas pa de nas bzung dkar mdzes khul du tshong 'grul 'u lag sa tshigs rim pas chags pa red/‘‘spyi sger gnyer pa'i mimi'os mi ni sa cha de ga'i nang gi khral pa mi ser gyi khrod nas phran bu'i rgyu phyug pa dang las ka'i 'jon thang che tsam gyi mi gsum re 'dems bsko byas nas re mos kyis 'gan 'khur byed kyi yod pa red/ de dag 'gan 'khur byed pa'i dus yun ni lo gnyis yin/ ‘‘spyi sger gnyer pa ’’btsugs pa'i skabs khang gsar tshang dang grong mi tshos grab gsog byas pa'i ma rtsa 'bru khal nyis brgya dang rgya dngul srang 160bu lon btang ba dang / 'bru rigs kyi lo re'i skyed ka'i gsum cha gcig dang / rgya dngul gyi skyed ka'i bzhi cha gcig lo ltar ma rtsa'i kha gsab tu bzhag 'phros kyi skyed ka dang de bzhin lo de ga'i dpya khral dang khral pa mi ser tsho'i 'u lag dang khral gyi yong 'bab 14

tshang ma ‘‘spyi sger gnyer pa'i ’’lo de rang gi 'gro song du gtong gi yod/ gal te gongagasal yong 'bab sprod ma thub na gnyer pa rang nyid nas kha gsab byed dgos kyi yod pa dang yong 'bab 'gro song las brgal ba byung na ma rtsar 'jog pa'am yang na gnyer pa so sos bgo bsha' rgyag pa bcas byas chog‘‘spyi sger gnyer pa'i ’’yong 'bab de dag thun mong byed sgo'i 'gro song du gtong ba dper na/ khang gsar pho brang nang gi sdod bya ste srung bya dang mdun skor 'go pa bcas kyi 'tsho ba'i 'gro song du gtong ba dang / gzhan yang lo ltar dkar mdzes dgon pa'i smon lam chen mo'i skabs khang gsar dpon khag nas chos lugs gtong sgo'i 'gro song tshang ma de dag gi khongs nas gtong gi yod/khang gsar tshang dpon khag de rim bzhin ma lag cha tshang ba'i dbang bsgyur sgrig gzhi chags pa red/ yul dpon ni go gnas mtho shos dang de'i 'ogaspra ‘‘gyod gsol mi’dang ‘‘mdun skor/’’ ‘‘'go pa ’’bcas rim pa gsum yod/ ‘‘gyod gsol mi’zhes pa de'ang 'go pa che gras kyi brjod tshul yin pa de'i dbang cha che tsam yod par gyod gzhi sogs gong la snyan zhu dang 'og la bka' gtong ba bcas rgyun ldan gyi nyin re'i las ka byed dgos kyi yod/ de'i mnga' 'og tu khral pa mi ser mang po yod/ khang gsar dpon gyi ‘‘gyod gsol ’ste yi pa kha'i phyag mdzod gyod gsol dang / kha rgyab rdzong kha gyod gsol/ ka la'i yar rlung gyod gsol/ ye ang gyod gsol/ spu zhod gyod gsol/ klo pa yar tsho gyod gsol/ sne mdo a rog gyod gsol/ grong gzhi gyod gsol/ mtha' smad lcags ri tshang gyod gsol/ ser gzhi sde'i rdzong grong gyod gsol/ zhi bde lha gyod gsol/ sha sha sde gyod gsol bcas khyon bsdoms mi tshang bcu gnyis yod pa red/15

gong gsal gyod gsol nang de snga shing lung yul dpon mgon po rnam rgyal gyis dkar mdzes btsan bzung byed paldi skabs khang gsar dpon dang mnyam du lo drug tsam ring bod la bros byol du 'gro myong zhing mthar bod dmag gis shing lung yul dpon mthar skrod btang rjes gzhi nas khang gsar yul dpon dang mnyam du dkar mdzes su phyir log byas nas ‘‘tā han ’’gyi ming gnas kyang thob yod/‘‘tā han ’’zhes par rang nyid kyi mnga' khongs sa cha dang mi ser yod pa ma zad khral 'u lag rgyug mi dgos pas spyir btang gi gyod gsol las go gnas mtho ba yod pa red/ gyod gsol gyi khyim rgyud rgyud 'dzin byas chog pa yin/lo re gyod gsol gyi nang nas mi gnyis yul dpon gyi pho brang du las byar sdod dgos pa dang lo re la brjes len thengs re byed kyi yod cing las byar sdod ring ‘‘tā han ’’gyi mtshan thob med pa de tsho yang de'i ring bca' khral 'jal mi dgos/ ‘‘mdun skor mi’ni 'go pa 'bring tsam gyi ming zhig yin zhing mi ser gyod gsol las nyung ba dang dbang cha'ang chung ba yod pa red/ khang gsar dpon gyi mdun skor ste/ ngo pa steng ya 'go dpon/ ma ta 'go dpon/ ching zla 'go dpon/ spu zhod 'go dpon/ rdo g.yung 'go dpon/ spu zhod ya dga' 'go dpon/ blo pa zla mtsho 'go dpon/ se shi ti'i sde rabs bla brang 'go dpon/ dkar ra'i pad ma seng lha 'go dpon/ sde dge blo rta mgrin 'go dpon/ na rdo'i shis an 'go dpon/ tshe rnam rgyal 'go dpon/ tso ye 'go dpon/ dgra lha 'go dpon/ bye rong 'go dpon/ khar tse 'go dpon/ye pa kha'i ye 'ong 'go dpon/ a pad 'go dpon/ se blo 'go dpon/ tā chi 'go dpon/ se sde 'go dpon bcas bsdoms khyim tshang nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam yod pa red/16

‘‘mdun skor ’’khrod kyi mi gsum nas bzhi'i bar yul dpon gyi pho brang du las byar sdod dgos kyi yod pa dang / zla rer brje len thengs re byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ de dag gi las 'gan ni nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i zhabs zhu'i las ka legs sgrub byed dgos pa dper na/ mgron por sne len bya rgyu dngo yul dpon gyi rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i zhabs zhu/ sdod khang la gtsang sbra bya rgyu sogs yin/ mdun skor las byar sdod ring khral 'ul yongs rdzogs rgyug dgos kyi med pa red/‘‘'bo/ pa ’’zhes pa de ni 'go pa chung gras kyi ming yin zhing shang krang dang go gnas 'dra ba yin/ de dag ni yul dpon gyis bsko bzhag byas pa'am yang na 'jon thang che ba'i mi sna mang tshogs kyis 'debs bsko byas pa brgyud las 'gan 'khur du 'jug gi yod/ khang gsar dpon gyi mnga' 'og tu 'go pa de rigs bcu grangs yod pa red/ 'go pa de dag gi las 'gan ni las byar nges pa'i gyod gsol dang / mdun skor gyi las kar gzhogs 'degs rogs skyor bya rgyu de yin/ dper na grong tsho khag la phyin nas bu lon 'ded rgyu dang /khral 'u lag skul rgyu/ zhing khra/ la tsha 'ded gtong rgyu sogs yin/ 'go pa so sor bdag pa'i sa zhing dang mi ser med rung 'go pa byed ring rang ngos kyi khral 'ul tshang ma rgyug dgos kyi med pa red/gong gsal gyod gsol dang mdun skor/ 'go pa bcas rim pa gsum po de dag phan tshun gcig 'og gcig tu 'dus dgos med par tshang ma yul dpon gyi khrid ka'i 'go khrid 'og 'dus dgos/ da dung dbang bsgyur gyi dgos mkhor gzhigs te khang gsar yul dpon gyis btson khang gnyigla btsugs yod pas bca' khrims sna tshogs la brten nas yul dpon gyi khe phan srung skyob byed kyi yod pa red/ dper na/ mi gsod gyod gzhi'i thad thag 17

gcod bya rgyu ste/ 'go pa dang mi ser su 'dra zhig bsad rung srog rin 'jal dgos/ 'go pa mi gcig bsad pa yin na srog rin rgya dngul bcu drug 'jal dgos pa dang / mi ser gcig bsad na srog rin rgya dngul gnyis mjal dgos pa sogs dang / rku rgyag gi gyod gzhi'i skor gtan 'bebs byas par/'go pa'i phyugs gcig rkus pa yin na phyugs bcu tham pa tshab tu 'jal dgos pa dang / mi ser gyi phyugs gcig rkus na tshab tu phyugs gsum 'jal dgos pa red/ 'go pa tshos khrims srol ltar spyir btang gi nyes don dang dmangs khrod kyi rtsod gzhi dang dmangs don skor gyi gyod gzhi thag gcod byed chog pa'i dbang cha yod pa dang thag gcod byas pa'i nyes dngul thog nas grangs tshad nges can zhig yul dpon la sprod dgos/gzhan yang khang gsar yul dpon la nang khul do dam byed stangs kyi sgrig gzhi yod pa dper na/ khyim tshang gi rgyu nor ‘‘dge slong ’’nang spyi'i do dam byed kyi yod pa/ ‘‘dge slong ’de'ang dkar mdzes dgon pa'i grwa pa zhig nas 'gan 'khur gyi yod pa de ni dgon pa rgyu stobs dang dbang cha che gshis grwa pas dge slong gi 'gan 'khur ba yin na/ khang gsar dpon gyi nor srid gtong yong la 'gan len thub kyi yod pa red/ ‘‘dge slong ’’gi 'og la ‘‘thog dpon ’’zhes pa gcig yod pa des yul dpon gyi sa zhing rmo 'debs dang btsas ma rnga rgyu/ 'bru rigs bsdu 'jug sogs kyi gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur dgos kyi yod pa dang / ‘‘dge slongami’dang ‘‘thog dpon’’gyi las 'gan de yul dpon gyis thad kar bsko bzhag byed kyi yod/ de yang mang che ba tshe gang ring las ka de byed du 'jug gi yod/khral pa mi ser nas yul dpon la khral rigs mi 'dra ba gsum rgyug dgos kyi yod pa ste/18
dkar mdzezlo ṅgesnerne—/——
shārko ོ gon/

gnyis ka khang gsar tshang nas gtan 'bebs byed kyi yod pa red/lo ltar bod zla dang por dkar mdzes dgon pas sde mgon por smon lam tshogs chen thengs re tshogs kyi yod pa red/ smon mjug sgril rjes dgon pa'i dngos rigs sogs yong 'bab khrod nas 'gyed skal nyi shu re khang gsar tshang la 'bul dgos kyi yod pa red/ khang gsar tshang nas lo re'i bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin dgon pa yongs kyi bla ma dang grwa pa tshang mar 'tshams 'dri mtshon byed bag leb chen po re sprod (bag leb re la ha lam ljid tshad rgya ma gang re yod )pa red/khang gsar tshang dang srid gzhung ngam yang na dpon tshang gzhan dbar gra ma 'grig byung tshe dgon pas 'grig thabs byed pa dang / phan tshun drag po'i gdong thug byung tshe dgon pa de dag khang gsar tshang gi drag shugs kyi rmang gzhir 'gyur gyi yod pa dper na/ 1929lor byung ba'i ‘‘dkar mdzes don rkyen ’nang dkar mdzes dgon pas gdong mchongs shi phod ru khag ces pa sgrig 'dzugs kyis paṇa chen tshang dang khang gsar tshang gi ched du nyen khar ma 'dzems par gdong mchongs byas te bzang btson du lo gcig tsam bsdad pa'i khang gsar dpon mo bde chen dbang mo skyob par 'gro myong yod pa red/'khrug rtsod kyi don rkyen/bcings 'grol ma btang gong yul dpon nang khul phan tshun dbang dang go gnas la ma 'cham par 'gal zla'i 'khrug rtsod gzhi rgya che trem byung myong yod pa red/ khang gsar dpon thog lnga pa skal bzang dar rgyas kyis dbang cha bzung skabs be ri yul dpon dang brtan lha ri bo'i rtswa kha'i don du phan tshun drag po'i gdong thug byung myong yod pas dgon pas bar 'dum byas rjes ri 21

rtser dkar gong phung gsog brgyab pa des phan tshun rtswa kha'i dbye mtshams sa thig byas pa'i rjes gzhi nas 'khrug rtsod mtshams 'jog thub pa red ces bshad srol yod 'dugaching rgyal rabs kong shus khri lo dang por (1rdo75lor ) khang gsar dpon thog bdun pa dbyangs can mkha' 'gro rang gi bza' zla a rdo tshe dbang dang 'cham mthun ma byung bar dbyangs can mkha' 'gros khyim tshang gi zang zing bya ba las kha bral te yar lung gtsang po'i nub ngos rdo thog dgon du lo gsum tsam bsdad/ de'i ring mnga' 'og gi 'go pa rnams shog khag gnyis su gyes te gcig gis dbyangs can mkha' 'gror rgyab skyor byed pa dang / gcig shos des a rdo tshe dbang gi phyogs su langs/ bzang tshang dbar gyi 'gal zla de rim bzhin rno ngar che ru phyin te mthar phan tshun dbang cha 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i gzhi rtsar gyur te phan tshun mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi gyod gzhi chen po zhig la gyur pa red/skabs der a rdo tshe dbang dang kho pa'i shog khag khang gsar pho brang nang bca' sdod byas te dbyangs can mkha' 'gror rgyab skyor byed mkhan gyi grong dkar 'go pa dang / yar lung 'go pa gnyis dkar mdzes su spun mched thug 'phrad la yong skabs khang gsar tshang gi nye 'gram du bsad pa ma zad gtsang po sgrol nas dbyangs can mkha' 'gror rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang tshogs la'ang me mda' rgyab ste bsad pa red/ gnas tshul de dag gis rkyen pas rang gshis gyong ba'i dbyangs can mkha' 'gro khong khro me ltar 'bar rjes/ kho mos lam sang stobs shugs yod rgu gcig sgril thog khang gsar pho brang mtha' bskor ba dang chabs gcig dza drag che ba'i phar rgol byas par a rdo tshe dbang phyogs nas kha gtad gcog ma thub par bros 'gro dgos byung ba red/ dbyangs can 22

mkha' 'gro pho brang du 'byor rjes kho mor ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi 'go pa tshor drag gnon byas pa dang / slar yang khang gsar tshang gi dbang cha cha tshang bzung thub pa byung zhing / de rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi shing lung du bca' sdod don gcod khang nas bar mol byas pa brgyud gzhi nas dbyangs can mkha' 'gro dang a rdo tshe dbang gnyis kyi bza' tsho'i 'brel thag chod pa ma zad/ kho pa tsho'i bu dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs med nas khang gsar tshang gi dpon gnas rgyun 'dzin byas te gzhi nas skabs de'i 'khrug rtsod zhi 'jam du gyur pa red/dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs med kyi bza' zlar phru gu bu gcig dang / bu mo zhig btsas kyang bu de grongs stabs de'i sems sdug gi rkyen pas gong gsal dngos grub bstan 'dzin yang grongs pa dang / de rjes ma dbyangs can mkha' 'gros slar yang dpon gnas bzung / dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'das po'i bza' zla dpal ldan sgron mas kho pa tsho'i gnyer pa bsod nams phun tshogs dang lkog 'brel gyis phru gu zhig byung stabs phru gu skye bar kho mo'i khyim tshang be rir phyin pa red/ dbyangs can mkha' 'gros dpal ldan sgrol mar skyes pa'i gnyer pa bsod nams phun tshogs kyi bu be ri dbang 'dus khang gsar tshang gi mi rgyud yin par khas ma blangs stabs slar yang 'khrug rtsod langs rgyu'i rmang gzhi zhig tu gyur pa red/ de rjes dkar mdzes dgon pa'i skyabs mgon bla ma dang / dar rgyas dgon pa'i tā bla ma rgyal sras sde dga' dang de bzhin phan tshun gnyis kyi 'go pa gtso gras a rdo/ rgyal dpon/ a pho sogs mdun la thon nas bar 'dum byas pa brgyud gnyer pa bsod nams phun tshogs nas rgya dngul dwo yang phing lnga bcu (phing re la srang 160re ) khang gsar la phyir slog byed rgyu dang dngos grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs med dang 23

dpal ldan sgrol ma'i bu mo bde chen dbang mo nas khang gsar tshang gi dpon gnas rjes shul bzung rgyu byas pa/ dpal ldan sgrol ma dang kho mo'i phru gu be ri dbang 'dus gnyis rang khyim be rir log rgyu bcas byas nas rtsod gzhi de mjug 'gril thub pa byung ba red/ 1925lor dbyangs can mkha' 'gro snyun mnar gyis grongs pa dang bde chen dbang mos dngos su khang gsar tshang gi dpon gnas bzung ba dang be ri dbang 'dus nas be ri tshang gi dpon gnas bzung ba red/dkar mdzes don rkyen/dkar mdzes don rkyen byung nas da bar lo ngo lnga bcu lhag tsam phyin pa red/ skabs der gsar 'gyur las khungs mi nyung ba zhig nas de'i skor gyi gsar 'gyur bkod 'bri byas yod cing / lhag don shi'i khams zhing chen gyi gsar 'gyur las khungs nas de bas zhib tshags pa bkod yod pa ma zad da dung〈khang ta'o zla re'i tshags par 〉gyi ‘‘dkar mdzes don rkyen ched bkod ’’ces pa'i le tshan gnyer yod/'on kyang dus da lta'i bar du'ang mi tshos dkar mdzes don rkyen skor la ngos 'dzin bya rgyu ha cang gsal po zhig byung med pa de'i rgyu mtshan ni skabs de'i shi'i khams zhing chen gyi gsar 'gyur de shi'i khams zhing chen dmag srid dbang bsgyur pa yi 'dod tshul gzhir bzung bkod 'bri byas yod pas dkar mdzes su bca' sdod dmag sde gya gcig thon lnga pa dang / rdzong srid gzhung kho nar phyogs nas rdzun gtam bshad pa dang / paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang sa gnas mang tshogs la dma' 'be+ebs dang ma nyes kha g.yog byas nas yin min go ldog gis mthong thos zang zing bzos pa red/24

da res kyi 'khrug gzhi'i 'byung rtsa ni nga dang khang gsar dpon mo bde chen dbang mo'i gnyen sgrig gi don rkyen las langs pa zhig red/ skabs der nga rang paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi sku srung ru dpon gyi las 'gan 'khur mus su bde chen dbang mo dang gnyen sgrig mthar khong ma grongs bar gyi mi lo bcu tsam ring mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel myong bar brten 'dir ngas rang nyid kyi myong ba de dag la dran gso byas te ngo sprod zhu rgyu yin pas tshang mas dpyad zhib gnang rogs/don rkyen gong gi don rkyen/lo rabs sum cu par shi'i khams zhing chen du snga rjes su ‘‘'ba' an don rkyen ’’ (deng gi 'ba' thang ) dang ‘‘nor bla don rkyen/’’ ‘‘dkar mdzes don rkyen ’bcas langs myong yod pa red/ don rkyen gong ma gnyis po ni go min tang krung dbyang dang shi'i khams li'u wun hu'i sa gnas stobs shugs dbar 'gal zlar gyur pa nas langs pa zhig yin zhing des dkar mdzes don rkyen gyi byung 'gyur kyi rmang gzhi bting ba red/shi'i khams zhing chen du bod phyogs su bskyod pa'i 'gag rtsa'i 'grul lamaganyis yod pa de'ang lo rgyus thog bshad srol yod pa'i lho lam dang byang lam zer ba de red/ 'ba' an dang dkar mdzes gnyis ni lho lam dang byang lam gyi 'gangs che'i grong rdal zhig yin pas dmag don gnyer mkhan tshos hab thob rgyag sa zhig red/ der brten li'u wun hu'i yis cun nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'i thon re sa cha de gnyis su bca' sdod byed du bcug yod/ go min tang krung dbyang gis li'u wun hu'i yi stobs shugs bkag bskyil byed ched lho lam dang byang lam gnyis nas 'dzul 'go tshugs pa red/ 1922lor go min 25

tang krung dbyang gis 'ba' pa skal bzang tshe ring shi'i khams zhing chen du tang don gnyer mkhan ched mngags btang ba des 'ba' an du 'ba' an don rkyen zer ba de bzos pa red/ 1925lo nas 1rdzo26lo'i bar go min tang srid gzhung gis yang bskyar nor bla sprul sku btang bas kho pas skul slong byas pa'i nor bla don rkyen de dang thog khams byang rgyud rta'u ru byung ba nas mthar 'ba' an du mjug sgril ba red/ go min tang krung dbyang gis skal bzang tshe ring dang nor bla sprul sku bed spyad de shi'i khams la lag pa rkyong rgyu'i ngan sems bcangs pa de mthar pham nyes su phyin rung / li'u wum/ hu'i yi ngos nas bshad na'ang dmag shugs thon gnyis tsam 'phro brlag tu phyin yod pa sogs kyis go min tang krung dbyang dang li'u wun hu'i phyogs gnyis kyi 'brel ba mu mthud je sdug tu phyin pa red/dus 'gyur byung ba'i rjes li'u wun hu'i yis phyogs gcig nas lho lam gyi 'gog srung las kar shugs snon rgyab pa dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas byang lam dang lhag don dkar mdzes de rang ngos kyi phyogs su bsdu rgyur de bas shugs snon rgyag gi yod pa red/ 1927lor li'u wun hu'i yis skabs der dkar mdzes su stobs shugs che shos yin pa'i lo chung dpon mo bde chen dbang mo bu tshab byed rgyu byas pa ma zad rang log dmag khongs nang nas kho mor go mag 'tshol rtsis thengs mang byas pa dang / go mag 'tshol rgyu'i bya thabs la brten nas khams byang rgyud mnga' 'og tu bsdu rgyu'i re ngan 'chang gi yod/ 'on kyang li'u wun hu'i khongs nas btsal ba'i go mag ni rgya rigs sha stag yin pa ma zad bde chen dbang mo dang kho tsho'i bar mi rigs kyi goms srol dang chos dad kyi skor la he bag chen po yong gi yod/ gzhan yang chab srid kyi skog g.yo de mngon gsal dod drags pa'i rkyen gyis gnyen sgrig gi don 26

de rtsa ba'i cha nas stabs legs po zhig ma byung ba red/1kha27lo'i zla ba 12pa'i tshes 1nyin paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mtsho sngon yud hru'u ru sku zhing du gshegs/ 1927lo'i zla ba 12pa'i tshes 15nyin paṇa chen bzhugs sgar khongs bod la 'gro thub rgyu'i re ba med pa shes rjes shi'i khams phyogs su 'gro rgyu'i thag bcad/li'u wun hu'i yis bde chen dbang mor go mag len thabs byed bzhin pa'i skabs der paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nas paṇa chen rin po che'i sku gdung gdan zhu ba dkar mdzes su 'byor ba red/tas khron shan dkar mdzes la slebs pa/paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dkar mdzes su 'byor ba de ni li'u wun hu'i yi ngos nas bshad na rlabs gcig ma 'jags gong la rlabs gcig 'phyur ba dang mtshungs shing de'ang bde chen dbang mo'i gnyen sgrig gi gnad don de li'u yi rang 'dod ltar ma 'grub stabs sa gnas stobs shugs de su'i phyogs su langs min tshod dpag dka' ba'i khar paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang krung dbyang dbar 'brel ba dam zab yod pa ma zad kho tshor mtshon cha dang stobs shugs nges gtan zhig yod tsang sa gnas kyi stobs shugs de paṇa chen bzhugasasgar gyi phyogs su langs pa yin na khams byang rgyud kyi 'phel rim la stangs 'dzin byed dka' ba'i gnas tshul de li'u wun hu'i yis gsal por shes kyi yod pa red/192rdolo'i zla ba ṭ+wāṃpar go min tang gi khrims 'dzugs u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang tas khron shan gyis gtsos gdung 'bul zhu mkhan rnams dkar mdzes su 'byor ba red/ skabs der ri 'gog dmag 'khrug rgyag 27

bzhin pa'i skabs su go min tang srid gzhung gi rgyal sa khrung ching du gnas spos zin pa des paṇa chen bzhugs sgar la bkod sgrig 'os 'tsham byas te krung dbyang nas paṇa chen bzhugs sgar la 'byung 'gyur sems khral byed mi dgos pa dang / tas khron shan gyis gdung 'bul zhu sgor zhugs pa ma zad/bzhugs sgar khongs mir 'tshams 'dri byed rgyu phud da dung bde chen dbang mo bu tshab tu ngos 'dzin byas pa dang g.yu lung 'go pa bya rgod kha stobs ldan dang krin ha'o (deng gi shing lung ) yul dpon chos smad sgrol ma/ gzhan yang dkar mdzes dgon pa'i khrung gsar rin po che sogs la byams skyong dang /gsar du 'byor ba'i paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang sa gnas dbar gyi 'brel bar shugs snon rgyag pa bcas kyi las don yod pa red/tas khron shan ni cang ce hre'i blos 'gel yid ches thob pa'i gras yin pa dang kho pas de snga nor bla sprus sku dang 'phrad myong yod pa red/ tas khron shan da res dkar mdzes su yong don ngo ma ni paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang sa gnas kyi stobs shugs bed spyad nas shi'i khams mnga' 'og tu 'jug thub pa byed rgyu de yin pa li'u wun hu'i yis ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ der brten tas khron shan dkar mdzes nas kha gyes ma thag li'u wun hu'i yis paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi khongs mi rnams la brnyas bsko mthong chung dang / sa gnas stobs shugs rang 'og tu bsdu rgyu bcas la shugs snon rgyag rgyu'i bya thabs spel ba red/don dngos thog paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi khongs mi mang che ba bod mi yin pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che'i zhabs zhur bcar nas gzhan yul du lo ngo bco lnga tsam ring sdod dgos byung bas gzhan gyi lung par 'tsho ba skyel rgyur zhen pa log mkhan sha stag yin pa dang / skabs der paṇa chen rin po che sku 28

༵3 —— gshegs zin pa song tsang / da dung kho tsho phyi phyogs su lus pa der de bas don gyi snying po med par gyur cing / khams byang rgyud de bzhin bod dang sa 'brel yin pas bod dang mtsho sngon la 'gro sa'i lam bu gtso bo zhig yin stabs g.yul 'gyed mkhan gyis hab thob rgyag sa zhig yin pa paṇa chen bzhugs sgar khongs mi tshos shes kyi yod/ khams byang ngos kyi rdzong drug po'i gnas sa ni 'bri chu'i shar ngos su yin pas 'bri chu'i rgyud kyi sa cha mang che ba shi'i khams kyi khongs su gtogs shing / de snga bod kyis bzung myong yod pa red/ bod bka' shag srid gzhung gis de snga dmag mi thengs mang btang nas gtsang po phred bcad kyis byang ngos btsan bzung byas pa dang dus mtshungs mtsho sngon mā h+phu'u h+phang nas 1kha42lo'i lo stod du dmag drangs nas g.yu lung 'go pa bya rgod stobs ldan dang dmag 'thab kyis bya rgod tshang gi 'go dpon gcig bsad pa ma zad phyugs zog mang tsam btsan 'phrog byas mthar krung dbyang nas tar yig btang ste bkag 'gog byas rjes gzhi nas mā h+phu'u h+phang gis dmag mi phyir 'then byas pa red/ gal te bzhugs sgar khongs mis khams byang ngos btsan bzung byas pa yin na mdun phyogs su li'u wun hu'i yod pa dang / rgyab phyogs su bod sa gnas srid gzhung yod pas kho pa tshos the jus ma byas par rang dgar 'jog ga la srid/ de 'dra song tsang bzhugs sgar khongs mir rgyab mdun gnyis nas rdung rdeg 'khel rgyu nges can yin pas dmag jus thog nas bshad na'ang de ni byed mi rung ba zhig yin phyin paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi khongs mi tshor rgyun shes de 'dra zhig kyang mi ldan pa'i glen lkug cig ga la yin/nga tshos dmag thog tu nus pa che shos 'don thub pa'i me skyogs de dkar mdzes su mnyam 'khyer byas yod kyang de dag 'dzugs ched kyi rkang pa de skye mdor bzhag pa red/29

paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang thon bu'u sne sdod rdzong srid gzhung bcas kyi dbar/paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dkar mdzes su 'byor ba'i rjes chos dad dang mi rigs goms srol gyi 'brel ba yod pa dang de'i sgang la lag sne gtong dngul mang ba dang 'gro gron gtong skabs 'jungs pa med pa bcas kyi rkyen pas sa gnas mang tshogs kyi brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor thobazlokyi yod kyang thon pu'u dang sa gnas rdzong srid gzhung gis phrag dog dang brnyas bcos byed kyi yod pa red/thon pu'u dang sa gnas sne sdod rdzong gis paṇa chen khongs mir 'bru rtsam dang mar sogs bza' chas nyo tshong mi chog pa'i bka' yig sa gnas mang tshogs la bkrams pa red/ skabs de dus li'u wun hu'i yis de 'dra byas pa bzhugs sgar gyi khongs mis shes kyi med par de ni phan tshun go 'dzol zhig byung ba yin shag gis gting skyes sprul sku dang li'u cwa cun gnyis dar mdor li'u wun hu'i yi sar btang nas phan tshun go 'dzol 'dra byung yod na sel rogs gnang dgos pa dang slad thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung dang paṇa chen bzhugs sgar bar gyi 'brel ba legs bcos yong rgyu'i re ba bton rung mthar 'bras bu gang yang ma thon pa red/thengs shig bzhugs sgar khongs kyi mdzo pa gcig gis sha khrom nas sha nyo skabs thon pu'u yi skad bsgyur zhig dang sngon la kha rtsod shor ba dang de rjes phan tshun rgyag res thug nas mdzo pa des sked gri bton ste skad bsgyur la btsugs pas kho pa de gar shi ba red/ de nas thon pu'u yi mi kha shas sa der 'byor rjes mdzo pa de 'dzin bzung byas/ bzhugs sgar nas gnas tshul de shes rjes lam sang mi btang nas mi shi byung bar srog rin ga tshod 'jal sprod 30

dgos rung 'jal rgyu sogs bshad de gnas tshul de'i rkyen pas phan tshun mthun sgril la gnod gzhi mi 'byung ched bar mol byas rung 'bras bu ma thon par thon pu'u nas mdzo pa de gnam thag brgyab nas nyes rdung btang ste shi ba'i phung po bzhugs sgar la rtsis sprod byas pa red/nga dang bde chen dbang mo/paṇa chen bzhugs sgar ni thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gnyis dang rtsa ba nas mi 'dra bar sa gnas mang tshogs dang 'brel ba ha cang yag po yod pas bzhugs sgar khongs kyi 'bring rim mi sna tsho sa gnas mang tshogs tshos mgron por gdan zhu dang mā cang rgyag par gdan zhu bcas byed kyi yod cing /skabs de dus ngos kyi ming la ye shes rdo rje zer gyi yod pas paṇa chen sku srung yan lag ru khag gnyis pa'i ru dpon gyi 'gan 'khur te las tshan pa'i go gnas yod pas nga yang rtag tu khang gsar dpon gyi mgron por gdan zhu byed kyi yod/ skabs der dkar mdzes khul du khang gsar tshang gi stobs shugs chen po yod pas lo na chung ba'i khang gsar dpon mo bde chen dbang mos mi ser tshor do dam byed pa dang khong gi khu bo khang gsar skyabs mgon bla mas dgon sde khag la do dam byed kyi yod pas mtshan snyan ha cang chen po yod pa red/ bde chen dbang mo'i sdod gnas ni khang gsar pho brang rgyab ngos kyi sgo ra'i nang yod pas mdun gyi sgo ra ni brgyad gcig thon lnga pa'i thon pu'u gnas sa de yin zhing / sgo ra rgyab mdun gnyis phan tshun nang log nas 'gro sa yod pa red/ khang gsar pho brang dang paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gnas sa'i bar ha lam kung khre nyis brgya tsam gyi bar thag las med pa red/ der brten bde chen dbang mos rtag tu nga tsho khong gi sar mā cang rgyag par 'bod kyi yod/31

skabs de dus nga rang rang lo nyi shu rtsa gcig dang bde chen dbang mo rang lo nyi shu tham par slebs yod/ der brten nged gnyis na tshod 'dra ba dang skad cha bshad na yang thun mong gi skad cha shod rgyu yod pas mgyogs myur phan tshun ha cang mthun por gyur/ thengs shig bde chen dbang mos mi btang nas nga khong gi sar yong dgos zhes brjod byung bas nga'i bsam par rgyun ldan ltar mā cang rgyag par skad btang ba red snyam ste dngul gra sgrig byas nas khong gi sar phyin pa yin/ khong gi sar slebs dus mi gzhan gcig kyang mi 'dug pas nged gnyis phan tshun gleng mol byas nas bsdad de dus tshod ring tsam song rung da dung mi gzhan yong mkhan mi 'dug pas de dus kho bo'i bsam par bde chen dbang mos nga rang la 'dod mos yod pa gzhi nas shes tshor byung zhing / de ltar phan tshun gleng mol rgyun ring tsam byas pa'i rjes de bas mthun lam shugs che ru phyin pa dang de nas bzung nged gnyis dbar phan tshun 'brel thug byed pa'i go skabs mang du phyin pa dang skabs 'gar yig thog nas phan tshun brtse sems mtshon res bcas byas mthar gnyis mos gnyen sgrig byed rgyu'i dus la slebs pa red/bde chen dbang mos rang gi khu bo skyabs mgon rin po che brgyud paṇa chen bzhugs sgar la go mag slong bar btang bas paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nas bde chen dbang mo ni li'u wun hu'i bu tshab yin gshis kho pas thog mtha' bar gsum du bde chen dbang mor go mag 'tshol rgyu'i gra sgrig yod khar skabs de dus paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang thon pu'u rdzong srid gzhung dbar mthun sgril yag po med pa'i sgang la khang gsar tshang dang gnyen sgrig byas tshe li'u wun hu'i la phog thug yong rgyu'i sems khral byed kyi yod pa red/ paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nas khang gsar phyogs la nga tshos mos mthun yod rung li'u wun hu'i yi sar 32

khang gsar tshang rang nas zhu phyogs gnang dgos pa las nga tshos zhu stabs bde min gsungs par skyabs mgon rin po ches mos mthun gnang ba red/skyabs mgon gyis thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung la snyan seng zhus par thon krang krang kre krung bsdad med pa dang rdzong dpon krang cwa lin gyis de ni gal che'i don gnad cig yin pas nges par du li'u wun hu'i la snyan seng zhu dgos zhes brjod/ li'u wun hu'i yis bde chen dbang mo dang ngos rang (khang gsar ye rdor ) gnyen sgrig bya rgyu yin pa shes rjes kho pa blo pham dang khong khro chen po byung nas krang cwa lin la nges par du gnyen sgrig bkag 'gog byed dgos pa'i tar btang ba red/gnyen sgrig la bkag 'gog byas pa/1kha2rdolo'i ston khar gnyen sgrig bya rgyu'i snga nub tu khang gsar tshang mnga' 'og gi 'go dpon che chung yongs rdzogs khang gsar dpon mo'i gnyen sgrig rten 'brel mdzad sgor khang gsar pho brang du mnyam 'dzoms byas pa red/bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la rdzong dpon krang cwa lin nas dmag mi ying gcig khrid nas khang gsar pho brang mtha' bskor zhing de'i nang yod pa'i mi tshang ma'i mtshon cha bsdu dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags dang 'brel khang gsar tshang mnga' 'og gi 'go dpon che chung yongs rdzogs lo gcig nang rdzong gnas sa'i khul du yong mi chog pa'i khas len byed du bcug pa/ de bzhin bde chen dbang mo'i yul dpon gyi dbang cha khas len mi byed rgyu dang / bde chen dbang mo'i khyim tshang gi las kar the gtogs byed mi chog pa bcas khyab bsgrags byas pa ma zad rten 'brel mdzad sgor yong mkhan mi rnams kyi mtshon cha bsdu ba dang / sa yig rgyag tu bcug rjes tshang ma rang rang gi khyim du phyir 33

log btang ba red/dus mtshungs krang cwa lin gyis khang gsar pho brang gi nye 'dabs su so khung gsar du brtsigs pa dang / so pa 'phar snon byas thog nyin mtshan bstud mar bskor g.yeng byed du bcug pa red/ bde chen dbang mo bzang btson du bzhag pa'i rjes khong gi khu bo skyabs mgon sprul sku nas 'go dpon rdo rje mkha' 'gro rab rgyas dang gsol dpon blo tshe gnyis dar mdor ched du mngags te zhing chen nang gi 'go pa mi nyung ba zhig la 'bul tshan bskyal rjes 'go pa de tshos li'u wun hu'i la bde chen dbang mo glod bkrol yong ba dang / khong dang ye rdor gnyis gnyen sgrig bya rgyu'i chog mchan thob rgyu'i re ba zhus rung li'u wun hu'i yis klad rnying mkhregs bzung gis mos mthun ma byas pa red/ de rjes rdzong srid gzhung nas khyab bsgrags byas par bde chen dbang mos gnyen sgrig bya rgyu'i don chen skor thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung la dngos su snyan zhu ma byas pa'i khar li'u wun hu'i yi chog mchan ma thob par gnyen sgrig byed rtsis byas par brten bde chen dbang mo rang nyid bzang btson du lo gcig 'jog rgyu dang / yul dpon gyi dbang cha dang tham ka gzhung bzhes gtong rgyu/ nyes chad rgya dngul bing stong phrag gnyis gcod rgyu bcas byas pa red/ (rgya dngul bing gcig la dngul srang brgya tham pa re brtsis kyi yod/)ri go sprul sku'i bsam 'char/bde chen dbang mo bzang btson du bzhag pa'i rjes li'u wun hu'i yi bsam par bzang btson gyi dus tshod lo gcig las med tsang phyin chad khang gsar tshang dang paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nas kho par dgra 'dzin byed nges yin 34

pa dang / dkar mdzes kyi stobs shugs kyang rang nyid kyi ngos nas bshad na bde med bgegs mang gi gnas la gyar rgyu yin snyam/ yang bde chen dbang mo dus thog la ma glod na rang nyid kha dan tshig la mi gnas pa zhig tu brtsi nges yin pa dang / mang tshogs kyis 'khon 'dzin yang byed nges yin pa gtan 'khel/ gong gsal gyi gnas tshul ma lhag pa byed ched li'u wun hu'i yis krang cwa lin la bka' btang nas bde chen dbang mo dang / dkar mdzes tung ku'u sa khul gyi hran shi'i tshong pa chen po hā blo dang gnyen sgrig byed rgyu'i skad cha byed dgos lugs bshad pa ltar lag bstar byas rung bde chen dbang mos khas len byas med pa red/li'u wun hu'i bya thabs gang yang ma rnyed pa'i skabs der dar mdo'i ri go rin po ches li'u wun hu'i la gal te bde chen dbang mos dar mdor nga dang gnyen sgrig thog dar mdo rang du gnas sdod byed rgyu khas blangs na nga dang bde chen dbang mo gnyen sgrig byed rgyur mos mthun byas na'ang 'grig gang lags she na/ gcig nas li'u wun hu'i khog yangs byams brtse che lugs mtshon pa dang / gnyis nas bde chen dbang mo dar mdor bsdad tshe dkar mdzes su kho mo'i stobs shugs khyab mi thub pa ma zad bde chen dbang mo dar mdor mi tshab tu lus rkyen dkar mdzes su yang bya thabs gang byung du spel mi phod par dkar mdzes kyi rnam pa yang brtan lhing zhi 'jags yong rgyu bcas dang / gal te bde chen dbang mo dar mdor gnyen sgrig bya rgyu khas len ma byas pa yin na bde chen dbang mo'i gnyen sgrig la chab srid kyi re ngan yod pa gsal bshad byed thub pas kho mo bzang btson lo gcig thims pa'i rjes su'ang mu mthud bkag nyar byas kyang lugs mthun du 'gyur nges yin pa bcas kyi gros 'go bton pa red/ 35

li'u wun hu'e nas gong gsal gros 'gor bsngags brjod chen po byas rjes dkar mdzes su ched mngags mi btang nas don de gsal bshad byas par brten bde chen dbang mo dang paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gnyis kas nged gnyis dar mdor gnyen sgrig dang gnas sdod bya rgyur mos mthun byas stabs li'u wun hus nas thon pu'u dang / rdzong srid gzhung la nga dang bde chen dbang mo dar mdor gnyen sgrig byed par 'gro rgyur phebs skyel zhu rgyu'i las 'gan yang sprad pa red/thon krang dang rdzong dpon gnyis nas sger gyi gnad don la bsam gzhig byed skabs kho tshos bde chen dbang mor nyes chad dngul 'bor chen btang ba dang / —lkog za lkog len byas pa de tsho dar mdor khyab na kho pa tshor gnod pa yong rgyu yin par bsams ste kho tshos dkar mdzes dang / dar mdo'i dbar lam thag ring bas lam bar btsan khrid byed mkhan yong rgyur kha btags nas 'char gzhi de lag bstar byed mi nyan pa'i snyan zhu phul bas li'u wun hu'i yis paṇa chen bzhugs sgar la thog mtha' bar gsum du dogs pa'i bsam pa 'chang bzhin yod pas don der rgyu mtshan 'dug snyam nas mthar 'char gzhi de med par bzos pa red/dkar mdzes don rkyen langs pa dang krang thon krang 'chi don skor/bde chen dbang mo bkag nyar dus tshod thims mtshams dkar mdzes gong 'og tshang mas bde chen dbang mo glod grol gtong dgos pa'i re 'bod shugs cher byed kyi yod pa red/ thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung nas dus tshod thims kyang glod grol ma btang ba'i khar de las ldog ste bde chen dbang mo glod 36

grol gtong dgos na nges par du paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dkar mdzes nas kha gyes dgos zhes khyab bsgrags byas pa red/ thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung gi khungs med ham shed kyi bya thabs de dag la khang gsar tshang gis gtsos dgon sde dang mang tshogs/ de bzhin paṇa chen bzhugs sgar khong mi tshang ma khong khro tshad med byed pa dang / thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung gis bde chen dbang mo'iganyen sgrig gi don de'i thog la lkog rngan len pa dang nyes dngul 'bor chen btang ba/ kha dan tshig la ma gnas pa sogs kho pa tshos rang snang gang dran gyis mi ser la thub tshod gtong ba'i bya thabs de rigs la go mtshon mnyam 'phyar gyi 'thab rtsod bya rgyu kho na las ma 'das pa'i ngos 'dzin gcig gyur du byas pa dang de nas khang gsar tshang dang de bzhin grwa pa mang tshogs tshos drag shugs la brten nas bde chen dbang mo skyel rgyu'i lkog gros byas pa dang /paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nas kyang 'gog srung bya thabs thad shugs snon rgyab pa red/ de dang dus mtshungs thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung nas li'u wun hu'i rgyab rten la ngoms nas bde chen dbang mo yang bskyar bkag nyar byas pa ma zad 'dzing rags kyang brtan po bzos nas su la'ang mi skrag pa'i rnam pa bstan yod pa red/ de ltar phan tshun gdong thug gam klan ka'i don rkyen bstud mar thon nas dmag 'khrug langs la nye ba'i gnas su gyar ba red/1929lo'i zla ba 12par khang gsar pho brang gi ja ma bud med ya ma mkha' 'gro khang gsar pho brang nas kha gyes te nang la log skabs bskor g.yeng mi sna'i bsam par bde chen dbang mor gsang brda skyel mkhan red snyam nas me mda' brgyab ste de gar bsad pa red/rkyen rtsa gcig gis rnyog rdzob kun nas slong zhes pa ltar dkar mdzes dgon pa'i grwa pa dang mang tshogs rnams kyis paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi sgrig 37

'dzugs 'og thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung la drag po'i phar rgol byas pa red/phan tshun dza drag che ba'i dmag 'thab nyin bzhi lnga tsam byas pa brgyud thon pu'u dang rdzong srid gzhung gi gras khang gsar pho brang nang gi sdod gnas mtha' mjug de paṇa chen bzhugs sgar khongs mis dam por bskor nas bsdad yod pas kho pa tsho grogs med kher rkyang gi gnas su gyar zhing chu bkag btang ba'i gnas tshul 'og paṇa chen bzhugs sgar la mgo btags zhu rgyu'i gsham gsal cha rkyen khag khas len byed dgos byung ba ste/ mtshon cha yod tshad rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu dang gcig bde chen dbang mo'i bde 'jags la 'gan srung zhu rgyu dang gnyis/ thon krang dang rdzong dpon de bzhin dmag mi dang bcas pa dkar mdzes nas kha gyes te dar mdor log dgos pa dang gsum bcas red/pho brang gi sgo phye ma thag mang tshogs rnams 'ur rgyab nas nang du 'dzul phyin pa'i skabs thon krang krang kran krung dang rdzong dpon krang cwa lin gnyis skrag snang shin tu chen po byed cing dar mdor bde blag ngang log thub e yong snyam pa'i sems khral dang bcas bzhugs sgar khongs mis srung skyob gnang rogs ces re 'dun zhus par bzhugs sgar nas krang thon krang dang krang rdzong dpon gnyis bde chen dbang mo dang chabs cig skyabs mgon sprul sku'i dben pa'i sgrub khang zhig yod pa der bskyal ba ma zad ched mngags srung bya'ang ma bzhag pa red/krang thon krang ni nyal tha 'then mkhan zhig yin pas nyin de'i dgong dro kho pas lus la 'khyer ba'i nyal tha zas nas rang shi brgyab pa red/god chag rjes kyi 'cho mjugadakar mdzes blangs pa'i rjes paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nas go min tang 38

krung dbyang la tar yig btang ste gnas tshu'/ snyan seng zhus par krung dbyang nas tar lan 'byor gsal du/ paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang li'u wun hu'i gnyis phan tshun dmag mtshams bzhag nas krung dbyang nas shi'i khrang bzhugs sgar (krung dbyang thad gtogs las khungs ) kru'u ren krang h+phang lun de phyogs ched rdzong gis khyod tsho mthun 'grig yong rgyur gros mol byed par gtong rgyu yin pas re bar phyogs gnyis kas phebs sgug zhus te sdod dgos ces 'khod/ dus mtshungs li'u wun hu'i yis kyang krung dbyang la tar yig btang ba dang 'brel dmag shugs gcig sgril thog dkar mdzes la dpung bskyod byas pa red/li'u wun hu'e yis gzhi rgya che ba'i tshur rgol byas pa dang paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang sa gnas mang tshogs kyi dmag shugs khyon bsdoms mi sum stong tsam las med pa de dag tshang ma ched mngags dmag zhugs kyi nyams myong dngos med pa dang / me sgrogs kyi stegs bu de yang med pa/ me mda' sbag sbag gi nus pa 'don mi thub pa bcas la brten mthar 1940lo'i zla ba 2par li'u wun hu'i yis dkar mdzes tshur blangs pa red/ bde chen dbang mo dang skyabs mgon sprul sku dang bcas pa paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang lhan du mtsho sngon skye mdor gnas spos byas shing dkar mdzes don rkyen de'ang snga rjes zla gnyis tsam nang mjug sgril ba red/skye mdor slebs nas ha lam zla phyed tsam song ba'i rjes de yang nga dang bde chen dbang mo gnyis bar lam dka' sdug dang rnyog 'dzing tshad med brgyud mthar 1940lo'i dpyid kar skye mdo kron chus chab mdo rdzong du gnyen sgrig byas nas bza' 'tsho'i 'tsho ba skyel rgyu byung ba red/1940lo'i dgun khar skyabs mgon sprul sku bod phyogs la phebs te 39

phyin chad nga tsho bod du 'gro thub rgyu'i skor la 'brel ba mdzad rgyu gnang zhing /nga dang bde chen dbang mo gnyis kyang zi ling du bskyod pa yin/ zi ling du 'byor rjes mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi mā h+phu h+phang gis nga tshor phyogs gang sa ci thad nas thugs 'khur yag po gnang gi 'dug gang lags she na/ mā h+phu h+phang yang khams byang rgyud la lag pa 'chang rgyu'i bsam pa yod pas nga tsho bed spyod gtong dgos bsam pas red/ li'u wun hu'i ni nga tsho dang mā h+phu h+phang lag 'brel thog khams byang rgyud la nyen kha gsar pa bzos mi yong ngam snyam pa'i sems khral byed kyi yod pa red/ sems khral de ltar byas pa'i 'og la shi'i khrang bzhugs sgar kru'u ren krang h+phang lun dang dkar mdzes gsar bkod thon krang shin gnyis nas ched mngags nga tshor 'brel gtugs byed mi btang ste nga tsho dkar mdzes la log dgos pa'i 'bod skul byed kyin 'dug kyang skabs de dus nga tshor yang de tsam gyi yid ches med pas khas len ma byas pa red/skyabs mgon sprul skus bod du phebs nas 'brel ba gnang tshar rjes nga tsho bod la yong dgos pa'i skor gyi phyag bris shig lag son byung zhing /1942lo'i dgun khar nga tsho zi ling nas kha gyes te skye mdor phyir log byas pa dang bod phyogs nas zhib phra'i gnas tshul gang yong sgug sdod skabs sde dge dpal spungs dgon pa'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse mchog nas (bde chen dbang mo'i zhang po )stsal ba'i phyag bris shig lag gsom byung ba'i nang nga tsho bod la 'gro rgyu gnas skabs ngang 'then gyis skye mdor sdod dgos pa dang /slad ji 'gab 'di nas lan gsal byas 'thus skor gyi slob ston gnang 'duga'ajam dbyangs mkhyen brtse mchog go min tang srid gzhung gi gdan zhus ltar khrung ching du ri 'gog dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob rgyu'i rim gro mdzad par 40

phebs zhor lam bar li'u wun hu'i sar phebs te nga dang bde chen dbang mo dkar mdzes la phyir log chog pa'i bka' mol gnang 'dug1944lo'i ston khar 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse mchog khrung ching nas dkar mdzes su phyir log phebs rjes slar yang nga tshor phyag bris gtong gnang mdzad pa'i nang li'u wun hu'i dang thon krang gsar pa kung kan yun tshang mas kha zhe gnyis med kyis nga tsho phyir log yong rgyu'i re ba byed kyi 'dug pa ma zad rgyu dngos kyi gnad don thad nga tsho log byung ba'i rjes 'phros mol gang legs byas 'thus brjod 'dug ces 'khod 'dug de rjes nga tshos 'go pa mgon po chos ldan btang ba dang mā h+phu h+phang gis kyang ched mngags mtsho bod tshong don cus kyi mā kru'u ren sogs khyon bsdoms mi sna nyi shu tsam dkar mdzes su yang snying gnas tshul gang 'dra yod med blta zhib byed par btang ba red/ gnas tshul dngos la blta zhib byas pa'i rjes 1944lo'i dgun dus su nga tsho dkar mdzes phyogs la phyir log byas pas lo de'i lugs rnying lo tho'i zla 11par dar mdo nas mtsho sngon dbar gyi rlangs 'khor gzhung lam shar bskyod thub pas nga dang bde chen dbang mo gnyis rlangs 'khor la bsdad de bde 'byor byung /dar mdor spyi lo'i lo gsar btang rjes nga tsho yan an la 'byor/ nga tshor phyir sprod byed dgos pa'i rgyu dngos dang khang pa/ sa zhing bcas pa zhib phra'i tho bkod byas nas li'u wun hu'i yis phar bskur bas li'u nas khang gsar tshang ni de snga cun nyer bzhi par legs skyes 'bul myong yod pas da res kyi don rkyen thad sngon gyi byas rjes la brten nas rtsad gcod bya rgyu min pa ma zad re bar da res tshur log rjes blo bde bag phebs kyis srid gzhung dang mnyam las yag po byed dgos pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan zhing rgyu dngos kyi gnad don thad li'u nas dar mdo'i shi'i khams zhing chen dmangs srid thing gi thing krang 41

dang / shi'i khams zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi'i sku tshab krang 'un cun la nga tshor phyir sprod byed dgos pa'i yi ge btang chog ces bshad byung /nga tsho dar mdor 'byor ba'i rjes krang 'un cun gyis kho bor li'u wun hu'i yi yi ge 'byor bas rgyu dngos tshang ma phyir sprod byed rtsis yod rung thon pu'u nas sa cha khag gcig bzung yod rkyen lam sang bkod sgrig byed bde min la re zhig ngang sgugs gnang rogs brjod de nga tsho lo gsum tag tag sgugs bcug pa red/ de'ang don dngos thog bkag nyar byas pa zhig rang red/194ṭ+wāṃlor dkar mdzes su bca' sdod thon krang krang kan yun dar mdor las bsgyur byas te slebs shing / kho pa 'byor rjes nga tshor rgyu dngos tshang ma phyir slog byas byung bas dkar mdzes don rkyen byung rjes lo ngo brgyad tsam ring yul gyar byed dgos byung ba'i 'tsho ba dus de nas mjug sgril thub tsam byung song /bde chen dbang mo nad kyis mnar nas grongs pa/yul gyar gyi 'tsho ba de mjug sgril thub tsam byung yang de'i shugs rkyen kyis bde chen dbang mor nad gzhi ljid po phog nas langs mi thub par gyur/bde chen dbang mor phog pa'i nad ni glo tshad yin pa dang / nad de thog mar phog pa'i brgyud rim yang 1929lor khong bkag nyar byed skabs thog mar na ba red/ gnyen sgrig gi don rkyen des khong la mnar gcod drag po phog pa dang / de'i thog yul dpon gyi gnas bab nas de ma thag tu btson rwa'i nang gi btson pa zhig tu 'gyur bas khong gi bsam pa'i thog rdung deg tshad med phog khar 'tsho bcud kyang mi 'dang bas lus sems gnyis kar ngal dub tshad las brgal ba myong dgos byung stabs glo tshad kyi nad de phog pa red/42

de'ang thog mar bkag nyar gyi dus mjug sgril rjes slar yang dkar mdzes don rkyen gyi god chags byung ba dang de nas lo ngo brgyad lhag tsam ring yul gyar 'tsho ba'i khrod du lus sems gnyis kar ngal gso ma byung ba dang / rgyun du 'tsho bcud mi 'dang ba sogs rgyu rkyen mang dag khar bstud mar phru gu lnga skyes pa bcas kyi rkyen pas bcos thabs bral ba'i nad gzhi je sdug tu song ba red/1950lo'i zla ba 2par dar mdor bcings 'grol btang ba red/ zla ba 4par dkar mdzes bcings 'grol btang ba dang de'i rjes bde chen dbang mo shi'i khams zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung skabs dang po'i u yon la 'dems bsko byas pa red/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dmag sde bco brgyad pa'i dmag mi'i sman pas bde chen dbang mo'i nad gzhi bcos thabs gang yong byas rung / nad yun ring ba'i rkyen gyis skyob ma thub par 1rdzo51lo'i dgun dus su grongs pa red/ skabs der khong rang lo sum cu so bzhi tag tag red/kho bo ni 195rkyalo'i zla ba 2pa'i zla stod du 'go pa shes mdzes dbang rgyal dang mnyam du dar mdor krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la phebs bsu dang de bzhin dar mdo'i dmag don u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes par rten 'brel dang sbrags ngo bcar zhus/ lo 'di'i dgun dus su shi'i khams zhing chen bod rigs sa khongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs dang shi'i khams bod rigs sa khongs rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung dbu brnyes pa'i mdzad sgor bzhugs pa dang / de nas rim bzhin srid gzhung gi las kar dngos su zhugs pa yin/ krung go gung khran tang gis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i chos nyid gzhir bzung / 1956lo'i dgun dus nas 'go btsugs te 43

shi'i khams bod khul la rlabs che ba'i dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul spel ba des lo ngo brgya phrag ring gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugasajide mjug sgril nas rgya che'i zhing bran dang thon skyed nus shugs la yongs su bcings 'grol thob nas thon skyed kyi 'brel bar 'gyur ldog byung zhing rang khyim rang bdag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung 'dzugs thub pa byung ba red/ mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la brtsi bkur zhu mkhan yin phyin blu nyo'i srid jus lag bstar byas nas sa zhing dang sdod khang yongs rdzogs bgo 'grems bya rgyu lag bstar byas/nga rang yang tang gi yang dag pa'i slob gso'i 'og la ngos 'dzin gong mthor song ste dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi srid jus la brtsi bkur zhus mthar srid gzhung nas 'go khrid kyi las gnas su bkod sgrig gnang byung bar snga rjes su rang skyong kro'u srid gzhung gi drung che gzhon pa dang / kro'u krang gzhon pa/ kro'u srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bcas kyi las 'gan 'khur myong yod cing / tang gi thugs 'khur 'og phru gu lnga po yang rim bzhin slob grwar gtong thub pa'i nang nas phru gu gnyis slob grwa chen mo thon pa dang / phru gu gnyis mtho rim slob 'bring thon pa/ phru gu gcig 'bring rim ched las slob 'bring thon pa dang bcas tshang ma las kar bzhugs thub pa ma zad rang rang khyim thab bzung nas mi rabs rjes ma yang 'tshar longs yong bzhin yod pas tshang ma'i 'tsho ba bcings 'grol ma btang gong las legs pa skyel rgyu yod pa/khang gsar skyabs mgon sprul sku sku phreng gsum pa de da cha dkar mdze4rdzong mi dmangs 'thus tshogs rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa'i 'gan 'khur gnang ba dang dus mtshungs dkar mdzes dgon pa'i mkhan po'i thugs 'gan yang bzhes mus bcas so/ (rdo rje dngos grub kyis bsgyur/)44

dpung skyod kyi lam du slob grwa btsugs pa/skal rnamagyisabartsams/bod rigs pur hri we khe ba rgan gras blo mthun phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang stobs ldan/ tseng chos grags sogs kyis krung gung 'ba' thang gi gsang ba'i tang gi rtsa 'dzugs ‘‘shar bod dmangs gtso gzhon nu'i mna' 'brel mi’zhes pa gsar 'dzugs byas don ltar 1950lo'i zla dang por nga rang yang rtsa 'dzugs der zhugs pa yin/ skabs der krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag ni gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i shugs drag dang bcas te rang rgyal gyi lho nub sa rgyud du 'byor bas si khron go min tang gi dmag shed can li'u wun hu'i bzod thabs bral te 'os langs byas pa dang / shi'i khams zhing chen srid gzhung de zhi ba'i sgo nas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas pa bcas kyi dus su 'khel yod/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'ba' la ma slebs sngon du gong gsal 'ba' thang gsang ba'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'go khrid 'og go min tang gi dmag sde cun nyer bzhi pa'i thon gcig gi go lag dang 'ba' sdod a ri'i chos tshogs pa'i rlung 'phrin 'phrul 'khor rtsis len bdag 'doms byas pa red/ nga tsho'i tang dang srid gzhung gi mi rigs dang chos lugs srid jus dril bsgrags dang go min tang dang de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rul sungs mun nag gi gnas tshul ther 'don byed phyir gong gsal ‘‘dmangs gtso gzhon nu'i ’rtsa 'dzugs kyis dril bsgrags ru khag btsugs te 45

nga tshos bod skad kyi thog nas bcings 'grol dmag gi (bsrung bya brgyad 〉dang / 〈sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad 〉dril bsgrags byas pa ma zad/ 〈pho gzhon dmag la skong ba 〉dang 〈pha rir sa cha yag po zhig 'dug〉 (gcen gcung pho mos sa rgod sbol ba 〉sogs kyi 'khrab tshan brtsams 'khrab byas par brten mi dmangs mang tshogs tshos rang re'i tang dang dmag la shes tshor rags tsam byung ba red/ 'ba' yul gyi ri klung kun tu ku shu'i dri zhim khyab pa sogs ston dus kyi dpal yon rab tu mngon pa'i dus der bod la dmag skyod dang / bod bcings 'grol btang nas mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur bzo rgyu'i don chen legs 'grub bya dgos pa'i tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' dgongs ltar dmag sde bco brgyad pa'i hre nga gsum pa'i chab srid u yon gzhon pa blo mthun me'o phe yi'i khongs kyi thon 157pa'i gdong skyod yan lag ru khag de zla brgyad pa'i zla stod du 'ba' la 'byor ba red/ ‘‘dmangs gtso gzhon nus ’’nga tsho mi bcu phrag 'ga' zhig 'ba' thang ser skya mang tshogs kyi sku tshab tu rta thog nas le dbar bcu phrag 'ga'i sa yi 'ba' chung grong tshor bcings 'grol dmag la dga' bsu zhu bar mngags gtong byas pa dang / de nas grong khyer du yong skabs mi rigs dang las rigs khag gi ser skya mi dmangs dang / tshogs pa/ slob ma bcas pas bsu ba zab rgyas zhus shing / grong khyer du 'byor rjes ‘‘mi rigs mthun sgril mtshon byed sha mog mog ’’dang / bod rag sogs 'bul gshoms dang 'brel nga tshos ‘‘skabs 'phral gyi sne len zhabs zhu ba ’’byas pa yin/mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'ba' thang du sdod ring 〈sgrig lam chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad 〉tshul bzhin du srung nas chos dad dang yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog byas thog 'ba' thang rdzong 46

gis phyar gru mnyam 'degs gnang bar brten dmag dmangs nya chu 'bral med kyi 'brel ba zab mo mgyogs myur chags pa red/ dmag dpung 'bri chu brgal nas bod skyod byed ran pas dmag grabs sgrig brel shin tu che zhing /de yang dgon pa'i grwa dmangs dang / bla sprul/ yul lung gi 'go pa bcas la 'brel mthud sogs byed dgos la dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul myang zhib dang /mi rigs kyi yul srol gshis lugs rtog thabs/ de bzhin bod kyi skad yig sbyangs rgyu dang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed gso skyong bya rgyu so gas kyi brel zings nang du gnas pa red/ nga tsho ‘‘dmangs gtso gzhon nu'i ’mikhongs kyi gzhon nu pho mo tshos rang 'gul ngang dmag dpung la gang ci'i gnas tshul ngo sprod dang / ri nas shing gru bzo byed kyi shing gcod du phyin pa/ thag ring du ko gru bzo byed kyi pags pa sgrub tu phyin pa/ dmag rta'i rtswa brnga ba/ mkha' thog nas dngos zog g.yug yong dus dngos zog blta srung sgrug len/ dmag rgyags dang rta zog sems can nyo sgrub kyi rogs ram/ dmag dpung la skad sgyur yig sgyur sogs kyi las ka mang dag byas pas bod du dmag skyod legs grub yong rgyur phan nus chen po thon pa red/bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol gang snga thob pa dang mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams srung skyob byed phyir tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis bod sa gnas srid gzhung la bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skor 'bod skul yang yang gnang ba tsam ma zad/ thabs lam mang po brgyud de phyag las gnang rung bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi phyogs nas bka' brtsi dang len zhu rgyu lta zhog da dung dmag grabs rgya che bsgrigs thog 'bri chu dang de min sa 'gag khag bzung nas chab mdo dang / 'jo mda'/ smar khams sogs kyi sa rgyud du bcings 'grol dmag bkag rtsis byas pa red/ de ltar bod sa gnas srid 47

gzhung gis zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi gros mol bya rgyu'i sgo yongs su brgyab rjes 1rdzo50lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes shar du mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'bri chu brgal nas bod du yong 'go tshugs pa dang / nga tsho 'ba' pa'i slob ma nyis brgya lhag tsam gyis smyu gu'i tshab tu mtshon cha thogs te dmag sde bco brgyad pa'i thon 154pa dang lho lam gyi ru shog 157pa'i gdong skyod yan lag ru khag la dpa' ngar dang ldan pa'i sgo nas zhugs pa yin/ byang lam gyi thon 154pa'i ying gnyis pa 'dan khog tu 'byor nas dmag 'thab byed 'go ma tshugs gong du thon gyi 'go khrid blo mthun gyis myang zhib tshogs chung zhig gsang stabs kyi sgo nas 'bri chu tshu kha'i 'gro lam dang dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul myang zhib byed du btang zhing / 'bri chu brgal nas myang zhib byed pa'i skabs shig la dgra phyogs nas shes tshor byung ba dang mi mang nyung shor ba'i rkyen gyis 'thab 'khrug gi nang nga'i slob grogs 'ba' thang rgyal btsugs 'ba' an dge 'os slob grwa'i slob ma blo mthun brtson 'grus rnam rgyal dang bcas rang phyogs kyi mi mang po zhig srog shor ba red/ sngon gshegs dpa' bo'i mdzad spyod de dag ni dus gtan du slob sbyong zhu yul yin pa dang / de dus dmag dpung la zhugs nas bod du yong mkhan nga tsho'i gras ni bod rigs kyi phul byung gzhon nu sha stag red/ gang lags she na/ nga tsho ni rgya skad bod skad gnyis ka shes pa dang dmag dpung la zhugs rjes las khungs khag dang rdzong khag gi dmag dpung sku tshab tshogs chung so sor mngags gtong gis nga tsho'i tang dang dmag dpung gi mdzad phyogs srid jus dang / (gros mthun 〉dril bsgrags dang skad sgyur yig sgyur gyi las 'gan 'khur nas bod ljongs bcings 'grol dang / mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon/ bod gsar 'dzugs skrun bcas kyi don du 'brel 48

zam dang ka ba lta bu'i nus pa bton pas yin/ tang gi yun ring gso skyong 'og skabs de'i mi yi gras nas deng sang tang gi phul byung mi rigs las byed pa dang las rigs so so'i rkang 'dzin byed mkhan du gyur pa dper na/ sku gshegs zin pa'i blo mthun blo bzang tshul khrims ni ljongs tang ud kyi hru'u ci gzhon pa dang bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa sogs gnang myong ba dang / blo mthun rgyal mtshan nor bu ni ljongs/ tang ud kyi hru'u ci gzhon pa dang rang skyong ljongs kyi kru'u zhi gnang myong ba/blo mthun yangs gling rdo rjes ljongs tang ud kyi hru'u ci gzhon pa dang ljongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gnang myong ba/ blo mthun rnam rgyal ni grong khyer lha sa'i hru'u ci dang hri krang gnang myong ba ma zad deng sang ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren yin mus/ blo mthun 'phrin las ni rgyal khab chos don cus kyi cus krang gzhon pa yin mus/ blo mthun 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni bod rigs kyi rtsom pa po grags can dang krung go'i bod rigs pa'i zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi zhib 'jug pa yin pa/ blo mthun skal bzang 'gyur med ni krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i sgra rigs pa mkhas can dang dge rgan chen mo yin pa/blo mthun bkra shis tshe ring ni si khron zhing chen mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa dang rgya bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po zhig yin pa/ blo mthun li'u yung khang ni bod dmag khul khang gi si ling yon gzhon pa gnang myong ba bcas kyi thog da dung krung dbyang dang / si kron/ bod bcas kyi las khungs mang por mang tshogs kyi 'go khrid de spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi las rigs khag tu rkang 'dzin gyi nus pa 'don mus yin pa'i blo mthun de dang de gras mang po yod/de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 49

bkag 'gog byed phyir drag shugs bkod gshoms byas khongs nas ta dang mda' dpon sde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dus smar khams dang / 'bri chu/brda chu bcas kyi sa srung yin pa dang / khong gzhon nu'i dus su rgya gar la slob sbyong du 'gro myong bas bod yig dang dbyin yig gnyis kar mkhas shing blo rgya che ba dang / rgyal spyi'i dus bab dbye zhib thub pa/ spyi don gtsigs cher 'dzin mkhan zhig yin zhing / bcings 'grol dmag gis phyogs gang thad nas brtson len blo 'gugs byas mthar khong gis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi 'bod skul dang len zhu rkyang gnang ste rang gi dmag sgar 'os langs byas par brten nga tsho smar khams la shar bskyod thub ste dmag sgar de la rang re'i tang dang dmag dpung gi srid jus skor gyi slob gso brgyab pa ma zad bskyar sgrig kyang byas pa yin/bod ljongs bcings 'grol gang myur gtong ba dang bod du nga tsho'i rkang pa brtan tshugs yong bar byed na thog mar skad yig mi gcig pa'i dka' gnad sel gal che zhing / bod ljongs bcings 'grol dang / bod ljongs yun ring 'dzugs skrun/ mtha' mtshams khyim du brtsi ba/ rgyal srung sra brtan yong rgyur bsam gzhig byed skabs dmag dpung gis bod skad yig ma sbyangs na 'grigs thabs med pas ye kran cun gnyis pa'i si ling yon li'u po khreng dang chab srid u yon teng zha'o phing gi ‘‘bod du dmag skyod byed skabs bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong zab nan byed dgos mi’ pa'i bka' slob ji bzhin chab mdo blangs zin ma thag hri dang thon gyi 'go khrid tshos rang khongs nas las byed dang dmag mi 160hrag sgrug brgyab ste smar khams su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong ru khag ces pa btsugs nas gtso bo bod kyi skad yig sbyangus pa dang / blo mthun ye shes rgya mtsho nged gnyis kyis dge rgan gyi las 'gan 'khur thog 'dzin grwa ka 50

pa dang kha pa gnyis su bgos yod/ skabs der nga rang lo bcu bdun tsam yin pa dang rgya bod gnyis kyi skad yig la sbyangs pa mi che yang stabs legs pa zhig la blo mthun ye shes rgya mtsho de dag la sbyangs pa chen po 'dug bcings 'grol ma thob gong khong gis lha sa skyid stod slob grwa'i dge rgan gnang myong bar brten slob khrid gi nyams myong phun sum tshogs la dbus skad bde po rgyag thub kyi yod/ de'i thog ta dang dmag sgar gyi nang nas rgan bdag lags dang /ye shes chos grags/ blo bzang smon lam bcas gzhon skyes gsum dge rgan gyi las rogs su bkug pa red/ de yang slob khang zur du med par brten phyugs ra'i nang sa phag rkub stegs dang sgrog tser byas pa dang / tshad ldan gyi slob deb med nga/sa rgyun mkho'i skad dang ming tshig rnams btus nas snum par brgyab pa des kyang ldang gi med par brten spyi thog la slob deb kha shas ma gtogs med/ snag tsha ni mang tshogs kyi thab tshang nas du ral blangs te spyin chu dang bsres pa las byung ba dang mtshan mo gur gyi nang du nyal dgos kyi yod/bod yig 'bri klog thub phyir slob ma rnams phyi rol gtsang 'gram sogs la khrid nas sbyong du bcug pa dang za rgyu 'thung rgyu ni spags dang ja thang ma gtogs tshal rigs rkang gcig kyang med pa sogs dka' ngal de dang de rigs bod du 'byor ma thag pa'i rgya rigs blo mthun la bltos na bzod par dka' ba'i tshad du slebs pa red/ de ltar 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal shin tu che ba'i gnas tshul 'og chab srid kyi spro snang dang 'khur sems chen po'i sgo nas bod skad bod yig sbyangs brtson byas shing / smar khams su slob sbyong zla shas byas rjes bka' bkod ltar brag yab brgyud chab mdor dpung skyod byed skabs dgun grang ngar che sgang yin pa dang nyin zhag bdun gyi rjes su gzhi nas brag yab tu 'byor tsam byung / lam bar gangs chen gyis bkag nas me gtong sa med rkyen 51
