chu 'khol hub gang yang rag thabs med par phye rtsam gangs dang chu yis 'ded dgos byung ba dang / gangs shel med tsang rtsid pa'i mig ras kyis gangs 'phyid 'gog thabs byas kyang gang ltar mig la gangs 'phyid brgyab par brten khal ma'i mjug ma nas 'jus te 'gro dgos pa dang / gom gang spo nyes shor na 'dom pa brgya phrag gi g.yang la lhungs nyen yod khar/ rdog khres rgya ma bdun cu brgyad cu'i ljid gnon dang sa mtho'i mkha' rlung srab pa'i dbugs ngal che ba bcas ni de snga dmar dmag rgyang skyod thengs gnyis pa'i skabs kyi ngang tshul dang gnyis su med/ 'on kyang blo mthun tshos dmar dmag gi snying stobs bcangs nas dka' khri khyad sad byas pa dang gsar brje'i spro snang las byung ba'i sems shugs kyis mdun skyod byas pa red/ de lta bu'i dka' ngal gyi khrod du bod sbyong ru khag gi blo mthun tshos da dung nyin re bod yig tshig gsar 'ga' zhig blo 'dzin byed dgos kyi yod/ mi so so'i lto phad kyi nang du tshig gsar zur bkod kyi shog ldeb re 'khyer rgyu yod pa de stabs bde la go chod po yod/1951lo'i zla 2par nga tsho chab mdo'i shar ngos stag ma la gsham gyi re ya grong du 'byor ba dang / skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis zhi ba'i gros mol byed mkhan pe cin du btang zin/ nga tsho yang gong gi bka' ltar mdun skyod byed mtshams bzhag ste re ya grong du bsdad pa dang dmag sgar a ma stag ma la nas sde dge bar gyi gzhung lam bzos nas bsdad pa yin/ 'grim 'grul mi bde ba'i rkyen gyis zas rigs 'byor ma thub pa'i ring ri la sngo tshal 'thu bar phyin pa dang / stag ma lar ri sgog sogs 'dra min 'ga' zhig 'thu rgyu yod kyang rgya rigs blo mthun 'gas bod du'ang nang sa'i byed stangs ltar sngo rjen par bzas pas dug phog pa dang / sngo dug bcos byed kyi sman med par 52

brten ye tsi'i khu bas khog pa bshangs thabs byas pas phan thogs chen po byung yod/ ri de la 'phyi ba mang po yod pa dang 'phyi sha bcud che la zhim po'ang yod pas 'phyi ba'i tshang la du sub gtong ba dang chu brgyangs pa/ 'jor bus bsngogs pa sogs byas te dgun nyal gyi 'phyi ba bton te zas su mi byed ka med byung / mang tshogs kyi g.yul kha'i nang du bod yig nyin phyed sbyangs pa dang lam bzo nyin phyed byed pa'i ngang nas zla gnyis tsam song ba bcas 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal shin tu che rung mi tshang ma blo sems gcig sgril gyi sgo nas rang dmag gi dka' spyad 'bad 'thab kyi snying stobs dar spel byas pas tang dang mi dmangs kyis nga tshor dkris pa'i slob sbyong dang lam bzo gnyis ka 'thus shor mi 'gro ba dgos rgyu'i las 'gan de legs grub thub pa byung /1kha51lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 2 2nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i gtam bzang khyab yong ba bzhin dmag dmangs tshos de skor phan tshun gleng ba dang zhing 'brog mi dmangs la gros mthun gyi skor dril bsgrags byas pa dang /tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis bod mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod gnang ba'i rgyal kha gzi 'od can der tshang mas dga' 'bod dang bod mi dmangs mes rgyal khyim tshang chen por log par rten 'brel zhus pa red/ gros mthun gyi 'bru don ltar rang dmag gis bod ljongs bcings 'grol gtong ba dang rgyal mtshams brtan srung bya rgyu'i las 'gan dang du blangs te lha sar dpung skyod kyi rlabs che'i bya ba sgrub 'go tshugs pa red/ zla 7par stag ma la rgyud du gangs 'khyags bzhu nas dro grang ran pa dang / spangs la spangs rgyan me tog bkra ba dang ri gseb la skye dngos dang kha dog sna tshogs kyi stag ma me 53

tog rab tu bzhad pa bcas dri zhim dang bya byi'u yi gsung snyan sgrogs la phyugs dkar nag sha shed rgyas shing yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu bo 'bab pa'i yul klung skyid pa'i nam dus bzang po der nga tshos cun krang krang go hwa dang lhan du phebs pa'i bod kyi zhi gros sku tshab nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs pe cin nas lha sar log phebs par dga' bsu zhus pa yin/ dga' bsu zhu mkhan gras su nga tsho bod sbyong ru khag gi dge slob tsho dang / thon 157pa dang 154pa'i lam bzo'i dpa' bo sogs yod pa dang / gsar du bzos pa'i gzhung lam gyi gzhogs gnyis nas kha btags med kyang stag ma me tog sogs lag tu thogs nas bsu ba zhus pa yin/ lam bzo mgyogs po de 'dra byas pa dang dka' sdug dang shi rgyur mi skrag pa'i dmag dpung gi gsar brje'i snying stobs de rigs krang cun krang dang zhi gros kyi 'thus mi tshos gzigs rtogs byung skabs khong tsho thugs sems 'gul te dmag dpung la phyag g.yab g.yob kyis gus 'dud 'tshams 'dri zhu gnang mdzad song /gros mthun gyi dgongs don ltar nga tshos zla 7pa'i zla smad du chab srid u yon gzhon pa me'o phe yi'i sne khrid 'og chab mdo nas yi dwags la dang / chu seng la/ yig drug la drug wa kha la bcas brgyud lho rdzong du 'byor ba dang /tud krang blo mthun nye heng yi'u yis gsungs don du/ lho rdzong du gru gu dgon zhes pa zhig la bod dmag gi gtso shugs mi grangs 27rkya0lhag tsam bsdad yod pa dang / chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi skabs su nga tsho'i dmag dpung gis g.yas lam g.yon lam dang dkyil lam gsum nas shugs drag chen pos chab mdo 'gag btsir btang bas mdo spyi bzod glags bral te lha sa'i phyogs su phyir 'then byed rtsis byas kyang nga tsho'i hri 52pa'i chab srid u yon gzhon pa blo mthun dbyin h+pha thang gis khrid yong ba'i thon 154pa dang skye rgu mdo nas yong 54

ba'i mtsho sngon gyi rta dmag gis mtshan mo 'bri chu brgal te nyin mtshan ltos med shar yong ste glo bur thog rgyag ri bo che dang rngan mda' blangs zin par brten bod dmag phyir 'then byed lam med par gyur rkyen nga tsho'i dmag dpung gis brtson len blo 'gugs byas mthar bod dmag gis go lag yongs rdzogs rtsis 'bul zhus te mgo btags pa red/ nga tsho dang lo mang ring mnyam du las ka byed myong ba'i bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gi de snga'i kru'u zhi gzhon pa mtsho sgo don grub tshe ring gis de skor gleng skabs/ skabs der khong mdo spyi'i phogs dpon yin pa dang chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed byed 'go tshugs rjes 'bri chu'i rgyud kyi bod dmag rnams bcings 'grol dmag gis kha 'thor btang zin par brten nga tsho mdo spyi ngo las dang bod dmag rnams chab mdo nas lha sa'i phyogs su phyir 'then bya rgyu las bsdad ma song / 'on kyang blo yul las 'das pa zhig la nga tsho ma slebs gong bcings 'grol dmag gis ri bo che dang rngan mda' blangs zin te nga tsho 'gro sa med par gru gu dgon du bsdad pa yin/ gru gu dgon ni grwa pa bcu phrag 'ga' zhig las med pa'i dgon chung zhig red/ de rjes rta drel khyon che 'byor yong ba dang rta drel gyi rgyab cha mang che ba gser chas dngul chas dang / dar gos chen/ go lag sogs red/dgon chung des dmag mi dang rta zog sems can mang po de 'dra gso thabs med par brten bcings 'grol dmag la mgo btags ma zhus ka med red/de 'dra'i dus su nga'i sems la ma'o kru'u zhis ‘‘dmag dpung ma slebs gong du dmag rgyags 'byor zin pa bya dgos pa ’’dang / ‘‘'bru rigs ni nor bu'i nang gi nor bu red ’’ces gsungs pa de rbad de bden pa yin 'dug bsams byung /nga tsho lho rdzong du nyin gnyis sdod ring thon 154pas nga tshor 'tshams 55

'dri dang sbrags sgra med glog brnyan thengs gnyis bstan byung ba dang / de nas nga tsho dkyil lam nas lho lam du kha sgyur gyis ngo mdo dgon brgyud mtho tshad spyi khri bdun stong lhag tsam gyi khyung gtor la brgyab ste spo bo chu mdo rdzong la slobs byung /bod kyi shar lho'i rgyud du yod pa'i spo bo ni rgya gar rgya mtsho'i drod rlung gi stabs kyis gnam gshis dro grang snyoms pa dang / sa rgyu yag la thon khungs 'dzoms pa/ ri klung tshang ma nags tshal yin la kham star dang / ku shu/ se'u sogs shing 'bras sna kha 'dzoms pa bcas la brten sa cha der ‘‘bod kyi skyid yul mi’zhes zer/ de'i sa bab chags tshul nas bshad na/ spo chu lung drug tu grags pa chu mdo rdzong la lung pa gnyis dang / sum 'dzoms la lung pa gnyis/yid 'ong la lung pa gnyis bcas yod/ bcings 'grol ma btang gong bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis spo bo khul du rdzong khag gsum btsugs pa dang / pad ma bkod kyi mon tsho khag lnga dang lho grwa dkar nag spyan 'brug yul tsho bcas kyang spo khongs yin 'dug spo bo khul gyi mi ser tshos sa gnas srid gzhung dang mdo smad spyi khyab la sa bogs dang / she khral/ mi bogs/ dmag khral/ tshon rgyu sman rgyu dang pags rigs sogs kyi 'khri cha/ skyed la skyed rgyag gi bun 'khri/de min khral rigs dang 'khri cha gzhan mang po zhig sgrub 'jal byed dgos kyi yod pa bcas kyi thog mi ser gyi sdod khang zhig ral dang / sa zhing sa stong du lus pa/ nad yams khyab gdal/ mi shi khyim stong bcas sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i nang du gnas 'dug pa dang / mi 'bor gyi sum cha gcig yan yul lung gzhan du gyar nas bsdad 'dugaskabs der log spyod shog khas dkrog gtam ched bzos byas te rgya dmar gyis phru gu za ba dang / rgan rgon tsho ltogs shi 'khyags shi rgyag tu 'jug 56

pa/ mi dmangs kyis chos byas mi chog pa/ bod rigs rtsa med bzo ba red zer ba sogs kyi khungs med gtam 'chal mang po khyab 'dug nga tsho spo bor slebs ma thag gi skabs su mang tshogs kyis nga tsho'i tang dang dmag dpung gi gnas tshul ji yin gsal rtogs mi thub pa'i rkyen gyis nga tsho dang 'brel ba byed mi phod pa dang khang pa'i sgo mnan te phyugs zog ded nas ri khug tu g.yol 'gro ba na nga tshos lho nub dmag srid u lhan gyi ‘‘bod du srid jus la brten nas 'gro dgos pa dang / srid jus la brten nas 'tsho dgos pa/ yang dag pa'i srid jus la brten nas log spyod shog kha'i dkrog gtam gyi smag rum sel dgos/ lo rgyus kyi thog nas lhags bsdad pa'i mi rigs kyi 'gal cha dang lta phyogs ngan pa gtsang sel/ rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs dang rgyal gces mi sna rnams la btsan rgol rgyas gces kyi dar cha'i 'og tu mthun sgril bya dgos ’’zhes pa'i bka' slob ltar skabs der nga tsho'i las ka gtso bo ni dgon sde bla sprul dang bcas pa'i mtho rim mi snar 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las ka byed pa dang chabs cig mang tshogs la'ang sman rin mi dgos pa'i sman bcos dang /skyed med bun gtong / skyob gso nyen sel sogs kyi las ka de dag red/'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don dang mang tshogs la shugs rkyen bzang po thebs thabs kyi las don gting zab bsgrubs pas nga tsho'i tang dang dmag dpung gi mtshan snyan gong du 'phel ba dang / mthun sgril bya yul rgya che ru song ba ma zad/ mang tshogs rnams kyang ri khug nas rang khyim du log ste blo bde bag phebs ngang gnas pa red/nga tsho chu mdo sum rdzong la slebs skabs se ra mkhan po'i phyag mdzod byams pa ye shes nas chab mdo sa gnas bcings 'grol u lhan gyi spo bo'i yan lag lhan khang khongs gtogs don byed khru'u gnyis pa'i 'go dmag yongs la 57

sne len zhus pa dang sbrags chu mdo rdzong gi rdzong nag khang chen tshang ma dpung sde'i las khungs tshugs yul du sprad pa red/ byams pa ye shes lags ni dbus khul chu shur rdzong khongs zhing pa dbul po zhig gi khyim nas yin pa dang / chung ngu'i dus nas chos zhugs byas te se rar dpe cha slob gnyer byas pa dang /chab mdo bcings 'grol ma btang gong ser byes mkhan po'i phyag mdzod du bskos mngags byas 'dug nga tsho der slebs rjes spo bor don byed khru'u gnyis pa'i kru'u ren me'o phe yis khong la rtag tu bka' mol gnang ba dang ngang rgyud ring po'i sgo nas tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus dril bsgrags dang / gros mthun gyi nang don 'grel bshad gnang bas khong gi blo dogs bsal te gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag ni sngar gyi go min tang dang mi 'dra bar bod mi dmangs kyi bde don sgrub mkhan zhig yin pa ngos 'dzin thub pa red/khong mkhan po'i phyag mdzod byed ring zhing khul dang 'brog sder rtag par 'gro dgos la khong rang nyid kyang chung dus sdug dka' las myangs myong ba'i rkyen gyis mang tshogs rnams gzhung dang dgon sde'i khral rigs dang skyed lci'i bu lon gyi 'og nas mgo btegs mi thub pa'i gnas tshul gsal po shes kyi yod pa red/ der brten khong gis rang 'gul ngang mi ser gyi mi rabs mang po'i bu lon bca' yang dang rtsa chag tu btang bas spo khul mi ser gyis khong la dga' po byed pa dang khong gi snyan grags kyang chen po yod/ dgun dus gangs chen gyis ri lam bkag nas 'grim 'grul byed sa med par dmag dpung bkres mnar gyi nyen kha 'phrad nye'i skabs su khong rang nyid dang dgon pa'i bkar 'bru rnams dmag dpung la btsongs pa ma zad/ yul lung gi 'go pa rnams la'ang skul slong gis bcings 'grol dmag la 'bru rigs dang phyugs zog btsongs nas dmag dpung gi 'phral sel dza drag gi dgos mkho bskangs/ par 58

brten spo khul bcings 'grol dmag gi 'go dmag tshos bka' drin snying bcangs dang gul brtsi chen po zhus pa red/ rjes sor khong don byed khru'u gnyis pa'i kru'u ren gzhon pa dang chab mdo sa khul bcings 'grol u lhan gyi kru'u ren gzhon par bsko gzhag byas pa ma zad/ bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon la'ang bsko bzhag byas pa red/ nga tsho bod sbyong ru khag ni chu mdo rdzong dgon pa'i phyi rol du bsdad nas bod kyi skad yig sbyong bdar mu mthud byas shing / spo bo'i don byed khru'u gnyis pa'i 'go khrid blo mthun gyis bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong la thugs khur che bzhes kyis bod kyi skad yig sbyangs rgyu de bod ljongs bcings ke'agrol dang mtha' mtshams brtan srung bya rgyu'i don chen gyi gras su bcug pa ma zad/ kru'u ren me'o phe yi dang / two tsu dbyin/ sun te jon sogs dbu khrid ngo mas bod kyi skad yig sbyong spyod yag po gnang bas dpung sde'i nang du slob sbyong gi rba rlabs 'phyur ba red/de'ang 〈thun mong rtsa 'dzin 〉dang (gros mthun 〉dngos gzhi'i slob tshan du byas pa dang / bod sbyong ru khag gi blo mthun tshos (gros mthun 〉blo 'dzin thub pa'i sgo nas mang tshogs la dril bsgrags slob gso dang / mang tshogs la mthun sgril byas pa ma zad/ dgra bor rdung rdeg gtong ba'i mtshon cha lta bur rtsis pa red/ bar seng nam yod kyi dus su dgon sde'i btsun chung dang grong mi dang skad cha bshad nas bod skad bde ru 'gro thabs byas pa dang / sbyangs 'bras legs thon byung rigs gzi brjid du brtsi ba dang tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' la nyan pa'i rtags mtshan ngo ma zhig tu rtsis te 'dzin grwa so so dang mi so so'i dbar 'gran bsdur tshugs pa dang / slob sbyong legs gras la 'khor res su thob pa'i dar dmar zhig yod pa/ sbyangs 'bras phul byung gi tshad du son tshe byas rjes tho 'god kyi gzhi 'dzin sar rtsis pa dang sde tshogs kyi slob sbyong 59

dpe bzang du bdams kyi yo da/ gzhan yang bod skad sbyangs nas zla shas song zin pa'i slob ma de gras spo khul rdzong khag so so'i dmag don sku tshab las don —tshogs chung du btang ba dang grong mi'i khyim du sbyong bdar byed du bcug pa red/de ltar zla shas ring gi bka' sbyong byed dus thims mtshams gzhi nas bod spyong ru khag la log chog pa byas pa bcas la brten lo gcig gi nang bod yig 'bri klog thub pa dang rgyun spyod bod skad rgyag shes pa byung ba red/kha bas 'grul lam bkag rkyen nga tshos khyer yong ba'i za 'bru rnams da ni ha lam bzas zin pa red/ ‘‘bod du dpung bskyod skabs sa gnas kyi 'bru rigs blangs mi chog ’’pa'i ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' slob brtsi srung zhu dgos shing /spo khul 'grim 'grul shin tu mi bde ba'i thog lo phyed ka tsam gyi ring kha bas lam bu bkag pa dang sa cha 'ga' zhig la rta lam yang med par mis dbor 'dren byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ der brten 'bru rigs sogs gang ci'i thad gron chung ma byas ka med yin zhing skabs shig ring rta chag mi zas su mi byed ka med yin pa dang kru'u ren me'o phe yi'i sne khrid 'og chu mdo rdzong dang /sum rdzong / chos rdzong / rdo rje rdzong / mda' shing / shor ba khā/ yid 'ong /shul mo sogs kyi rgyud du sa sgong sa sbol byas pa yin/ de'ang dgun dus sa 'khyags bsdams nas sa sbol dka' bas thog mar me btang ste sa 'khyags bzhu thabs dang de rjes rim pas sa sbol byas pa mu'u brgya phrag 'ga' zhig yod pa bzhin lo rjes ma'i nang bsdu 'bab yag po byung ste 'bru rigs dang tshal rigs khag gcig thag gcod byung nas mang tshogs la bsun po bzo mi dgos pa byung ba red/ de bzhin spo yul nas gsang sngags chos rdzong dang rdza yul dbar la rta lam bzos te 'bru rigs dang de min dgos mkho gzhan dag spo bor drangs pa dang / dmag don sku tshab tī tsu dbyin dang don byed khru'i kru'u 60

ren gzhon pa byams pa ye shes kyi sne khrid 'og dmag dmangs chig sgril gyi sgo nas g.yu phug rong du lam bcos shugs che byas shing / de'ang ra 'u gtsang 'gram du sgar phab ste nyin mo sa rud dang chu log sogs la kha gtad bcas pa dang mtshan mo nags gseb tu me btang nas tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus dril bsgrags dang gsar brje'i glu gzhas sbyangs pa dang mi ser gyis bod kyi gzhas dang zhabs bro bslabs pa sogs dga' spro'i ngang gnas pa bcas de ltar zla shas ring dka' spyad 'bad 'thab byas mthar rta lam spyi le 500mthud bzo byed thub ste dgos mkho'i dngos zog spo yul du drangs 'go tshugs pa red/ lam bzo byed ring bod sbyong ru khag gi slob ma tsho'i bod skad kyang bde ru phyin pa dang mi ser gyis kyang rgya skad tha thor dang gsar brje'i glu gzhas gtong shes pa bcas rgya bod mi rigs kyi brtse sems zab tu phyin song /de ltar nga tsho bod sbyong ru khag gis dmag 'thab dang / dpung skyod/lam bzo bcas byed bzhin pa'i mur bod kyi skad yig sbyangs par brten de ni slob grwa yin la lam bzo'i ru khag dang / thon skyed ru khag dmag 'thab ru khag dril bsgrags ru khag bcas kyang yin/ tang dang mi dmangs kyi bka' yin phyin dka' ngal ji tsam che rung legs sgrub byed rkyang dang gsar brje'i zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi go cha bgos te dka' ngal grangs las 'das pa zhig las rnam par rgyal ba red/bod spyong ru khag gi thog ma'i dus kyi tud krang ni blo mthun nye heng yi'u yin pa dang / spo yul du 'byor rjes dmag sde bco brgyad pa'i dmag 'thab dpa' bo blo mthun ting yung tha'e yis tud krang dang te khreng cun gyis tud krang gzhon pa byas pa red༈ de ni tang gi 'go khrid 'og bod du btsugs pa'i slob grwa dang po dang rang ljongs slob gso'i 'thab phyogs kyi gdong skyod lam 61

bshangs byed mkhan zhig yin pas der don snying gting zab ldan yod/da phan lo ngo bzhi bcu lhag tsam ring bod sbyong ru khag khongs kyi blo mthun de dag gis bod kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun/ mes rgyal gyi gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong dang mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon/ mi rigs kyi phul byung rig gnas dar spel/ mthun phyug shes gsum ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun bcas byed phyir byas rjes gzengs su thon pa bzhag pa rnams lo rgyus kyi deb ther nang 'khod nges yin/ dper na khong tsho'i khrod nas blo mthun li khra'o cun bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi khongs su gtogs pa gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi zhib 'jug pa mkhas can zhig yin pa dang / blo mthun ci wen kreng ni bod dang / lho pa/ mon pa rigs bcas kyi gshis srol rig lam mkhas can du gyur pa/ blo mthun hu cin an ni bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mkhas can dang mi rigs rig gnas kyi phul byung las byed cig yin pa/ blo mthun li ci zha'o ni bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags bdag gnyer khang gi lo rgyus yig tshags kyi lo tsā ba chen mo yin pa bcas khong rnam pa dang 'dra ba'i gsar brje pa rgan gras kyis dka' ba dpag med spyad de 'dzam gling gi yang rtser gsar brje'i sa bon btab pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba smin yod/ da cha khong rnam pa snga rjes su rgan yol zhus zin rung zhen chags kyi las 'brel lta bus rang gi dga' sa gces sa ni 'di yi phyogs su yin pas khong rnam pa'i gras kyi mang po zhig gis dus da lta'ang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi slad du rang gi nus pa 'don mus yin/‘‘bod 'byor rgan rabs pa ’’de dag gis dka' ba brgya phrag spyad pa dang sger sems spangs te sngar med bya gzhag gi sgo 'phar phye ba dang / bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun yun ring byed pa/ mtha' mtshams khyim du brtsi ba/ dka' sdug 62

dang shi rgyur mi skrag pa'i gsar brje'i snying stobs kyis rgyal kha gcig rjes gnyis mthud du blangs pa dang / blo mthun de tshos rgan yol zhus rjes 'jig rten gyi 'dod yon longs spyod la mgo ma 'khor bar da dung 〈sems pa bod la 'khor nas/ 'bad 'thab lhod med byas pa/〉 〈tshe mjug si/ nus pa bton nas byas rjes gsar du bzhag pa/〉 〈mi rigs brtse sems cizab pas las la brtson pa ma dor 〉ba bcas byed thub pa'i sems nus de 'dra gang nas byung ngam zhe na/ de ni spyi khyab hru'u ci cang tse rmin bod du gzigs zhib tu phebs skabs khong gis ‘‘lhag par du dka' sdug myangs thub pa dang / lhag par du bzod bsran byed thub pa/ lhag par du dmag 'thab byed thub pa/ lhag par du legs skyes phul thub pa'i bod 'byor rgan rabs pa'i snying stobs ’’zhes phyogs bsdoms gnang ba de yin/ de lta bu'i gsar brje'i snying stobs la brten nas bod kyi spyi tshogs 'gyur ldog gtong ba dang / dpal 'byor gong 'phel gtong ba/ bsam pa'i dpal yon spel ba bcas kyi thad la legs skyes chen po phul ba red/ deng sang nga tshos krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i skabs su nga tshos nges par du ‘‘bod 'byor rgan rabs pa'i snying stobs ’’rgyun 'dzin dar spel gtong dgos/snying stobs 'di ni nga tsho'i tang dang dmag dpung gi phul byung srol bzang rnams gcig tu bsdus pa'i snying po lta bu yin pas mi rabs nas mi rabs su rgyun ma chad pa spel dgos pa dang / de la brten nas mes rgyal gyi gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong dang / mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon/ kha phral la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod mtha' 'khyol byed pa dang / rang ljongs kyi 'dzugs skrun bya gzhaka khag gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed dgos pa lags so/63

gangs ljongs lo rgyus yig tshags mkhas dbang blo mthun ye shes chul khrims la dran gso byed pa/yesub/dang po/ rmi lam nas sad pa/blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims ni bod byang phyogs rtswa thang steng gi 'brog 'bring khyim tshang zhig tu 'khrungs/ 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen cung legs tsam yod pas chung byis pa'i dus nas pha ma gnyis kyis sa thag 'gyangs tsam du gnas pa'i rwa sgreng dgon gyi sger btsugs slob grwar slob sbyong byed par btang / 'dir khong gis bod du skad grags ldan pa'i nang bstan chos lugs kyi gdan sa rwa sgrong dgon du slob gnyer la zhugs pa'i skor nas 'bri rgyu yin /de'ang khong dang thog rwa sgreng dgon du phebs dus chod sems 'di 'dra zhig bcangs yod de/ ‘‘ngas nges par du slob sbyong la 'bras bu gzengs su thon pa zhig byed rgyu yin mi’zhes rang gis rang la dam bcas/ der brten khong bis slob sbyong gi dus tshod skar cha gcig kyang chud zos su gtong gi med/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa ma gshegs gong rwa sgreng dgon du rten mjal la phebs te lha sar phyir phebs gnang khar rwa sgreng sprul sku dang lhan cig 64

tu sku 'cham la phebs skabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas rgya shug cig bdams gnang ste gang nyid mya ngan las 'das rjes gdung rten bzhengs rgyu'i rgyu cha yin zhes gsungs pa dang / shing sdong de'i ldebs su rtags shig bskyon pa gnang yod/ grwa rgan tshos gsungs par gzhigs na/ de ni rwa sgreng sprul sku bod kyi rgyal tshab gnang rgyu'i snga ltas la brtsi bar grags/ sngar byung gnas tshul de 'dra zhig gis skul ma thebs nas da lta dus tshod byung ba dang blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims kyis rgya shug gling du dpe deb klog pa dang spro 'cham du 'gro bzhin mchis/ slob sbyong la dka' spyad 'bad brtson byed pa'i dus tshod chud zos mi gtong bar 1kha25lor slob mjug sgril ba'i dus 'dir khong la rgyun du gang ci'i thugs 'khur gnang mkhan rwa sgreng sku thog drug pas khong zhal slob tu nyar ba gnang / de rjes mchod dpon dang drung yig gcig lcogs bsko bzhag gnang / de nas bzung khong rwa sgreng sprul skus dga' snang gces skyong gnang yul gyi sku bcar mi sna zhig tu gyur/1922lo'i zla 10tshes 21nyin dgung lo 15la phebs pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku gshegs pa'i gtam ngan thos pas na/ ye shes tshul khrims khong gi bsam par de sngon rwa sgrong dgon gyi grwa rgan rnams kyis zer don ltar/ gal srid rwa sgreng sprul sku dngos su bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rgyal tshab la 'dems thon byung na mjug 'bras ni rang dgon gyi sprul sku sku phreng gsum pa dang 'dra ba zhig mi yong ngam snyam/ rwa sgreng sprul sku sku phreng gsum pa ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgya mtsho rgyal tshab gnang ba'i dus su tshod dpag dka' ba'i mi ngan khag gcig gis ma nyes kha g.yogs byas mthar mes rgyal nang khul du nyen g.yol bros byol gnang dgos byung ba red/tā la'i bla ma sku gshegs pa nas yang srid sku na ma son pa 'i bar bod sa 65

gnas srid gzhung gi chab srid dang chos lugs sogs kyi las don nges par du ho thog thu'i go ming thob pa'i bla chen sprul sku zhig gis rgyal tshab 'gan 'khur gnang dgos/ lugs 'di ni ching rgyal rabs skabs gong ma chan lung gis srol gtod cing gtan la phab pa zhig yin/ rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku gshegs rjes bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rgyal gces chos gces kyi mi sna rwa sgreng sprul skur rgyal tshab gnang dgos pa'i re ba drag po bton par brten bod ri sa gnas srid gzhung gis rwa sgreng sprul sku'i mtshan rgyal tshab la gdam bya'i 'os mi'i mtshan gzhung nang du bkod/ rwa sgrong dgon grwa dmangs nas gnas tshul de thos 'phral phyag mdzod 'jam dbyangs dge legs dang / mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims rnam gnyis kyis sgrig 'dzugs byas nas rwa sgreng sprul sku rgya' tshab tu bdams thon mi yong ba'i chos 'don smon lam 'tshogs shing chos sgra yang phyogs bzhir khyab/ de rjes dza sag dang mchod dpon gnyis kyis rwa sgreng sprul sku mjal 'phrad zhus te lhag bsam zol med ngang ‘‘nga tshos rin po che khyed rang rgyal tshab tu gdam bya'i 'os mi'i mtshan khongs su yod pa thos pas nga tshor dngangs tshab chen po skyes byung / sngar rang dgon gyi sprul skus rgyal tshab 'gan bzhes gnang ba la bar chad shugs chen byung gshis/ da res dgon pa'i 'dus tshogs yongs kyis gang nyid rgyal tshab tu bdams thon mi yong ba'i smon lam chos 'don 'tshogs pa yin la/ rin po che khyed rang gis kyang bdams thon mi yong ba'i thugs smon gnang rogs gnang ’rizhes zhus/ 'on kyang rwa sgreng dgon gyi grwa dmangs rnams yid pham dgos pa zhig la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gtso dpon dang de bzhin gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po sogs kyis po ta la'i pho brang du nang bzhugs 'phags pa lo ke shā ra'i spyan sngar gzan rtags zhus nas rwa sgreng ho thog thu thub bstan 'jam 66

dpal ye shes kyi mtshan thon pa red/1924lo'i zla 1tshes 21nyin bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rwa sgreng sprul sku rgyal tshab tu rgya che gzab rgyas kyi khri 'don mnga' gsol zhu ba'i mdzad sgo 'tshogs pa dang / go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung nas rwa sgrong sprul sku rgyal tshab kyi 'gan bzhes rgyur chog mchan thob pa'i tar lan yang sgrog sbyang gnang / de nyin gna' bo'i grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhir bsangs kyi du bas khengs shing brjid nyams dang ldan pa'i dmar po ri'i pho brang gi nang nas chos kyi sgra chen 'don/ skye bo rnams glu gar la rol te grong khyer lha sa dga' skyid dpal gyi rnam pas 'jebs par byas/ yin na'ang skabs der bod kyi mtho rim dbang sgyur gral rim nang gi btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dga' nyen du brten mkhan ngo tsha khrel med kyi mi ngan khag gcig gi gdug tsub kyi rang bzhin rim bzhin mngon yong ste kho pa tsho dang bden pa'i phyogs langs kyi rgyal gces mi sna'i dbar gyi 'thab rtsod 'di lkog gyur nas mi rnams kyi mig lam du mngon sum 'char ba'i spyi tshogs thog gi gnad don gtso bo zhig tu gyur/rwa sgreng sprul skus bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rgyal tshab kyi 'gan bzhes rjes rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang dang rgya che'i bod mi dmangs kyi mi tshe'i mdun lam srung 'dzin ched du nus shugs gang yod kyis bod sa gnas dang krung dbyang srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel bar shugs snon rgyag pa dang chabs cig dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rjes 'brangs par ngo rgol dang rdung rdeg btang ste mi dmangs rnams gnas bzos bde po yong ba byas/ 'on kyang ngo tsha khrel med kyi mi ngan de tsho'i 'gog rkyen 'og rwa sgreng sprul sku rgyal tshab lo ngo kha ༅/sa las gnang long ma byung bar mthar srid don gyi bya gzhag las zhal mi bral thabs med byung / ma 'ongs bod kyi mdun lam btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rkub 67

g.yog rgyug khyi de tshos brlag par byed pa'i dus ngan mi yong ched khong gis bsam pa rnam dag gis rang nyid kyi yongs 'dzin stag brag sprul sku rgyal tshab kyi khrir bzhugs su gsol/ de'i dus su lha sa'i khrom gzhung srang lam du yang dmangs gzhas gsar pa zhig gtong gi yod pa ste ‘‘rwa pho dang dod langs nas/stag la og zhol g.yogs song / stag pho ngo tsha med pas/ rwa pho hob ste zas song ’’zhes so/ gzhas des don rkyen gyi 'phel rim gnad du 'khel ba'i lung bstan 'dug stag brag sprul skus rgyal tshab kyi 'gan bzhes rjes dbyin ji'i gsang myul li ga shun dang ngan pa lag 'brel byas nas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi bkol spyod bya yul gyi lag cha zhig tu gyur/ khong gis sngon la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs nang du sngar med gsar byung gi ‘‘phyi rgyal las khungs ’zhes pa'i las khungs gsar 'dzugs byas te btsan rgyal ring lugs dang 'brel ba dam zab tu btang / de rjes 'thus mi mngags te ‘‘ya gling tshogs 'dur ri’bzhugs nas ‘‘bod rang btsan mi’zhes pa'i 'dod tshul bton pa dang rgyal dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen la zhugs rgyu dang len ma byas/go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung nas bdams thon byung ba'i rgyal dmangs 'thus mi rwa sgreng sprul sku tshogs 'du la zhugs rgyur yang bkag 'gog byas/khong gi byed stangs de tshor krung dbyang srid gzhung gis ngo rgol dang bod mi dmangs rnams yid mi rang par gyur/ ser skya mang tshogs tshos rwa sgreng sprul sku rgyal tshab tu slar bsko gnang rgyu'i re ba nan po bton skabs stag brag dang dbyin jir mgo btags mkhan tshos rwa sgrong sprul sku khong tsho'i bsam ngan sgrub pa'i bkag rdor brtsis nas 1947lo'i ston ka'i dus su pho brang po ta la'i gnas skabs kyi btson khang nang du gdug tsub chen pos bla na med pa'i rgyal gces bla sprul 'di bkrongs/ 'di ni gangs ljongs mi rnams rnying rlung dang 68

sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i don rkyen chen po zhig tu gyur/ rgyal gces mi sna rwa sgreng sprul sku bkrongs na'ang rwa sgreng rin po che'i rgyal gces kyi dgongs bzhed de rgya che'i bod mi dmangs kyi sems nang rdo la ri mo brkos pa ltar nam yang bsub thabs med par gnas yod/gnyis pa/ bde skyid kyi 'cho ba thob pa/rwa sgreng sprul sku ma bkrongs gong gsang ba'i ngang mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims mes rgyal nang khul du gtong gnang mdzad de skabs de'i go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la bod kyi gnas tshul thag gcod bya rgyu'i re ba zhus/yin na'ang rgyal tshab stag brag dang ngan grogs tshos ye shes tshul khrims gsang bros byas pa shes te khong gis nan cing du kho pa tsho rang nyid kyi bya ngan ther 'don byas yong bsams nas bod kyi sa gnas khag gi mi sus ye shes tshul khrims 'dzin bzung thub na de la bya dga' sprod rgyu'i 'ju bzung bka' rgya yang bkram pa dang chabs cig mes rgyal nang khul du 'gro 'ong byed sa'i sa mtshams su srung 'gag btsugs/ de bzhin nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi don gcod khangagi dpon rigs nas khong nan cing grong khyer du yong ba la bkag 'gog byed dgos rgyu'i tar btang / de lta bu'i bar chad bzos kyang rwa sgreng sprul skur mtshan gnod kyi bya ba sel ba dang / bod mi dmangs sdug bsngal gyi gnas las grol bar bya ba'i ched du ye shes tshul khrims kyis snga sa nas rang nyid kyi 'chi gson la mi 'dzems par bza' 'thung rlung khrod du byas nas mtshan mor le dbar stong tsam gyi lam bgrod kyis mthar 'tshe med bde ba'i ngang bod kyi sa mtshams sgrol te mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sa khongs su slebs/khong stag brag tshogs pa'i 'dre lag las grol ba dang / rang nyid kyi pha yul 69

nas zhal bral yang nyen kha las grol ba'i dga' tshor med la gzhan yul du 'khyams pa'i skyo snang chen po yang med par sems nang du stag brag la 'khon 'dzin dang khong khro 'ba' zhig 'chang bzhin mchis/ mun nag gi dus de 'dra zhig gi nang gzhan yul du 'khyams po'i 'tsho ba skyel dgos byung ba ye shes tshul khrims gcig pu ga la yin/1kha47lo'i zla 4par ye shes tshul khrims mtsho sngon skye rgu mdo nas dkar mdzes bskor te dar rtse mdo la 'gro skabs rwa sgreng sprul skur bar chad byung ba shes/ sngar khong gis rang nyid dang bod mi dmangs la bla na med pa'i bka' drin gyis skyong ba yid la dran nas mig chu rang dbang med par shor/khong gis stag brag tshogs pa'i mes rgyal la rgyab gtod kyi bya ngan ther 'don bya rgyur sngar bas sems thag bcad de lam sang go min tang shi'i khams zhing chen la snyan zhu phul nas nan cing du phebs te rgyab skyor zhu rgyu'i re ba bton/ 'on kyang shi'i khams zhing chen nas ‘‘krung dbyang gi lag khyer med na 'gro mi chog ’’ces pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad nas bkag 'gog byas/ de rjes snyan zhu thengs mang phul yang rgya mtshor rdo dbyugs pa ltar du gyur/ thabs shes ci yang med par brten shi'i khams zhing chen du phyin te li'u wun hu'i thug 'phrad gnang nas ‘‘rwa sgreng sprul sku ni rgyal gces ring lugs pa zhig yin/ stabs ma legs par dbyin ji dga' nyer brten mkhan tsho gas khag gis rwa sgrong dgon la sgo thel brgyab ste sprul sku dang rgyal gces mi sna 'ga' zhig lkog tu bkrongs/ krung dbyang srid gzhung nas bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral thabs med pa'i cha shas shig yin pa'i langs phyogs mtha' 'khyongs gnang dgos pa'i re ba zhu ched li'u kru'u zhi khyed rang gis nga tsho ngo ma nan cing du krung dbyang la snyan seng dang rgyab skyor gnang rogs zhu bar 'gro rgyur bkag 'gog med 70

pa'i chog mchan gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin ’’zhes gsungs mur mig chu rang dbang med par thon/ de nas shi'i khams zhing chen du zla ba kha shas bzhugs ring rwa sgreng mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims kyis zhing chen srid gzhung la snyan zhu thengs mang phul nas nan cing du stag brag tshogs si zhu gtugs byed par 'gro rgyu dang / shi'i khams zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi li'u wun hu'i thengs gsum mjal chog pa zhus nas bkag 'gog med pa'i re bton kyang khong gi re ba dang 'bad brtson chen po de la mos mthun dang rogs ram thob rgyu lta ci/ thabs shes yod rgus bkag 'gog byas/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni li'u wun hu'i yis snga sa nas bkag shag srid gzhung gis shi'i khams zhing chen du btang ba'i gsang myul gyi lag nas mjal rten blangs yod pas red/ li'u wun hu'i yis ye shes tshul khrims la mgo bskor btang ste ja dang ma dngul mkho 'don gyis tshong rgyag tu bcug nas nan cing la 'gro rgyu'i bsam pa med pa bzo rgyu de yin/ 'on kyang gser dngul dang khe dbang gis ye shes tshul khrims kyi sems la g.yo 'gul spu tsam yang thebs med/ shi'i khams zhing chen rgyab bcol du mi rung bar brten ye shes tshul khrims kyis bros rgyu'i thabs shes shig rnyed/ khong gis sngon la zhabs bcar dbang chen rnam rgyal mtsho sngon zhing chen du btang / de rjes rang nyid skye mdor gnas skabs gdan zhu'i tar yig cig btang 'byor yong ba'i bya thabs bton/ thabs shes de mngon du 'gyur bas khongagis mtsho sngon nas btang ba'i tar yig de 'khyer nas li'u wun hu'i yā an du don gcod byed par song ba'i dus de dang bstun te las tshab kru'u zhi krang tā btsal/ krang gis tar yig bltas rjes ye shes tshul khrims mtsho sngon du phebs rgyur mos mthun byas/ 1kha4〈lo'i lo 'gor khong shi'i nying la mā h+phu h+phang thug par phebs thog gnas tshul tshang ma zhus nas rgyab skyor gnang rgyu'i re 71

ba bton/ de nas yun mi ring bar bod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang kon ci yus mtsho sngon du paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i khri bzhugs mdzad sgo gtso skyong gnang ba dang bstun nas kon ci yus la rwa sgreng sprul sku bkrongs lugs dang stag brag tshogs pa'inag nyes mtha' dag zhus/ stag brag tshogs pas ye shes tshul khrims mtsho sngon du slebs pa shes nas nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi don gcod khang gis mtsho sngon du 'brel gtugs byed mi mngags te ngo log bros byol du song ba'i rwa sgreng dgon gyi mi bdag sprod rtsis len dgos pa'i 'gan dkri yang mā h+phu h+phang ni rnam 'gyur drag po dang ldan pas bsam ngan de bsgrub thub med/ khong tsho bya thabs bral te don gcod khang gi dpon mkhan po dang / drung rtse zung nas ‘‘nga tsho ni khyed rang gi don du ched mngags zi ling du yong ba yin/ nga tsho tshang ma chos lugs gcig 'dzin gyi dge lugs pa yin zhing / da cha khyed rang yul byol du phyin te rjes su sdug bsngal de las lhag pa 'phrad nges la bkag shag srid gzhung bis gu yang gtong srid/ gal srid khyed rang bod nang du log 'dod na nga tshos bkag shag la ngo chen snyan sgron zhus chog ’’ces bslu brid byas kyang ye shes tshul khrims kyis de ni ngan g.yo yin pa shes nas ‘‘sku ngo rnams thugs rje che/ dgongs pa 'khrol ba gnang rogs ’’zhes gsungs par brten nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi don gcod khang gi mkhan chung sogs don ci yang ma 'grub par phyir log byed dgos byung /ye shes tshul khrims kyis mes rgyal nang khul du phebs nas rwa sgreng don rkyen thag gcod bya rgyu'i skor go min tang srid gzhung la re ba bcol yang ngan hrul du gyur pa'i go min tang srid gzhung gis gnad don 'di snang med ling skyur byas/ nan cing du bskyod nas stag brag tshogs pa'i nag nyes zhu gtugs bya rgyu de mi lam ltar gyur/ 1949lolī zla 7par krung go mi dmangs bcings 72

'grol dmag gis mtsho sngon bcings 'grol btang rjes gzhi nas nyin mtshan kun tu re sgug gi 'dun pa de mngon 'gyur byas/ khong gis bcings 'grol dmag gi 'go khrid par rwa sgreng don rkyen dang mes rgyal nang khul nas rgyab skyor gnang rogs zhu bar yong ba'i brgyud rim cha tshang gsungs shing / mgyogs nas myur du sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba'i bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i re 'dun zhus pa dang / khong rang nyid krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag nang zhugs te mtsho sngon kun khyab rlung 'phrin khang du ‘‘thun mong rtsa 'dzin ’le tshan gyi bod skad 'phrin gtong pa'i gzi brjid kyi las 'gan de bzhes pa dang / stag 'tsher sprul sku dang reb gong dge 'dun rgya mtshos gtso skyong gnang ba'i krung dbyang la bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i re zhu tshogs pa'i nang la'ang rang 'gul gyis zhugs/ de bzhin khong gis gsang ba'i ngang lha sa dang 'brel ba gnang ste bod bskyod dpung sder lam sne 'dren rgyu'i sa bkra thig len sogs rogs skyor gyi bya ba mdzad/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong skabs khong krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dmag sde bco brgyad pa'i mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag dang mnyam du bod la bskyod/ 1954lor bod dmag khul khang nas khong la hra'o zha'o yi go ming gnang /gsum pa/ yig tshags bya gzhag la bcangs pa'i dung sems/de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung nang du yod pa'i mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas shig gis kha dan tshig la ma gnas par 195rdzolo'i zla 2tshes 10nyin drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug skul slong byas nas po ta la dang nor bu 73

gling kha'i nang nas rang re'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi bca' sdod du me mda' brgyab ste nyes pa sa steng mi shong ba bsags/ grong khyer lha sa der slar yang mi dmangs gnas bzos mi bde ba'i zing cha langs/ rgya che'i bod mi dmangs kyis sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung nang gi log spyod bya ba rtsom mkhan de tshor sems gting nas sdang ba chen po skyes/rang re'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo dang tang krung dbyang gi bka' ltar mgyogs myur ngang kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas shig gis bslangs pa'i drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su btang nas kho pa tsho'i ‘‘rang btsan ’’zhes pa'i bsam ngan de yang thal rdul bzhin du gyur/ zhing bran bdag pos dbang sgyur bya yul 'ing bran dang bran g.yog tsho dus de nas dngos su rang nyid dang rgyal khab kyi bdag por gyur/ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su btang rjes blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims gnas skabs ring bod dmag khul khang nas las gnas spos shing / de dus sa gnas thog rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i yig tshags phyag las gnang mkhan rgya bod blo mthun tsho dang mnyam du sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang dgon sde khag sku drag bcas kyi lo rgyus yig cha bsdu rub dang myur skyob kyi bya gzhag brtsams/ de nas bzung khong dang yig tshags dbar la bral thabs med pa'i thog nas bod kyi lo rgyus yig tshags phyag las gnang mkhan rgan rabs tsho dang mnyam du dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis gangs ljongs yig tshags kyi phyag las gnang / skabs der bod du spyi le bcu phrag tsam gyi gzhung lam zhig kyang med/'grim 'grul lag cha ni de bas nyung zhing las ka'i cha rkyen ha cang zhan po yod na'ang yig tshags phyag las gnang mkhan tshos dka' ngal la ma 'dzem par 74

sems nus yod rgu bton nas pho brang dang dgon pa/ thag ring gi gzhis ka/grong khyer gyi dpon tshang sogs nas kha thor song ba'i lo rgyus yig cha sna tshogs re re bzhin bsdu rub dang / rigs dbye nas legs sgrig byas ste sde khag 120lhag tsam dang khri 200lhag tsam gyi yig cha nyar tshags thub pa byung yod/1rdzo59lo nas 1962lo'i nang bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags khang gra sgrig khru'u dbu brnyes/ blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims kyis rgyun du dmag chas rnying pa de gyon nas yig tshags bsdu rub dang legs sgrig gi bya gzhag la dka' spyad 'bad brtson chen po gnang / de rjes blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims kyi thugs 'dod ltar bod dmag khul khang gis khong las gnas spos te mu mthud nas bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags khang gra sgrig khru'u gzhung don khang gi gtso 'gan bzhes te phyag las gnang rgyu'i chog mchan sprad/ khong la bod kyi lo rgyus yig tshags phyag las skor rgyus mnga' zab mo yod la bod rig pa dang brda rnying la'ang mkhyen rgya yangs par brten yun ring ma song bar ljongs phyi nang gi mi sna tshang mas gong bkur zhu yul gangs ljongs kyi bod yig yig tshags ched rams pa zhig tu gyur/ khong gis snga rjes su bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags khang gi dbu 'dzin gzhon pa dang / bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags cus kyi cus krang gzhon pa/ blo 'dri bya yul sogs kyi las gnas bzhes gnang /1kha66lor ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i ’’mun nag de gangs ljongs kyi dgung sngon steng du sgrib 'go tshugs/ gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi rdung rdeg drag po phog nas bya thabs ci yang med par/ ye shes tshul khrims gang nyid nas dung sems zab mo 'chang ba'i bya gzhag de nas zhal bral dgos byung ba ma zad/ chab srid dang 'tsho ba'i thog btang snyoms med pa'i thob thang yang myong dgos byung / ‘‘g.yon ’’gyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen gting zab thebs pa'i 75

grong lhan las byed pas skyon brjod 'thab rtsod tshogs 'du'i thog khong ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran ring lugs dang / go min tang gi gsang myul yin pa/ g.yo sgyu byas nas gung khran tang gi las byed pa byed kyi yod pa bcas kyi skyon 'dzugs dang 'brel ‘‘chos 'don mi shes pa'i mchod dpon dang / me mda' rgyag mi shes pa'i dmag dpon ’’red ces 'phya dmod kyang byas/ lo bcu'i ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i nang ’’khong la btang snyoms med pa'i thob thang sna tshogs rag yod kyang khong gis gung khran tang la yid ches brtan po gnang gi yod pa dang / sems gting du bcangs pa'i gung khran ring lugs kyi bsam pa der 'gyur ba spu tsam yang byung med/ ‘‘nyi ma sprin pa'i 'og nas dwangs ba'i dus shig yong mi’ zhes pa ltar/ 1976lo'i zla 10tshes 14nyin ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag ’thal rdul tsam yang med par bzos/ de'i phyi lor blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims slar yang brtse ba dang ldan pa'i yig tshags bya gzhag nang zhugs thub pa byung yod/blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims la gzhung gi las don slar gso byung nas dus yun mi ring bar sems shugs dang ldan pa'i ngang bkag shag sde khag sogs yig tshags khang nas nyar tshags gnang ba'i yig tshags sde khag bcu tsam legs sgrig dang dkar chag su sgrig gnang ba dang / 'byung gzhir rtog zhib byed pa'i phyag las nang du'ang zhugs/ de bzhin gna' bo'i yig tshags 'bor chen gsal 'byed kyi dpyad zhib dang gal che'i lo rgyus yig tshags phyogs sgrig gi phyag las gnang nas gdung 'degs ka ba ltar gyi nus pa thon yod/ blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims ni mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la srung brtsi dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag mkhan phul du byung ba'i rgyal gces yar thon gyi mig dpe bzang po zhig yin/76

1rdzo〈7lo nas lha sar mi ngan gyis mes rgyal kha bral gtong rtsis kyi chab srid kyi zing cha chen po bslangs rjes/ khong gis gzhon nu rjes rabs pa rnams la slob gso bya rgyu de gal chen du bzung nas rtag tu yig tshags dpang rtags su byas te bod 'di sngar yon rgyal rabs dus nas bzung mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su gyur te krung hwa mi rigs khyim tshang chen po'i ya gyal zhig yin pa'i lo rgyus shes bya slob 'khrid gnang gi yod pa dang / rang nyid ngo mas brgyud pa'i myong tshor la brten nas las la brtson zhing shes rab dang ldan pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis 'dzugs skrun byas pa'i gna' bo'i grong khyer lha sa 'di 'das pa'i lo zla'i nang du bkas bkod zhing bran bdag po'i rdzig rngam dang / rgya che'i zhing bran rnams kyi khrag rngul gyis khengs nas yod pa sogs kyi lo rgyus gsungs te phyi rabs pa tshos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs la sdang sems drag po skye bar byed pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mes rgyal la dga' zhen zab mo byed pa/ kha phral dang kha bral la ngo rgol byed pa'i chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod nang langs phyogs brtan po yong bar byed pa'i slob gso gnang ba ma zad/ khong nyid mi rigs kyi tang yon las byed pa dang /skabs rim byung gi mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi 'thus mi/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi rgyal gces mi sna bcas yin pa'i thob thang gi thog nas yig tshags rgyu cha 'bor chen gzhi 'dzin sa byas te tshogs 'du khag gi thog tu bod dang mes rgyal ni chu dang nya mo ltar kha bral thabs med pa'i don dngos kyi lo rgyus zhib par gsungs shing / kha bral ring lugs pa tshor zhe nas sdang ba'i 'dul gtam drag po bsgrags/ de bzhin khong gis dus rgyun du dka' spyad 'bad brtson gnang bar brten nas thob pa'i g.yur za'i grub 'bras la 19ṭ+wāṃrdolo'i zla 5par rang skyong ljongs tang ud dang mi dmangs srid gzhung 77

gis khong la ‘‘ljongs yongs kyi mi rigs mthun sgril sngon thon pa'i ’gzi brjid kyi mtshan snyan gnang /dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i blo mthun ye shes tshul khrims bskun gzhi phog nas 1994lo'i zla 6tshes 6nyin sku gshegs so/(nyi ma tshe ring gis bsgyur/)
bsamagling tshe ring pal

phebs/ da lta grong khyer lha sa srid gros kyi u yon yin/nga rang rang lo 16las ma son skabs khu bo bkra shis don grub (bka' drung dang / mda' dpon/ tha'i ji/ mdo spyi bcas gnang myong yod ) kyis nga rang la mos mthun med bzhin par u tshugs ngang gnang byung ba'i khyim du mna' mar sbyin/ lo gsum song rjes bza' zla 'das grongs su gyur/ nga lo 2 0son skabs bsam gling phun tshogs rdo rje dang rang mos gnyen sgrig byas/khong gis de snga byang glang ru rdzong dpon dang / bka' mgron/ sbrag spyi bcas gnang myong ba dang / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang rjes 1952lo'i zla 1por grong khyer lha sa'i rgyal gces gzhon nu mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs nang zhugs/ 1rdzo56lor bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes rjes gra ud rig slob khru'u rig slob kho'o yi kho'o krang gzhon pa gnang /1rdzo5rdolor khrag nyams pa'i gnad gzhi'i rkyen gyis 'das grongs su gyur zhing nga'i 'tsho ba'i nang gi gtan grogs bzang po dang nga gsar brje'i 'gro lam thog bskyod rgyur rgyab skyor byed mkhan las rogs bzang po de nyid med par gyur stabs skabs shig ring skyo snang ha cang chen po byung /krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes bod ljongs phud rgyal yongs kyi skam sa chen por bcings 'grol thob cing / 1950lo'i zla 1por tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis ‘‘bod du dpung bskyod kyis bod mi dmangs bcings 'grol btang nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas phyir 'bud dang rgyal srung sra brtan gtong dgos ’zhes pa'i brjid che'i bka' rgya btang zhing bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang btsan nye'i stobs shugs nyung shas/ de bzhin kha phral ring lugs pa nyung shas bcas kyis gnas tshul de shes rjes skrag thag chod nas ci bya gtol bral ngang tsher ma'i steng du 80

bsdad pa lta bur gyur/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs dang mi nyung shas kyi dmigs bsal dbang char srung skyong ched kho pa tshos phyi rgyal log spyod shog khar ngan 'brel gyis sku tshab tshogs pa zer ba zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas nas ‘‘bod rang btsan ’’gyi lkog g.yo ngan gshoms byas yod/ kho pa tshos phyogs gcig nas gang sar dmag mi gsar bsdus kyis drag dpung rgya skyed gtong ba dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas mdza' mthun tshogs pa zer ba zhig a ri dang / dbyin ji/ rgya gar/ bal yul bcas rgyal khab bzhir ched gtong gis ‘‘bod rang btsan ’’yin tshul brjod de gang sar dkrog gtam zang zing bzo ba dang / yin min go ldog gis mi sems dkrug pa/ rnyog 'dzing bzo ba sogs bya thabs sna tshogs spyad de mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyod bya rgyur bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i re stong bcangs yod/spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul sne mang rnyog 'dzing de lta bu'i skabs su bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mdo smad spyi khyab dang /nga'i bza' zla dang mtsho sgo don sgrub tshe ring gnyis mdo smad bka' mgron gyi las gnas su bkod mngags byas shing / 1950lo'i zla 7par mdo spyi ngo las chab mdor bskyod/ de rjes nga dang gcen mo nga phod tshe brtan sgrol dkar lags mdo spyi'i las bya gzhan khag gcig dang mnyam du chab mdor bskyod/lam bar dpal 'bar du slebs skabs chab mdo nas lha sar phebs mkhan bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje sogs dang mjal zhing khong tshor chab mdo dang bza' zla'i gnas tshul bka' 'dri zhus par khong tshos chab mdo'i gnas tshul tshabs ha cang chen po 'dug gung khran tang gi dmag dpung chab mdor slebs zin zhing mdo spyi nga phod kyi sku srog la nyen kha chen po yod pas khyed tsho chab mdor phebs rgyu med/ gal te phebs tshe mjug 'bras bsam yul las 81

'das pa zhig yong rgyu rang red ces gsungs pa thos 'phral sems 'tshab chen po byung zhing ci bya gtol bral ngang kong po rgya mda'i nga phod gzhis su phyir log byas/ skabs der dkrog gtam je sdug tu song ba des mi rnams la dngangs 'tshab chen po bzos yod/ gung khran tang gi srid jus shes rtogs lta ci gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag mthong myong tsam yang med stabs ngas gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag la skrag snang chen po byed kyi yod/1kha50lo'i zla 11tshes 25nyin gyi sa srib mtshams su nga'i bza' zla dang cin krung rgyal mtshan phun tshogs lags gnyis thal ba 'tshub 'tshub 'a chad 'u thug ngang glo bur nga tsho'i sdod gnas su phebs byung bas nga tsho tshang ma dga' skyo mnyam 'char ngang 'phral mar khong gnyis la mdo spyi nga phod dang /bka' drung mtsho sgo ba/ de bzhin bcings 'grol dmag dang gung khran tang sogs kyi gnas tshul bka' 'dri zhus par/ khong gnyis kyis mdo spyi nga phod kyi sku gzugs gsal thang yin skor dang / khong gnyis ni mdo spyi nga phod dang bcings 'grol dmag mi'i 'go khrid wang chi me'i yi bkod mngags gzhir bzung lha sar tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag la gzhung yig gal che zhig phul bar 'gro mkhan yin skor gsungs pa dang / nga'i bza' zlas da dung chab mdo bcings 'grol btang rjes bzung dmag tu tshud rung mdo spyi nga phod kyi re 'dun ltar nga dang mtsho sgo don grub tshe ring gnyis nga phod kyi gam du bkod sgrig gnang ba dang de min gzhan rnams sa cha gzhan zhig tu yod ces dang /khong gis da dung bcings 'grol dmag gis bzung dmag la nyes rdung gshe gshe gtan nas mi gtong ba dang / gung khran tang gi sgrig khrims dam zhing drang ba/ mang tshogs kyi sdod khang nang mi sdod pa/ mi ser gyi rgyu dngos rang 'dod ltar gang byung mi 'khyer ba/ mi ser gyi don du bya ba bzang po sgrub pa 82

bcas byas stabs mi ser gyis bsngags brjod byed kyi 'dug ces gsungs stabs nga tsho'i dngangs 'tshab sel zhing gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag la 'dzin pa'i 'jigs skrag gi bsam pa yang rim bzhin med par gyur song / nga'i bsam par bcings 'grol dmag gis nga tsho'i bza' zla dmar gsod gtong rgyu lta ci khong tshor gzigs skyong dang yid ches de lta bu gnang bar ngas gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag la thugs rje che zhu dgos pa zhig 'dug snyam/ de ni ngas gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag la thog ma'i ngos 'dzin byung lugs de ltar lags/nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs pa snga por khong gnyis lha sa'i phyogs su thon/ de nas tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag la yig cha phul rjes lha sar nyin bcu grangs bzhugs/ bka' shag gi bkod mngags ltar nga'i bza' zla dang cin krung rgyal mtshan phun tshogs lags gnyis pe cin du zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gyi gros mthun la zhugs par phebs mkhan 'thus mi mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas dang lhan cig chab mdor phebs/ zhi gros 'thus mi rnams pe cin phyogs su thon rjes nga'i bza' zla'ang lha sar phyir phebs gnang / khong phyir phebs rjes nga tshor chab mdor gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag gis mi ser gyi don du sgrub pa'i byas rjes bzang po dngos su gzigs pa rnams ngo sprod gnang stabs bcings 'grol dmag mi'i byed lugs byed stangs la ya mtshan chen po skyes shing bcings 'grol dmag mi gang mgyogs mthong na snyam pa'i 'dun pa chen po zhig skyes byung /1kha51lo'i zla khatshes 9nyin wang chi me'i yis sne khrid gnang ba'i krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod sngon skyod yan lag ru khag lha 83

sar 'byor bar bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang mtho rim mi sna/ de bzhin ser skya mang tshogs bcas kyis spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhus shing rang nyid kyang gzhan dang 'dra bar rgyan gos bzang po spras thog ngo mtshar gyi bsam tshul bcangs bzhin mtho rim bud med gzhan dang mnyam du bcings 'grol dmag lha sar bca' zhugs gnang bar phebs par dga' bsu zhu bar phyin pa yin/de nyin bcings 'grol dmag thengs dang po mthong zhing khong tsho'i byad gzugs dang nga tsho mi 'dra ba gang yang med thog dkrog gtam nang bshad pa'i 'jigs snang de rigs rtsa ba nas mi 'dug dmag dpung ru ltar sgrig cing chas gos gtsang sbra dod pa/ tshang ma rngam brjid dpa' ngar dang grung sha dod pas thos pa brgya las mthong ba gcig lhag zer ba ltar mngon 'brel dang ba 'dren pa zhig 'dug pe cin du bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 'jog par phebs mkhan de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbu bzhugs sku tshab nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang sngon skyod yan lag dpung dmag snga rjes su lha sar phebs 'byor byung bar de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang las rigs khag gi mang tshogs kyis spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhus shing / nga tsho'ang skyid chu'i nye 'gram du dga' bsu zhu bar bskyod cing / khong tsho 'dzum bag ldan zhing grung sha dod po'i ngang nas phebs pa mthong skabs sems nang dga' spro chen po byung /gong lo'i zla 10tshes 6nyin krang go hwa dang than kon san gyis sne khrid gnang ba'i dpung sde chen po lha sar 'byor skabs nga de bas sems 'gul chen po thebs shing bcings 'grol dmag la dga' gus chen po skyes byung ba de ni bcings 'grol dmag dpung mthong thengs gnyis pa yin zhing sems nang bag chags de bas gting zab byung /84

1952lo'i zla 2tshes 10nyin bod dmag khul khang du bod kyi skad yig sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa dngos su tshugs/ yun ring ma song bar bod ljongs dmag khul khang rgyab phyogs zhabs 'degs pu'u yi chab srid u yon zhu'i a'e rmin dang skad sgyur zhig nga tsho'i khyim du phebs nas khyim tshang gi gnas tshul dang nye ba'i lo shas nang spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur/ de bzhin nga tshos gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag la 'dzin pa'i lta tshul dang 'pho 'gyur byung tshul gyi brgyud rim bcas kyi skor bka' 'dri gnang byung bar nga tshos don dngos ji ma ji bzhin lan 'debs zhus par thugs mos po gnang gi 'dug de nas khong gis ‘‘khyed rang khyim du las don med par sdod pa las spyi tshogs thog las don phran bu byed dgos ’’zhes bcings 'grol dmag mir bod yig slob khrid bya rgyu'i gdan zhu gnang byung bas ngas ‘‘bod yig slob sbyong byed myong yod rung gzhan la slob khrid byed myong med cing bcings 'grol dmag la bod yig slob khrid byed thub e yong ’zhes zhus par khong gis ‘‘nga tsho bod du bod mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu'i ched du yong ba yin/ bod kyi skad yig mi shes pa de mig sngar nga tsho'i dka' ngal che shos shig yin zhing bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong bya rgyu ni nga tsho'i mig snga'i las 'gan che shos kyi gras shig red/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs la tang gi srid jus dang gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun dril bsgrags kyis bod rgya mi rigs dbar gyi 'brel bar shugs snon ched nga tshos nges par du bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong byed dgos/ grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du bod kyi skad yig ma shes tshe bya dka' byed gtad yong nges yin pas khyed tshos nga tshor rogs ram shugs chen byed dgos mi’zhes gsungs/ chab srid u yon gzhon pa zhu'i a'e rmin gyis ngang ring gi go skon slob gso dang bza' zla'i shugs che'i rgyab skyor 'og ngas las 'gan de dang len zhus te 85

dma' rim 'dzin grwa'i slob khrid kyi las 'gan 'khur ba yin/ slob grwa'i slob ma ni brgya shog 'go khrid rim pa yan gyi las byed dang las khungs kyi las don mi sna yin zhing khyon slob ma rdo00lhag tsam yod pa dang / dge rgan mi grangs 20yod pa'i nang thang smad dkon cog dpal mo dang / mtsho sgo bde skyid g.yang 'dzoms/ hor khang thub bstan nyi ma/ cin krung rgyal mtshan phun tshogs/ 'bri yul tshe brtan bu khrid sogs mtho rim gzhon nu rgyal gces mi sna mang po yod/ nga'i 'dzin grwa'i nang slob ma bcings 'grol dmag mi 40yod cing khong tshos bod kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun gyi ched dang / bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol thob ched ngal ba 'dzems med kyis slob spyong nan tan gnang thog sgrig khrims nan srung dang dge rgan la brtsi bkur bcas byed pa des nga'i sems nang khong tsho'i bla na med pa'i spyod bzang gi bag chags gting zab byung ste ngas gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag la ngos 'dzin sngar lhag thub pa byung song / dus tshod de'i nang ngas tang gi slob gso thengs dang po dang len gyis gsar brje'i 'gro lam thog gom pa dang po spos pa yin/bod las don u yon lhan khang gis sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bod kyi las don la 'dzin pa'i tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus dang gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gyi dgongs don dril bsgrags byed ched/ mtho rim nang gi gzhon dar khag gcig sgrig 'dzugs kyis slob sbyong byed pa dang gzhon nus dga' po byed pa'i byed sgo sna tshogs spel yod/ skabs der nga bod dmag khul khang las byed slob grwa'i nang slob khrid byed kyi yod stabs phyogs gcig nas slob khrid dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas las don u yon lhan khang gis sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i slob spyong sogs byed sgo sna tshogs nang zhugs pa yin/86

thengs gcig krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung bod sdod sku tshab krang cing wu'u dang khong gi sku zla dbyang kang gis nga dang nga'i bza' zla gnyis khong tsho'i bzhugs gnas su ched 'bod gnang ste nga tsho'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul bka' 'dri gnang ba ma zad ngas dmag khul khang gi las byed slob grwar slob khrid byas pa'i grub 'bras la gdeng 'jog gang legs gnang ba dang sbrags nga tshosaspyi tshogs thog gi dkrog gtam gang byung la yid ches bya rgyu med pa dang /‘‘gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun ’’dang tang gi srid jus la slob sbyong yag po byed dgos pa/ bsam blor g.yo 'gul mi thebs pa bya rgyu/ tang gi 'go khrid la yid ches brtan po byed dgos pa bcas kyi blang bya bton gnang ba dang /mjug tu khong gis da dung nged bza' zla gnyis la hur brtson chen po'i sgo nas mi ring bar 'dzugs rgyu yin pa'i ‘‘grong khyer lha sa rgyal gces gzhon nu rig gnas mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang ’’nang zhugs dgos pa'i re ba bton gnang byung / khong gi bka' mol des nga tshor skul ma ha cang chen po dang slob gso gting zab thebs pa dang nga tsho'i yid ches de bas brtan por gyur te nged bza' tsho gnyis kyis hur brtson chen po'i sgo nas las don u yon lhan khang gis sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i byed sgo'i nang zhugs pa yin/‘‘grong khyer lha sa rgyal gces gzhon nu rig gnas mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs ’’dbu brnyes rjes nged bza' tsho gnyis de'i khongs mir gyur/ bod las don u yon lhan khang gis gzhon nu mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs kyi las don la spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gnang stabs mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis der srung brtsi dang yid mthun rogs ram gnang ba dang lha sa'i rgya che'i gzhon nu rnams kyis dang len zhus yod/ de nas bzung byed sgo sna tshogs nang zhugs mkhan lha sa'i mi rigs 87

khagagi pho gzhon mo gzhon je mang du gyur zhing gzhon nu mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs kyi 'go khrid 'og tshang mas rtag par mnyam du chab srid dang tshan rig rig gnas shes byar slob sbyong dang rig gnas lus rtsal gyi byed sgo sna tshogs spel gyi yod/ gzhon nu rnams rang nyid kyis sgyu rtsal 'khrab tshan sna tshogs 'khrab ston byed pa dang skabs 'gar mnyam sdeb kyi ngal rtsol nang zhugs stabs phan tshun sngar lhag rgyus mnga' dang gsar brje'i gnad lugs mang po shes rtogs thub pa byung zhing bod mi dmangs la phan thogs yod pa'i las don sgrub dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin thob byung / de nas bzung ngas gzhon nu mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs kyi las don gtso bor byas te slob khrid kyi las don mtshams 'jog byas pa yin/ 1954lo'i zla 2tshes rdonyin ‘‘lha sa grong khyer bud med mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs ’ridangos su btsugs shing ngas rgyun las u yon gyi las 'gan thog dril bsgrags las don gyi 'gan 'dzin gcig lcogs 'khur ba yin/ 1955lo dang 1956lo ni lha sa grong khyer rgyal gces gzhon nu mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs dang bud med mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs la 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba'i dus skabs yin zhing bud med gzhon nu mang po bud med mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs nang hur brtson chen pos zhugs pa dang rang khyim nas thon te spyi tshogs la zhabs zhu'i las don byas yod/ skabs de'i ring bod las don u yon lhan khang dang ‘‘mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs ’miganyis kyi 'go khrid kyis nga tshor rtag tu mes rgyal nang sa'i dus bab ches bzang po dang / rgyal spyi'i dus bab/ de bzhin bod kyi mdun lam skor bcas gsungs pa dang / nga tshor dus bab gsal rtogs dang lhag par yin min gsal 'byed byed dgos pa'i slob gso gnang gi yod/ tang gi 'go khrid 'og ‘‘mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs miganyis kyis spyi tshogs dril bsgrags kyi byed sgo mang po 88

spel thog gzhon nu khag gcig nang sar slob sbyong byed par btang ba nas mi nyung ba zhig deng skabs gal che'i 'go khrid las gnas thog las don byed bzhin pa dang khag gcig las 'khyur ngal gso byas te tshe mjug bde skyid ngang 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod/tang rtsa 'dzugs kyis nga la lo shas ring gso skyong slob gso gnang ba dang rim khag 'go khrid dang blo mthun rnam pas rogs ram gnang ba/ bza' zlas shugs che'i rgyab skyor gnang ba bcas kyi 'og ngas dka' ngal sna tshogs khyad bsad dang / spyi tshogs thog dang lhag par log spyod mtho rim mi sna'i dma' 'bebs dang / skyon 'dogs/ 'jigs skul sna tshogs bcas la 'jigs zhum ma byas par bod mi dmangs rnams mthar bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi gnya' gnon bshu gzhog las thar te krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og mi dmangs mang tshogs rang nyid kyi srid dbang zhig 'dzugs thub nges yin pa'i yid ches brtan po bcangs te hur brtson gyi sgo nas yar thon brtson len gyis tang rtsa 'dzugs la tang nang zhugs rgyu'i re 'dun zhu yig phul ba yin/ nga'i ngos 'dzin du mi zhig la rang nyid kyi khyim tshang 'byung khungs gdam ga rgyag rgyu med rung rang nyid kyi mdun lam gdam rgyu'i dbang cha yod pas ngas krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og gung khran ring lugs kyi rgyang ring dmigs tshad mngon 'gyur ched tshe gang 'bad 'thab byed dgos snyam/ tang rtsa 'dzugs kyis zhib tshags gso skyong dang rang nyid kyis las don la 'bad brtson byas mthar 1956lo'i zla 11par nga gzi brjid ngang krung go gung khran tang nang zhugs rgyur krung go gung khran tang gi gra sgrig tang yon zhig la 'gyur thub pa byung song / skabs der nga'i sems nang g.yo 'gul shin tu chen po thebs nas dus de nas bzung gnam 'og gnas tshul ji 'dra byung 89

rung ngas nam yang gung khran tang gi rjes su bskyod de rang nyid kyi mi tshe hril po tang dang mi dmangs kyi bya gzhag gi ched du legs skyes su 'bul rgyu'i sems thag bcad pa yin/ skabs der nga tang nang zhugs pa'i gnas tshul phyi phyogs su gsang ba byed kyi yod/ de ltar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni spyi tshogs thog gi log spyod pas bod rigs las byed pa dang lhag par tang yon las byed par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas 'khon 'dzin byed cing kho pa tsho'i mig nang gi gra ma dang sha nang gi tsher ma lta bur rtsis nas ‘‘rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi ’’zhes ngan smras byed kyi yod stabs bod rigs las byed par srung skyob bya rgyu'i ched du yin zhing las don stabs bde yong ched tang nang zhugs rjes rtag tu nga tshor rang nyid kyi ming thob phyir mi mngon pa byas nas nam rgyun ltar mang tshogs la 'brel gtug dang /sku drag gi 'tsho ba skyel stangs/ mi rigs kyi goms srol/ chos lugs byed sgo bcas tshang ma sngar rgyun ltar byed dgos/ sems nang tang rtsa 'dzugs dang gcig gyur dang / sne mang rnyog 'dzing gi 'thab rtsod nang bsam blor g.yo 'gul ma thebs na 'grig pa red ces slob gso gnang gi yod/1957lor tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis bod ljongs sa khul gyi dngos yod gnas tshul la khyon yongs nas dbye zhib zhib 'jug gis ‘‘lo drug bcos bsgyur mi byed pa dang / skum 'then 'os 'tsham bya rgyu'i mi’mdzad phyogs gtan 'khel gnang zhing bod las don u yon lhan khang gis blo brtan 'gyur med kyi sgo nas mdzad phyogs de lag bstar gyis las byed pa'i khrod du bsam blo gcig gyur dang / ngos 'dzin gcig gyur/ bya spyod gcig gyur bcas kyi las don mang po gnang yod/ de'i gong du nga dang nga'i bza' zla gnyis rgyal gces mi sna gzhan mang po dang 'dra bar dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gang mgyogs bya rgyu'i re ba mtha' gcig tu 'don gyi yod cing / lo drug dmangs gtso'i 90

bcos bsgyur mi byed pa'i skor thos 'phral yid la mi 'thad pa byung stabs bod las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gzhon pa than kon san gyis nga gnyis la ngang ring gi slob gso gnang zhing khong gis nga tshor mig sngar lha sa'i dus bab ha cang rnyog 'dzing yod stabs dus bab gsal rtogs dang / dkrog gtam la yid ches dang mgo gnyis ma mi byed par gung khran tang la yid ches kyis blo gcig sems gcig gis bod kyi rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu'i bsam blo 'dzugs dgos zhes dang khong gis da dung khyed rang ni gung khran tang yon zhig yin stabs dus dang rnam pa kun tu bsam blor nges dgos pa zhig la lo drug ring dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur mi byed pa ni tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i thabs jus yin zhing nga tshos nges par du lag bstar byed dgos zhes gsungs/ tang rtsa 'dzugs dang 'go khrid kyi slob gso dang yig char slob sbyong nan tan byas pa brgyud tang krung dbyang gi thabs jus der sngar lhag ngos 'dzin dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur nar 'gyangs byed dgos pa'i don snying shes rtogs thub pa byung song / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur mi byed stabs skabs de'i rim khag sgrig gzhi khu bsdu dang mi sna nyung bsdu byas shing bod ljongs bud med mnyam tshogs kyi las byed nang nas gzhon nu bud med khag gcig bdams te nang sa dang lha sa bod ljongs las byed slob grwar slob sbyong byed par btang ba red/1rdzo57lo'i zla 5par bud med mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs kyis nga bod kyi bud med sku tshab tshogs pa'i nang bkod sgrig gis pe cin du skong tshogs byas pa'i krung go'i bud med 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs gsum pa'i nang zhugs shing mes rgyal gyi rnam pa dang ri klung ches bzang po dngos su mthong bas mthong rgya che ru song ba dang slob gso thebs nas yid ches brtan por gyur song /91

bcings 'grol dmag bod du phebs pa nas bzung bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs dang kho pa tsho'i dmigs bsal dbang cha srung skyong ched mes rgyal kha phral gyi byed sgo sna tshogs mtshams 'jog gtan nas byed myong med cing ‘‘mi dmangs gros tshogs ’’zhes pa cha bsdu ya bsdu byas thog ‘‘chu bzhi sgang drug mimigi log spyod sgrig 'dzugs btsugs te gang sar dkrog gtam spel ba dang don rkyen bzo ba/ thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas mi rigs 'brel bar gtor bshig gtong ba bcas byas nas gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag phyir 'bud bya rgyu'i re ngan 'chang gi yod/ kha bral ring lugs pas ‘‘bod rang btsan ’gyi bsgrags yig mngon gsal sbyar 'grems dang ‘‘bod rang btsan rgyal khab mi dmangs gros tshogs ’’skong tshogs byas pa/ lha sdod hin rdu'i gzhungatshab don byed khang la ‘‘srung skyob ’’kyi re ba bton pa/ ngo log zing 'khrug sgrig 'dzugs byas pa bcas kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs te bod las don u yon lhan khang gis las byed pa khag gcig 'dems sgrug gis tang yon sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa'i nang slob sbyong byed du bcug cing ngas kyang de'i nang zhugs pa yin/ tang yon sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa ni bod las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gzhon pa than kon san gyis 'gan khur gnang ba dang / gtso bo bsam blo chab srid kyi slob gso gtong ba dang / skabs de'i lha sa'i dus bab skor 'grel bshad kyis nga tshor rno ngar rnyog 'dzing gi dus bab nang langs phyogs brtan po dang lta ba gsal po'i ngang mes rgyal kha phral gyi byed sgo mtha' dag la ngo rgol byed dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod/1959lo'i zla 2tshes 10nyin bod kyi mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs kyis drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs shing / zla 2tshes 20nyin lha sar bca' 92

sdod tang srid dmag gi las khungs dang khe las dang bya las tshan par khyon yongs nas tshur rgol byas shing / tang krung dbyang dang bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid 'og lha sa'i rgyal gces mtho rim pa dang ser skya mang tshogs kyis gzhogs 'degs hur thag byas pa'i 'og mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis nyin gnyis lhag tsam gyi dza drag dmag 'thab brgyud lha sa grong khyer khul gyi drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags mthar phyin btang ba red/lha sa'i ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang rjes/ krung gung lha sa grong khyer u yon lhan khang dang lha sa grong khyer dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang btsugs pa dang sbrags bod sa gnas srid gzhung med par bzos pa dang /snang rtse shag dang / zhol las khungs sogs log spyod kyi srid dbang sgrig 'dzugs tshang ma med par bzos te lha sa khul gyi chab srid dang / dmag don/dmangs srid sogs las don tshang ma rtsis len bdag sprod byas/ tang yon sbyong brdar grwa'i slob ma rnams lha sa grong khyer dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang gi las don ru khag nang las don byed par btang zhing nga yang grong khyer shar khul ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang ‘‘ngo rgol gsum dang chag yang gnyis ’(ngo log zing 'khrug la ngo rgol dang / khral 'ul la ngo rgol/ bran bkol la ngo rgol/ bogs ma dang skyed ka chag yang )kyi las 'gul nang zhugs te hur brtson gyi sgo nas tang gi srid jus dril bsgrags byas pa yin/gong lo'i zla rdopar nga'i bu rgan pa blo bzang dkon cog gis hur brtson chen pos tang krung dbyang dang bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'bod skul dang len zhus te krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwas sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags kyi las don ru khag nang rang mos the zhugs kyis pe 93

cin nas lha sar log zla 9par khong gis 'phan po sa khul gyi ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags 'thab rtsod nang zhugs shing (bcings 'grol dmag gi skad sgyur ) zla 11par jag 'joms dmag 'thab nang khong dang bcings 'grol dmag blo mthun 'ga' zhig gshegs/ skabs der khong lo bcu dgur son pa tsam yin/ de rjes 'phan po khul dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid gtso bo sung tse yon gyis yid shin tu skyo ba'i ngang nga'i bu gshegs pa'i gnas tshul gsungs byung zhing gtam ngan de thos rjes nga'i sems la skyo snang shin tu chen po byung / lha sa grong khyer gyi 'go khrid blo mthun 'ga' zhig kyang nga'i sar 'tshams 'dri gnang bar phebs shing khong tshos nga la gzugs por bdag gces dang / da yod phru gu gnyis la gces skyong byed dgos/gsar brje'i bya gzhag gi don du dpa' ngar chen pos rang srog blos gtong gi bu rgan pa'i snying stobs mig dper 'dzin nas skyo snang stobs shugs su 'gyur ba dang snying stobs hur skyed kyis gnon shugs dang tshod bgam sna tshogs theg thub pa byed dgos zhes gsungs byung / nga'i bza' zla snga sa nas 'das grongs su gyur pa dang bu rgan pa gshegs pa des nga la rdung rdeg shugs che phog yod rung gong gi dbu khrid rnam pa'i slob gso dang gcen mo gnyis pa nga phod tshe brtan sgrol dkar lags steng zhal nas sems gso gzigs skyong gnang ba'i 'og yid kyi skyo snang sel te tshod bgam theg thub pa byung song /1960lo'i zla 2par ngas lha sa grong khyer u yon lhan khang gis sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i tang yon las byed sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa thengs dang po'i nang zhugs pa dang gong lo'i zla 10tshes 6nyin gzi brjid ngang krung go gung khran tang gi tang yon ngo mar gyur cing / de rjes ngas snga rjes su grong khyer shar khul tang tshogs chung gi tsu'u krang dang sde tshogs u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci 94

sogs kyi 'gan 'khur/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur nang bod las don u yon lhan khang gis zing zhugs min pa'i mtho rim mi snar 'dzin pa'i tang krung dbyang gi blo 'gugs srid jus lag bstar gyis blo 'gugs khyim dud la blo 'gugs lag khyer dang blo 'gugs dngul gnang skabs rtsa 'dzugs nas nga dang bu phrug gi 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs thog gi bag chags la dgongs bzhes kyis nga la yang blo 'gugs 'gro lugs gnang rung ngas sems thag gtsang bcad kyis blo 'gugs kyi dngul phyir 'bul zhus pa yin/ nga ni gung khran tang yon zhig yin stabs blo 'gugs kyi dngul len mi 'os shing yar langs zhing bran khri brgya dang grangs 'das gsar brje'i las byed pa rnams dang 'dra bar rang nyid kyi ngal rtsol la brten nas rang kha rang gso byed snyam/1961lo'i zla 4par lha sa'i shar lho nub byang grong khul gyi sgrig gzhi med par bzos pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog khreng kon chus mi dmangs srid gzhung btsugs shing / ngas khreng kon chus kyi chus krang gzhon pa dang dmangs srid dang rig slob las don gyi las bgos 'gan khur byas/ grong khyer u yon lhan khang dang khreng kon chus tang ud kyi 'go khrid 'og ngas rogs res tshogs chung dang / las zhor dril bsgrags ru khag dang lha mo ru khag dmangs 'dzugs slob chung sogs 'dzugs rgyu'i thad las don nges can byas par rim gong rtsa 'dzugs dang 'go khrid kyis bsngags brjod gnang byung / gzhan yang ngas hur brtson gyi sgo nas ‘‘gtsang sgrig gtsang bsher ’’dang / ‘‘ngo rgol gsum/’’‘‘ngo rgol lnga ’sogs grong khyer dang grong gseb kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi slob gso'i chab srid las 'gul nang zhugs shing chab srid kyi las 'gul de dag brgyud rang nyid la slob gso thebs pa dang / kha phyogs gsal rtogs thub nas 95

gung khran tang gi rjes su 'brang ste spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam thog skyod rgyu'i yid ches dang chod sems brtan por gyur song /1rdzo62lo'i lo mjug gi krung hin sa mtshams rang srung rgol lan gyi dmag 'khrug skabs bod las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gzhon pa dbyang tung hreng gis tshogs gtso dang zhol khang thub bstan nyi mas tshogs gtso gzhon pa gnang ba'i bod kyi las rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs kyis rta dbang khul du bcings 'grol dmag la 'tshams 'dri zhu bar phebs shing nga yang khreng kon chus kyi 'thus mi byas te 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i nang zhugs pa yin/ 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa gang du slebs kyang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bkod 'thab pa'i dga' skyo gnyis ldan gyi dpa' ngar chen po'i byas rjes dngos su mthong ba'am thos rgyu yod pas rgyal gces ring lugs kyi slob gso gting zab thebs byung /1965lo'i lo stod du bod las don u yon lhan khang gi mdzub ston dgongasadon gzhir bzung lha sar ‘‘slob gso gsum ’ (gral rim slob gso/rgyal gces ring lugs kyi slob gso/ spyi tshogs ring lugs mdun lam gyi slob gso )las 'gul gyi las don tshogs pa btsugs pa de'i nang zhugs shing /grong gseb kyi slob gsum las 'gul skor gyi krung gung krung dbyang gi gtan 'bebs gzhir bzung nga tshos stag rtse dang stod lung bde chen rdzong gi slob gso gsum gyi ‘‘mnyam gsum gcig spel ’’gyi nyams myong phyogs bsdoms kyis tang dang mang tshogs kyi 'brel ba dam zab tu btang yod/ skabs der ngas da dung bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi mi dmangs kung hre dang po ste mthong dga' mi dmangs kung hre 'dzugs rgyu'i lasatshodon nang zhugs pa dang de rjes slar nga/nga stag rtse rdzong 'brom thod shang du mi dmangs kung hre chod 'dzugs kyi las don nang zhugs pa 96

yin/1966lo'i zla 5par slob gso gsum gyi las don mjug sgril rjes las don tshogs pa lha sar phyir log gis gtsug lag khang nang krung dbyang gi yig cha slob sbyong dang bzo bcos ring lugs pa zhes par dgag pa brgyab/ krung dbyang gi ‘‘lnga gcig drug ’brda tho gsham spel byas rjes 'go khrid pas nor 'khrul ngang skul slong byas pa dang / lin pe'o dang cang ching gsar brjer ngo rgol ru tshogs kyis bed spyod kyis tang dang rgyal khab/ rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs bcas la god chags tshabs che bzo ba'i rig gnas gsar brje chen po 'go tshugs shing / nga khreng kon chus kyi chus krang gzhon pa yin stabs 'go khrid las byed gzhan dang 'dra bar ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan tang nang gi dbang 'dzin shog khag dang tang nang g.yo 'dzul byas pa'i zhing bran bdag po'i tshab byed mi snar brtsis te dgag rgyag 'thab rtsod byas rung nyes med nyes 'gel byas pa'i zing cha'i dus skabs nang du'ang ngas tang la yid ches byed pa'i bsam blor 'gyur ba byung med/1971lor khreng kon chus tang ud kyis nga la brda tho gtong gnang gis grong khyer srid gros kyis btsugs pa'i rgyal gces mi sna'i slob spyong 'dzin grwa'i nang zhugs su bcug yun ring ma song bar ngas slob spyong 'dzin grwa'i 'go khrid tshogs chung gi tsu'u krang gzhon pa byas pa yin/ 1975lo'i zla 〈pa'i tshes 2nyin grong ud 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u tang kri pu'u nas nga'i sgrig 'dzugs skyid sdug slar gso gnang ba dang / ‘‘rig gsar ’’nang nyes ming btsan 'gel byas pa rnams dag sel gtsang dag byas/1975lo'i zla 12par lha sa grong khyer bud med mnyam tshogs skabs gnyis pa'i bud med 'thus mi'i tshogs chen skong tshogs gnang skabs nga skabs 97

gnyis pa'i bud med mnyam 'brel tshogs pa'i u yon la bdams thon byung ba dang yun ring ma song bar lha sa grong khyer bud med mnyam 'brel tshogs pa'i kru'u ren gzhon par bsko gzhag byas/ 1977lo'i zla 11par srid gros lha sa grong khyer u yon lhan khang skabs gsum pa'i u yon lhan khang gi rgyun las u yon la bsko gzhag byas/19〈5lo'i zla 5par grong khyer srid gros nang las bsgyur byas shing lo de'i zla rdopar grong khyer srid gros skabs bzhi pa'i tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa'i thog grong khyer srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon par bsko gzhag byas thog 19rardolo'i lo mjug tu grong khyer srid gros tang tsu'u yi khongs mi byas/19ṭ+wāṃ7lo'i zla khatshes 27nas bzung bod kyi kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas kyis rgyal spyi'i krung rgol stobs shugs kyi ngan skul 'og ngan pa lag sbrel gyis lha sar zing cha'i don rkyen thengs mang bzos shing / kho pa tshos gangs seng gi dar cha 'khyer te khrom skor dang ‘‘bod rang btsan ’gyi 'bod tshig bsgrags pa ni dmangs sems dkrug pa dang brtan lhing mthun sgril gyi chab srid rnam par gtor bshig gis mes rgyal kha phral gyi stong bsam bcangs pa zhig yin pas ngas grong khyer srid gros kyis sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i slob sbyong tshogs 'du'i thog don dngos mang po drangs nas kha bral ring lugs pa'i lkog g.yor dgag rgyag dang kha rdung drag po btang ba dang / tang krung dbyang dang rang skyong ljongs tang ud dang srid gzhung gis zing cha zhod 'jags su gtong rgyur 'dzin pa'i bya thabs rab dang rim par yongs su srung brtsi zhus pa dang /gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don bzhi rgyun 'khyongs kyis bsgyur bcos sgo dbye rgyun 'khyongs dang tang gi rjes su 'brangs te spyi tshogs ring lugs 'gro lam thog bskyod rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byas pa yin/98

nga la da lta bde skyid ldan pa'i khyim tshang zhig yod/ phru gu gnyis ka khyim btsugs las zhugs zin zhing bu mo rig 'dzin dpal mo bod ljongs tshags par las khungs rtsom sgrig pu'u nang las ka byed pa dang / bu 'jigs med bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang skad yig zhib 'jug khang gi so'o krang byed cing 1khardordolor a rir lo gcig lhag tsam gzab sbyong du bskyod pa bcas 'das pa'i shul lam la phyi mig blta ba dang ma 'ongs par rgyang lta byed skabs mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes dpal ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar dang lha sa gsar pa zhig 'dzugs skrun thub nges yin par yid ches chen po skye gi 'dug pas ngas rlabs chen dmigs tshad de mngon 'gyur ched nus pa lhag ma gang yod 'don spel thub pa bya rgyu yin/('jigs med rnam rgyal gyis bsgyur/)

lo rabs lnga bcu par thon 1 2 6gis rdza yul sa khul du las don sgrub par dran gso zhu ba/wang rje rmin dang / jon g.yun grang /hran kru'u lin/ ko'o zha'o ru'u bcasakyis/yun nan dmag khul khang hre shog 42khongs mda' shog 126gis chab mdo'i dmag 'khrug nang zhugs zin rjes bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉gzhir bzung 1950lo'i zla 10tshes 1nyin rdza yul mtha' mtshams su dpung skyod byas pa red/ rdza yul bcings bkrol btang nas lo 40'khor ba'i dus 'dir/ skabs de'i rdza yul sa khul gyi las don nang zhugs myong ba'i nga tsho blo mthun 'ga' zhig gis spyi lo 1956lo'i zla ba 5pa ste bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu ma brnyes pa'i sngon rol du dmag dpung gis rdza yul sa khul du mi rigs las don sgrub pa'i gnas tshul la dran gso byas pa dang bsam blo btang bas de ni ha cang phan thogs pa zhig yin par snyam zhing / gson nyams ldan pa'i gnas tshul dang mi bzang las bzang / de bzhin nyams myong mang po zhig da lta yang yid la gsal por dran gyi 'dug100

gcigardza yul ni bod ljongs shar lho khul gyi lung gzhung du gnas yod pa dang /lang long du 'phyur ba'i rdza chus mnga' khongs yong rdzogs brgyud yod pa/gdod ma'i nags tshal gyis khengs shing / ri tshogs kyis mtha' yongs su bskor ba/ dus bzhi'i dro grang dpyid ka ltar snyoms pa/ thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa bcas yod pas ‘‘bod ljongs kyi 'bri chu'i lho rgyud ’’ces grags bzhin yod/ rdza yul de rgya gar dang 'bar ma gnyis kyi sa mtshams yin pa dang /mtha' mtshams kyi ring tshad le bar 1rkya00lhag tsam yod/ der bod rigs dang teng pa/ tu'u lung rigs/ lho pa rigs sogs spun zla mi rigs gzhis chags yod cing bod rigs mi 'bor mang bas dbang bsgyur gyi go gnas bzung yod pa dang / teng pa dang / tung lung rigs/ lho pa rigs sogs mtha' mtshams sa khul du 'dres mar gnas yod/ de'i nang nas teng pa de ri khrod nags stug tu gnas yod pas ‘‘klo pa ’’zhes dma' 'bebs kyang byed kyi yod cing kho pa tshor chab srid kyi go gnas med kyang dpa' ngar che bas — dug mda' dang dug gris rngon rgyag pa sogs byed cing mi gzhan gyis skrag snang yang byed kyin yod/ bcings bkrol ma btang gong dbang bsgyur log spyod pas dbyen spyor dkrug shing byas rkyen mi rigs khag dbar gyi 'gal zla cung che tsam yod cing mtshon 'khyer rub 'dzing gi don rkyen lo ltar yong gi yod pa dang phan tshun dgra ltar bzung nas mi mthun pa'i gnad don tshabs chen lhag gi yod/dmag dpung rdza yul du 'byor rjes thon tang ud kyis tang gi mi rigs srid jus khyab bsgrags dang mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag rgyu de thog 101
