ma'i las 'gan du brtsis nas thon mdun phyogs tang ud hru'u ci blo mthun wang rje rmin sku ngo mas dam 'dzin gnang gi yod/mi rigs las don ru khag sgrig 'dzugs byas te mi rigs khag gi grong dud sar zab mjug gis brtag dpyad dang las byed 'thab 'dzing par tang gi mi rigs srid jus lag bstar nan po dang spun zla mi rigs kyi yul srol gomasagashis la brtsi 'jog 〈sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad 〉brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i slob gso dang skul slong byas te dmag 'thab ru khag de las don ru khag la bsgyur nas mang tshogs las don tan tig ngang spel ba red/ spyi lo 1952lo'i zla rdopar tang gi gcig gyur 'go khrid la shugs snon rgyag ched rim pa gong ma'i mdzub ston gzhir bzung blo mthun wang rje rmin gyis hru'u ci gnang ba'i rdza yul gyi lte ba'i tang ud dbu brnyes te mi rigs las don dang sa gnas srid dbang / dmag dpung 'dzugs skrun/ de bzhin mtha' mtshams kyi 'thab rtsod bcas la phyogs bsdoms byed kyi yod/ rdza yul sa khul du mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag rgyu'i gtso gnad de chab srid thog mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin pa las bstar dang / lo rgyus thog dngos su gnas pa'i mi rigs khag dbar gyi 'dra mnyam min pa'i gnas tshul gtsang sel/ lhag par du teng pa dang / tu'u lung rigs/ lho pa rigs bcas la chab srid kyi go gnas med pa'i gnad don thag gcod byed dgos pa'i skor tang ud nas ngos 'dzin gting zab byung ba red/dmag dpung gis spyi lo 1952lo'i zla 2par sa gnas la rogs ram byas te rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang btsugs pa'i skabs 'go pa dang gros mol thog yongs khyab tu mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char nyan 'jog byas pa brgyud mi rigs khag gi snyan grags che rigs 'go pa dang ma/nga tshogs kyi 'thus mir 102

'dems sgrug gis bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi las don nang zhugs su bcug yod cing bod rigs blo mthun ā 'bi dang pad ma bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa'i u yon la 'dams yod/ tu'u lung rigs mi grangs nyung yang bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang la zhugs mkhan 'thus mi yod pa dang / teng pa rmu gcod bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi u yon la 'dams shing mi rigs khag 'dra mnyam gyis gzhung don la gros mol byed pa de lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba zhig red/ lhag par du bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa'i skabs rmu gcod rdza yul sa khul gyi 'thus mi yin pa dang gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi tshogs pa'i tshogs mir 'dems thon byung ba des mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs la shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/sa de'i mi ser gyis mi sna sgrig 'dzugs byas te dmag sgar gnas sar dmag dpung la lta bar yong skabs nga tshos spun zla ltar spro sems chen pos sne len byas pa dang kho tsho 'gro khar lag rtags sprad pa ma zad ched mngags ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par zhig sprad pa de yul mi spun zla tshos lta ched yin/ lo gnyis par kho tshos sku par de khyer nas slar yang rdza yul du spun mched 'phrad par slebs byung / sku par der rtag par lag pa 'chang gi yod med mi shes kyang gang ltar nag rkyang du gyur 'dug spyi lo 1956lor yong thengs gcig la kho tsho mi 2rkyalhag tsam slebs byung bas nga tshos kho tsho rdza yul gyi mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen la gdan 'dren zhus pa dang / tshogs 'du grol rjes mi gsum pe cin du mdzad gzigs la zhugs su bcug pas kho tsho'i bsam par krung go ba yinagyin gzi brjid chen po 'dug snyam pa ma zad ma'o kru'u zhi mjal 'phrad byung nas slob gso chen po thebs byung zhes gang sar dril bsgrags byed kyi yod/103

dmag dpung tang ud kyis sa de'i mang tshogs khrod ‘‘rgya rigs dang /bod rigs/ teng pa/ tu'u lung rigs/ lho pa rigs bcas spun zla'i mi rigs yin pa'i ’’shod rgyun chags pa dang 'brel tang gi mi rigs mthun sgril dang 'dra mnyam srid jus dril bsgrags byas shing / mi rigs khag khyim tshang gcig ltar phan tshun brtsi bkur dang / mthun sgril dam zab/ mdza' mthun mnyam gnas/ tshang ma 'dra mnyam bcas sngar las lhag par byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang don snying gsal bshad byas yod pa ma zad rdzong skabs bzhi pa'i mi dmangs 'thus tshogs thog gros chod brgyud teng pa ri las babs te bca' sdod dang thon skyed byed du bcug par bod rigs 'thus mi rdo rje dang rnam rgyal sogs kyis hur bskyed ngang brtsi bkur dang dmangs yongs kyi sne khrid de teng pa spun zlar dga' bsu thob pa dang teng pa'i chab srid go gnas gong mthor phyin yod/ slob gso dang las ka byas pa brgyud bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rang 'gul ngang teng pa chu brgal dus 'breng thag gcod dgos pa'i khungs med kyi dka' ngal bzo ba de med par bzos shing / krung go'i sman rdzas rigs brje res byed skabs lho pa rigs dang gong tshad mi snyoms pa'i bya spyod yo bsrang byas yod/ dmag dpung dang sa khul tang ud kyi mi sna tshang mas gnad don gang zhig gi thad la yang mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin pa'i lta stangs 'a chi༈na rgyur gzab nan ha cang chen po byas pa dang / gal che'i las 'gul khag gcig la mi rigs tshang ma'i 'thus mi zhugs rgyur thugs khur byas te mi rigs so so rang nyid kyi khe phan dang 'brel ba yod pa'i don la tshang ma mnyam zhugs kyis thag gcod byas shing / tshang ma'i blo sgo phye nas rang nyid kyi chab srid dbang cha longs spyod gang thub dgos pa'i shes rtogs byung yod/ gal te 'u lag lam lugs dang khral ngan sna tshogs kyi gnad don med 104

pa bzo dgos na tshang ma mang tshogs kyis blang bya bton pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog 'go pa dang mang tshogs kyi 'thus mi dang gros mol gros bsdur byas nas bsam 'char gcig gyur byung rjes slar yang mi dmangs 'thus mi brgyud de thag gcod byas par phan 'bras cung zad legs tsam thob thub pa byung yod/dmag dpung gis da dung rang dpe gzhan ston byas te phar 'gro tshur 'ongakhyed mkhan gyi mi rigs khag gi mi snar spro sems 'khol pos 'dra mnyam gyis sne len byas pa dang / mang tshogs khrod du mi rigs mthun sgril dang 'dra mnyam srid jus kyi rtsa ba gting zab por btsugs yod/ spyi lo 1955lor nub byang dmag khul khang gi bod bskyod dmag dpung 'tshams 'dri tshogs par bsu ba zhu ba'i skabs rgya rigs dang bod rigs teng pa bcas kyis stegs bu gcig gi steng 'thus mi tshogs par dga' bsu zhu ba'i 'khrab ston byas pa dang 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'tshams 'dri'i las 'gul khag la gzigs pas mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi rang khyim rang bdag byed pa'i gzi ldan bsam pa je cher phyin yod/ lo drug lhag tsam ring las ka gting zab zhib tshags byas pa brgyud rtsa ba'i thog nas mi rigs khag dbar gyi 'gal zla sel thub pa dang /mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon/ brtse sems 'brel mthud bcas byed thub pa byung yod/ lhag par du bod rigs spun zlas sa mtshams brgal bskyod byed mkhan gyi spun zla mi rigs la spro sems 'khol pos sne len byas pa brgyud teng pa rang khyim du mgron por gdan zhu byas pa dang khong tshor sa zhing 'debs rogs byas pas sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas phan tshun bar gyi 'khon 'gras sel thub pa byung yod/ spyi lo 1955lor lho pa rigs kyis da dung lo gnyis sngon du dug mdas bsad pa'i bod rigs kyi rmo phyugs gnyis skyin tshab tu sprad pas mi rigs khag gi mang tshogs dbar phan tshun 'gro 'ong dang / phan tshun 'dra 105

mnyam gyi spyod tshul 'dzin pa/ phan tshun brtsi bkur bcas kyi rnam pa zhig chags thub pa byung yod/ sngon ma phan tshun mthong chung byed kyi yod na'ang da lta tshang ma lhan du mnyam za mnyam 'thung dang / tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa/gleng mol byed pa/ glog brnyan lta ba/ par rgyag pa sogs byed kyi yod/bcings 'grol btang ba'i rjes phan tshun 'khrug rtsod dang 'khon 'dzin gyis mi gsod pa la sogs pa'i gnad don gcig kyang lhag myong med cing dmag dpung dang spun zla mi rigs dbar khyim mi lta bu'i mdza' brtse che ba dang mang tshogs la gnad don 'phrad tshe rang 'gul ngang dmag dpung btsal nas thabs 'don jus 'god gnang rogs zhu ba/ dka' ngal yod tshe dmag dpung la rogs ram dang thag gcod gnang rogs zhu ba/ gal te phan tshun dbar rtsod gzhi byung skabs dmag dpung la yin min zhib dpyad dang mthun 'grig yong thabs byed rogs zhu ba bcas byed kyi yod/ kho tshos rtag tu ‘‘bcings 'grol dmag gis las don sgrub na gzhung drang shos dang / gnas lugs gsal bshad byed pa/ thag gcod byas pa'i gnad don la mi rnams blo yid tshim shos yong gi 'dug ’’ces shod kyi yod/ dmag dpung gi las byed dang 'thab 'dzing pa las don sgrub par 'gro skabs lam bar mang tshogs kyis rang 'gul ngang khang pa gtsang shos sprod pa dang / chu bkol ba/ kha lag bzo ba ma zad/ da dung mtshan mo so lta skor g.yeng byed mi 'jog gi yod/ blo mthun 'ga' zhig gi dngos po bor brlag byung tshe khang bdag gis bdag po rgyab nas rjes su bor mkhan la phyir sprod byed kyi yod/ mgo chen grong du rgan po zhig yod pa des rang khyim nas dmag dpung blo mthun zhig gi bor brlag song ba'i lag khyer glog zhu zhig rnyed pa de yang lam thag nyin gsum bzhi'i sar yod pa'i dmag sgar du skyel bar yong ba red/ spyi lo 1955lor dmag mi 106

rgan gras dmag khongs nas phyir log pa'i skabs dmag sgar gnas sa'i mtha' 'khor gyi mang tshogs mang po dmag sgar du yong nas kho tshor 'tshams 'dri dang skyel ma byas pa ma zad lam bar du mi dmangs tshos kha btags 'bul ba dang / chu bkol ba/ mchod chang bkyag pa/ rta khrid de skyel ma byed pa/mchi ma gtong bzhin par kha gyes pa'i snang tshul des mi rnams sems 'gul thebs pa zhig yong gi yod/ mang tshogs kyis ‘‘gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag mi nyi ma 'dra zhing gang du khyab na gang du gsal ba dang / nga tshor mis mi la brnyas bcos byed mi chog pa dang / mis mi la gnya' gnon byed mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan drangs shing / nga tshos bcings 'grol dmag mir gces skyong byed pa ni nga tsho'i 'tsho ba gsar par gces skyong byed pa zhig yin ’’zhes shod kyi yod pa red/ de nas bzung rdza chu'i chu ngogs g.yas g.yon du lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i dmag dmangs dbar dang / spun zla mi rigs dbar mthun sgril dang mdza' brtse/ mdza' ma thun mnyam gnas bcas kyi snang tshul thon pa red/gnyis/mi rig/sa mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag par da dung tan tan tig tig ngang rgyal gces ring lugs dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs/ mi rigs srid jus bcas kyi slob gso btang thog rtsa ba'i cha nas mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyi bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin je zab tu btang nas rang rtogs rang bzhin che ru gtong dgos pa nga tshos don dngos las shes rtogs byung / thog mar nga tshos gzab nan gyi sgo nas zhib phra'i gnad don dang dmag dpung gi don dngos kyi shugs rkyen dam 'dzin byed pa de yang dgos nges shig red/ 'on kyang zhib 107

phra'i gnad don 'di thag gcod byung rung slar yang gnad don gzhan zhig thon yong gi yod pas nga tshos dus rim 'di'i steng rang sor lus pa yin na gzhi rtsa'i thog mi rigs mthun sgril gyi gnad don thag gcod mi thub pa dang /gzhan yang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rig gnas byang tshad cung zad dma' ba dang mi rigs khag gcig la yi ge med cing da dung nges byed kyi brda rtags rgyag bzhin yod pa/ rgya yig khrod kyi ming tshig dang tha snyad mang po zhig dang /lhag parari spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun khrod kyi ming tshig dang tha snyad gsar pa khag gcig go mi thub la yig bsgyur yang dka' bas dpe mang po bzhag tshe kho tshos gzhi nas rab rib tsam shes kyi yod stabs nga tshos don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te gson nyams ldan la mang tshogs kyis dang len byed bde ba'i thabs shes spyad de slob gso rgyag gi yod/glog brnyan sogs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas slob gso rgyag gi yod pa dang mi rigs khag gi mang tshogs sar dus bkag ltar skor skyod kyis glog brnyan ston pa phud/ tang ud kyi gtan 'bebs ltar dmag dpung gis glog brnyan ston pa'i skabs sdod sa dkyil mar mang tshogs sdod du 'jug dgos pa dang / res gza' lhag pa dang spen pa'i dgong mor mang tshogs las med du mi lus pa'i ched dus bkag gis glog brnyan ston pa dang / ‘‘lnga gcig mi’dang / ‘‘bdun gcig’’ ‘‘brgyad gcig’’ ‘‘rgyal ston ’’sogs gal che'i dus chen skabs glog brnyan ma bstan gong du 'go khrid kyis rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi don chen dang /da lta lag bstar byed mus yin pa'i tang gi srid jus khag 'grel bshad rgyag pa/mang tshogs la gson nyams ldan pa'i rnam pa'i thog nas rgyal gces ring lugs dang spyi tshogs ring lugs/ de bzhin mi rigs mthun sgril dang srid jus sogs dril bsgrags slob gso rgyag gi yod/ ri khrod nags stug tu gnas 108

pa'i teng pas sngar bzhin nyi tshod la brten nas dus tshod nges pa'i thabs shes spyad de dus bkag gi sngon du dmag sgar nang yong nas glog brnyan ston rgyur sgug sdod kyi yod pa dang / dmag sgar nye 'gram gyi bod rigs mi dmangs kyis gcig la gcig sbrel gyis lam bzhu'i tshul du dpal 'bar spar te khyu dang khyu byas nas dmag sgar du yong gi yod/ kho tshos sa phag bsregs khung brgyud skabs tshang mas rang 'gul ngang sa phag bzhi lnga tsam 'khyer nas dmag dpung la dmag sgar rgyag rogs byed kyi yod/ de ltar yun ring song rjes kho tshor shugs rkyen thebs nas rim bzhin mes rgyal chen po yod pa dang / rig gnas yar rgyas song ba/ thon skyed gong 'phel 'gro ba/ zhing las dang bzo las 'phel rgyas 'gro mgyogs pa bcas cung zad legs pa'i tshor snang gi shes rtogs byung yod/ de'i khrod nas rang nyid krung go ba zhig yin par gzi brjid yin snyam pa des mes rgyal gyi lta ba dang / slob sbyong gi lta ba/ de bzhin spyi tshogs ring lugs la dga' zhen byed pa'i bsam blo bcas gong mthor phyin yod/ gzhon nu mang po zhig gi rang 'gul ngang nang sa'i mi dmangs kyi sngon thon thon skyed lag rtsal dang / gtsang sbrar dga' zhing dang dod byed pa'i 'tsho ba'i goms gshis la slob sbyong byed pa dang / nad phog tshe dmag dpung gi sman pa btsal nas bsten pa/ lha 'drer yid ches lta bu'i rmongs dad las 'gul la yang rim bzhin yid ches byed kyi med pa red/gong rim mi sna'i 'thus mi dang mang tshogs hur brtson can sgrig 'dzugs byas te nang sar lta skor la phyin pa dang / snga phyir bsdoms thengs lnga sgrig 'dzugs byas te mi 40lhag tsam phyin yod/ mig mthong lag zin byung ba'i dngos don mang po zhig brgyud nas bsam blo'i slob gso brgyab pa ma zad/kho tsho'i sgrog spel brgyud de mang tshogs la slob gso byed kyi yod cing de'i shugs 109

rkyen thebs tshad ni tshod dpag byed dka' ba zhig yin/ bod rigs kyi 'go pa rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa pad ma 1955lor nang sar lta skor la phyin te phyir log rjes bsarma blor 'gyur ba chen po byung nas zhing bran la res gza' nyi mar ngal gso 'jog pa'i lam lugs lag bstar bya rgyu dril bsgrags byas pa ma zad/ mang tshogs la bcos bsgyur dril bsgrags byas pa dang / de yang dang thog rang khyim gyi sa zhing nas bcos bsgyur bya rgyu 'go tshugs pa red/ khrims 'dzin kho'o yi kho'o krang rnam rgyal gyis rang nyid kyi sa zhing khongs nas rang rmo'i sa zhing phud de byings tshang ma bran g.yog tshor rmo rgyur bgo bsha' brgyab pa ma zad/ kho tshor bcings 'grol btang ste rang nyid kyis 'tsho ba skyel du bcug pa red/ rdza yul chus bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa rdo rje phur bu lha zlas hur brtson chen pos tang nang zhugs rgyu'i re ba bton pa dang khong gis ‘‘gung khran tang ni nga yid che shos byed sa yin pas chu thon zam dper ma song bar nam yang gung khran tang gi rjes su 'gro gi yin ’’zhes bshad yod/ mang tshogs kyi 'thus mi phyir slebs rjes mang tshogs khrod du nang sa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi sngon thon bsam blo dang 'dzugs skrun grub 'bras kyi dpe mtshon brgyud bsgrags byed pa ni de bas yongs khyab chen po red/ gzhon nu'i sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa gnyer nas sa de ga'i gong 'phel dang yar rgyas la sne 'khrid mkhan gso skyong byas yod pa red/ dmag dpung gi 'go pas mos mthun dang gros bsdur byas te snga phyir gzhon nu'i sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa khag gsum gnyer nas mang tshogs dang 'go pa'i khrod kyi hur brtson che la yar rgyas 'gro 'dod yod pa'i bu phrug zhugs su bcug ste mi rigs srid jus dang chab srid kyi rgyun shes sogs slob sbyong byas shing / tang la dga' zhen dang / rgyal khab la dga' 110

zhen/ bcings 'grol dmag mir dga' zhen bcas byed mkhan gso skyong dang / sngon thon thon skyed lag rtsal pa hur brtson can gang sar khyab gdal byas pa'i rjes kho tshos de bas yongs khyab che ba'i sgo nas mang tshogs dang 'brel ba dang / mang tshogs la slob gso/ mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs bcas byas pa brgyud mi rigs gong 'phel dang bya gzhag yar rgyas btang yod/ mi de dag mang che bas rjes su ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang bcos bsgyur la sogs pa'i gal che'i 'thab rtsod khrod hur brtson can gyi nus pa thon yod/mi rigs slob chung 'dzugs gnyer byas pa dang gzhung gron btang ste slob grwa btsugs thog mi sna gso skyong byas yod/ snga phyir 'gro ba dgon dang /rdza yul ri gdong / tsha ba rong bcas su mi rigs khag gi bu phrug slob chung btsugs pa dang / dmag dpung gis mi rigs las don ru khag gi blo mthun zha'o krang dang dge rgan byed par mngags pa/ de snga dmag dpung gi mi rigs las don ru mi chab mdo sa ud kyi hru'u ci blo mthun dbyang ya'o tsha'e ni rdza yul slob chung gi zha'o krang dang po yin pa dang / slob deb med pa'i sa de'i don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te yul bab mtshon pa'i slob gzhi brtsams yod/bza' bca' dang sdod gnas tshang ma gzhung nas 'gan 'khur ba dang de'i khrod nas mdun lam yod pa'i lo chung khag gcig gso skyong bya rgyur nub byang dang krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa che mo gnyis su btang bas mi mang che ba slob grwa thon rjes rang sa khul du log nas las byed pa byas yod pas der mang tshogs 'dod blo ha cang tshim po byung ste teng pas nga tsho'i mes po tshang ma lo stong phrag ring slob grwar 'gro myong med kyang / da lta dngul sprod mi dgos par nga tsho'i bu phrug dpe deb lta rgyu yod la las byed kyang byed rgyu byung ba ni ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku drin yin/ gung khran tang ma slebs tshe gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba lta 111

bu'i bya ba bzang po 'di 'dra yong mi srid ces shod kyi yod/gal che'i dus chen/ dang dmag dmangs kyi gal che'i las 'gul spel ba brgyud rgyal khab la dga' zhen dang / tang la dga' zhen/ bcings 'grol dmag mir dga' zhen bcas kyi bsam blo'i go rtogs je mthor phyin yod/dmag dpung gis ‘‘lnga gcig ’’ rgyal spyi'i ngal rtsol dus chen dang /dmag 'dzugs dus chen/ rgyal ston dus chen bcas la rten 'brel zhu ba'i tshogs chen skong tshogs dang / gnam lo gsar tshes dang dpyid gsar dus chen la 'khrab ston byed pa/ yang na krung dbyang dang lho nus dmag khul khang gi 'tshams 'dri tshogs par bsu ba zhu ba sogs tshang mar mang tshogs zhugs su bcug nas chab srid kyi bsam blo'i slob gso gson nyams ldan pa rgyag gi yod/dus mtshungs mi sna mngags te grong dud du zab zhugs kyis mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun gyi grub 'bras dang tang gi da lta spyod bzhin pa'i srid jus khyab bsgrags dang / lhag par du lo re'i dpyid gsar dus chen gyi sngon rol du las don ru khag sgrig 'dzugs byas te khyim tshang re re bzhin du bskyod nas lo gsar la rten 'brel zhu gi yod/ 1952lor dmag dpung gis mi 1000lhag tsam yod pa'i dmag dmangs mnyam 'brel gyi byas rjes gzengs bstod kyi rten 'brel tshogs chen 'tshogs skabs mang tshogs dang / 'go pa/ grwa pa bcas kyi khrod nas thon skyed dang / skyel 'dren rogs skyor/ lam bzo ba/ spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags srung skyong sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi dpe bzang bdams te dmag dpung gis bdams pa'i byas rjes can dang mnyam du byas rjes la rten 'brel zhu ba'i tshogs chen dang / bzhugs mol/ 'khrab ston las 'gul bcas la zhugs su 'jug gi yod/ dmag dpung gi dbu 'dzin dang rdzong 112

bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid kyis byas rjes can dang dpe bzang mi sna tshor kha btags gnang ba dang / me tog dmar po 'dogs pa/gzengs bstod byed pa/ rta khrid nas skyel bsu byed pa/ mnyam du kha lag za ba sogs byas par kho tsho'i yid la sngar byung ma myong ba'i chab srid kyi mtshan snyan longs spyod bya rgyu byung snyam pa dang rang nyid bdag po ngo ma yin pa shes tshor byung thog sems 'gul thebs bzhin du ‘‘dmag dpung gi 'go khrid tshos nga tsho mi dkyus ma dang bran g.yog tsho rta thog tu skyel bsu byed pa dang me tog btags pa ni dngos gnas lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i bya ba zhig yin zhing spyi tshogs ring lugs dngos gnas yag po yin pa dang bcings 'grol dmag dngos gnas yag po yin pa/ gung khran tang dngos gnas mkhas mdzangs ldan pa zhig red ’’ces brjod kyi yod/nga tshos las don dngos kyi khrod nas nyams zhib byung don du/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus ni mar khe si le nyin ring lugs kyi mi rigs lta ba mtshon pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi ngo bo mtshon pa/ rgyal gces ring lugs kyi gal che'i rang bzhin ldan pa bcas yin/ rgyal gces zhes pa ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang / gung khran tang gi 'go khrid la brtsi bkur byed pa de yin/ de yang blo brtan 'gyur med kyis tang gi mi rigs srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol dang mi rigs gong 'phel gyi bya gzhag yar rgyas yong phyir mang tshogs kyi hur brtson rang bzhin skul slong gang legs byas te spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod ljongs gsar pa dang rdza yul gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed ched 'bad brtson chen po bya rgyu de yin/gsum/rdza yul ni sa bab bzang la gnam gshis dro grang snyoms pas chu 'bras 113

dang zhing las skye dngos sna tshogs btab na chog pa dang / nang sa'i kwa rigs dang shing tog mang po 'dems 'dzugs byas na chog kyang bcings 'grol ma btang gong mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi dug tsub che ba'i bshu gzhog gyi rkyen pas mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba ha cang skyo po yin pa dang / rong sar gnas kyang thon skyed lag rtsal rjes lus yin pas skam zhing 'debs rgya che yang thon 'bab nyung ba dang lud rgyag pa sogs mi byed par gnam la brten nas 'tsho thabs byed pas thon tshad ha cang zhan po red/ teng pa ri mthor gzhis chags yod cing da dung mu mthud bsregs rmos gris 'debs dang lo ltar thon skyed byas pa'i bza' 'brus zla ba gsum bzhi tsam las 'dang gi med/ lho pa rigs ni rngon rgyag par brten nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod pas 'tsho bar 'gan srung med/dmag dpung gi tang ud kyis don dngos de dag las mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i go rtogs gong mthor gtong ba dang dus mtshungs mi rigs khag gi thon skyed gong 'phel dang 'tsho ba legs bcos gtong rgyur rogs ram byed pa ni mi rigs mthun sgril dang mi rigs yar rgyas 'gro ba'i dngos po'i rmang gzhi brtan shos shig yin pa shes rtogs byung / dmag dpung rdza yul du 'byor nas yun ring ma 'gor bar tang ud kyis las byed 'thab 'dzing pa sgrig 'dzugs byas te zhing las thon skyed gong 'phel gtong bar 'go khrid du bcug pa dang /dmag dpung gi rang kha rang gso'i nus pa je cher gtong ba'i brgyud rim nang bya spyod ngo ma'i thog nas mang tshogs kyi thon skyed bya rgyu dang 'tsho ba'i chu tshad gong mthor gtong rgyur shugs rkyen thebs yod/ dmag dpung gi dpon dmag tshos thon skyed byed pa'i brgyud rim nang dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyi snying stobs dar spel byas pa dang / lo ngo stong phrag ring sa stong du lus par sa zhing gshin po mu'u 〈rkyakyalhag tsam gsar sbol byas te chu 'bras dang / gro/114

ma rmos lo tog ba dam sogs btab yod/ 'thab 'dzing pa tshos pha yul gyi spun mched tshor 'bri chu'i lho byang gnyis kyi son bzang sna tshogs bskur du bcug ste sngon ma 'debs skyong ma myong ba'i shi'i kwa dang / nan kwa/ rgya tsong /sgog pa/ pad tshal/ la phug sur pan/ che tsi/ sran ma/ u sun sogs tshal dang kwa rigs sna kha 20lhag tsam 'debs 'dzugs byas pas 1956lor 'bru rigs dang tshal rigs khyon bsdoms rgya ma khri 20lhag tsam thon skyed thub ste 'bru rigs gsum cha gcig dang sngo tshal rang mkho rang thon thub pa des rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi blo sgo phye ba dang dmag dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen legs bcos chen po byung yod/dmag dpung rang nyid kyis thon skyed byed pa dang dus mtshungs da du ṅka ci mi khag gcig sgrig 'dzugs byas te mang tshogs kyi dpyid 'debs dang ston bsdur 'char gzhi ldan pa'i thon skyed rogs ram byed par mngags shing /dmag dpung gi chu 'bras 'debs 'dzugs dang / rtsa ngan 'gog thabs /lud rgyag thabs/ chu 'dren thabs sogs kyi lag rtsal mang tshogs khrod du khyab spel btang bas mang tshogs kyi rjes lus thon skyed dang goms gshis la bsgyur bcos byung ba dang / thon skyed chu tshad gong mthor phyin yod/ da dung dmag dpung rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i thon skyed lag cha mi rigs khag gi mang tshogs la sprad yod/ dmag dpung gis lo ltar mang tshogs dbul phongs la son dang bza' 'bru sprod pa dang / hur brtson chen pos gsar sbol byed rogs byas pa ma zad gsar sbol byas pa'i zhing sa gshin po mu'u 500tsam mang tshogs la sprad de 'debs 'dzugs byed du bcug yod/ lhag par du chab mdo nyen zon bde srung dmag khul khang gi dmag spyi gzhon pa dmar dmag snying pa cin rung kung gis 1kha54lor shar gyi me stag thun mong zhing rwa nas khyer yong ba'i 115

'bras son dag las byed 'thab 'dzing pa tshos nan tan ngang 'debs gso byas pa brgyud snye ma rer 'bras rdog 2 00lhag tsam thon thub rgyur dmag sgar gyi dmag mi yongs kyis do 'khur chen po byas pa red/ ston bsdu zin rjes grong gnyis po'i mang tshogs la 'bras tshod 'debs bya rgyur sprad de lo legs chen po byung ba des sa de'i mang tshogs kyis sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas lag rtsal legs bcos dang son bzang 'dems sgrug gi gal che'i rang bzhin shes pa dang / sngon thon lag rtsal slob sbyong byed pa'i mang tshogs kyi spro snang 'phel yod/ dmag dpung gis 'go khrid cing rogs skyor byas par brten mi rigs khag la thon skyed gong spel dang 'tsho ba legs bcos byed pa'i tsha rlabs shig 'phyur zhing / 1956lor mang tshogs kyi khyim tshang tshang mar 'bru rigs lhag ma yod pa dang khul yongs kyis lo gcig la 'bru rigs lhag ma zla ba gsum bzhi tsam 'deng ba gsog nyar byed thub kyi yod pa dang / skabs der dmag dpung gis mdzod nyar byas pa'i skyob gso'i bza' 'bru rgya ma khri 2tsam zin pa de sprod sa med par gyur pa/ sa smad grong sde rgya chen po med rung sa rgod mu'u brgyad cu lhag tsam gsar sbol byas pa dang / spyi lo 1kha54lo kho nar 'bru rigs rgya ma rdzo600 0lhag tsam thon 'phar byung yod/ sa de'i rgan rgon tshos rgyun du bu tsha rnams la ‘‘bcings 'grol dmag mi slebs pa'i rjes nga tshor bden don zhig bshad yod de/ bde skyid ni ngal rtsol gyis bskrun pa dang thon skyed gong 'phel ni nga tsho phyug po'i lam du 'gro ba'i lam bu dngos gnas de yin ’’zhes shod kyi yod pa red/ 1952lor dmag dpung gis yun nan dmag khul khang gi 'char gzhi ltar rang nyid kyis lag pa sgul nas dngos gzhi can gyi dmag sgar skrun yod par shing bzo dang / sa phag sgrig sbyor sogs tshang ma rang nyid kyis gcig nas slob sbyong dang gnyis nas bya ba dngos nang 116

zhugs par brten dgos kyi yod/ phyi gzugs lta na sdug la gral star 'grig po'i dmag sgar re re bzhin 'gying nger thon pa'i skabs/ mtha' bskor gyi mang tshogs khyu dang khyu byas te dmag sgar du yong nas dri ba sna tshogs bton par 'thab 'dzing pa tshos spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang kho tshor sne len byed pa dang 'grel bshad rgyag gi yod/ mang tshogs tsho rgyun chad med par ha las hang sang gis mthe bong bsgrengs bzhin ‘‘bcings 'grol dmag mi ni dngos gnas byang chub sems dpa' yin 'dug ste las ka gang yang byed thub kyi 'dug nga tsho khang pa 'di 'drar sdod rgyu byung na ci ma rung ’’ces shod kyi yod/ mang tshogs mi nyung ba zhig gis dmag dpung mig dper bzung nas rim bzhin lag pa sgul te rang nyid kyi shing khang dang / shing lpags kyi khang pa/ 'jag khang bcas bsgyur bcos byas te sdod gnas kyi cha rkyen legs bcos byas pa dang 'ga' zhig gis da dung thog brtsegs can gyi sdod khang bskrun yod/dmag dpung gis da dung lam bzo ba dang zam pa brgyab ste mtha' mtshams dang nang sa'i dbar gyi 'grim 'grul 'brel mthud byas yod/ rdza yul du thog mar bskyod pa'i skabs dmag dpung rang nyid kyis lag pa sgul zhing ‘‘mer bsregs chu gtor ’’gyi thabs shes spyad nas rdo chen 'bar gtor btang ste sa g.yom gyis gtor ba'i 'gro ba dgon nas rdza yul bar gyi rta lam le dbar nyis brgya yod pa bskyar bzo byas pa dang / bod rigs spun zla'i zam pa rgyag pa'i thabs shes rnying pa bed spyad de rdza chu'i lam brgyud la zam pa che chung bsdoms bzhi bcu lhag tsam btsugs pa dang / 'gro ba dgon nas mgo chen bar gyi rta lam de yang mang tshogs kyis bcings 'grol dmag mi'i thabs shes la slob sbyong byas te rgya che ru btang ba red/ de'i rjes sa cha gzhan dag dang nyo tshong byed pa brgyud sa de'i mi dmangs la mkho ba'i ja lo dang / tshwa/117

nyin mkho'i 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho sna tshogs kyi dka' ngal sel/ dmag dpung gis da dung rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang la gzhogs 'degs kyis nyo 'tshong kung si dang / sbrag khang / sman bcos 'phrod bsten las khungs sogs btsugs pas mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba stabs bde ru phyin pa dang mang tshogs kyis sa de rang nas thon pa'i rtsa che'i dngos rdzas snyi ba dang / gla rtsi/ dom mkhris/dbyar rtsa dgun dbu/ de bzhin pags rigs sogs dang nang sa'i dngos rdzas brje res byas pas mang tshogs kyi yong 'bab mang du phyin pa dang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad gong mthor phyin pa red/rdza yul ni 'dar nad dang / 'khru nad/ mgrin nad/ rgyu tshad sogs nad yams tshabs chen mched khul zhig yin pa dang / sngon ma mang tshogs la nad rigs byung tshe sman med pa dang sman bcos byed thabs med par lha mchod 'dre skrod la brten dgos pas mi mi nyung ba zhig shi zhing / nang mi tshang ma shi ba dang / grong tsho yongs kyi grong mi shi ba'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhig kyang byung myong yod/ de sngon dmag dpung gnas sa'i ri kha thang sder gyi grong mi ni rims nad byung nas shi ba sha stag red/ dmag dpung rdza yul du 'byor rjes mang tshogs la rogs ram byas te nad 'gog nad bcos bya rgyu de spun zla mi rigs mthun sgril dang gong 'phel yong ba'i gal che'i las 'gan zhig tu brtsis nas dam 'dzin byas yod/ 'phrod bsten ru khag gi blo mthun tshos sku ngal la ma 'dzems par zhing dud du zab 'jug gis rims 'gog nad bcos byas pa dang / dus tshod gtan 'khel thog mang tshogs tshor rims 'gog sman khab rgyag pa dang / khor yug gtsang ma bzo ba/ chu mgo legs bcos/ nad pa tshor dus thog tu sman bcos bcas byas yod/ bsdoms brtsis brgyab par gzhigs na/ 1955lo'i skabs dmag dpung gis mang tshogs mi grangs 118

12 260la nad bcos byas yod pa dang / nad gzhi tshabs chen phog pa khag gcig dmag dpung gi sman khang du bsus nas sman bcos byas pa red/1954lor rtsa ba'i thog nas rims nad bkag 'gog thub pa byung zhing / mi shi tshad de bas nyung du phyin yod pas spun zla mi rigs kyi bde thang dang mi grangs rgyun srol ltar gong 'phel yong rgyur srung skyob byung yod pas mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis gus bkur dang thugs rje che zhu gi yod/ 'phrod bsten ru khag gi tud krang wa ci h+pha yi bza' zlar phru gu btsas pa sa de'i mang tshogs kyis shes rjes mi mi nyung ba zhig gis bca' dngos khyer nas bkri shis bde legs zhu bar yong ba red/ teng pa'i a ma rgan mo zhig yod pa des ma rmos lo tog slo ma gang sprad de rang nyid kyi bsam pa mtshon par byas yod/ thon skyed gong 'phel dang mang tshogs kyi rang kha rang gso'i nus pa gong mthor phyin pa dang / dngos zog brje res rgya cher phyin pa/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad gong mthor phyin pa/ de bzhin bde thang gi cha rkyen legs 'gyur byung ba dang sprags mi rigs khag dbar mthun sgril de bas zab pa dang / dmag dmangs brtse sems de bas zab pa/ dmag dmangs mnyam du mtha' mtshams 'dzugs skrun dang rgyal mtshams mnyam srung gi rnam pa bzang po de bas sra brtan bcas byung yod/bzhi/grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rang skyong nus pa gong mthor gtong ched mi rigs las byed ni tang dang spun zla mi rigs bar gyi 'brel bar shugs snon rgyag pa'i zam pa lta bu yin zhing / grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed gso skyong bya rgyu ni tang de mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs khrod du rtsa ba tshugs par byed pa'i 119

gal che'i gnad don zhig yin pa dang de ni mi rigs rang skyong sa khongs dang /mi rigs rang nyid bdag skyong lag bstar byas te mi rigs sa khul yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong bar skul 'ded byed pa'i 'thab jus dang byed phyogs shig yin pa nga tshos lag len dngos kyi thog nas shes rtogs byung /dmag dpung gis yun nan du bod bskyod gra sgrig byed pa'i dus rim nang rim pa gong ma'i mdzub ston gzhir bzung bde chen sa khul gyi rgya skad shes pa dang / yar rgyas mdun lam yod pa'i bod rigs dang / 'jang rigs sogs kyi gzhon nu 'dems sgrug byas te mi 25las grub pa'i mi rigs las don ru khag cig sgrig 'dzugs byas nas gso skyong sbyong brdar byas pa brgyud dmag dpung dang mnyam du bod bskyod byas pa dang / lam bar du mang tshogs kyi las ka dang yig bsgyur las ka byas yod/ dmag dpung rdza yul du dpung bskyod byas rjes tang ud kyis las don ru khag gi las 'gan gtso bo ni mi rigs mang tshogs kyi las don sgrub rgyu dang rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang la gzhon 'degs kyis srid dbang skyong ba'i las don sgrub rgyuci de yin pa'i thag gcod byas yod/ las don ru khag gi blo mthun tshos dka' tshegs che ba'i 'thab rtsod sna tshogs nang bsam blo dang chab srid kyi chu tshad dang las ka'i nus shugs rgyun chad med par gong mthor btang yod/ kho tshos dka' ngal la mi skrag par bod rigs grong dud dang / teng pa'i ri khul/ de bzhin rdza yul stod kyi lho pa rigs dang / ri gdong gi tu'u lung rigs bca' sdod khul la zab 'jug gis brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas te tang gi mi rigs srid jus lag bstar dang mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs byas te thon skyed gong 'phel btang ba dang / 'phrod bsten rims 'gog ru khag dang mnyam du mang tshogs la rogs ram byas te nad 'gog nad bcos byas par phan 'bras ha cang bzang 120

po thob yod/ kho tshos da dung mtha' mtshams khul gyi rtsa che'i lo rgyus dang sa khams/ de bzhin mi dmangs kyi yul goms gshis lugs skor gyi rgyu cha bcas mi nyung ba zhig 'tshol bsdu thub pa des sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas mi rigs mthun sgril gyi las don sgrub rgyu dang mtha' mtshams brtan srung la dpyad gzhi mkho 'don byas yod/ blo mthun de dag gis yun ring spun zla mi rigs dang mnyam za mnyam 'thung dang las don spel ba'i nang nyams myong ha cang mang po gsog 'jog byas shing rang nyid kyi nus par yang sbyong brdar byas yod/ de snga'i chab mdo sa gnas tang u'i hru'u ci kron yon blo mthun dbyang ya'o tsha'e ni mi rigs las don ru khag khrod kyi bod rigs las byed cig yin pa dang /las don ru khag gi khrod du mi rigs las byed bcu phrag kha shas yod pa de dag mang che ba rjes su bod ljongs kyi rdzong rim pa dang chus rim pa'i las byed du 'tshar longs byung yod/ khag gcig gis dka' spyad snying rus kyis las ka byas pa dang / ngal dub kyis mnar yang mtha' mtshams 'dzugs skrun dang /rgyal mtshams sra brtan yong ched rtsa che'i tshe srog kyang phul yod pa dper na/bod rigs las byed blo mthun wu'u zhan ku'e yis sa smad khul du lo 2 0lhag tsam las ka byed ring blo gcig sems gcig gis bod rigs mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhus stabs mang tshogs khrod du bla na med pa'i ming grags yod pa dang / ‘‘bod sdod pa rnying pa mi’dang / ‘‘mtha' srung ba rnying pa ’’zhes yongs grags su brjod kyi yod/ lhag par du mtha' mtshams brgal mkhan mi rigs mang tshogs kyi 'gro 'ong gnas tshul gsal por shes pa dang / grongs khar rang nyid kyi phung po sa smad du sbas rgyu'i kha chems bzhag pa des khong gis mi rigs las don ched du nam 'tsho'i ba ra zhabs zhur brtson pa gsal por mtshon yod/thabs shes sna mang spyad de gso skyong byas pa brgyud sa de'i mi rigs las byed 121

mi nyung ba zhig myur du 'tshar longs byung nas rdzong dang chus rim pa'i las 'gan 'khur yod pa dper na/ krung gung rdza yul rdzong ud kyi hru'u ci gzhon pa blo mthunakhang h+phu hwa (bod rigs bud med ) krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa che mor sbyong brdar byas te thon pa zhig red/dmag dpung tang ud kyis sa gnas srid dbang khrod du mi rigs las byed kyi nus pa 'don spel bya rgyur ha cang mthong chen byed kyi yod/ de snga'i dmag dpung gi chab srid u yon dang sa gnas tang ud kyi hru'u ci/ rdzong u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gcig lcogs bcas gnang ba'i blo mthun wang rje rmin gyis las ka'i khrod las bgos 'gan 'khur dang bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes zhing / khong gis gal che'i gnad don 'phrad skabs mnyam du gros mol byas te thag gcod byed pa las mi gcig gis bshad par brtsi rgyu med pa'i rtsa don lag bstar byed thub pa dang /mi rigs nang khul dbar gyi 'brel ba'i gnad don khag gcig la mi rigs de rang gi las byed gdan zhus kyis thag gcod byed par mngags pas kho tsho'i mthun 'grig gi nus pa 'don spel byed thub pa ma zad mang tshogs khrod kho tsho'i snyan grags kyang che ru phyin yod/ sa khul de'i 'go pa dang / srid dbang sgrig 'dzugs khrod kyi mi rigs las byed tshos ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur/ de bzhin krung hin bar gyi rang srung rgol lan slog pa'i dmag 'thab bcas kyi khrod du nus pa ha cang yag po thon yod pas der ngo log zing 'khrug lang myong med pa dang / sa gzhan gyi ngo log zing 'khrug pas rdza yul du lkog 'dzul gyis 'brel mthun byas te zing cha slong rtsis byas pa tshang ma sa de'i mang tshogs kyis bkag pa red/ de dag gi thog nas dmag dpung tang ud kyis dpon dmag sgrig 'dzugs dang / mi 122

rigs las don ru khag la spel ba'i mi rigs las don tan tig bya rgyu de mi rigs mang tshogs kyi khrod du rtsa ba brtan por tshugs pa dang 'bras bu smin pa je gsal du mtshon yod/dmag dpung dang sa gnas srid dbang gis da dung mtha' 'khob sa khul nas rdza yul du yul gyar yong ba'i spun zla mi rigs kyi lo chung gzhon nu khag gcig nyar gso byas yod pa dang / kho tshor gso skyong slob gso byas pa brgyud khag gcig rjes su mi rigs las byed du 'tshar longs byung yod/dmag dpung ga ge mo'i drag jus pa dge rong (teng pa ) ni chung ngu'i dus su khyim gzhis med par lto slong nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan zhig yin/ khong rdza yul du 'khyams yong skabs dmag dpung gis nyar gso byas te rdza yul slob chung du slob sbyong byed par mngags pa dang rjes su dmag dpung nang zhugs te gsar 'gyur rtsom 'bri mkhan byas pa dang / krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa che mor zab sbyong du'ang btang bas chab srid rig gnas kyi chu tshad gong mthor song ste da lta mtha' srung sa tshigs ga ge mo'i drag jus pa yin/ da lta rdza yul rdzong drag chas pu'u yi hrang sha'o go gnas ldan pa'i krang sung wu'u (teng pa )yang mtha' mtshams sa khul nas yul gyar du yong rjes dmag dpung nang zhugs pa dang /de rjes krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa che mo dang dmag don slob grwa che mo ga ge mor zab sbyong du'ang btang ste rim bzhin gso skyong byas pa'i mi rigs las byed zhig red/mjug bsdu'i gtam/1956lo'i lo stod la bod ljongs dmag khul khang chab srid dril bsgrags pu'i pu'u krang wang kung la'e yis las don ru khag gi sne 'khrid de rdza 123

yul du slebs pa dang / lo phyed lhag tsam brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas pa brgyud rdza yul dmag dpung tang ud kyis las byed 'thab 'dzing pa sgrig 'dzugs byas te mi rigs las don sgrub pa'i nyams myong phyogs bsdoms byas pa ma zad ljongs yongs kyi mtha' srung dmag dpung la khyab spel btang bar phan 'bras ha cang bzang po thon pa tshang mas gdeng 'jog gang legs byed kyi yod/rdza yul sa khul bcings 'grol btang ste lo 40'khor ba'i skabs 'dir nga tshos bod bskyod thog mar byed skabs kyi dka' tshegs che ba'i lo zla'i nang mi rigs las don sgrub pa'i skor lo rgyus dang gnas tshul legs sgrig byas te sngar bzhin bod ljongs spyi dang bye brag rdza yul du phyag las gnang bzhin pa'i blo mthun tshor nga tshos bod ljongs kyi las don la sems 'khur dang rdza yul gyi spun zla mi rigs dang dmag dpung gi blo mthun tsho dran sems mtshon byed tsam du phul/ mjug tu bod ljongs su phyag las gnang bzhin pa'i blo mthun tshos tang krung dbyang dang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang / bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud/bod ljongs dmag khul khang tang ud bcas kyi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og yang 'bad bskyar 'bad kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs bod ljongs gsar pa dang rdza yul gsar pa'i 'dzugs skrun ched du 'bad brtson gnang rgyu'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin/(phun tshogs kyis bsgyur/)124

de snga'i man yang gron chus kyi si khron khrang zhi tshogs pa ang gnyis pa bod du bskyod pa'i skor gyi dran tho thor bu/chi'u wun kang gisabashad desadabyang kha'i tisalegasasgrig byas/gcig si khron nas thon te bod du bskyod pa/1959lo'i ston ka shar mtshams su nga tsho man yang kron chus kyi si khron khrang zhi tshogs pa ang gnyis pa grong gseb khul du skor bskyod 'khrab ston byed bzhin yod pa nas mi khag gcig pheng la grong rdal du yod cing ngas sne khrid pa'i mi khag gcig su'i nying rdzong pad+ma shang du yod/ nga tshos mtshan mor 'khrab ston byed pa dang nyin mor ‘‘dar cha dmar po gsum ’dril bsgrags byed pa dang sbrags grong gseb kyi ‘‘mdun mchong chen po'i ’’ngal rtsol nang bzhugs bzhin yod/ nyin zhig nga zhing kha'i nang 'bras brnga bsdu byed bzhin yod/ de skabs ston thog 'bras bu smin nas gser mdog can du gyur zin pas gong rim gyi bka' ltar zhing kha 'ga' zhig gi ston thog zhing kha gcig gi nang du bsags nas mi rnartsa/sa lta skor byed du bcug nas ‘‘thon tshad mtho ba'i srung skar ’’zhig bzos te nam mkhar 'phangs bsam gyi yod/125

nga'i lus la 'dam bag gis bcings shing dngul chu 'dzar 'dzar du ngal rtsol byed pa'i skabs glo bur du rdzong la lam seng phyir log dgos pa'i brda 'byor nas dza drag gi gnas tshul 'dug ces bshad byung / nga 'phral du rdzong la phyir log byas pa na man yang kron chus kyi rig slob kho'o krang kro'u ci yā sogs ched mngags man yang nas su'i nying si khron khrang zhi tshogs par phebs te nga la gong rim gyi bka' brgyud bsgrags gnang nas bod sdod dpung sde'i nang si khron gyi dmag mi mang po yod pas khong tshos pha yul dang gnyen nye rnams shin tu dran po byed kyi yod stabs nga tsho'i khrang zhi tshogs pa bod du bskyod nas 'tshams 'dri'i 'khrab ston nang zhugs dgos zhes gsungs/ kro'u ci yā yis nga la ‘‘de ni chab srid kyi las 'gan ha cang gzi brjid chen po zhig yin la shin tu dka' tshegs che ba zhig kyang yin pas khyed kyis kri pu'u hru'u ci dang thon krang gcig lcogs kyi ngos nas blo 'gug skul slong gi las ka yag po byed dgos/ khyed la dus tshod zla gnyis gra sgrig bya rgyur sprad na yong ba 'dug gam ’’zhes gsungs byung / ngas bsam blo yud tsam btang rjes ‘‘don de lcags tsha thog la rdung na dga'/ mtshan ring na rmi lam mang zhes pa'i dpe ltar dus tshod ji tsam 'gyangs na de tsam gyis zhib phra'i gnad don mang po thon rgyu yin pas nga tsho gang mgyogs ngang thon thub pa'i brtson len byed kyi yin ’’zhes zhus pa yin/skad cha khyab ma thag tshogs pa'i nang skad cor gyis khengs shing la las sa cha der 'gro ga la nyan/ gangs dang 'khyags pa'i sa der rna cog 'khyags nas lhung 'gro ba dang / gcin gtong skabs grang ngad kyis hreng nas dbyugs pas snun dgos zhes dang / la las bod kyi ngo log jag pa rnams gtum drag shin tu che bas mi mthong ma thag lpags pa bshu ba dang / rting rtsa gcod pa/ mig 126

'bras 'don pa sogs byed pas der bskyod tshe phyir log rtsis ma byed ces zer ba dang / yang la las nga tsho bod du bskyod tshe bza' mi bu phrug gang 'dra byed dgos sam zhes shod kyi 'dug skabs der ngas dus tshod dam 'dzin gyis kri pu'u tshogs 'du dang 'khrab ston pa dang las byed mi sna'i tshogs 'du skong 'tshogs byas nas go skon skul slong byas pa ma zad mi mi re ngo re btsal nas gleng mol byas shing / tang yon dang thon yon gyis ming tho 'god rgyur sne khrid dgos pa'i re ba bton pa yin/ de rjes mi ring bar tshang ma'i bsam blo brtan lhing du gyur nas rtsa 'dzugs kyi bkod sgrig la brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu zhu rgyu'i chod sems bzhag pa red/ nga tshos na rgas gzugs gcong dang gzhi khungs yag po med pa/ chab srid dang lo rgyus thad kyi gnad don yod pa'i mi rnams rang sar bzhag pa dang gzhan yang skabs der 'gro 'dod med mkhan gsum yod pa de tshor yang u tshugs byas med kyang rjes su rang 'gul gyis yong yod/ mthar bod du bskyod mkhan khyon bsdoms gtan 'khel mi grangs 1rkya〈yod pa de dag la bod sdod dpung sdes mi rer khyim 'dzugs dod dngul zla ba gsum re'i gla phogs sprad de tshang ma'i khyim don gyi sems khral sel rogs byas pa ma zad/ lam bar du mkho ba'i 'gro gron grangs tshad ltar sprad yod/phyogs gang ci'i thad la thag gcod bya rgyu yag po byung stabs gza' 'khor gcig ma song bar nga tsho'i bod bskyod dpung sde de thon thub pa byung /gnyis/ tshwa 'dam gyi nyen kha brgyud pa/nga tsho su'i nying nas rlangs 'khor du zhugs te man yang du 'byor zhing man yang nas me 'khor la zhugs te sba'o ci'i ru bskyod/ nga tsho'i khrod kyi mi mang po zhig me 'khor la zhugs te thag ring du bskyod pa thengs dang po yin 127

pas tshang ma'i spro ba rab tu 'khol zhing / de'i khar da dung gzhon nu lo chung mang po yod/ rmi tse zhi'u sogs lo 12 14yi bu mo chung chung sha stag yin/dbyang h+phung ching gnyen sgrig byas ma thag yin pa dang / wang yung khrang lo 11chung thos hu'u hre jon lo 9yin gshis las ka tsag tsig byed mkhan kreng thing kong phud nga rgan shos yin/ tshang ma me 'khor nang kha brda glod pa dang dgod slong zhing gzhas dang zhabs bros ha go 'di go med par sba'o ci'i ru slebs/ si khron nas phyir thon pa thengs dang po yin pas byang phyogs kyi yul ljongs mthong skabs tshang mar ngo mtshar shin tu che ba'i tshor snang byung / sba'o ci'i ru si khron ltar 'tsho ba skyo po de 'dra med cing / me 'khor 'bab tshugs su bya sha bsregs ma 'tshong mkhan mang po yod pas tshang ma mthong ba tsam gyis 'gram chu ldang / am khrag nang du'ang dngul 'khur rgyu yod stabs mi res bya de re nyos te bza' gin bsdad/ de nas yun ring ma song bar nga tsho lan kro'u phyogs su 'gro ba'i me 'khor du zhugs shing lam bar du sngar bzhin dga' dga' spro spro'i rnam pas khengs/ lan kro'u ru nyin shas sdod skabs cung ma goms pa zhig byung ba gtso bo 'bras bza' rgyu dkon zhing mang che ba thug pa dang kring mog bza' dgos pas mi la la pha yul si khron yid la dran/ skabs der lan zhin lcags lam de sgo gsum 'gag sgo'i shar bar du ma gtogs 'brel med pas sgo gsum 'gag sgo'i shar la slebs rjes rlangs 'khor du mi zhugs dka' med red/ bod dmag khul khang lan kro'u bca' sdod don gcod khru'u yis rlangs 'khor ru khag zhig nga tsho bskyel bar mngags 'dug pas tshang ma khag bgosaḥnas bcings 'grol rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor chen po lnga drug zhig nang zhugs shing rang rang so so'i mal chas dang gyon chas rlangs 'khor thog 'khur yod pa dang / 'khrab ston gyi 'khrab chas rnams zur du 128

rlangs 'khor nang du blugs nas nga tsho'i rjes su 'brangs nas yod/ rlangs 'khor ru khag gral star ring por bsgrigs nas sa mtho'i nub phyogs su bskyod cing / gzhung lam thog thal rdul 'tshub pa de ni g.yu 'brug 'khyug pa ji bzhin yun ring ma yal bar gnas yod mod/ mi tshang ma sngar bzhin spro ba rab tu brtas pas lam bar du ci bsam smra zhing ci dgar dgod nas bskyod/de nas yun ring ma song bar chi lin ri bo brgal skabs rlangs 'khor rim bzhin mtho sar bskyod mtshams kha ba bu yug je cher song nas gangs gsog je mang du 'gro ba dang gso rlung je nyung du song nas tshang ma'i sems yang je grang du song / khrang zhi'i dar gzhon bud med 'khrab mkhan h+phan kren hen sems skyo nas ngu shor/ kho mos ngus ma thag gzhan rnams kyang skyo snang skyes nas dbang med du tshang ma ngu shor/ nga tsho thon skabs dmag dpung nas gtan 'bebs 'di ltar byas par rlangs 'khor la brgal skabs kha lo ba sdod sa'i nang nges par du 'go khrid bsdad de kha lo ba dang 'phros mol byas nas kha lo ba grung por sdod thabs byas te gnyid mi shor ba'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ gang lags she na/gsorlung nyung bas thang chad sla zhing kha lo bas mig cher gdangs nas rlangs 'khor gtong bzhin du gnyis ltas byed/ skabs der 'khrab ston pa zhig yid shin tu skyo bzhin du ngu ba ngas thos byung bas rlangs 'khor kha bkag tu bcug nas kho mo kha lo ba sdod sa'i nang sdod du bcug ste rang nyid rlangs 'khor gyi steng du langs nas dgod bro'i gtam yang yang smras nas tshang mar dgod bslangs te tun hong bar bskyod/tun hong du nyin shas ngal gso brgyab nas skad grags yod pa'i mo'o ka/'o brag phug la lta bskor byas rjes tshang ma lhod du bab/ 'on kyang phyogs bzhi'i lung stong la rgyang lta byed pas na/ mtha' yas bye thang steng du ston gyi 129

rlung bu ldang / bye rdul gyis ngo gdong 'gebs shing 'gro sa'i lam thag ha cang ring snyam/ gnam gshis grang ngad che bas dmigs sa'i yul der ga dus slebs thub min mi shes/ de skabs bud med 'khrab ston pa'i yid la ‘‘kra'o cun 'gag las byon pa'i mi’skabs kyi yid gdung ba'i tshor snang rang shugs su 'char rgyu 'gog tu med/ skabs der mi 'ga' zhig phyir bshol byed cing nga'i rna 'gram la tshang ma khyim tshang dran shugs che bas nga tsho phyir log byas na tag tag red/ lo hran khul gyi si khron khrang zhi tshogs pa lan kro'u nas phyir log byas 'dug nga tsho 'di bar yong ba yag po zhe drag red ces bshad/ de'i lan du ngas de 'dra byas na ga la 'grig si khron gyi dmag mi mang po zhig gis nga tsho'i khrang zhi blta rgyur sgug bsdad yod pas nga tshos lam phyed tsam nas phyir log byas na si khron pha yul gcig par gdong bstan nus sam zhes smras pa na/glo bur du yid la si khron khrang zhi'i nang gi gzhas tshig dum bu gcig dran byung ba de glu la len pa 'di ltar ‘‘khyed kyi khyo bo yong sar nga'i khyo bo yong mi thub bam ’’mi gzhan 'gro thub sar nga tsho yang 'gro thub/ gang ltar nges par 'gro thag chod yin zhes bshad/tun hong nas kha bral te yun ring ma song bar mtsho sngon gyi sa khongs su slebs/ de ni lam brgyud hril po'i nang dka' tshegs che shos kyi brgyud rim de yin/ rlangs 'khor rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmis 2000yod pa'i tshwa 'dam sa gshong du slebs shing / der bde thang sa khul dang bsdur na gso rlung brgya cha 40 — 50tsam nyung ba dang sngo bsangs kyi nam mkha' phud/ mig lam du mthong rgyu bye thang ma gtogs med cing / rtswa dang lcang ma/ bya byi'u sogs gang yang mthong rgyu med la mi ni de bas mthong rgyu med pa dang nyin shas song yang chu thig gcig kyang mthong bar dkon/ de nas mdun du bskyod tshe mu 130

mtha' med pa'i tshwa khar slebs shing rlangs 'khor tshwa mtshe'u 'gram du bskyod skabs mtha' skor du dkar thing thing gi ze tshwas khengs nas shar lho nub byang dbye mi thub/ nyin zhig rlangs 'khor tshwa zam ring po zhig gi thog bskyod skabs nga rlangs 'khor gyi steng du langs nas yod/ mdun phyogs nas 'khor lo bcu sgrig gi rlangs 'khor chen po zhig rlung gis 'ded pa ltar btang yong gi 'dug pas ngas lam sang rlangs 'khor gyi thog nas brdung ste ‘‘rlangs 'khor zur bshol byed dgos/ rlangs 'khor zur bshol byed dgos ’’ces skad brgyab kyang phyis drags nas 'khor lo bcu sgrig gi rlangs 'khor des nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor gyi rna la brdung nas gzhogs gcig la bkug pa dang rlangs 'khor mgo rting slog nas 'khor lo gnam la bstan/ mi rnams tshwa'i steng la lhung / nga'i mgo brtol nas khrag dang lbu ba dkar pos zhwa mo'ang brlan par gyur nas lus/g.yas kyi rtsib ma gsum chag nas de ma thag dran pa thor/ dus yun ga tshod song min mi shes par rang nyid dran pa gsos skabs gor mo'i lcags lam sman khang gi nyal khri'i thog lus te 'dug rjes su tshang mas de skor gleng skabs gzhi nas shes gsal la la'e ta'i sa tshigs shig yod pa de'i la'e ta'i brnyan shel thog nas nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor la bgegs bar byung ba mthong nas la'e ta'i sa tshigs kyi chab srid u yon sku ngo mas mi 'khrid de myur skyob gnang nas nga tsho gor mor bskyal gnang ba shes byung / 'khrab ston pa tshos sman khang nang nga la nyin mtshan gsum lta skyong byas nas bsdad 'dugagor mor sdod ring si khron khrang zhi tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso gzhon pa tseng kru'u cha'o dang krang zha'o khre sogs kyis nga rmas skyon tshabs chen byung ba mthong skabs sems khral chen po byed bzhin du tan tan tig tig gis nga'i bsam 'char bsdu len byas pa ste/ khyed la rmas skyon chen po 'di 'dra phog pa dang 131

mdun la bskyod rgyu'i lam de bas nyen kha che zhing ho'o dbyan ri bo dang li'u hra gtsang po/ thung than ho'o gtsang po sogs brgyud dgos pas gang 'dra byas nas thar thub bam/ de las log phyin na dga' zhes bshad byung / ngas de 'dra byas na ga la 'os/ sgrig 'dzugs kyis nga tsho bod la mngags gtong mdzad pas nga tshos nges par bod du 'byor thabs byed pa las lam phyed nas 'gro mtshams gtan nas 'jog rgyu min zhes bshad pa yin/ kho tshos gal te khyed la bgegs bar 'phrad tshe ji ltar byed dgos sam zhes bshad par ngas lan du nga shi na tshwa yi khrod du sbas na 'grig khyod tsho phyir log nas rang yul du 'byor mtshams nga la 'das mchod byas pas 'thus zhes bshad pas na mi tshang mas bshad thabs bral nas sems thag gtsang bcad kyis lha sar bskyod rgyu las phyir 'then bya rgyu med pa'i blo thag bcad/ 'khrab khrid pa lu'o go hwa yis bshad don/ tha na nga mi gcig las ma lhag kyang lha sar 'gro nges yin la/mtha' ma sgrung gtam shod rgyu dang khrang zhi'i rnga rdung rgyu zhig las ma byung yang 'grig ces bshad/nga gor mor nyin bdun brgyad tsam bsdad nas khrang zhi tshogs pa sngon du thon pa red/ lha sa nas tar 'phrin btang nas nga'i gnas tshul skad cha 'dri ba ma zad da dung 'tshams 'dri gnang mkhan kyang mngags 'dug sman khang nas nga la bshag bcos bya rgyu'i skor krang si ling yon la dgongs skor zhus par lha sar slebs rjes bshag bcos byed dgos pa'i tar lan 'byor 'dug pas/nga lha sa'i ye kran sman khang du bskyal nas zing 'khrug lhing 'jags gtong mkhan 'thab 'dzing dpa' bo dang mnyam du bsdad pa yin/gsum/ krang go hwa yi khyim du mgron por bskyod pa/lha sa'i ye kran sman khang du hrang zha'o dmag dpon yin pa'i sman pa zhig 132

nas ched mngags nga'i sman bcos kyi 'gan 'khur bzhes 'dug krang go hwa yis sman rdzas la brten nas sman bcos byed dgos pa las bshag bcos byed mi rung ba'i bka' slob gnang 'dug pa de'ang ha lam nga 'khrab ston pa zhig yin stabs bshag bcos byas rjes phyis 'byung stegs bu'i thog 'khrab ston bya rgyur gnod nges yin par dgongs bzhed gnang ba yin shas che/ khong tshos nga la phyi rgyal nas nang 'dren byas pa'i rin gong che ba'i sman zhig sprad byung ba de bstud mar gza' 'khor gnyis ring zos shing / sman de ni dngos gnas ngo mtshar che ba zhig 'dug ste de bzas pas rus pa chag grum byung ba dag rim bzhin rang 'jags su sgrig pa lta bu rang so sor yang tshor snang byung / da lta nga'i mgo'i steng gi rma shul yang mthong rgyu med/ si ling yon krang go hwa dang chabasrid u yon than kon san rnam gnyis sman khang du nga la thengs kha shas gzigs par phebs nas ngal gso yag po byed dgos pa'i skul lcag gnang /ngas sman khang du zla gsum lhag tsam bsdad pa dang 1960lo'i dpyid gsar dus chen tshar rjes gzhi nas sman khang nas thon pa yin/sman khang nas phyir thon te yun ring ma song bar krang si ling yon gyis mi mngags nas nga khong gi khyim du bsus gnang byung ba de ni nga krang go hwa yi khyim du mgron por bcar ba thengs dang po de yin/krangago hwa ni sku gzugs tshad ma zhig yin pa dang 'dris bde la bka' mol gnang skabs thugs gshis 'jam pa dang / cang zhi'i yul gyi skad 'dres pa'i spyi spyod skad bskyon pa dang bar mtshams su si khron gyi yul skad phran bu'ang bskyon gyi 'dug khong gis nga 'jus nas ko ba'i hru h+pha thog mnyam du bzhugs/sku bcar dmag dpon gyis cang zhi'i nas thon pa'i dri zhim gsol ja zhus shing /de nas krang go hwa yis nga la dkar yol gcig gnang ste ‘‘khyed kyis brtsams 133

sgrig byas pa'i 〈ta yu'i yis chu log brtul pa 〉zhes pa de ha cang yag po 'dugata yu'i yis rang khyim gyi sgo 'gram nas thengs gsum brgyud kyang khyim du ma phyin/'on kyang nga tsho'i 'di ga'i las byed dang 'thab 'dzing pa mang po zhig rang gi khyim tshang dran bzhin yod mi’ces gsungs/ nga sman khang la sdod ring si khron khrang zhi tshogs pas lha sar bstud mar 'khrab ston thengs mang byas shing / si khron gyi khrang zhi 〈ta yu'i yis chu log brtul ba 〉zhes pa de mi mang pos blta myong yod stabs ngas ‘‘dbu 'dzin mchog nas skyon brjod dang yo bsrang gnang rogs ’’zhus/khong gis‘‘a tsi/ dbu 'dzin zhes 'bod rgyu med/ ngo log jag pas ga sa ga nas dbu 'dzin bzung rtsis byed mus red ’ ces dang 6‘nga tshor ang grangs bsgrigs pa khyed kyis mi shes sam/ nga ang dang po dang than kon san ang gnyis pa red ’’ces gsungs shing / de nas khong gis dbugs thengs gcig la si ling yon gzhon pa dang chab srid u yon gzhon pa/ tshan mo krang sogs kyi ang grangs tshang ma gsungs byung / khong gis da dung mu mthud nas ‘‘ngas bod sdod dpung sder khyed la slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i brda tho btang yod/ khyed la rmas skyon tshabs chen 'di 'dra phog kyang da dung bod la yong rgyu mtha' 'khyongs byas pa des 'thab 'dzing pa tshor slob gso chen po thebs rgyu red/ nga tsho'i 'dir yod ying krang man gyi dmag mi tshang ma si khron gyi mi kher gtsang yin pas 'dir pha yul si khron gyi khrang zhi blta rgyu byung ba ni dngos 'brel khong tshor sems gso byas pa zhig rang red ’’ces gsungs/de nas mu mthud krang si ling yon gyis si khron khrang zhi'i skor rgyas par gleng mdzad nas spro ba rab tu brtas pa'i ngang nas gsungs pa'i tshul la gzhigs na khong ni si khron khrang zhir zhen chags che bar brtsis chog134

‘‘khyed tsho'i si khron khrang zhi'i brjod byed tshig yag po bris 'dug snyan 'jebs tshig la nyams 'gyur dang ldan pa 'di lta bu ngas bltas na pe cin gyi khrang zhi phud si khron gyi khrang zhi tsam red ’’ces gsungs/ khong gis (brtse dung 'tshol ba 〉zhes pa'i 'khrab gzhung la dpe bzhag nas gsung don ‘‘(brtse dung 'tshol ba 〉zhes pa'i 'khrab gzhung gi brjod byed tshig ni snyan 'jebs ldan pa zhig bris 'dug ste/ ca'o ku'i dbying gis glu dum bu gcig len pa 'di ltar ‘bdag ni lan tshar can zhig la 'gyur bar 'dod ’lan tshar can zhes pa ni bya zhig yin cing mjug ma med/ rgya byar mjug ma yod/ ca'o ku'i dbying ni mjug ma med pa'i bya zhig la 'gyur 'dod yod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni kho mos khyim 'dzin ma'am chung ma zhig bya rgyu'i re ba med pa shes nas g.yog mo zhig bya rgyu byung na'ang 'grig bsam pa'i re ba byed pas so/ bya de rigs nga tsho'i bod du'ang yod ’’ces gsungs/ de rjes khong gis ‘‘nga tsho'i pha yul du 〈shing pad+ma'i bsil khang 〉zhes pa'i brtsam bya zhig yod pa de'ang ha cang yag po bris yod/khyed la deb de yod dam/ med na nam zhig ngas khyed la gcig phul chog ’ces gsungs/de nas zla phyed ma song bar nga khong gi gzims shag tu bcar tsa na khong gis gna' bo'i shing brkos par ma (shing pad+ma'i bsil khang 〉zhes pa'i deb zhig nga la gnang byung /krang go hwa yis bka' mol lhug por gsungs stabs ngas kyang 'tsher snang spangs nas ‘‘si ling yon lags pha yul gang nas yin nam mi’zhes dris/‘‘la'o sbe'o red pā/ ’‘‘gang la la'o sbe'o zer ram/ ’‘‘cang zhi'i yi mi yin/ cang zhi'i tshang mas la'o sbe'o zer/’ri135

‘‘da lo dgung lo ga tshod yin nam/’’‘‘khyed kyis da dung mi shes sam/ nged gnyis lo mnyam red/’’‘‘khyed nyid mkhyen pa'i bdag po 'di lta bu phyag dpe mang po gzigs yod shas che/’’‘‘deb lta khom ci la yod/ khyed dang gcig mtshungs red/ chung dus mi gzhan gyi ba phyugs 'tsho bar phyin nas grod pa'ang rgyags kyi med/ rjes su dmar dmag nang zhugs kyang skabs de dus dmar dmag ces pa gang byed mkhan yin min mi shes/ mi tshos dmar dmag nang zhugs tshe za ma bza' rgyu yod skor bshad pa thos myong yod/ yan an la slebs rjes gzhi nas dpe deb phran bu klog rgyu byung /’’‘‘sku nyid si khron khrang zhir thugs rgyus chen po 'dug ’’ces zhus par/khong gis ‘‘si khron bcings 'grol gtong skabs ngas thang 'thab dpung sde gnyis pa'i cun bco brgyad par sne khrid de ku'e kro'u nas si khron du yong ba dang khren tur slebs skabs si khron gyi khrang zhi mi nyung ba zhig bltas pa ma zad/da dung si khron khrang zhir skad grags yod pa'i khrang zhi khrab mkhan mang po zhig rgyus mnga' yod stabs khrang zhi'i thad shes rtogs phran bu byung ba red ’’ces gsungs/nga tsho'i 'khrab ston tshogs pa bod du yong nas blo mthun pa'i grogs po khyed lta bu zhig 'phrad yong bsam pa ma byung /de nyin nyin gung krang go hwa yis nga khong gi gzims shag tu gung zas la mgron 'bod gnang ba dang khong gi lcam dang bde srung sman pa/ sku bcar dmag dpon bcas kyis cang zhi'i yi ro bcud ldan pa'i zhal lag bzos gnang zhing / tshang mas rang 'dod ltar bza' bzhin du gang bsam lhug por 136

smras/de rjes krang go hwas rgyun du mi mngagar+sā nas bsus te las ka'i skor gleng ba'am si khron yul lugs skor ci 'phros mol 'phrol gyi kha brda byed kyi yod/thengs shig nga khrang zhi tshogs pa 'khrid nas phyir thon mtshams krang go hwas mi mngags nas nga khong gi gzims shag la bsus te/ nga phyir thon rjes skad cha ji ltar shod dgos min dang / mi la gus zhabs ji 'dra byed dgos min/'og rim gyi mi 'phrad skabs yid gzab gang byed dgos min dang gong rim gyi mi 'phrad skabs skad cha ji ltar shod dgos min bcas kyi skor bslab bya gnang zhing / khong gis ‘‘khyed tsho phyir thon pa'i skabs su ngo log jag pa thug tshe pha rol nas sngon la lag pa ma btegs na/ khyed rang tsho so so lam du 'gro rkyang byed pa las rang sgul gyis kha gtad phyogs la rgol mi nyan/ gang lags zhe na/khyed tsho ni 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa yin pa las zing 'khrug lhing 'jags kyi las 'gan med pas 'khrab ston mi sna byings kyi bde 'jags srung thabs la yid gzab gyis ’’zhes gsungs/ krang go hwa'i bka' mol des skabs de'i nga'i sems khral med pa bzos song / drang por bshad na nga'i sems khral che shos ni 'khrab ston pa byings kyi bde 'jags 'gan len yong thabs de yin/skabs der 'khrab ston tshogs pa'i nang gi mi tshang mas drag chas spras thog gzhon pa stobs shed can gyis me mda' sbag sbag dang me mda' sag sag thogs shing ched mngags dmag don sbyong brdar nang zhugs myong / 'on kyang khong tsho tshang ma lo na ha cang chung la rnam pa mdzes po yod stabs ngo log jag pas mthong tshe las sla por gang 'gror gtong mi srid/ gal te chag sgo 'dra byung tshe/ nga thon krang gi 'gan 'khur mkhan gyis rjes su pha yul du log nas rtsis sprod ji ltar zhu dgos sam/ krang si ling yon gyis nga la ‘‘skrag mi dgos/’’137

khyed tsho gang du bskyod kyang nga tshos dpung sde mngags nas srung skyob byas choga'akhrab ston tshogs par mkho byed gang dgos shod rkyang byas na nga tshos gang thub ci thub kyis 'dod pa bskong thabs byas chog ’’ces gsungs byung /bzhi/ ngo log jag pa thug pa/bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug de 1rdzo59lo'i spyi zla 2tshes 19nyin gyi mtshan mor langs shing / ngo log zing 'khrug pas lha sar yod pa'i bod sdod dpung sde'i si ling pu'u dang krung dbyang gi bod sdod las khungs la khyon yongs nas tshur rgol byas/ nyin gnyis pa'i snga dro chu tshod 10pa'i thog bod dmag khul khang gi dpung sdes bzod bsran byed thabs bral ba'i gnas tshul 'ogadrag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug la phar rgol byed 'go tshugs shing / nyin gnyis lhag tsam gyi dmag 'thab byas pa brgyud lha sa grong khyer gyi ngo log zing 'khrug mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas thal ba'i rdul du brlags te ngo log jag dmag 400rkyalhag tsam 'dzin bzung byas shing jag dmag lhag 'phro khag gcig lha sa'i shar lho'i phyogs dang yar klung gtsang po'i lho rgyud kyi lho kha sa khul du bros byol du song / de rjes kyi lo 'ga' zhig nang jag pa nyung shas kyis ngo log zing 'khrug mu mthud nas bslangs yod pa ni lha sa grong khyer nang du'ang mtshams chad med/ gnas tshul de 1962lo'i zla 2pa bar bar mtshams ma chad par lus/ 1960lo'i zla 5pa nas bzung dus bab slar yang dza drag che ru song nas ngo log jag pas ‘‘las byed pa mi gcig gsod thub na dpe cha khri phrag klog pa las lhag hur brtson can mi gcig gsod thub na/ mchod rten gcig bzhengs pa dang khyad par med ’’ces yongs grags su shod kyi yod/ nga tsho'i 'khrab ston tshogs pa'i bud med 'khrab ston pa h+phan thing h+phen la nad gzhi 138

tshabs chen phog nas sman khang du skyel ba'i skabs dmag mi mngags nas me mda' brgyad kyis srung skyob byas pa'i tshul de ha cang dza drag po red/ skabs der ming la cang thing hwa zer ba'i dpung sde'i dmag rgyag kho'o yi kho'o krang zhig yod pa der pho mo'i gnad don gyis rkyen pas skyon brjod phog kho pa yid mi rang ba byung ste ngo log jag par mgo btags nas jag pa'i khongs su bzhugs/ngo log jag pas kho la hra'o cang dmag dpon gyi go gnas sprad pa dang / tha'e wan nas bud med gnyis kyang bskongs nas dmigs su kho pa'i bza' zla byed du bcug bcings 'grol dmag gis ngo log jag par kha gtad gcog pa'i 'thab jus de dag kho pas ngo log jag par bshad stabs de nas bzung jag pa'i smyo ham che ru song zhing / kho pa tshos dmag chas ma spras par phyi tshul nas bltas na mi ser yin khul gyis bcings 'grol dmag dang rgya rigs las byed pa 'phrad tshe glo bur du 'jab rgol byed kyi yod/ skabs der dmag dpung du me mda' ang dang por rgyab mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs nan po yod pa de ngo log jag pas shes rjes de bas smyo ham che ru song /zla bdun pa'i nyin zhig gi dgong mo'i chu tshod bdun par bod ljongs las don u yon lhan khang la tshogs 'dur zhugs dgos pa'i brda tho 'byor byung bas nga 'khrab ston tshogs pa sdod sa'i me ru nas thon skabs bde srung las byed pa h+phu'u wun li'ang gis ‘‘khyed tsho chu tshod bdun par tshogs 'du tshogs tshe phal cher chu tshod dgu pa tsam la ma gtogs grol thub kyi ma red/ ngas chu tshod brgyad par khyed bsu bar bcar chog la khyed la chag sgo mi yong ba ngas 'gan len zhus chog ’’ces zer/ h+phu'u wun li'ang ni khrang zhi'i nang gi drag rtsal pa 'khrab mkhan yin zhing 'khrab ming la ‘‘lcags lta bu'i bden 'dzin dpa' bo ’zhes brjod la shugs rtsal drag rtsed la shin tu mkhas pa ma zad/ de snga hwa ying 139

hran nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi tu'e krang byed myong yod pa dang lag g.yas g.yon gnyis kas me mda' rgyag thub kyi yod/ ngas kho par bsu bar yong na ‘‘'grig pa 'dug ’’ces bshad de song ba yin/de nyin dgong mo'i tshogs 'du yud tsam zhig las ma 'tshogs shing /nang don ni dza drag gi skul slong tshogs 'du red 'dug ste/ tshogs 'du'i thog tshan pa khag tshang mas dogs zon cher bskyed kyis gra sgrig gang legs byed pa dang dus dang rnam pa kun tu dmag rgyag ang gsar gyi byed phyogs bzung ste jag pas zing 'khrug slong bar rgol lan slog rtsis byed dgos pa'i blang bya bton/ tshogs 'du grol skabs dus tshod snga po red 'dug na bsu bar yong rgyur sgug sdod mi dgos par rkang 'khor bzhon te log 'gro rgyu red/ nga'i rkang 'khor de dbyin ji nas thon pa zhig yin pas rkang 'khor thog glog gtong 'phrul 'khor chung chung zhig yod cing 'khor lo bskor ba dang glog btang nas rang 'gul gyis glog bzhu 'bar gyi yod/ ngas ra mo che'i srang lam brgyud phyir log pa dang srang lam de ni man yang mā cwa srang lam 'ga' yi ring thung yod cing de ni nye lam zhig yin/ nga de nas 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs der mdun phyogs nas bod rigs lnga drug zhig gis lag tu gri thogs te g.yug g.yug byed pa dang sbrags kha nas gang byung skad cor brgyab nas yong gin 'dug nga'i sems la ‘‘ngo log jag pa ’’red snyam byung / gang 'dra byed dgos sam/ sa rub skabs su srang lam ring po de 'dra zhig nang nga gcig pur 'gro mus yin/skabs de dus dmag dpung nas nga la krung zha'o dmag dpon gyi go gnas gnang thog dmag dpon gyi gyon chas cha tshang zhig kyang gnang byung yang rgyun gtan ngas rtag tu krung hran gyon chas sngon po zhig gyon gyi yod/ mi ser byas tshe ngo log jag pa 'phrad skabs ‘‘me mda' ang dang po rgyag mi chog pa'i ’tshod 140

'dzin med/ ngo log jag pa mdun du bcar la nye bas ngas lam sang rkang 'tho/ rakha bkag nas lag g.yas pas sked pa nas lnga gcig rtags can gyi me mda' thung mda' de bton te ngo log jag pa'i rkang pa'i mdun du mde'u kha shas brgyab pa yin/ de rjes kho pa tshos da dung phyir bshol ma byas par nga'i phyogs su bcar nas yong gi 'dug nga'i sems la yag po byung ma song snyam ste lam sang rkang 'khor kha phyir bskor te bzhon nas yud tsam song mur yang ngo log jag pa 'ga' zhig gis 'gro lam bkag nas 'dug skabs der nga sems 'tshab langs shing slar yang g.yon ngos kyi lnga gcig rtags can gyi me mda' thung mda' de bton nas mde'u re zung brgyab pas pha rol la me mda' phog nas mi zhig gis lag pas brang kha mnan te rmas skyon phog pa'i smre sngags 'don gyin 'dug kho pa tshos gzhogs gnyis la g.yol ba'i skabs dang bstun nas ngas rkang 'khor bzhon te 'phur ba ltar btang nas dbugs thengs gcig la me rur bros thub tsam byung / me rur slebs skabs nga'i lus po'i zungs kyang shor 'dug h+phu'u wun li'ang chu tshod brgyad pa yol tsam la 'byor nas mi gcig kyang med pa mthong skabs dngangs 'tshab chen po skyes shing lag tu me mda' thung mda' sbag sbag thogs te gang sar nga 'tshol bar phyin 'dug nga log yong ba mthong skabs gzhi nas sems lhod po byung song /de nas bzung khong gis nga dang skad cig kyang kha mi bral bar sdod kyi yod/lnga/ ‘‘sa mtho'i bya rgod/’’bod ljongs ni skad grags yod pa'i ‘‘'dzam gling yang rtse ’’yin pa dang skabs der mi 'bor bsdoms grangs khri 120yod pa'i nang brgya cha 90bod rigs yin zhing / rgya khyon spyi le khri tsho 122yod pa de cha snyoms ltar na spyi le gru 141

bzhi ma gcig la mi gcig kyang lon gyi med/ skabs de'i bod ljongs la kron chus 〈dang / rdzong 140yod/ nga tsho'i 'bod tshig ni ‘‘yun ring du bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun dang / dmag dang las byed bzo pa gsum la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyumimide yin/ skabs de dus gang sar dmag dpung dang las byed pa yod stabs nga tsho bod du sdod pa'i lo lnga'i ring nub rgyud kyi mnga' ris sa khul phud/ de min sa khul bdun po tshang mar bskyod pa yin/ mnga' ris sa khul du skabs der bca' sdod byed mkhan lan kro'u dmag khul khang gi dpung sde yin pa dang dmag mi mang che ba byang phyogs rgyud kyi mi yin pas si khron gyi /sring zhi blta mi shes/ der brten 'go khrid kyis nga tsho mnga' ris su mngags gtong ma byas/nga tsho sa phyogs gang du bskyod kyang de ga'i bca' sdod dpung sde dang las byed pas thag ring nas rnga dang sbug chal brdung ba dang 'bod tshig sgrog bzhin du ru bsgrig nas dga' bsu zhu ba dang nga tshor ‘‘pha yul nas yong ba'i gnyen nye ’’red ces smras nas 'thab 'dzing dpa' bo dang legs po lnga ldan gyi 'thab 'dzing pa tsho nga tsho'i gdong 'khru byed kyi chu len mkhan dang rkang pa 'khrus pa'i chu gsho mkhan la bkod sgrig gnang gi 'dug nga ni 'khrab ston tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso yin la rang skyong ljongs 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i khongs mi yang yin stabs sa phyogs gang du slebs kyang tshang mas nga la ‘‘dbu 'dzin lags ’’zhes 'bod pa ma zad da dung ‘‘dbu khrid ’’kyis gsung bshad dang ‘‘bka' slob ’’gnang dgos zer ba de ni nga skrag snang che shos byed dgos pa de yin/nga ni si khron khrang zhi khrab mkhan zhig yin la rig gnas gang yang med mkhan zhig yin/ sdings cha'i thog khrang zhi 'khrab rgyur snang dag med/ da lta las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa mang po de 'dra zhig gi mdun la skad cha shod rgyu de 142

dngos 'brel khag po 'dug stabs legs pa zhig la thon khar krang go hwa yis nga la skad cha shod stangs skor slob myong yod pas ngas mig btsums nas u tshugs kyis skad cha tshig kha shas bshad de de ma thag gus 'dud zhus nas sdings cha nas babs pa yin/ nga tsho'i 'khrab ston par rgya che'i las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa tsho'i spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu thob stabs 'khrab ston byed skabs kyang sems shugs chen po skyes shing snang med gtan nas byed kyi med/ der brten sdings cha'i 'og nas thal mo brdab pa'i sgra'ang rgyun mi chad/ 'khrab ston byed mi dgos pa'i khrang zhi ba tshos rang 'gul gyis dmag dpung sdod sar bskyod de 'thab 'dzing pa tsho'i gos 'khru rogs dang 'tshem rogs byed pa'am yang na thab tshang nang du bza' ma bzo rogs dang chu len rogs/ shing gshag rogs sogs byas nas nges par du rgyab phyogs kyi las byed mi sna tsho brjes nas khong tsho 'khrab ston gzigs par gdan 'dren zhu ba bcas byas pa red/nying khri'i lho ngos dang ri bo he ma la ya'i ri khrod na rta bzhon nas bskyod dgos pa'i so lta khang zhig yod pa der rgyun du bca' sdod byed mkhan bcings 'grol dmag mi bcu shog shig yod/ sa cha de'i ri klung kha bas g.yogs shing 'gro lam dog la gzar bas glu gar 'khrab ston ru khag gcig kyang skyod myong med/ 1960lo'i zla 12par wang ta'o phing sogs gzhon nu 'khrab ston pa bcus kha ba chen po'i khrod du nyin gcig hril por bskyod pa dang bud med 'khrab ston pa ho'o su'i an 'gro ma thub par gzhon pa 'ga' zhig gis res mos kyis kho mo sgal par 'khur te mthar so lta khang der slebs thub tsam byung /so lta khang de dong lam zhig nang btsugs yod cing 'thab 'dzing pa tsho lo nas lo bstud mar kha ba chen pos sa phug nang bkag nas sdod dgos pas 'tsho ba 143

shin tu dka' ngal chen po yod/ 'khrab ston 'tshogs pa yong ba mthong ma thag tshang mar dga' tshor dpag med skyes song / dong lam nang 'khrab ston byed thabs med stabs khong tshos bzhu mar yang lā spar nas 'thab 'dzing pa tsho dang mnyam du nyal khri'i thog bsdad de lcags krin stong pas rnga'i tshab byas nas brdung pa dang 'khrab tshan nang gi gzhas dum bu 'ga' shas btang / wang to'o phing gis cin hu'u pi wang gis 〈zha'o kha'i man 〉zhes bya ba'i khrang zhi'i rol dbyangs dkrol bas tshang mas spro ba rab tu brtas bzhin nyan/ pha yul khren tu nas yin pa'i 'thab 'dzing pa chung chung zhig sems pa'i rba rlabs g.yo zhing mig zhag 'khor bzhin du ‘‘khyed tshos si khron gyi khrang zhi he ma la yar 'khrab ston gnang ba de ni 'dzam gling thog ches khyad du 'phags pa'i sgyu rtsal pa zhig dngos gnas red ’’ces bsngags brjod byas/'khrab ston tshogs pa dang mnyam du bod la yong mkhan na gzhon slob ma de rigs dka' tshegs che ba'i khor yug nang sbyong brdar byung stabs 'tshar longs dang yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i thad ha cang mgyogs po byung zhing / khong tshos bshes gnyen brten nas sgyu rtsal sbyangs pa dang / nyin ltar tho rengs chu tshod lnga pa tsam la langs te rtsal dang skad sbyong ba dang kha bas btums pa'i sa gzhi'i khrod du 'gran rtsod glu dbyangs len pa sogs pa'i byed stangs gtan nas chad myong med/ khong tsho'i 'khrab rtsal byang chub pa dang gzhas gdangs snyan 'jebs ldan pa/ chas bzo rmad du byung ba/ gar gyi nyams 'gyur mdzes pa bcas yod stabs thang bde ru 'khrab ston byas kyang gzigs mo ba tshos 'jam thing nger sdod kyi yod/ skabs 'gar kha ba bu yug 'tshub nas sdings cha'i steng shod tshang ma dkar thing nger gyur te 'khrab ston pa'i 'khrab chas dmar po de rigs kyang gangs kyis btums nas dkar por gyur kyang 144

gzigs mo ba thams cad yid dbang 'phrog ste ce rer bltas nas sdod la khrang zhi'ang 'khrab rkyang byed kyi yod/ si ling yon krang lags khrang zhi gzigs par phebs na rtsa bslas sbol gdan thog skyil krung du zhugs shing sku srung dmag mis dmag spyod kam pa li 'khyer yong ste khong gi sku gzugs la dkris nas khong gis khrang zhi 'khrab ma tshar bar du gzigs nas bzhugs kyi yod/ bod rigs spun zla tsho nga tsho'i bud med 'khrab ston pa tsho'i 'khrab ston blta rgyur shin tu dga' po byed cing bud med 'khrab ston pa de tsho ni nam mkha' nas byon pa'i lha mo red ces brjod pa dang tshang mas brkyangs phyag 'tshal te yul ring langs kyi med/'khrab ston tshogs pas gzigs mo ba 'dra min gyi gnas tshul la gzhigs nas rgyun srol gyi 'khrab gzhung rnying pa 'khrab kyi yod la/ deng dus kyi 'khrab gzhung yang brtsams nas 'khrab ston byed kyi yod/ nga tshos 'khrab ston byas pa'i rgyun srol khrang zhi ni rgyal gces ring lugs kyi bsam blo dang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi nang don mtshon pa'i 'khrab gzhung sha stag yin pa dper na/〈ta yu'i yis chu log brtul ba 〉zhes pa dang / 〈dka' ba spyad nas rgyal khab kyi dgra sha lenata (dmag rnga rdung nas cin hran ri bor 'thab payi(dbyang tshang gi dmag dponata (rgya bza' kong jo/〉 (tsha'e wun ci'i 〉sogs dang da dung 'khrab gzhung thung ngu'i khrang zhi 'ga' zhig yod cing / deng dus kyi 'khrab gzhung gras su 〈mtha' mtshams kyi khong khro'i me lce 〉zhes pa dang /(sa mtho'i dpyid kyi 'brug sgrata (mtha' mtshams kyi so lta khang ta〈gangs ri'i drod rgyun/〉 〈skyes mi chog pa'i mi 〉sogs yod/ deng dus kyi 'khrab gzhung de tshos dus thog tu bod kyi mun nag gi zhing bran lam lugs 'ther 'don dang bran g.yog gi 'gog rgol dang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i snying 145

stobs la bsngags brjod byas shing bod kyi dmag dmangs tshos dpa' ngar chen pos 'thab rtsod byas pa dag mtshon par byas yod pas las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa/ bod rigs spun zla bcas tshang mar slob gso dang skul lcag gi nus pa gang legs thon yod/bod kyi tshags par thog rgyun du nga tsho 'khrab ston tshogs pa'i byed sgo'i gnas tshul spel ba dang 'khrab ston pas mi bzang las bzang byas pa'i skor ngo sprod byas te nga tsho ni sa mtho'i steng gi ‘‘thang dkar rgod po mi’zhig red ces bsngags brjod byed kyi yod/ 'khrab ston tshogs pa sa phyogs gang du bskyod kyang tshags par thog ‘‘sa mtho'i thang dkar rgod po sa phyogs ྾ ྾ ྾ la 'phur bskyod byas pa ’’zhes bkod/ skabs de'i lo rgyus dran gso byed skabs de dus ni dngos 'brel me ltar 'bar ba'i 'tsho ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi myong ba zhig red/drug gangs ri'i thog dka' ngal 'phrad pa/bod kyi sa cha ni dngos gnas yangs shing rgya che ba zhig red/ rdzong zhig la 'gro bar rgyun du lam bar nyin bcu lhag tsam 'gor gyi yod/ skabs 'gar rdzong ྾ ྾ ྾la slebs song zer ba thos nas phyogs bzhir lta skabs dgon pa re zung zhig ma gtogs mi'i grib gzugs kyang mthong rgyu med/ der brten nga tsho gang du bskyod kyang sbra gur 'khyer nas 'gro ba dang / gang du slebs dus mun pa rub tshe de gar ngal gso rgyag rkyang byed kyi yod/ lo dus shig nga tsho lha sa nas thon te shar phyogs su bskyod cing kong po rgya mda' dang nying khri/ chab mdo sogs brgyud nas si khron dang / yun nan dag dang nye ba'i tshwa khron du 'byor/ lam bar du star chags kyi la mo brgyud dgos pa dang gangs ri chen 146

po mang po brgal dgos pa tshang ma mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngo las smis lnga stong ngam drug stong yan red/ gangs ri brgal skabs gso rlung mi 'dang ba'i rkyen gyis dbugs rngub 'byin dka' ba dang rlung gi gnon shugs chung bas kha lud sna lud tshang ma'i nang khrag 'dres nas yod/ ri nas 'bab skabs tshang mas pags pa'i tā dbyi'i yis lus po btums shing lag gnyis la rta'i srab mda' dam por dkris te rbab sgril gtong bas mi la la gang gsob nang zags te rta'i mthur thag nas 'then mtshams gzhi nas steng du don thub pa dang de nas gzab gzab kyis thur du 'bab/ zhags sar sdod skabs sbra gur phub ma thag tshang ma nang du 'dzul nas pho mo mi bltos pa tshang ma gyon gos lus sbyar thog nyal dgos kyi yod/ mtshan mo gangs je cher babs nas ras gur thog gi gangs gsog je mang du 'gro zhing / gangs kyis rim bzhin gur mnan te mthar mi'i lus po'i thog thug pas tshang ma 'khyags kyis mnar nas gnyid ga la khug skabs der mi la las ‘‘de las langs nas phyin na dga'/ gnam grang mo 'di 'drar gang ltar gnyid yur thabs bral ’zhes bshad par ‘‘de rang red ’ces tshang ma langs nas rdog khres 'khur te mu mthud mdun du bskyod/nyin zhig gi snga dro kha ba ha cang chen po 'bab cing gang sar rab rib tu gyur pas shar lho nub byang dbye mtshams 'byed mi thub pa dang nga tsho'i rta'ang chad nas 'gro mi thub pa'i gnas su gyar grabs yod pa'i skabs glo bur du nye 'khor nas me mda'i sgra bsgrags/ nga tsho srung skyel byed mkhan pha'e krang gis nga la ‘‘dbu 'dzin lags nga tsho jag pas mtha' bskor 'dug mi’ces snyan seng zhus byung bar ngas ‘‘lam sne 'khrid mkhan gang du 'dug gam/ sa cha 'di gang du yin nam ’zhes dris/ pha'e krang gis ‘‘sno 'khrid mkhan bros zin 'dug pas kho pa ngo log jag pa red 'dug ’zer/ skabs der ngas tshang mar 'phral du rta 147

nas babs te rang sar kha bub nas sdod ces skad shugs chen pos bshad pa yin/ 'khrab ston pa skyes pa tshang ma dpa' ngar che bas khong tshos bcings 'grol dmag gi 'thab 'dzing pa dang 'dra bar me mda' sbag sbag dang sag sag khag thogs te mtho gnas bzung ste thag ring me mda'i sgra bsgrags sar me mda' drag po brgyab/ ngas bud med 'khrab ston pa tshor srung skyob byas nas khong tshor rang sar kha bub nas 'gul bskyod gtong ma bcug dmag yud tsam brgyab rjes de ma nyid du kha ba babs mtshams chad/ nam mkha' dwangs shing nyi ma dmar po shar phyogs nas rim gyis thon pas gangs ri thams cad dmar mdangs rgyas/ de nas rgyang blta byed skabs ngo log jag pa'i grib gzugs tsam yang mthong rgyu med/ mdun du bskyod nas blta skabs gangs kyi steng du rkang rjes kyis khengs nas yod pa de dag la nga tshos dbye zhib byas nas ngo log jag pas nga tsho'i mdel shugs che bas kho pa tshor rgyal kha thob pa dka' snyam ste rang 'gul gyis phyir 'then byas pa los yin/tsha khron nas chab mdor phyir log gis spang mda'i rtsa thang brgyud skabs slar yang kha ba bu yug 'phrad nas 'khrab ston tshogs pa dang dmag dpung tshang ma nyin mtshan 'ga' zhig de gar lus/ dmag gi rlangs 'khor gangs gsog nang tshud nas gtong thabs bral/ tshang mas res mos kyis gangs bshangs kyang mi res thengs 'ga' bshangs ma thag snying gi 'phar shugs che ru song ba dang mgo yu 'khor ba/ rkang shugs med pa/ tha na dbugs kyang 'byin rngub dka' bar gyur stabs mi tshang ma gangs gsog thog 'gyel nas 'gul mi thub/bza' rgyur 'khyer ba'i kring mog 'khyags rdog ltar gyur te so 'debs mi thub/dgong mor grang ngad kyis brdung zhing ltogs pas mnar/ de 'dra byas nas bsdad na rang sar 'khyags shi thebs nges yin na chab mdo yan lag dmag 148

khulakhang gi si ling yon gzhon pa yu'e lags kyis tshang mar yar langs nas mtshams ma bzhag par mchong rgyugs 'phag 'tshag rgyob cig ces bka' btang zhing khong gis rang gi a rag shel dam gang po de bton nas mi tshang mar phran tsam 'thung du bcug pa des kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa'i mtshan mo de 'khyol tsam byung / de'i rjes yu'o zhi'i zhes pa'i dmag sgar du slebs skabs tshang ma ltogs nas nyin shas song / dmag sgar nas tshang mar thug pa btsos nas ster yang mi res srang do tsam ma gtogs bza' mi chog ces si ling yon gyis bka' gnang don de ni tshang ma ltogs drags pas ha cang bzas drags na sbos te 'chi yong snyam nas za rgyu nyung tsam dang lto dus mang tsam bzas tshe skyon chag mi yong ba'i ched du red/1kha61lo'i zla bzhi pa'am lnga pa'i bar/ nga tsho'i mi 20lhag tsam yod pa'i ru chung zhig tung a hran zhes pa'i la brgyab pa'i skabs kha ba ha cang chen po babs nas gangs mi'i sked pa bar du slebs nas mdun du bskyod thabs bral la phyir bshol yang byed thabs bral bas nga tsho tshang ma dgon pa chung ngu zhig nang 'tshang kha bshig bshig gis sdod dgos byung / mi so sor bza' bca' gang 'dug blta skabs khyon bsdoms kring mog lnga rang las lhag med/tshang ma bkres skom gyis bzod par dka' bas gangs ril bzas nas kha nang 'jug pa las kring mog lnga po de sus kyang bza' ma phod/ tshang mas nga la mi dgos khyod zo zhes phan tshun thugs 'dzems byas mthar nyin gsum par gzhi nas phan tshun bgos nas bzas/ de nas mi ring bar gangs thag chod song bas nga tshos mgyogs myur ngang rbab 'dril btang nas ri bo'i thur du 'bab pa yin/1962lo'i zla 11par krung hin mtha' mtshams dmag 'khrug skabs 149
