yin zhing / nga tsho'i mi 20lhag tsam yod pa'i ru chung zhig hi ma la ya'i ri 'dabs su bca' sdod byed mkhan dmag mi pha'e zhig yod pa der 'tshams 'dri byed par bskyod skabs nyin mtshan bstud mar kha ba bu yug rab tu 'tshub ste 'grim 'grul 'gag stabs ru chung gi tshogs mi rnams la bza' rgyu med pa dang dpung sde la'ang 'bru rigs chad/ tshang ma 'khrab ston tshar skabs zas bza' rgyu med pas 'thab 'dzing pa tsho dang mnyam du gangs kyi gting nas ri skyes 'bras bu bsngogs te bzas/ 'thab 'dzing pa tshos 'bras bu de ‘‘gro ma ’red ces zer/ tshang ma ltogs drags pa'i rkyen gyis yin shas che ste/ ri skyes 'bras bu de zos na mngar zhing ro dang ldan pas gang zhig las zhim pa 'dugabadun/ ngo log jag pa dang chang 'thung brgyab pa/1961lo'i dpyid gsar dus chen la si khron khrang zhi tshogs pa bod kyi shar rgyud du bskyod cing mthong med zam pa grol mtshams de ga'i zing 'khrug lhing 'jags gtong mkhan dpung sder 'tshams 'dri zhus/ khul der dmag dpung gis pa lcog bla mas gtso byas pa'i ngo log jag pa khag gcig mtha' nas bskor/ dmag dpung ri 'dabs su yod pa dang jag pa tshang ma ri rtser yod pas dmag dpung gis mtha' bskor ba las phar rgol mi byed pa'i dmag jus spyad nas lo ngog jag pa tshang ma nang khul du 'khrug nas kha thor 'gro rgyu'i re sgug byas/ pa lcog bla ma ni tha'e wan gsang myul las khungs kyis bsko bzhag byas pa'i krung cang si ling yin pa dang kho pa'i lag 'og tu mi khri gsum lhag tsam yod/ bcings 'grol dmag gis jag pa khri gsum nas phyed ka lhag tsam rtsa med btang bas lhag 'phro de tsho thar mi thub par ri rtser lus nas yod/bcings 'grol dmag gis mtha' bskor ba las rgol lan ma sprad pa'i tshul 150

mthong skabs jag pa'i bsam par bcings 'grol dmag gis kho tsho brtul thabs med pa red snyam nas slar yang smyo ham che ru song / dpyid gsar dus chen skabs kho pa tshos ri rtser skad sgra che ba'i rgyang bsgrags btang nas bcings 'grol dmag la skad cor brgyab/ rgyang bsgrags nang nas sgyu ma'i nyams ldan pa'i bud med kyi skad sgra phra mo zhig 'di ltar bsgrags te ‘‘gung khran dmag gi spun zla tsho/ ri rtser lo gsar gtong bar phebs shog tha'e wan nas nga tshor 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa mngags 'byor dang 'tshams 'dri'i rten 'bul bskur cing / da lta 〈chu skyes pad+ma 〉zhes pa'i ltad mo bstan mus la mgyogs po ri rtser gzigs par phebs/ zhabs bro 'khrab rgyur dga' po yod mkhan tsho/ gzhon nu mas sgug nas bsdad yod pas mgyogs po phebs shog phebs shog ’’ces zer/ nga tsho'i 'khrab ston pa tshos gsal thing nger go bas tshang ma khong khros jag par ‘‘'dre phrug khyod tsho shi la khad kyi skabs la'ang skyid po stong pa byed rgyu dran yong / ’ ‘‘'jon thang yod na nga'i rtsar 'bab shog ’’ces yud tsam ngan smras byas rjes kha ya byed mi 'dod par tshang mas mu mthud 'khrab ston byas nas bsdad/snron zlari tshes lnga'i dus chen gyi snga nub tu nga tsho dmag dpung du bca' sdod thon pu'u la bskyod pas thon krang dang chab srid u yon gyis nga tshor spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhus shing khong rnam pas nga la ‘‘khyed phebs pa tag tag byung / de ring khyed la sku mgron zhig ngo sprod zhu rgyu yod pas khyed tsho ngo shes yag po zhig gtong rogs mi’zhes gsungs/ gung zas bza' skabs sku mgron zhig gis a rag btegs nas nga la bstud mar gtsang dag gsum bkyag pa dang de rjes rang gis rang ngo sprod byas nas ‘‘nga ni pa lcog bla ma yin/khyed tsho'i 'khrab ston tshogs pa'i mtshan snyan go thos byung nas yun ring song ’’151

zhes zer/ngas ‘‘khyed ri rtser bkar nas lus pa ma red dam 'dir gang 'dra byas te slebs pa yin nam ’’zhes dris/‘‘nga la de snga mi khri gsum lhag tsam yod mod/ mthar mi gsum ma gtogs lhag ma song / thabs dang bral nas ngas mgo 'dogs rgyu'i re ba zhus par bcings 'grol dmag gi dga' bsu thob stabs nga 'dir yong ba yin mi’zhes zer/ngas ‘‘nga tsho 'dir 'phrad yong bsam pa gtan nas ma byung ’’zhes bshad mur zla shas gong kho pa tsho ri rtser bkar ba'i gnas tshul dag yid la dbang med du dran byung /pa lcog bla mas ‘‘nga tsho mjal thengs gnyis pa red ’’ces bshad pa dang sbrags nga la blta bzhin du ci yin dpog dka' ba'i 'dzum bag bstan/ ngas don snying ma gtogs pa'i mtshams der khos ‘‘nyin shas gong nga'i dmag dpung pham nyes byung nas stobs zhan du gyur yang ngas tha'e wan phyogs su byas rjes mngon phyir rgyal kha zhig len rgyu'i re stong bcangs/ khyed tsho phebs kyi yod pa go thos byung 'phral nga tshos lam bar du 'jab sgug brgyab nas sdod skabs khyed tsho phebs pa mthong zhing / mdun la rgad po zhig yong bzhin pa de'i kha spu ring la gyon pa nag nog gyi tshul der brtag tshe dmag dpon tan tan min la/bar na bu mo chung chung sha stag red na dmag dpon min pa thag chod/ mtha' mjug tu tshang ma bcings 'grol dmag mi yin pa mthong skabs nga tshos lag pa sgul phod ma byung ’’zhes bshad byung /ngas ‘‘gnas tshul de 'dra zhig rang yod ’ces bshad pa dang sbrags kho'i skad char dgod shor zhing ‘‘nga zla shas kha spu bzhar med pas khyed tshos ngo shes 152

dka' ba los yin ’’zhes bshad/ de nas bzung nga gnyis ngo shes su gyur/rjes su kho pa thengs kha shas 'phrad byung / mi de kha bzo 'pher po yod la rgya skad bod skad chu rgyug rgyug rgyag shes stabs phran bu'i do snang ma byas na kho pa bod rigs yin pa rtogs mi thub/brgyad/ me sgrogs kyi me lce'i khrod kyi khrang zhi'i sdengs cha/1962lo'i zla 10tshes 20nyin krung hin mtha' mtshams kyi rang srung rgol lan dmag 'khrug langs pa dang / skabs de dus hin rdus lu'i bcu lhag tsam gyi dmag shugs btang nas krung hin mtha' mtshams kyi shar nub gnyis nas dus gcig tu krung gor tshur rgol byas/ krung go'i mtha' srung dmag dpung gis shar rgyud nas ‘‘ma'e khe ma hung sa thig mi byang ngos kyi khe ji lang sa khul bar btsan 'dzul byed mkhan hin dmag lu'i bdun pa dang de min gyi hin dmag khag gcig gtor thengs gcig la rtsa med bzos/ de mtshungs su nub rgyud nas hin dmag gis khrims 'gal gyis btsugs pa'i btsan 'dzul gyi rten gzhi 27yod pa de rnams rtsa brlag tu btang / hin rdu'i phyogs nas pham nyes byung bar sdug 'khur ma bzod par slar yang dmag shugs cher bsgrigs kyis byang phyogs su tshur rgol byas/ zla 11tshes 16nyin krung go'i mtha' srung dpung sdes slar yang phar rgol byas te nub ri'i rgyud dang / pang 'di'i la/ wa lung sa khul bcas la snga rjes su sa phyogs khag nas tshur rgol byed mkhan hin dmag rtsa med btang ba dang / slar yang btsan 'dzul gyi rten gzhi khag 16rtsa med bzos shing / snga rjes su hin dmag dpung shog lu'i gnyis tshar gcod dang lu'i gsum nang gi mang che ba rtsa med bzos pa dang /'grun cang dmag dpon dang lu'i krang dmag dpon ha'o 'ar shin ka dang 153

tar wu'i gnyis kyi gsham 'og dpon dmag bsdoms mi grangs rdo700lhag tsam zhig bsad rmas sam 'dzin bzung byas/ skabs der nga tsho'i si khron khrang zhi tshogs pa shar rgyud du ‘‘ting gi bkod 'doms ’’zhes pa'i bya spyod nang zhugs yod/ ‘‘ting gi bkod 'doms ’’zhes pa de cun 54yi ting hreng bkod 'doms pu'u la zer/ ting hreng lags ni khrang zhi'i zlos gar la zhen chags shin tu che zhing dmag rgyag pa'i bar mtshams la chas gos mnabs stangs las g.yog gi tshul dang 'dra bar thugs brel med tshe mi tshogs nang nas 'tshang kha bkyon te nga tsho'i 'khrab ston gzigs par phebs/ zhal lag mchod skabs khong gis dbu 'dzin gyi dmigs bsal bzhugs sar mi bzhugs par zhal dkar phyag la bsnams te nga tsho 'khrab ston pa ji bzhin rub rub dang mi mang tshogs sar phebs rgyur mnyes po yod pas rgyus mnga' med pa zhig gi bltas na dpung shog khri stong mang por bkod 'doms gnang mkhan gyi dmag dpon zhig red bsam pa ga la yong / nga tsho'i 'bod tshig ni ‘‘gang du dmag sa yod gyur na de ru zlos gar 'khrab stegs yod mi’ces pa de yin/ dmag dpung gis mdun du mchongs nas dgra bo'i rjes 'ded gtong ba na/ nga tshos rjes nas dmag dpung gi rjes zin pa 'gro ba dang / dmag dpung 'gro mtshams bzhag nas ngal gso brgyab ma thag nga tshos lam sang 'khrab chas bton nas 'thab 'dzing pa tshor 'khrab ston byed cing / tha na skar ma 'ga' shas las med kyang 'khrab thabs byed/ dmag dpung 'gro bskyod byed pa na nga tshos kyang de ma thag tu rdog chas bsgril te rjes su 'brangs/ dmag dpung ‘‘ma'e khe mā hung sa thig ’’las brgal skabs nga tsho'ang mnyam du slebs shing rgya gar gyi grong gsar la slebs mtshams gzhi nas phyir log byas/ zla 12tshes 1nyin nas 'go tshugs krung go'i mtha' srung 154

dmag dpung rnams krung dbyang gi bka' bkod bzhin spyi le 20sar phyir 'then byas/ nga tshos rdza yul du phyir 'then dmag dpung brgyud dgos nges kyi sa cha zhig 'khrab yul la dmigs nas gra sgrig ang gsar gyis dmag dpung 'byor ma thag nga tshos 'khrab ston byed pa dang / dmag dpung thon rjes tshang ma gzhi nas ngal gso brgyab/ dmag dpung dpung shog re re bzhin phyir 'then byas gshis nga tsho'i 'khrab ston yang chu rgyun bzhin 'khrab thag ma chod/'khrab gzhung ni 〈chu log brtul ba 〉zhes pa dang 〈gnam sgo'i jus las rnam par brgal ba 〉zhes pa sogs dang zlos gar gyi rol cha dang rnga sbub gyi sgra di ri ri sgrogs shing / nga tsho'i nye 'gram la btson ra zhig yod pa'i mtha' 'khor lcags skud kyis bskor yod cing / de'i nang bzung dmag hin rdu ba lnga brgya drug brgya skor yod pa de rigs kyis 'dzems snang med par a ri'i tha mag 'then bzhin du hu rir nga tsho'i 'khrab ston la blta bzhin 'dug 'khrab ston tshar rjes khrang zhi ba tsho 'khrab chas kyang ma phud par hin dmag la blta bar song zhing phan tshun gnyis ka ya mtshan chen po zhig byung / bzung dmag nang da dung spre'u gcig kyang yod pa de ni dmag dpon go sa krung cang yin pa'i kha'o er bros byol skabs kho pa'i rlangs 'khor nang lus pa red 'dugabacings 'grol dmag gis spre'u de bzung rjes zlos gar tshogs pa'i 'khrab ston pa chung gras tshang mas de la dga' po byed pa shes pas zlos gar tshogs par gnang zhing phyis su rbad de gso nyar gyis si khron du log skabs kyang mnyam du 'khrid pa red/dgu/ sa mtho'i thog khyim tshang 'dzugs pa/khrang zhi tshogs pa bod du sdod ring gi lo lnga'i nang nga tshos yun ring bod 155

ljongs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i gra sgrig tan tan byas shing pha tsha bu rgyud si khron la phyir ma log par bod du sdod rtsis byas/ der rgya rigs las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa mang po yod cing gang sar pha yul gcig pa si khron pas khengs yod/ nga tsho rme ru dgon pa'i sdod gnas la khrang zhi'i sdings cha bzos pa dang tshogs pa'i ming yang ‘‘bod ljongs si khron khrang zhi tshogs pa ’’zhes par bsgyur cing / dus tshod nges med nang 'khrab tshan 'ga' 'khrab ston byas pa dang nga tshos da dung lha sa'i shar ngos dpal sding la mu'u bcu lhag tsam yod pa'i zhing rwa zhig bzung yod pa de'i sa rgyu ha cang gshin po yod cing dmag dpung nas 'drud 'then 'phrul 'khor btang nas nga tsho'i sa zhing rmo rogs byed kyi yod gshis nga tshos 'debs rkyang dang bsdu rkyang kho na byas pas 'grig ngas bza' zla bu phrug tshang ma bod du bsus shing bu mo brgyad gcig slob chung du slob grwar btang /lha sar lo gnyis la nye ba zhig bsdad rjes khrang zhi tshogs pa chab mdor gnas spos/ bod yongs kyi sa cha nas nying khri phud chab mdo yag shos yin/der kha rlung bzang ba dang char chu mang ba/ sa rgyu gshin po bcas yod stabs ‘‘zas sna 'dzoms pa'i yul khams ’’zhes bshad chog der slebs rjes tshang ma'i sems de bas lhod la babs/ de gar nga tsho'i zhing rwa shin tu rgya che bas 'bru rigs dang tshal rigs bzas mi tshar ba dang lan hwa pad tshal shin tu che bas de'i thog mi'ang sdod thub/ phag pa'ang lus shed rgyas te tshil lu mang bas bza' dka'/ skabs de'i lo shas nang mes rgyal nang khul du 'tsho ba ngan ngon las med pas mi mang po zhig 'bam nad phog pa dang da dung mi mi nyung ba zhig bkres ltogs kyis mnar nas 'chi lam du gyur/ 'on kyang nga tsho bod du 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen 'grig tshod yod cing / de skabs kyi dmag dpung dang sa gnas 156

gnyis kas nga tshor 'bru rigs dang snum mkho 'don byas/ de lta bu'i dus skabs bzang po gang nas 'tshol thub/ dmag dpung gis nga tsho'i zlos gar tshogs par dmigs bsal gyi lta skyong gnang zhing pags pa'i tā dbyi'i dang ko lham/ kam pa li sogs gang mkho de sprod gnang gi yod/ rang skyong ljongs kyis nga ljongs srid gros kyi u yon du bkod sgrig gnang ba dang chab mdor slebs rjes slar nga/nga nga de ga'i srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon la bkod sgrig gnang byung / de mtshams su ngas slob grwa zhig gnyer rgyu'i gra sgrig byas shing khrang zhi tshogs pa'i bu phrug tsho slob grwar bskyod rgyu'i gnad don de thag gcod byed dgos snyam zhing / de 'dra byung tshe tshang ma'i khyim tshang gi sems khral gang yang med par byed thub/nga tshos yun ring bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i 'char gzhi 'god pa'i skabs kyi 1ba64lo der dus bab slar yang dza drag tu song zhing / bod du ‘‘slar yang zing 'khrug langs ’’rgyu'i nyen kha yod ces dkrog gtam gang sar khyab/ krung dbyang nas bod du yod pa'i thon skyed dang dmag don tshan pa phud de min tshang ma thog mar gang nas yong ba der phyir log byed dgos pa'i brda tho 'byor stabs nga tsho si khron du phyir log mi byed ka med byung / si ling yon krang go hwas kyang nga tsho phyir log gtong ma phod par khyed tsho sngon la phyir log byas te gnas skabs shig ngal gso dang spyong sgrig byas nas nus shugs je cher gtong thabs byed dgos/ ji ltar yang lo gnyis nas mi 'gyangs par ngas slar yang khyed tsho 'dir gdan drangs chog ces gsungs/ dmag dpung gis nga tsho mi rer dmag spyod kam pa li re gnang ba dang de min rlangs 'khor chen po gnyis kyang gnang rtsis yod mod kyang nga tshos ma blangs/ de nas nga tsho chab mdo nas rdog thon byas te khron bod gzhung lam brgyud si khron du phyir log byas/157

lam bar du brgyud pa'i dmag sgar dang grong brdal khag la 'byor rim du nga tshos 'gro mtshams bzhag nas nga tsho'i 'khrab tshan yag shos gras 'khrab ston byas/ lhag par du 〈skyes mi chog pa'i mi 〉zhes pa'i 'khrab bya de skabs de'i gral rim slob gso dang mthun stabs kun gyi gleng cha chen po byung zhing / khren tur slebs mur khren tu dmag khul khang gis nga tsho bcings 'grol dmag glog brnyan zlos gar khang du 'khrab ston gyi bkod sgrig gnang zhing bstud mar 'khrab thengs 40lhag tsam byas pa dang 'khrab thengs tshang mar zlos gar khang la sdod sa stong pa gcig kyang ma lus par rang khengs su gyur/ de ltar rgyun mthud kyis zla 1rkyapa'i zla mjug bar 'khrab ston byas rjes gzhi nas nga tsho su'i nying khul du phyir log byas pa yin/zhar byung / 1rdzo59lor man yang kron chus kyi si khron khrang zhi chogs pa gnyis pa'i be+ed du bskyod mkhan gyi ming tho/rus ming / pho mo/ lo grangs/ zur mchan/cha'o wun kang / pho/ 44 thon krang /tseng kru'u cha'o/ pho/ 24 thon krang gzhon pa/ 'das zin/zha'o dbyi shin/ pho/ 40 bzo tshogs kru'u zhi/ skyes pa gtso 'khrab pa/tseng cid yun/ pho/ 40 rnga pa/ 'das zin/h+phan kren hen/ mo/ 42 bud med gtso 'khrab pa/ 'das zin/dbyang h+phung ching / mo/ 25 khyim ma 'khrab mkhan/ rgyal yongs gsum brgyad dar bsgrengs pa/khren shing / mo/ 29 dpa' mo 'khrab mkhan/yon tha'o co'an/ mo/ 2ṭ+wāṃ gzhon nu ma 'khrab mkhan/158

thang yung zha'o/ pho/ 25 rig gnas pa 'khrab mkhan/zhe ta cun/ mo/ 20 gzhon nu ma 'khrab mkhan/li khe ming / pho/ 2rdo rtsis pa/cang khrun yus/ mo/ 15 khyim ma 'khrab mkhan/dbyin an pi/ mo/ 14 gzhon nu ma 'khrab mkhan/krang zhi'u pi/ mo/ 14 dpa' mo 'khrab mkhan/li'ang tun yu'i/ mo/ 15 gzhon nu ma 'khrab mkhan/dbyang ha'e kro'u/ pho/ 42 zhwa chas bdag gnyer pa/ 'das zin/li'u hra'o yun/ pho/ 2ra 'khrab chas bdag gnyer pa/krang wan go/ pho/ 24 g.yog 'khrab mkhan/li'u tsha'e te/ pho/ 44 glog las pa/ 'das zin/go kha'i/ pho/ 29 gnyer pa/can tse yun/ pho/ 29 ma byan/dbying hung cun/ pho/ 40 ris mo ba/ 'das zin/li'u hra'o wu'u/ pho/ 42 'khrab chas bdag gnyer pa/tun tsu'o khrang / pho/ 2kha g.yog 'khrab mkhan/ 'das zin/krang li kre/ pho/ 42 hu'u chin gtong mkhan/ 'das zin/ho phe kre/ pho/ 40 rol dbyangs rtsom mkhan/ 'das zin/krang zha'o khre/ pho/ 42 tshogs gtso gzhon pa/ 'das zin/khren ko'ang rming / pho/ 24 gzhung las khang gi kru'u ren/lu'o go hwa/ pho/ 40 spyi khyab 'khrab khrid pa/wu'u tse can/ pho/ 42 skyes pa gtso 'khrab pa/h+phu'u wun le'ang / pho/ 29 skyes pa drag rtsal can 'khrab mkhan/'das zin/ho'ang kha'i/ pho/ 25 skyes pa drag rtsal can 'khrab mkhan/159

'das zin/wan ho ling / pho/ 29 skyes pa drag rtsal can khrab mkhan/'das zin/hre ti chi'i/ mo/ 21 gzhon nu ma 'khrab mkhan/ thon kri pu'u hru'u ci/li zhu'e lin/ pho/ 1rdo skyes pa rtsal mkhas bstan bshig can 'khrab mkhan/li'u kong h+phu'u/ pho/ 2 2 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan/rmi tse zhi'u/ mo/ 14 dpa' mo 'khrab mkhan/li'ang h+phu yun/ mo/ 16 khyim ma 'khrab mkhan/ho su'i an/ mo/ 14 dpa' mo 'khrab mkhan/wang h+phung ching/ mo/ 15 nag gos pa 'khrab mkhan/ 'das zin/hu'u wun zho'an/ pho/ 42 sbub chal che ba rdung mkhan/kren thing kong / pho/ 46 tsag tsig pa/ 'das zin/tha'an ching yun/ pho/ 25 g.yog 'khrab mkhan/dbyang li'an khreng / pho/ 41 glog las pa/tshu'i ping yun/ pho/ 40 'khrab ljongs pa/ 'das zin/kra'o ting go/ pho/ 4rkya ma byan che mo ba/ka'o tha'i hwa/ pho/ 20 ma byan/wang chan li'u/ mo/ 11 gzhon nu ma 'khrab mkhan/krung khrang li'u/ pho/ 20 g.yog 'khrab mkhan/li'ang kha'i rming / pho/ 42 rnga pa/ 'das zin/li'u te'ang h+phu/ pho/ 40 'khar rnga che ba rdung mkhan/ 'das zin/cang an ci/ pho/ 2ṭ+wāṃ 'khar rnga chung ba rdung mkhan/'das zin/160

li ha'i tha'o/ pho/ 41 'bud gtong rol cha dkrol mkhan/zhe kong rming / pho/ 2kha 'khar rnga chung ba rdung mkhan/wang to'o phing / pho/ 16 rol dbyangs pa/h+phan thing h+phen/ mo/ 21 ram skyor gtong mkhan/ 'das zin/wang yung khrang / pho/ 11 pho gzhon 'khrab mkhan/li'u wu'u krung / pho/ 14 rang gshis mngon pa'i skyes pa gdong khra 'khrab mkhan/pa'e yung khang / pho/ 10 slob ma/krang rming / pho/ 11 slob ma/phe'ang khe yun/ pho/ 25 skyes pa 'khrab mkhan/sun go zhi'i/ pho/ 12 rang gshis mngon pa'i skyes pa gdong khra 'khrab mkhan/wang su'u lān/ mo/ 22 rgad mo 'khrab mkhan/thang yus kren/ mo/ 15 ram skyor mkhan/dbyang hung / pho/ 16 'khar rnga che ba rdung mkhan/ 'das zin/dbyin hra'o khreng / pho/ 44 dmigs bsal can 'khrab mkhan/'das zin/li su'u zhan/ pho/ 41 pho rdzus mo 'khrab pa/ 'das zin/cang ha'o hran/ pho/ 25 'khar rnga chung ba rdung mkhan/'das zin/yu'i hrun we/ mo/ 14 slob ma/cang hrun te/ pho/ 21 pho gzhon 'khrab mkhan/kra'o ko'ang to'u/ pho/ 40 g.yog 'khrab mkhan/krang yi'u nyan/ pho/ 15 drag rtsal deg rdung pa 'khrab mkhan/dbyang wun ya'o/ pho/ 2rdo pho gzhon 'khrab mkhan/ 'das zin/161

kreng zhus tung / pho/ 42 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan/ 'das zin/kung h+phu cho'an/ pho/ 22 sna dkar khra can 'khrab mkhan/'das zin/dbyang su'u kren/ mo/ 44 zhing rwa'i bzo pa/ 'das zin/thu'u su'u ching / mo/ 41 zhing rwa'i bzo pa/ 'das zin/wu'u hwa'i ching / pho/ 44 'khrab chas bdag gnyer pa/'das zin/thang hrun rung / mo/ 42 chi'u wun kang yi bza' zla/cang rung ya'o/ pho/ 20 rnga gnyis ldan rdung mkhan/chi'i li'ang / pho/ 15 rol mo ba/wang hra'o hwa/ pho/ 21 rnga gnyis rdung mkhan/kran kreng chis/ pho/ 24 rol mo ba/dbyang krung jon/ pho/ 12 pho gzhon 'khrab mkhan/hu'u hre jon/ pho/ 9 bu chung 'khrab mkhan/li'ang kha'i dbyi/ pho/ 11 slob ma/kre'ang zho'an dbyi/ pho/ 15 skyes pa 'khrab mkhan/li cun/ pho/ 26 skyes pa 'khrab mkhan/ho yus lung / pho/ 12 skyes pa drag rtsal can 'khrab mkhan/kra'o hra'o zhan/ mo/ 16 rgan mo 'khrab mkhan/to'an su'u kren/ mo/ 15 slob ma/li'u hre ho/ pho/ 17 spub chen rdung mkhan/krang rming jo'an/ pho/ 22 g.yog 'khrab mkhan/ 'das zin/li ko'ang zhan/ pho/ 40 g.yog 'khrab mkhan/kung te yun/ pho/ 29 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan/me'o te zhi'u/ mo/ 14 slob ma/ 162

cang hru'u te/ mo/ 25 rgan mo 'khrab mkhan/ko'o hru'u dbyi/ mo/ 27 gzhon ma 'khrab mkhan/kreng teng wu'u/ pho/ 44 skyes pa phal pa 'khrab mkhan/'das zin/thang ho'o ran/ mo/ 25 dngul gnyer/dbyang tse yun/ pho/ 27 drag rtsal rdeg rdung pa 'khrab mkhan/'das zin/dbyang tse zhu'e/ mo/ 44 zhing ra'i bzo pa/ 'das zin/khren hre cun/ mo/ 4rkya zhing ra'i bzo pa/ 'das zin/krang kung jung / mo/ 27 bzo pa/li'ang kran go/ pho/ 29 ma byan che mo ba/chi'u kreng yung / mo/ 2 chi'u wun kang gi gces phrug

chab mdo'i g.yul 'argyad las don gyi zin bris gnad bsdus/dbyang dbyi kren/spyi lo 1949lor mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'thab 'di bzhin rgyal yongs su thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i rgyal kha thob pa dang / rgyal yongs mi dmangs spro sems rab tu 'khol zhing gsar brje'i dus bab nyin rer le dbar stong phrag bskyod pa lta bur snang / mes rgyal skam sa chen por bod sa gnas phud pa'i sa cha yongs su bcings 'grol thob zin pa red/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas go min tang gi mnga' thang nyams zin par gzhigs nas sngar bas btsan rgyal ring lugs dang ngan 'brel byas te mes rgyal la rgyab gtod bya rgyu'i ngan sems bcangs shing / btsan rgyal ring lugs dang rgyal phyi'i log spyod stobs shugs kyi rgyab skyor dang jus skul 'og spyi lo 194khalo'i zla 7tshes rdonyin ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud don rkyen ’’bzos pa ma zad/ ‘‘mthun 'brel tshogs pa ’’zer ba zhig sgrig 'dzugs kyis rgya gar dang / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab khag la bskyod de rgyal khab la rgyab gtod byas te ‘‘rang btsan ’’gyi byed sgo spel rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa red/krung dbyang gis mgyogs myur mes rgyal skam sa chen po gcig gyur yong ched gcig nas nus ldan gyi phyi 'brel 'thab rtsod byed pa dang / gnyis nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la gang mgyogs 'thus mi tshogs pa btang nas gros 164

mol— bya rgyu'i 'bod skul byas te bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i brtson len byas pa red/ 'on kyang btsan rgyal ring lugs dang phyi rgyal log spyod shog khag gis bod la bcangs pa'i skog g.yo'i ngan sems nyin bzhin shugs cher 'gro bzhin par brten tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis ‘‘bod du dpung bskyod bya rgyu ni snga ba las phyi mi 'os mi’pa'i mdzad phyogs dus thog tu bton nas cun bco brgyad par gra sgrig gang legs byas te sems thag gtsang bcad ngang bod la dpung bskyod dang / bod bcings 'grol gtong dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba red/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 2par zhi ba'i gros mol 'thus mi tshogs pa btang yod kyang dmag 'thab kyi 'dod blo 'dzin mkhan shog khag gi ham bzung 'og 'thus mi tshogs pa pe cin du 'gro mi 'dod par rgya gar du rang sor bsdad pa dang dus mtshungs dmag shugs rgya bskyed du shugs chen btang nas dmag gra sgrig pa dang / dpung chen chab mdor rub 'dzoms kyis 'bri chur rgyab rten byas te bkod sgrig nan po'i thog rang dmag nub phyogs su dpung bskyod byed par bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i re ngan bcangs/rang res mngags gtong byas pa'i zhi ba'i pho nya dge rtag sprul sku'ang chab mdor 'byor rjes gdug rtsub kyi sgo nas lkog gsod byas pa red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og mes rgyal skam sa chen po gcig gyur dang / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob phyir nges par du dmag don thad kyi 'gran rtsod byed dgos pa ni g.yol thabs bral ba'i dus bab zhig chags yod pa red/ der brten spyi lo 195rkyalo'i zla 1tshes 10nyin cun krang krang go hwa khrung ching du phebs nas bod la dpung bskyod dang bod bcings 'grol gtong dgos pa'i gzi brjid kyi las 'gan bzhes rjes zla ba dgu yi ring gra sgrig khag byas pa 165

brgyud spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 10par chab mdor g.yul 'gyed bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas pa red/chab mdo g.yul 'gyed ni rang re'i krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdo sa khul du bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bod dmag gtso shugs rtsa gtor gtong ba'i dmag 'thab cig yin/ dmag 'thab de'i nang bod dmag gi mda' dpon (thon zhig dang mtshungs ) drug po yongs dang mda' dpon gsum gyi mang che ba ste bsdoms mi grangs 570rkyalhag tsam rtsa gtor btang nas bod la dpung bskyod kyi sgo mo 'byed pa dang bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ched rmang gzhi 'ding thub pa byung yod/ dmag 'thab gra sgrig dang lag len byed ring rang nyid cun bco brgyad pa'i mdun skyod bkod 'doms pu'u nang du las ka byed kyi yod pas de dus kyi las ka'i zin bris legs sgrig 'grems spel byas nas blo mthun rnam par zhib 'jug dang dpyad gzhir 'bul rgyu yin/ gal te nor 'khrul dang chad lus yod tshe de skabs kyi bod bskyod dbu khrid dang blo mthun rgan gras rnams nas skyon brjod dang legs bcos yod pa zhu/1950lo'i zla 2ches 15nyin/btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i gnya' gnon 'og tu tshud pa'i bod rigs spun zla rnams bcings 'grol thob rgyu dang / mes rgyal gyi nub phyogs rgyal srung sra brtan yong ched krung gung krung dbyang lho nub cus dang / krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag lho nub dmag khul khang thang 'thab cun gnyis pa'i si ling pu'u gnyis nas zung 'brel thog bka' mngags ltar bod du dpung skyod byed mkhan dmag dpung la chab srid skul slong gi bka' btang 166

don/ bod du dpung skyod byas te bod de nyid bcings 'grol btang nas mes rgyal gcig gyur yong ba'i bya gzhag legs grub dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs par rang rgyal gyi sa cha tshon gang tsam la'ang btsan 'dzul byed du mi 'jug pa/mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams srung skyob dang 'dzugs skrun gyi las 'gan bsgrub rgyu ni ha cang gzi brjid ldan pa zhig yin zhes bton pa dang / skul slong gi bka' rgya'i nang du bod bskyod dmag dpung gi dpon dmag yongs dang gung khran tang yon tshang mas gsar brje'i bya gzhag la bla na med pa'i lhag bsam rgyun 'khyongs dang bod la dpung bskyod byed pa'i rlabs che'i chab srid don snying ngos 'dzin gting gzab byed dgos pa ma zad/ bsam blo dang / rtsa 'dzugs/ las don bcas kyi thog gra sgrig gang legs byas te mi dmangs dmag dpung gi dpa' ngar brtul phod dang / dka' spyad 'bad 'thab kyi srol rgyun bzang po dar spel dang / mthun sgril mnyam rub byed pa dang gral rim gyi mdza' bshes zab pa'i snying stobs dar spel gyis blo thag rbad bcad sgo nas bod du dpung bskyod bya rgyu'i las 'gan legs grub dgos pa'i 'bod skul gnang ba dang sbrags bod bskyod dmag dpung gis khams dang bod sa khul gyi spun zla dang mdza' mthun yong ba dang / lhag bsam zol med ngang (thun mong rtsa 'dzin 〉nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i mi rigs srid jus lag bstar dang / nan tan ngang 〈sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad 〉dang 〈sdom khrims brgyad 〉lag len byed dgos/ brtag zhib gting zab dang / dril bsgrags kyi las ka gang legs byas te sa gnas de ga'i skad yig slob sbyong dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul shes rtogs byed pa/ mi dmangs kyi bde sdug la sems 'khur gyis kho/ tsho'i dka' sdug sel rogs hur brtson byed dgos pa'i skul brda gnang ba ma zad/ bka' rgya'i ci 167

mjug tu dpon dmag tshang mas yun ring bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa'i bsam blo dang chod sems 'dzugs dgos pa dang / dpung skyod byed skabs mi shugs dang dngos shugs la bdag gces gron chung bya rgyur do snang byas te hur brtson ngang 'gro lam bzos nas 'grim 'grul 'dzugs skrun gong 'phel gtong dgos/ dmag don bya spyod spel mtshams bzhag rjes bod kyi dpal 'byor rig gnas 'phel rgyas shugs chen gtong dgos pa dang /bod mi dmangs dang mnyam du thun mong thog dmangs gtso dar rgyas kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byas te rang dbang dang bde skyid/ dpal yon ldan pa'i me tog mes rgyal mtha' mtshams gang sar bzhad par byed dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod/rlabs che ba'i dpung bskyod byed 'go tshugs nyer blo mthun rnams kyis gra sgrig ang gsar byas nas tshang mas bod bcings 'grol gtong ched nus shugs yod tshad legs skyes su 'bul rgyu dang / gsar brje mthar phyin pa bya rgyu'i chod sems mtshon par byas/1950lo'i zla 2ches 14nyin/cun pu'u nas mdun skyod bkod 'ardoms so'o dang / sngon skyod yan lag ru khag 'dzugs rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas/'di lor bod la dpung skyod byed thub pa dang / zla 6par chab ma do'i g.yul 'gyed mjug sgril nas zla 9pa'i zla mjug la lha sar 'byor thub pa'i brtson len byed ched hre 52dang 52pa gnyis so so nas thon re (thon 154dang thon 157) tshur 'then te hre pu'u yis khu 'dus las 'pher gyi bkod 'doms las khungs shig sgrig 'dzugs bya rgyu ma zad/ hre'i las byed pa 168

mi gnyis (wu'u krung dang me'o h+phe dbyi )mngags gtong gis sngon skyod ru khag btsugs nas hre 52pa dkar mdzes dang hre 52pa 'ba' an du bskyod rgyu byas/ cun pu'u yi blo mthun wang chi rmin dang li cu'e gnyis kyis bzo skrun ying dang / myul zhib ying / zhib 'jug khang / de bzhin rgyab phyogs zhabs zhu'i mi sna khag gcig bcas las grub pa'i mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o yi sne khrid nas dar rtse mdor 'byor/ de'i las 'gan ni hre 52dang 52pa'i sngon skyod ru khag la gcig gyur bkod 'doms bya rgyu ma zad bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi gnas tshul brtag zhib byas te bod du dpung skyod byed pa'i lam thig dang srid jus gtan 'khel bya rgyur dpyad gzhi dang bsam 'char mkho 'don/ de bzhin chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi ched du dmag 'thab 'char gzhi gra sgrig dang 'brel yod dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu bya rgyu bcas yin/1950lo'i zla 2ches 29nyin/hre 52kyi hre krang wu'u krung gis hre'i mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o dang thon 154yongs khrid nas snga dro le hran (྾tshe)nas thon te de nub zhin cin (ཿ6tshokhyi)du zhag sdod byas/cun mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o yā an du rdog thon byas/1950lo'i zla 4ches 1nyin/hre 52gyi mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o yis thon 157pa khrid de rdog thon gyis than chon du bca' sdod byas/1950lo'i zla 4ches 24nyin/cun mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o de nyin chu tshod bco lnga pa'i thog 169

dar rtse mdo ru 'byor/1950lo'i zla 4ches 2rdonyin/hre 52kyi mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o dkar mdzes su 'byor/1rdzo50lo'i zla 5tshes 14nyin/cun pu'u yis khrung ching phyogs kyi mdzad phyogs la brten nas bod du dpung skyod bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang don/gcig khams bod sa khul gyi rang byung cha rkyen dang rang re'i dngos rdzas mkho sprod kyi gnas tshul gzhir bzung bod la dus rim dbye nas dpung skyod bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas pa ste gom pa dang por zla brgyad pa'i zla mjug la chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong rgyu dang / gom pa gnyis par lha sa dang /gzhis rtse/ sgar thog (oṃrkiṭ+wāṃ)bcas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu/gnyis/ lha sa'i srid 'dzin mkhan la thabs shes yod rgu btang nas kho pa tsho krung go gsar pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung la mgo sgur rgyur brtson len gyis chab srid la brten nas bod la dpung skyod byed dgos/ gal te chab srid kyi thog nas dpung skyod byed thub tshe rang dmag la khe phan yod par brten sngon skyod dmag dpung khag gis gnas yul ang dang por 'byor rjes 'gro lam slar bzo dang dngos rdzas skyel 'dren bcas kyi gom pa gnyis pa'i gra sgrig bya rgyu phud chab srid kyi phar rgol bya rgyur shugs snon rgyag dgos/1950lo'i zla 5ches 16nyin/hre 52kyi mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o dang thon 154pa'i ying gnyis pa 'bri chu'i shar ngos chu 'gram gyi 'dan khog la bca' sdod byas/170

1rdzo50lo'izla 5ches 24nyin/cun pu'u nas sngon skyod yan lag ru khag gi las don la mdzub ston gnang don/sde dge dang 'dan khog tu bca' sdod sngon skyod dmag dpung gis mig sngar 'bri chu brgal na mi 'tsham pa dang / gra sgrig gi las ka mtha' dag gsang ba gang thub kyi sgo nas byed dgos/ rang phyogs kyis chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi dmag shugs spyod lugs gtso bo ni 'dan khog gi phyogs nas gab yib byed bzhin 'bri chu brgal te ri bo che dang chab mdo'i nub byang gtor nas bod dmagagi phyir bros lam bu bcad rgyu'i gra sgrig yod pas mig sngar thabs shes spyad de bod dmag gi do snang byed shugs de 'ba' an dang sde dge'i phyogs su 'gyur thabs bya rgyu de yin/1950lo'i zla 6ches 5nyin/ cun pu'u yis hre 52dang 52gyi sngon skyod yan lag ru khag dang / cun gyi mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o bcas la chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi thog ma'i bkod sgrig bsam 'char bton/1950lo'i zla 6ches 6nyin/ hre 52pa'i chab srid u yon gzhon pa blo mthun me'o h+phe dbyi yis sngon skyod yan lag ru khag gi thon 157pa khrid nas chu tshod bcu bzhi'i thog than chon nas rdog thon gyis dar rtse mdo brgyud de 'ba' an phyogs su dpung skyod byas/171

1950lo'izla 6ches 12nyin/hre 52gyi sngon skyod yan lag ru khag dar rtse mdor 'byor/1950lo'i zla 6ches 20nyin/lho nub dmag khul khang gis chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi thog ma'i bkod sgrig bsam 'char la mos mthun byas pa bzhin chog mchan gnang /1950lo'i zla 6ches 21nyin/dpung skyod kyi gra sgrig myur gtong dang dus tshod snga snur yong ched cun pu'u nas gtan 'bebs byas don/ hre 52pa'i thon 15rdotshes 2〈nyin sbe krang (—phyo4)nas rdog thon gyis bzo skrun thon bdun par gzhogs 'degs byas te than chon nas 'gro lam gnyis mtshams kyi 'gro lam dang zam pa 'phral bzo bya rgyu dang / hre 54pa'i thon 162tshes 26nyin rdog thon gyis bzo skrun dmag la gzhogs 'degs byas te than chon nas ar lang ri bo'i mtshams kyi 'gro lam dang zam pa bzo dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang /1950lo'i zla 6ches 22nyin/hre 52pa'i thon 154sngon skyod dmag dpung gi myul zhib pha'e yis 'bri chu brgal nas myul zhib byas pa dang / chu tshod bcu pa'i thog 'dan khog nub phyogs le dbar 40sar bod dmag gi rta dmag dang 'phrad nas bod dmag gtor pham du btang / chu tshod 12tsam la bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag gis rang re'i myul zhib pha'e phyogs su ngar mchongs byas pas myul zhib pha'e yis 'thab kyin phyir 'then byas pa dang / bod dmag khag gcig gis 'dan 172

khog phyogs su rjes 'ded byas/ thon 154yi lan bzhijipa dang drug pas 'tshab 'tshub ngang 'bri chu brgal nas dmag lan sprad pa dang / bod dmag gi sku tshab mda' dpon dang brgya dpon man chad mi grangs 60tsam bsad/1950lo'i zla 6ches 24nyin/cun pu'u nas mdzub ston gnang bar/shes rtogs byung gsal la/ chab mdo'i bod dmag khag gcig 'dan khog dang sde dge'i phyogs su skong 'then byed pa dang / rang res chab srid kyi thog nas bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i lhag bsam mtshon pa dang /lha sa'i dbang bsgyur par srid jus khag la bsam gzhigs byed pa'i dus tshod sprod ched dang sbrags rang re'i mkho sprod kyi gnad don thag gcod ma byung ba dang / dmag shugs gcig bsdus bya thabs bral bar brten mig sngar bod dmag dang rgya che ba'i dmag 'thab byas tshe rang rer phan thogs med stabs nga tshos bod dmag dang dmag 'thab rgyag rgyu de phyir 'gyangs gang thub byas thog nus shugs gcig bsdus kyis chab srid kyi brtson len dang / gra sgrig gi las don khag spel dgos/ 'bri chu brgal nas nub ngos su yod pa'i dmag dpung tshang ma 'bri chu'i shar ngos su phyir 'then byed dgos/ bod dmag gis 'bri chu brgal nas shar ngos su 'dzul yong ba'i gnas tshul 'og gzhi nas phar rgol byed dgos pa ma zad/ sems thag gtsang bcad kyis rtsa med gtong dgos pa bcas red/gong gsal gyi mdzub ston la gzhigs te thon 154yi lan bzhi pa dang drug pa/ myul zhib pha'e bcas 'bri chu'i shar ngos kyi 'dan khog tu phyir 'then byas/173

1950lo'i zla 7ches 10nyin/dge rtag sprul sku dkar mdzes rdzong dpal gling dgon nas lha sar phebs te bod kyi srid 'dzin mkhan la go skon blo 'gug gis zhi ba'i thog nas bod du dpung skyod bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/dge rtag sprul sku ma phebs gong la krung dbyang gis chog mchan thob pa'i zhi bas bod du dpung skyod bya rgyu'i gros mol gyi rmang gzhi don tshan bcu 'khyer rgyu yod pa ste/gcig bod mi dmangs mthun sgril gyis dbyin ji dang a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i stobs shugs bod nas phyir 'bud byas te bod 'di krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang phyir log byed dgos/gnyis/ bod mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag len bya rgyu/gsum/ bod kyi da yod lam lugs sna tshogs rang sor 'jog pa las 'gyur ldog mi gtong rgyu dang / tā la'i bla ma'i 'gan dbang dang go gnas la 'gyur ldog mi gtong ba dang rim pa khag gi dpon rigs kyang sngar bzhin las gnas thog 'jog rgyu/bzhi/ chos dad rang mos lag bstar gyis dgon sde srung skyob dang bod mi dmangs kyi chos dad dang / yul srol goms gshis la brtsi srung zhu rgyu/lnga/ bod kyi da yod dmag don lam lugs la 'gyur ldog mi btang bar da yod dmag dpung de dag krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal srung drag chas kyi cha shas shig la 'gyur bar bya rgyu/drug bod kyi skad yig dang slob grwa'i slob gso 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu/174

bdun/ bod kyi zhing 'brog bzo tshong las rigs 'phel rgyas btang ste mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos gtong rgyu/brgyad/ bod kyi bcos bsgyur skor gyi 'brel yod las don khag thams cad bod mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo gzhir bzung bod mi dmangs dang bod kyi 'go khrid mi snas gros mol gyi bya thabs spyad nas thag gcod bya rgyu/dgu/ de snga dbyin ji dang / a ri/ go min tang bcas dang nye ba'i dpon rigs re zung gis dbyin ji dang / a ri/ go min tang bcas dang 'brel thag bcad nas gtor bshig dang 'gog rgol ma byas tshe mu mthud dpon gnas bzung chog pa dang sngon byas la rtsad mi gcod/bcu/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du skyod de rgyal srung sra brtan gtong ba dang / gong gsal gyi srid jus khag la brtsi srung zhu rgyu ma zad bcings 'grol dmag gi 'gro gron tshang ma krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas mkho 'don bya rgyu dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis nyo tshong drang gzhag bya rgyu bcas red/1950lo'i zla 7ches 12nyin/lho nub dmag khul khang gi zla 4tshes 12nyin gi mdzub ston gzhir bzung yun nan nas bod skyod cun 1ṭ+wāṃpar gzhogs 'degs dmag 'thab byed mkhan thon 126gi sngon skyod ying gis ho'o ching (tshoṭha)nas rdog thon gyis de nyin bde chen du 'byor/ thon 126gi gtso shugs dmag sngar bzhin ho'o ching byang ngos sa khul du bca' sdod byas yod/ ho'o ching nas bde chen bar gyi dmag tshugs sgrig bkod legs grub zin/175

1950lo'i zla 7ches 24nyin/cun 1rdopar gzhogs 'degs dmag 'thab byed mkhan mtsho sngon gyi bodaskyod rta dmag yan lag ru khag gis zla 6tshes 1rdonyin zi ling nas rdog thon gyis de nyin skye rgu mdor 'byor/ yan lag ru khag de ni cun dang po'i rta dmag thon gyi ying gnyis pa'i rmang gzhi las grub pa dang / dmag shugs mi grangs 700lhag tsam dang bzhon rta kha00tsam yod/cun 1ṭ+wāṃpa'i mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o ni blo mthun wang chi'i rmin dang / li cu'e gnyis kyis sne khrid de dkar mdzes su 'byor/1rdzo50lo'i zla 7ches 20nyin/hre 52gyi chab srid u yon gzhon pa me'e h+phe dbyi nas sne khrid byas pa'i thon 157gyi ying dang po (sngon skyod ying )chu tshod bcu drug tsam la 'ba' an du 'byor/1950lo'i zla raches 2nyin/hre 52gyi sngon skyod bkod 'doms so'o yi si ling pu'u dang chab srid/mkho sprod/ 'phrod bsten bcas las khungs kyi cha shas shig dang / hre bzo skrun dmag gi lan zhig 'ba' an du 'byor nas 'bri chu brgal rgyu'i dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig las ka byas pa ma zad/ dmag shugs khag gcig gis 'bri chu'i 'gog srung bkag sdom byas/ 1950lo'i zla raches 20nyin/lho nub cus kyis chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi lag bstar 'char gzhi 176

ma'o kru'u zhir snyan zhu phul ba'i nang don gtso bo ni/gcig chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed nang nga tshos cun 1rakyi gtso shugs thon bzhi dang ying gnyis bsdoms mi grangs 12000zhugs rgyu gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / de dang mnyam du bkod 'doms las khungs kyi mi grangs bsdoms pas mi grangs 16rkya00yod/ da dung bzo skrun thon gcig gi mi grangs 2kya00tsam zhig gi gra sgrig dpung khag bcas yod pa red/ chab mdo'i bod dmag gi dmag shugs ni mi grangs drug stong bdun stong tsam yod/nga tshos rtsis brgyab par gzhigs na rang dmag gis thon gcig (mi grangs 200rkya)bsdus tshe dgra bos gtor mi thub pa dang gal te dgra bos mi grangs drug stong bdun stong tsam zhig bsdus kyang rang re'i shugs chen gyi me sgrogs dang rdzas mes gtor thub nges red/ g.yul 'gyed kyi thog nas dgra dmag gcig bsdus byas tshe nga tshor phan thogs yod pa dang kha gram nas bsdad tshe phan thogs med par brten g.yul 'gyed kyi rtsa 'dzugs thad rang re'i gtso shugs dmag 'di g.yas phyogs dang / byang ngos su bed spyod byas te chab mdo'i nub ngos nas skor skyod byas te dgra bo 'u thug thabs zad kyi sgo nas chab mdor 'dus su bcug nas de dag sa der rtsa gtor gtong dgos/ nga tshos da yod dgra dmag gi gnas tshul la gzhigs na/ rang res thon bzhi dang ying gnyis bed spyod byas thog skye rgu mdo dang rdza yul phyogs kyi (yun nan dmag da pung )dmag dpung nyung shas kyi gzhogs 'degs byung tshe 'grig mod kyang dmag dpung kha snon byung tshe de bas brtan pa dang gdeng tshod thub pa yong srid/'on kyang za ma'i gnad don ha cang dza drag po yod pas hrag bsdus byas na legs/ gnyis/ bod dmag gi dmag 'thab stobs shugs de tsam chen po med 177

rung rim bzhin shugs cher 'gro nyen yod pas glog 'phrin gyi mdzub ston ltar dmag 'thab drag po 'ga' zhig rgyag rgyu'i gra sgrig dgos pa ni ha cang gal 'gangs chen po yin pa dang mdun phyogs kyi blo mthun tshor dgra bor mthong chung ye nas byed mi rung ba'i bslab bya yang yang byed dgos/ nga tshos sems khral byed dgos pa ni dgra bos nga tsho dang thag gcod dmag 'thab mi rgyag pa'am nag chu'i phyogs su phyir 'then gyis nges med rgol rdung byas tshe nga tsho gzhan dbang gi gnas su gyar yong snyam pa de yin/gsum/ nga tsho'i bsam par zla ṭ+wāṃpa'i zla mjug la dkar mdzes bar gyi gzhung lam shar gtong thub tshe zla 10pa'i zla stod la chab mdo len thub nges yin/bzhi/ de snga nga tsho'i bsam par da lo'i ring chab mdo ma blangs par dus sang dbugs thengs gcig la len dgos snyam rung gcig nas mtshan ring na rmi lam mang ba'i dpe ltar/ gnyis nas snga tsam chab srid la 'gyur ba gtong rgyur skul 'ded thub pa/ gsum nas nga tshos mdun skyod gang 'tsham byas na lha sa len rgyu'i la sa ka'i gra sgrig khag kyang tan tig yong thub par brten da lo chab mdo len gang thub bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas/lnga/ thengs 'di'i bod skyod rgyab skyor gyi dngos rdzas gra sgrig gang legs byung yod kyang skyel 'dren gyi gnad don la gdeng tshod de tsam med/ lam bzo dang skyel 'dren dmag dpung ni ha cang dka' sdug che la 'bad brtson ha cang chen po byed kyi yod pas zla phyed de'i ring char chu shugs che na'ang gnas tshul 'dra min ma byung tshe dus thog tu dpung skyod thub pa'i 'gan len byed thub/drug deng skabs gnam grus dkar mdzes la dngos rdzas 'phen rgyu'i gnas tshul legs tsam yod kyang da yod kyi gnam gru'i 'phrul chas rnying pa yin 178

stabs 'phur skyod kyis dngos rdzas 'phen thub mkhan mang shos la'ang gnam gru 7tsam las med/ gal te gnam gru ngo grangs 20tsam la 'phar snon thub tshe zla rer dngos rdzas rgya ma khri tsho nyis brgya tsam gnam gru nas 'phen thub pas dka' ngal yang chung du 'gro rgyu red/ yun ring gi bsam blo btang ste bod la mkha' 'grul 'dzugs dgos nges yin pas dmag ud nas dgongs bzhes yod pa zhu/lho nub dmag khul khang gi chab srid u yon teng zha'o phing gis ‘‘sems thag gtsang bcad kyi sgo nas tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus lag bstar byed dgos pa ni rang res bod la dpung skyod bya rgyur thag gcod rang bzhin gyi don snying ldan yod pa zhig dang / bod la skyod par srid jus la brten nas gom pa spo rgyu dang / srid jus la brten nas kha lag za ba/ srid jus ni srog rtsa rang yin ’’zhes mdzub ston gnang ba red/1rdzo50lo'i zla raches 21nyin/sngon skyod bzo skrun dmag dpung gis nyin shas ring dka' spyad ngal rtsol byas pa brgyud yā an (mchi38)nas dkar mdzes bar gyi gzhung lam 'di bzhin sngon dpag byas na zla rdopa'i zla mjug la yongs su rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub rgyu dang / dpung skyod kyi gra sgrig las ka khag rtsa ba'i cha nas grub zin par brten cun pu'u nas chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi dpung 'jug bka' rgya btang ba dang / dmag yongs nas bod skyod dang / zi khron du sdod mkhan khag gnyis su bgo rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas pa red/ bod skyod dmag dpung gi las 'gan gtso bo ni chab mdo'i bod dmag rtsa gtor btang nas chab mdo len rgyu dang spyi lo 1951lor lha sar dpung skyod byed ched 'gro lam 179

gsar gtod bya rgyu de yin/ chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i las 'gan bsgrub mkhan sngon skyod dmag dpung 'ba' an dang / dkar mdzes/'dan khog la 'byor zin pa phud hre 52pa'i gtso shugs dang me skyogs dmag sgar/ cun mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o khag gcig zla 8tshes 25nyin si khron nas rlangs 'khor la bzhugs te rdog thon gyis zla khapa'i zla stod la dkar mdzes su 'byor dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs byas/de nyin la rang res mngags gtong byas pa'i zhi ba'i pho nya dge rtag sprul sku chab mdor bkrongs/1950lo'i zla ṭ+wāṃches 25nyin/ma'o kru'u zhis chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la gnad don gsum bton pa ste/gcig dkar mdzes nas chab mdo bar gyi gzhung lam 'di dmag dpung mdun bskyod byed pa'i myur tshad dang 'tsham pa'i sgo nas bzo thub bam/gnyis/ chab mdor gnam gru 'bab thang bzothub min dang mkha' thog nas dngos rdzas dbyugs na 'tsham po yod med/gsum/ chab mdor phar rgol byed par dmag shugs hre gcig gis 'grig min/ bod dmag la dmag 'thab kyi stobs shugs chen po yod bzo 'dug pas nges par du gra sgrig yag po byed dgos/1rdzo50lo'izla raches 26nyin/lho nub dmag khul khang gis ‘‘chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi rtsa ba'i bka' rgya ’’khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / bka' rgya'i nang don gtso bor/180

bod dmag mda' dpon mdun gyi gtso shugs dmag rnams chab mdo lte bar byas pa'i mtha' 'khor du gnas shing / hur brtson ngang dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig byas te rang res bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyur bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i re ngan bcangs yod/ bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag rnams chab mdo dang /de'i nub phyogs kyi rngan mda' dang ri bo che sa khul du rtsa gtor btang ste chab mdo blangs nas dus sang lha sar dpung skyod kyis bod bcings 'grol gtong ba'i rmang gzhi 'ding ched dmigs bsal gtan 'bebs bya rgyur/gcig cun 1〈kyis hre 52pa'i thon gsum dang / cun myul zhib ying / me skyogs ying / de bzhin si ling pu'u la rgyab skyor byed mkhan bzo skrun dmab/ gi thon gcig bcas sne khrid kyis yid lhung (nyoṣā)dang sde dge/'dan khog bcas nas rdog thon byas te chab mdo'i nub phyogs su dpung 'jug gis dgra bo phyir bros kyi 'gro lam bkag nas rtsa med gtong dgos/gong gsal dmag dpung khag zla 9pa'i zla stod la dkar mdzes dang yid lhung du 'du 'dzoms byas te zla 9pa'i zla dkyil la sa gnas 'di ga nas rdog thon gyis zla 1rkyapa'i tshes 10yi yas mas tsam la chab mdo len thub pa'i brtson len byed dgos/ gzhan yang hre 52gyi thon gcig nas de dang dus mtshungs 'ba' an nas rdog thon gyis smar khams khul gyi dgra bo rtsa med btang ste chab mdor mdun bskyod byed pa'i hre 52la gzhogs 'degs byas nas chab mdo'i dgra bo rtsa med gtong dgos/ zhib phra'i bkod sgrig cun 1rdopas bzos te nga tshor gong zhu bya rgyu/gnyis/ yun nan gyi cun 14pa'i nus ldan dmag dpung gcig gis cun 1ṭ+wāṃpa chab mdor dpung skyod byed pa dang dus mtshungs tshwa lho'i dgra bo rtsa med btang nas sa 'di bkag sdom byed dgos pa ma zad smar khams kyi dmag 181

dpung dang 'brel ba bya rgyu 'gan len byed dgos/ de min thon gcig gis go skabs dang bstun nas 'gro ba dgon (khog smad dang rdza yul dbar )blangs nas bkag sdom byed dgos/gsum/ nub byang dmag khul khang gis skye rgu mdo'i dmag dpung dang cun 1rdopa'i hre 52la 'brel ba byed dgos pa ma zad hre 52pa'i bkod 'doms 'og chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa'i bka' gtong rgyu'i gros 'go bton pa red/de nyin zhogs pa'i chu tshod bdun pa'i thog cun krang krang go hwa yis cun gyi mdun bskyod bkod 'doms so'o yi thengs dang po'i mi sna 2〈0lhag tsam sne khrid kyis rlangs 'khor la bsdad de zhin cin (lo ṭha)nas dkar mdzes la rdog thon byas te chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la bkod 'doms gnang bar phebs/1rdzo50lo'i zla ram̐ches 21nyin/ma'o kru'u zhis mkha' thog skyel 'dren gnam gru 20nyo sgrub kyis bod la dpung bskyod bya rgyur rgyab skyor byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang /lho nub dmag khul khang gis dkar mdzes gnam gru thang myur skrun dgos pa'i mdzub ston gnang /cun krang krang go hwa dar rtse mdor 'byor nas dar rtse mdo'i bca' sdod dmag dang / mang tshogs/ srid gzhung de bzhin bod rigs mi dmangs dang grwa pa bcas mi grangs brgya phrag gi spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu thob pa ma zad 'tshams 'dri'i me tog kyang phul ba red/182

1950lo'i zla rdzoches 2nyin/hre 52kyi thon 155pas zhin cin (lko4 ṭha)nas rdog thon byas te chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la zhugs par bskyod/1950lo'i zla 9ches 5nyin/krang go hwa yis cun bkod 'doms so'o yi mi sna'i sne khrid kyis dkar mdzes la 'byor te cun mdun skyod bkod 'doms so'o dang mnyam 'dzoms byung ba ma zad mnyam spro'i tshogs chen yang 'tshogs song bas sa mtho'i grong khyer dkar mdzes dga' spro'i rnam pas khengs shing 'thab grogs rnams yun gyes bskyar 'dzoms byung bar brten phan tshun 'tham res dang / 'ga' re'i mig nang dga' spro'i mchi mas rab tu khengs/1950lo'izla 9ches 6nyin/hre 52kyi thon 156pa zhin cin nas rdog thon gyis bod du chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la zhugs par bskyod/1950lo'izla 9ches 10nyin/lho nub cus nas mdzub ston gnang don/ chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyedanang yul dmag brtson len gyi las don la do snang byed dgos/ gang thub kyi sgonas yul dmag dang dmag 'thab mi yong ba byas te dmag brgyab rjes kha 'thor nas tshur bsdu mi thub pa'i gnas tshul mi lhag pa byed dgos/cun pu'u nas lho nub dmag khul khang la chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi bkod sgrig gnasatshul dang dpung skyod kyi dus tshod snyan seng zhus/183

1kha50lo'i zla 9ches 11nyin/krung gung bod ljongs kung ud kyis chab mdo bcings 'grol btang rjes kyi las don skor la mdzub ston gnang ba ste gtso bo ni/gcig las don gyi mdzad phyogs skor/ chab mdo bcings 'grol btang rjes lha sa'i srid 'dzin mkhan gyi rnam 'gyur gsal ston ma byas sngon du las ka mtha' dag gom gang mdun spos ngang dus sang bod skyod las don ched du gra sgrig byed dgos/ srid jus thad krung dbyang gi srid jus chen po bcu dang chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi rgyal kha thob pa gnyis zung 'brel byas te hur brtson ngang chab srid kyi brtson len dang dmangs sems bde 'god kyi las ka spel dgos pa ma zad/ rang dmag gi dpe bzang mtshon pa'i sgrig khrims bya spyod la brten nas zhib phra'i thad chab mdo sa khul gyi rim pa khag gi mthun sgril las don gang legs spel dgos/gnyis/ chab mdo mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang sgrig 'dzugs kyis dbu brnyes thub pa byed dgos/ u yon lhan khang 'di ni sa gnas 'di ga'i mtho rim 'go khrid kyi dbang cha'i sgrig gzhi zhig yin zhing /de'i las 'gan ni spyi tshogs kyi sgrig khrims srung skyong dang / srid gzhung med pa'i rnam pa sngon 'gog khyad bsad kyis dmangs sems bde 'god dang / rgya khyab ngang 'brel gtugs byas nas bod khul chab srid kyi shugs rkyen bzang po dang brtson len gyi khyab khongs shugs cher gtong dgos pa ma zad dus sang bod skyod bya rgyu'i gra sgrig las ka sna tshogs byed dgos/chab mdo sa khul gyi sngar yod rtsa 'dzugs dang lam lugs nang rang rer ngo rgol ma byas pa'i gnas tshul 'og sngar gnas sor bzhag gis 'gyur ldog 184

gtong rgyu min/'os langs byed mkhan dmag dpung gi ang rtags sngar bzhin 'gyur ldog mi gtong / gsum/ hor tsho sum cu so dgu'i mthun sgril las don yag po bsgrub rgyu/bzhi/ chab mdo sa khul gyi dmangs sems bde 'god brda khyab par 'grems bya rgyu bcas so/1rdzo50lo'i zla 9ches 12nyin/zla ratshes 25nyin yā an nas dkar mdzes dbar gyi rlangs 'khor gzhung lam shar gtong thub tshun dar rtse mdo nas dkar mdzes bar gyi lam che ba brgyad tshang ma legs grub zin te zla phyed tsam ring 'bru rigs dang /dngos rdzas 'bor chen dkar mdzes su skyel 'dren byas/ de'i skabs skyel 'dren gyi gnas tshul ha cang legs po yod/ rgyab skyor si ling pu'u yis zla 11pa'i gong la 'bru rigs rgya ma khri tsho 1100tsam nyar gsog bya rtsis yod pa red/ de ltar byas tshe dkar mdzes shar ngos dmag dpung gi mkho sprod dbor 'dren bya rgyu'i gnad don gzhi rtsa'i thog thag gcod byed thub/ chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi dmag 'thab nang zhugs mkhan dmag dpung la rgyab skyor byed ched/ zla 9tshes 7nas bzung pu'u krang h+phu yan zhi'u yis dmag tshugs bdun dang 'phrod bsten so'o gnyis sne khrid kyis yid lhung dang / rdzogs chen/'dan khog sde dge/ skam thog bcas la dmag tshugs 'dzugs pa ma zad phyugs rigs skyel 'dren sgrig 'dzugs byas/ 'on kyang skyel 'dren nus shugs mi 'dang ba dang myur tshad ha cang dal ba'i rkyen gyis chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed gong du 'bri chu'i 'gram du dbor 'dren bya rgyu'i 'bru rigs rgya ma khri tsho 185

40tsam nas mang che ba lam bar du bkag gsog thebs/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bod rigs kyi mi shugs dang phyugs shugs rgyab skyor bya rgyur skul slong byed ched cun krang krang go hwa dang / kru'u ren li'u kreng go gnyis sang nyin (tshes 12nyin ) yid lhung bya rgod stobs ldan dang / gling tshang / sde dge thu'u si'i sar bskyod de thu'u si dang 'go pa yis yid lhung nas chab mdo ru 'bru rigs rgya ma khri tsho 200dbor 'dren sgrig 'dzugs byed dgos pa'i skul slong bya rgyu gtan 'khel byas/1950lo'i zla 9ches 12nyin/cun 1rdopa'i tang ud kyis chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i g.yul 'gyed kyi chab srid bka' rgya btang ba'i gtso don ni/gcig da lta dpung bskyod kyi las don khag gzhi rtsa'i cha nas gra sgrig byas zin pa ma zad zla 10pa'i zla dkyil la chab mdo bcings 'grol btang nas bod kyi gtso shugs dmag rtsa med gtong rgyu'i las 'gan sgrub dgos pa gtan 'bebs byas/ nga tshos rgyal kha'i ngang chab mdo len thub tshe bod kyi dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul sngar bas kha thor du song nas bcings 'grol thob rgyur re sgug byed mkhan gyi bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyi rgyal kha thob pa'i sems shugs che ru phyin te bod bcings 'grol gtong ba'i dus bab la gzhi rtsa'i 'gyur ldog yong nges yin/ mig snga'i dus bab ni rang rer phan pa yod pa ste/ nga tshor yun nan dang / mtsho sngon/ zhin cang bcas kyi dmag dpung che khag gi gzhogs 'degs yod pa dang / dmag shugs ha cang chen po yin pa/ 'char gzhi ldan la gra sgrig yod pa/ mi dmangs kyi srung brtsi dang rgyab skyor thob pa'i dpung skyod cig yin stabs rgyal kha len thub pa'i gdeng 186

tshod rbad de yod/ der brten rang re'i tang yongs dang dmag yongs/ de bzhin rim pa khag gi tang ud kyis hur thag 'bad thag dang / nan tan ngang srid jus lag bstar byas te chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la dmag don dang chabasrid gnyis kyi thog rgyal kha cha tshang len thub pa'i 'gan srung ched brtson len dgos pa'i re ba yod/gnyis/ mtha' mtshams kyi gnam gshis grang ngar che ba dang / gangs 'khyags kyi khrod du sdod dgos pa/ 'tsho ba'i goms gshis ma 'phrod pa/ skyel 'dren dka' ngal che bas 'bru rigs mkho sprod dus thog byed mi thub pa/ chu 'khol 'thung rgyu med pa/ zas kyis grod pa mi rgyags pa sogs kyi gnas tshul 'phrad srid pas dka' ngal mtha' dag khyad bsad dang dka' sdug chen po myong rgyu'i bsam blo dang las don la zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs ldan pa'i gra sgrigakhyed dgos/ lhag par du rim pa khag gi las byed pa dang / gung khran tang yon/ de bzhin blo mthun tshang mas dka' ngal gyi khrod du tshad mtho'i mthun sgril mdza' brtse dang phan tshun rogs ram gyi snying stobs dar spel gyis thun mong thog 'bad brtson byas te dka' ngal las rnam par rgyal thub pa'i brtson len byed dgos/ gsum/ dgra bos nga tshor mkhregs rgol bya rgyu'i gra sgrig yod pa dang /khong tshor sa mtho'i 'tsho ba'i goms gshis 'phrod pa dang thabs jus nges can ldan pa ma zad dmag 'thab kyi stobs shugs kyang gang 'tsham yod pa red/ nga tshor de snga dgra bo grangs med rtsa gtor btang ba'i gzi brjid kyi dmag 'thab lo rgyus yod kyang da lta'i bod kyi dgra bor shes rtogs de tsam med par brten nga tshos spobs pa dang / snang chung lhod g.yeng rtsa ba nas ma byas par nges par du —dpa' ngar chen po dang / gzab nan/ sems chung bcas byed dgos/187

brtag dpyad zhib 'jug bya rgyur shugs snon dang gting zab ngang skul slong slob gso brgyab ste dmag mi'i dmag 'thab kyi sems shugs dar 'phel gong mthor btang nas sems thag gtsang bcad ngang drag po'i dmag 'thab legs pa re gnyis tsam rgyag thub pa byed dgos/ dmag dpung gi sgrig khrims nan po dgos pa dang / gong 'og mthun sgril/ phan tshun gzhogs 'degs/ bka' rgyar srung brtsi dang bkod 'doms la nyan 'jog bcas byed dgos/bzhi/ bod la bcings 'grol gtong rgyu ni btsan rgyal ring lugs pa phyir 'bud dang / rgyal mtshams sra brtan/ bod rigs mi dmangs bcings 'grol thob pa dang bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun bcas kyi ched du yin stabs nges par du srid jus dang sgrig khrims kyi slob gso gting zab brgyab ste dmag dmangs kyi sgrig khrims la do nan gyis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi srid jus la srung brtsi zhus nas chos dad rang mos lag bstar dang / dgon sder srung skyob/mi dmangs kyi yul srol goms gshis dang chos dad rang mos la srung brtsi/nan tan ngang bzung dmag gi srid jus lag bstar byas te mtshon cha bzhag pa'i bod dmag mtha' dag la nyin gcig ring slob gso brgyab nas lam dngul sprad de glod grol gtong ba bcas byed dgos/lnga/ 'bru rigs kyi 'gro song rtsis zhu'i lam lugs nan po dgos pa dang /lam rgyags tshad gzhir brten nas za ba/ me shing yang tshad gzhir brten nas 'bud dgos/ lan tud tang kre pu'u yis mtshon cha dang dngos rdzas sgrig sbyor sogs la bdag gces bya rgyu'i las don 'gan srung tan tig yong ba byed dgos/ drug rgyab phyogs las don gyis mdun phyogs dmag dpung gi mkho sprod dang srid jus lag bstar bya rgyur 'gan srung byed dgos/ sman bcos sde 188

tshan gyis dmag sa'i thog sman bcos srog skyob kyi las don gang legs spel nas rmas ma'i zug zer dang shi skyon nyung du gtong gang thub byed dgos/ rang re'i rgyab phyogs kyi mi sna tshang mas dka' sdug la ma 'dzem par dka' ngal khri stong khyad bsad dang / 'jon thang yod pa'i phul byung las byed pa mngags te phyugs rigs skyel 'dren sgrig 'dzugs byas nas mdun phyogs kyi mkho sprod bya rgyu'i las 'gan bsgrub phyir 'bad brtson byed dgos/bdun/ rang re'i tshan mo'o mi sna dang / glog 'phrin gtong mkhan/gsang ba gnad can gye las byed mi sna bcas tshang mas dpa' ngar zhum med kyi las ka'i snying stobs dang / dka' tshegs la mi skrag pa'i snying stobs dar spel gyis nan tan zhib tshags kyi sgo nas nyin mtshan med par las ka byas te mgyogs myur ngang las 'gan legs grub kyis dmag 'thab kyi go skabs 'thus shor mi 'gro ba byed dgos/1950lo'i zla 9ches 14nyin/cun pu'u nas dgra bo'i gnas tshul brda khyab byas pas gtso don ni/bod kyi srid 'dzin mkhan gyis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rgyab skyor dang ngan skul 'og ‘‘bod rang btsan ’’yin mdog gis sngar bzhin mu mthud go min tang la spyad pa'i thabs shes la brten nas lha sa dang chab mdo so so nas mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung dang / mdo khams zhing chen srid gzhung /dkar mdzes bca' sdod dmag bcas la 'phrin yig btang ba'i don du ‘‘krung bod dbar de snga'i sa mtshams ('bri chu'i mtshams ) rgyun 'khyongs byas na legs par 'os ’zhes 'khod/ dkar mdzes be ri dgon pa'i rgyal gces grwa pa dge rtag sprul sku mchog chab mdor phebs nas kho pa tsho mes rgyal gyi pang du 189

log dgos pa'i kha ta bslab bya gnang bar phebs dus bkrongs par brten zhi ba'i gros mol gyi rgyal sgo de mur dbang med du rgyag dgos byung / rang dmag gis 'ba' thang dang / dkar mdzes/ sde dge/ 'dan khog bcas la skyod sdod byas rjes/ bod sa gnas srid 'dzin mkhan gyis hur brtson ngang dmag mi bsdus nas dmag gra sgrig byed bzhin yod pa dang / 'bri chu'i nub ngos sa khul du 'gog srung bkod sgrig byas te rang res bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyur bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i re ngan bcangs/ kho pa tsho'i 'gog srung gi khyad chos ni chab mdo lte bar bzung ste chab mdo brgyud srib mda' nas 'dan khog bar gyi lam gtso gnad du bzung nas chab mdo'i nye 'khor dang mdun phyogs/'bri chu'i lho ngos nas tshwa lho bar dang / byang phyogs kyi dgon mda' yi sa rgyud bcas la khungs so sor kha thor bkod sgrig byas nas 'bri chu'i btsan sar brten te 'gog rgol gyis rang re dang 'bri chu yis mtshams bcad bya rgyu'i sems ngan bcangs pa red/ de yang zhib phra'i bkod sgrig ltar na/mda' dpon brgyad pa yongs dang / mda' dpon bdun pa mang che ba/mda' dpon gnyis pa dang drug pa khag gcig bka' blon srung dmag ru khag bcas chab mdor rub 'dzoms bya rgyu dang / mda' dpon bdun pa'i khongs nas khag gcig ri bo cher bskyod rgyu/mda' dpon gsum pa dang phu lung (r+sā7khri)mda' dpon gnyis srib mda' lte bar byas pa'i ya yo sum mdo dang / dgon mda'/ mkhar gru kha/yi chus kha bcas kyi khul du gnas yod/mda' dpon bcu pa skam thog dang / thang phu/ rgya mda' bcas kyi khul du gnas yod/mda' dpon dgu pa smar khams (bhe+ostsa)dang tshwa lho'i khul du gnas/190

gong gsal mda' dpon bdun la mi grangs 4500yod pas bod dmag gi dmag shugs spyi'i sum cha gnyis zin gyi yod/ de min yul dmag 2500yod pa rnams mda' dpon khag la bkod sgrig byas yod pa red/khyon bsdoms bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dngos gzhi'i dmag dpung dang yul dmag mi grangs ṭ+wāṃ000lhag tsam yod pa de dag tshang ma chab mdo spyi khyab kyi bkod 'doms khongs su gtogs yod/cun krang krang go hwa dang / kru'u ren li'u kren go rnam gnyis dkar mdzes su phyir log gar/nga / 1rdzo50lo'i zla rdzoches 15nyin/cun bkod 'doms so'o yis dkar mdzes su dmag rgyag gi tshogs chen skong 'tshogs byas/ krung dbyang dmag ud dang / lho nub cus/ lho nub dmag khul khang gi mdzub ston dgongs don la gzhigs te chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi bkod sgrig rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang / bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag chab mdo sa khul du rtsa med btang nas bod skyod kyi sgo mo 'byed dgos pa dang / bod yongs bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i rmang gzhi 'dzugs rgyu/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur cha rkyen skrun rgyu bcas kyi ched du thon drug gi dmag shugs/ de bzhin lho byang gi dmag 'thab tshogs khag gnyis la dbye nas dus tshod gcig nang 'bri chu'i lam rgyud la phar rgol byed dgos/zhib phra'i bkod sgrig ni/byang ngos tshogs khag ste rang dmag gi gtso shugs dmag yin zhing hre 52kyi thon gsum khri) nga / cun me skyogs ying / myul zhib ying / bzo skrun ying dang hre 54yi me skyogs lan/ de bzhin mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru 191

khag bcas las grub yod/ hre 52kyi gtso shugs dmag gis 'dan khog nas 'bri chu brgal rgyu dang myul zhib dang bzo skrun ying gnyis kyis skam thog nas 'bri chu brgal te dmag 'thab bya rgyu/ de dag tshang ma hre 52kyi mdun skyod bkod 'doms pu'u nas gcig gyur thog bkod 'doms bya rgyu yin/lho ngos tshogs khag ste thon 157dang hre 52gyi me skyogs lan dang /bzo skrun lan/ thon 126pa/ de bzhin thon 125yi ying gcig bcas las grub yod/ thon 157gyis 'ba' an nas 'bri chu brgal te nying cin du yod pa'i bod dmag mda' dpon dgu pa rtsa gtor gtong dgos pa dang /thon 126dang thon 125yi ying gcig gis bde chen dang ting hran (ṭha7)byang ngos nas lam phyogs gnyis su gyes te tshwa lho dang man sgang / bul thog bcas kyi dgra bo rtsa gtor btang nas dgra bo rdza yul phyogs su phyir bros byed par sngon 'gog byed dgos/ de dag tshang ma hre 52gyi mdun skyod bkod 'joms pu'u nas gcig gyur thog bkod 'doms bya rgyu/1rdzo50lo'i zla 9ches 20nyin/cun pu'u nas chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi bka' bkod gnang ba'i gtso don/myul zhib gting zab bya rgyur shugs snon gyis dus thog tu dgra bo'i gnas tshul gyi 'gyur ldog shes rtogs thub pa byed dgos/bkod sgrig thad mdun phyogs kyi dmag shugs ha cang mang na mi 'os pa dang / gtso shugs bed spyod kyis skor skyod brgyab ste nges par du dgra bo'i phyir bros lam bu bcad nas khag bgos mtha' skor dang me shugs drag por brten nas rtsa gtor rang bzhin ldan pa'i shi rmas gtong dgos/192

'phral sgrub dang skor skyod dmago/ dpung tshang mas ying dang lan gyi sde tshan ma yin sar kha thor byas na mi 'grig pa dang / 'phral sgrub kyi stobs shugs rgyun 'khyongs byas te gang la gang 'tsham gyi sgo nas gnas tshul sna tshogs la kha gtad bcog dgos/bya spyod spel ba'i brgyud rim nang gsang ba dang / mgyogs po bsher 'tshol nan tan bcas byas nas dgra bo'i rta dmag gis 'jab rgol bya rgyur dogs zon byed dgos/sgar rgyag sa tshang mar nges par du 'dzing rags bzos te ga dus yin yang dmag 'thab byed rgyu'i gra sgrig yag po byed dgos/dgra bo dang gdong thug byed pa'i skabs 'tshab 'tshub med par dmag lan slog dgos pa dang / dgra bo'i gnas tshul shes rtogs gsal po thub rjes mgyogs myur rang re'i gtso shugs dmag dgra bo'i rgyab phyogs nas bskor te kho tsho'i phyir bros lam bu bkag nas rtsa med du gtong dgos/dgra bo 'phrad nas zhi mthun yong re zhu skabs nges par du dogs zon cher skyes kyis phyogs gcig nas gros mol dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas dgra bo mtha' skor kyi las 'gan legs grub byas thog phar rgol gyi gra sgrig byed dgos/dgra bor bsam blo gtong ba'i dus tshod ring po sprod mi nyan la dgra bo'i dus 'gyangs dmag jus la dogs zon byed dgos/yul dmag rnams nus shugs yod rgus rang phyogs su 'gug thabs byas nas kho tsho dang dmag 'thab mi yong ba byed dgos/bzung dmag skor gyi srid jus dang mi rigs srid jus gnyis lag bstar don 'khyol thub pa byed dgos/193

1950lo'i zla 9ches 22nyin/zhogs pa'i chu tshod bdun par thon 154dkar mdzes nas rdog thon gyis (grak+ṣiṃ༈khru)'dan khog phyogs su dpung skyod byas/ dmag dpung gi ca dngos mang bas mi re res rgya ma 70lhag tsam 'khur dgos par brten 'gro ba'i myur tshad ni ha cang dal po yin/ cha snyoms su chu tshod rer spyi le 2tsam mdun skyod byed kyi yod/ chu tshod 1ṭ+wāṃl dpal rir 'byor nas der zhag sdod byas/1950lo'i zla 9ches 24nyin/thon 155chu tshod 15tsam la dkar mdzes nas thon te 'dan khog phyogs su dpung skyod byas pas de'i dgong mo dpal rir zhag sdod byas/1950lo'i zla rdzoches 25nyin/zhogs pa hre 52dkar mdzes nas thon pas chu tshod 15tsam la dpal rir 'byor/thon 154rdog thon byas pa nas bzung tshan mu'u krang li cu'e nyin mtshan med par nyag chu gtsang po'i rab khar dmag dpung 'bri chu brgal rgyur bkod 'doms gnang bas dus yun ring po gnyid khug longs ma byung /1950lo'i zla 9ches 26nyin/chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang chi rmin gyis g.yul sa'i bkod 'doms mi sna khag gcig dang hre 54yi me skyogs lan gyi sne khrid nas zhogs pa'i chu tshod 7par dkar mdzes nas thon te sde dge'i phyogs su bskyod/194

chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi byang phyogs dmag dpung tshang ma de ring dkar mdzes nas kha bral te 'char gzhir zla ba 1kyapa'i zla 'gor tshang ma 'dan khog dang / sde dge'i ngos su rub 'dzoms tshar ba bya rgyu red/ lho phyogs dmag dpung thon 157gyi lan rim pa yan gyi dmag don las byed pa rnams snga snur du dar rtse mdo nas thon te de ring 'ba' an ( kho)du 'byor/ hre 52gyi g.yul sa'i bkod 'doms khang gis 'ba' an du dmag 'thab kyi tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ tshogs 'du grol rjes chab srid u yon me'o h+phi dbyi dang thon krang gzhon pa tse hung con gnyis kyis so so'i dmag don las byed pa khrid de 'bri chu rgyud kyi 'ba' an lho byang ri bor sa dbyibs rtsad zhib byed pa dang 'bri chu rgal ba'i dmag 'thab kyi jus gzhi gtan 'bebs byas/zhib phra'i bkod sgrig ni/thon 157nang gi ying dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis 'ba' an gyi byang ngos rab kha nas 'bri chu lkog brgal bya rgyu dang / lan lnga pas 'phral rgol lan gyi 'gan bzhes rgyu/ 'bri chu brgal tshar rjes ying gnyis pa'i lan lnga pa dang drug pas lho ngos kyi tshug la ri bo (rnyeṣā7 yitshe)brgal te zhi sum sgang gi (stso71)nub ngos su skor skyod byas nas thon sku srung lan la gzhogs 'degs dang / phar rgol drag pos dgra bo rtsa med gtong dgos/ ying dang po 'bri chu brgal tshar ba'i rjes smar khams (r+har+ṣa)phyogs su shar bskyod byed dgos pa dang / thon byang lam bkod 'doms so'o nas lan bzhi pa dang me skyogs lan gnyis sne khrid de ying dang po'i mjug tu mdun skyod byas te smar khams du shar bskyod byed rgyu/ying gsum pas 'ba' thang lho ma'i rkang 'khru gtsang po ( lko.oṃkho)nas slor skyod byas te gru ba lung la drag rgol bya rgyu/ sa cha de ga'i sru nga dmag 195

bcom pa'i rjes 'bum sa dang / lha mdun/ gna' stong brgyud smar khams du skor skyod bya rgyu bcas so/1950lo'i zla rdzoches 2ṭ+wāṃnyin/lho nub dmag khul khang gi brda khyab/ yun nan zhing chen nas bod du bskyod pa'i cun 14hre 42nang gi ying gcig da res sgang ri (r+sāsgre)la 'byor rgyu dang / 'char gzhir zla ba dgu pa'i zla mjug la sgang ri'i byang ngos kyi man sgang (/cika.au)bzung rgyu red/ bde chen nas ying gnyis btang ste zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu'i rjes man sgang du yod pa'i dmag dpung dang mnyam 'brel thog tshwa lho (sa〉)dang / bul thog (za༅)gnyis la dpung 'jug byas nas cun 1〈kyis chab mdo dang smar khams la dpung 'jug byed pa ra ram 'degs bya rgyu red/1rdzo50lo'i zla rdzoches 2rdzonyin/thon 157dar rtse mdor bca' sdod byed pa'i dmag dpung rnams snga rjes so sor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer bdun dang / nyer brgyad/ nyer dgu bcas la 'ba' thang du dpung skyod byas te chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi lho phyogs tsho khag gi dmag dpung nang zhugs rgyu red/ 'bri chu brgal ba'i dmag 'thab yongs su mjug sgril rjes shing gru che chung bsdoms bcu gsum dang / ko gru bzhi bcu/ 'gyig gru bzhi/ de bzhin dmag 'thab kyi dngos rdzas gzhan dag khag gcig rtsis len byas/ dmag 'thab ma byas gong 'ba' chu'i nang ko grur sdod pa'i nang sbyong dang shing gru dang 'gyig gru gtong rgyu'i sbyong brdar yang byas pa red/196

1950lo'i zla 9ches 20nyin/lho nub dmag khul khang nas chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed skor la gnang ba'i mdzub ston/chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed ni bod la bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i don snying ldan pa'i dmag 'thab cig yin/ tshod dpag byas na rang re'i stobs ldan gyi dmag don gnon shugs 'og bod dmag nas phal cher kha gtad 'di lta bu gcog rgyu ste/ de yang dmag shugs khag gcig gis gtso gnad kyi sa cha bzung ste rim bzhin rang re'i dmag dpung gi 'gro lam 'gog pa dang / gtso shugs dmag so sor phyir 'then byas nas stobs shugs nyar tshags byed kyi red/yang na kha 'thor rjes sa gnas drag shugs dang mnyam 'brel byas te nges med rgol rdung gi dmag 'thab byed kyi red/ bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag phyir 'then byed pa'i lam bu gnyis las dang po rngan mda' dang ri bo che brgyud lha sar bros rgyu de red/ lam de nas phyir bros byed pa'i nyen kha chen po yod/gnyis pa chab mdo nas lho phyogs su bros te spang mda' dang dpa' shod brgyud lha sar bros rgyu dang / yang na lam de nas lung gzhung brgyud lho phyogs kyi rdza yul du bros rgyu red/ der brten rang res thon drug gi dmag shugs bed spyad nas lho byang gi dmag dpung tsho khag gnyis sgrig 'dzugs bya rgyu dang / byang phyogs tsho khag gtso bor bzung ste mdun phyogs su phar rgol dang dmag 'thab skor skyod kyi thabs jus bed spyod byed dgos/ dmag 'thab nang mdun phyogs phar rgol dang skor skyod mtha' skor gyi bya thabs zung 'brel byas nas chab mdo bzung thub pa bya rgyu dang dgra dmag gi gtso shugs rtsa med gtong rgyu dmigs yul du bzung nas de dag 'bri chu'i nub ngos dang rdza chu'i shar ngos/197

de bzhin chab mdo dang ri bo che/ rngan mda' bcas kyi sa khul du rtsa med gtong dgos/1950lo'i zla 10ches 1nyin/lho nub dang / nub byang dmag khul khang gi mdzub ston la gzhigs na/skye rgu mdo'i rta dmag yan lag ru khag 'di hre 52nas bkod 'doms bya rgyu dang / de'i ru dpon sun dang / chab srid u yon gzhon pa than gnyis/ zla dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu nyin 'dan khog tu chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed nang gi dmag rgyag las 'gan dang len zhu bar yong dgos pa dang / hre 52kyi hre krang wu'u krung dang / chab srid u yon gzhon pa dbyin h+pha thang / tshan mu'u krang li rming /de bzhin thon 154yi dbu khrid bcas kyis sun dang than mnyam du rta dmag yan lag ru khag gi zhib phra'i las 'gan dang gzhogs 'degs dmag 'thab byed phyogs skor gyi gnad don thad zhib 'jug gis gtan 'khel gsal po byas rjes sun than rnam gnyis de ring 'dan khog nas rang gi dmag dpung sdod gnas su log1950lo'i zla 1kyaches 4nyin/lho nub dmag khul khang chab srid pu'u nas chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed nang zhugs mkhan gyi dmag dpung la gnang ba'i mdzub ston/chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed ni 'go tshugs grabs yod pas de'i 'bras bur rgyal yongs dang rgyal spyis do khur chen po byed kyi yod la bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyu dang / lhag par du chab srid thog nas bod ljongs mes rgyal gyi pang du log rgyur 'brel ba ha cang chen po yod/ dmag 'thab la rgyal kha thob rgyu 198

'gan srung thub pa'i ched gtso bo dgra bo'i da yod stobs shugs rtsa med gtong thub pa bya dgos/ re bar gnas tshul der gzhigs te g.yul zhugs dmag dpung yongs la skul slong gting zab byas thog dpa' mdzangs gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis dgra dmag bcom pa'i dmigs yul 'grub ched 'bod skul byed dgos/ g.yul sa'i khul du rang re'i tang gi srid jus dril bsgrags shugs chen byas nas chab srid thog 'gug thabs byed dgos pa dang bzung dmag srid jus lag bstar nan tan byed dgos pa/ de bzhin mi tshang mas brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gi las don sgrub dgos/ hre 52kyi mdun bskyod bkod 'doms pu'u dang thon 154de ring tshang ma 'dan khog tu 'byor ba ma zad khams 'thab ang rtags gsum pa'i bka' rgya yang btang zhing / bka' rgya'i nang don gtso bo ni/hre yongs kyi dmag dpung rnams spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 10tshes 6nyin gyi snga dro chu tshod bdun pa nas 'go btsugs te 'dan khog phyogs nas 'bri chu brgal te chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong rgyu dang / bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag rnams rdza chu'i shar ngos dang rngan mda'/ ri bo che bcas kyi sa khul du gcig bsdus kyis tshar gcod byed rgyu'i las 'gan gtan 'bebs byas/zhib phra'i bkod sgrig ni gsham gsal/1 g.yas ngos ni/ mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag dang / hre'i myul zhib rta dmag lan/ thon 154bcas las grub cing de'i chab srid u yon gzhon pa dbying h+pha thang dang / tshan mu'u krang li rming gnyis kyis bkod 'doms bya rgyu/ rta dmag dang rkang dmag gi dpung khag gnyis phan tshun zhogs 'degs kyis legs cha dang len dang zhan cha sel nas chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed la g.yas gzhogs bya rgyur rgyang ring skor skyod mtha' skor gyi las 199

'gan lag bstar bya rgyu/ mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag dang / hre'i myul zhib lan/ de bzhin gsar du bkod sgrig byas pa'i hre'i me skyogs lan gyi pha'e gcig bcas nas me skyogs gnyis 'khyer te spyi lo 1950lo'i zla 10tshes 9nyin dar rtse mdo nas thon pa dang / lam bar nyin grangs bdun tsam phyin rjes nang chen len thub pa byas nas nang chen dgon pa dang / dkri yang ( ṣ+ṭhaṣā)mdo gtsang kha (lkolo.oṃ)bcas brgyud de thog mar ri bo che'i bod dmag rnams mtha' skor/ de nas rang re'i stobs shugs la gzhigs te dgra dmag tshar gcod gang thub byed dgos pa dang / lhag ma rnams thon 154la rtsis sprod dgos/ de rjes rngan mda' bzung ste bod dmag chab mdo nas lha sar phyir 'then byed lam gcod pa dang bod dmag gi rgyab snon dmag chab mdor 'gro ba'i lam 'gog rgyu/thon 154'di thon krang chi cin wu'u dang / chab srid u yon dbyang cun gnyis kyis sne khrid de spyi lo 1kha50lo zla 10tshes 6nyin 'dan khog nas 'bri chu brgal te skye rgu mdo'i lho ngos le dbar lnga bcu yod pa'i 'ba' thang khul du lam skor byed pa dang / de rjes mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag gis nang chen dgon pa dang / mdo gung pa/(lko1phya) rgya gtsang kha (stoske'isher )bcas brgyud nas nang chen gyi dgra dmag tshar gcod btang / de nas ying gcig gi dmag shugs bzhag ste nang chen brtan srung byed pa dang /dgra dmag chab mdo nas nang chen brgyud nag chur 'gro sa'i lam yang bkagade'i gtso shugs dmag rngan mda' khul du shar bskyod byas/ dmag 'thab kyi las 'gan ni mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag dang gcig mtshungs yin/2 dbus ngos ni thon 155dang / thon 156 cun me skyogs ying /200

'brel ri bo mthon po brgyud chab mdo phyogs su shar bskyod byed dgos/thon 156(cun me skyogs ying khongs gtogs )'di tshes 10nyin 'dan khog nas chu bo brgal te mgyogs lam brgyud srib mda' phyogs su thad kar mdun skyod byed pa dang / gzhan yang dmag dpung chung chung zhig srib mda'i lho ngos sa khul du skor skyod byas te thon155dang mnyam 'brel thog srib mda'i dgra dmag mda' dpon mu bya ba'i dmag dpung tshar gcod byed dgos/ de nas yi chu kha (loh+la.oṃ)dang / tu'u lan mdo (oṃdze+elko)brgyud de zi khron zam pa myur 'phrog byas nas chab mdor mnyam 'brel dpung 'jug byed dgos/ mdun skyod bya rim nang ga dus yin yang 'bri chu rgyud kyi nub bros dgra dmag mtha' skor tshar gcod bya rgyur do snang byed dgos pa ma zad myul zhib ying dang bzo skrun ying bar 'brel ba bya rgyur yang do snang byed dgos/ 2 g.yon ngos ni/ cun myul zhib ying dang / bzo skrun ying / hre 54me skyogs lan bcas las grub cing / de dag myul zhib ying krang su'u thung ching dang / cun thad gtogs chab srid khru'u kru'u ren wang tā zhon gnyis kyis bkod 'doms bya rgyu red/ tshes brgyad nyin zhogs pa chu tshod bdun par skam thog (oṃ—6)nas chu bo brgal te thog mar skam thog khul gyi dgra dmag tshar gcod pa dang / de nas thang phu dang / 'jo mda'/ skyor gzhung sogs kyi sa khul brgyud dgra dmag mgo skor btang ste stag ma la (ṣ+ṭhapaṃkhri )'phrog pa dang / zi khron zam pa bkag sdom byed dgos/ myul zhib ying dang bzo skrun ying gnyis mdun skyod byas te chab mdo dang bar thag nyin gsum gyi 'gro lam yod pa'i sar slebs skabs dmag shugs khag gcig rang mos kyis lam bu 'dems nas chab mdo'i lho khul du skor skyod byed dgos shing dgra dmag 202

rnams ri khul lam yang na cin mda' (༅7) (chab mdo'i lho phyogs/)bkra ya khri rdo (ā+oṃ'iskyalko skre)bcas skor nas bros pa'i nyen kha yang 'gog dgos/4 hre bkod 'doms pu'u 'di hre krang wu'u krung dang / hre krang gzhon pa khren tsi kri gnyis nas sne khrid bya rgyu yin/ gom thengs dang po 'dan khog yin pa dang / gom thengs gnyis pa srib mda' yin pa/ gom thengs gsum pa gdong grong gru kha yin/1rdzo50lo'i zla 10ches 5nyin/chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang chi rmin gyis cun thad gtogs mi sna khag gcig dang hre 54yi me sgrogs lan gyi sne khrid de sde dge ru slebs/yun nan gyi cun 14pa'i khongs hre 42kyi thon 126pas zla 10tshes 5nyin man sgang du yod pa'i dgra dmag la phar rgol byed skabs mdun phyogs dmag dpung bya spyod spel snga ba dang / dgra dmag mtha' skor ma tshar gong lam seng phar rgol byas pas dgra dmag skad cig tsam la pham nyes byung bar brten rang dmag gis dgra dmag kha shas zhig las bzung thub med/ de'i lhag ma rnams byang phyogs tu'u leng (skeṭ+wāṃlko )khul du bros/ hre 42kyi thon 126dang thon 125nang gi ying gcig gis g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mnyam gshib thog 'ded rdung byed pa dang / dmag shugs khag gcig tshwa lho'i nub byang khul gyi brag sna ru 'dzul te dgra dmag nub phyogs su bros rgyur bkag dgos/1950lo'i zla 10ches 6nyin/tu'u leng ( skeṭ+wāṃlko )gi dgra dmag bzhi brgya lhag tsam rnams thon 203

126gis mtha' skor nas dmag 'thab chu tshod gnyis byas pas dgra dmag 2kha5'dzin bzung thub pa byung / de'i nang dgra dmag brgya dpon gcig dang / lding dpon brgyad/ dmag mi sum brgya brgyad bcu gya bzhi/ rmas skyon byung ba gnyis bcas tshud yod/ de min dgra dmag gcig bsad pa dang /ring mda' dgu bcu/ thung mda' gnyis/ bod mda' nyis brgya bdun cu don gcig mde'u nyis stong nyis brgya drug cu re brgyad/ rta bcu gnyis bcas 'phrog pa red/hre 52kyi dmag yongs 'dan khog tu 'byor te 'bri chu brgal ba'i gra sgrig tshar/ rdzogs chen nas blangs pa'i g.yag 14400lhag tsam des dngos rdzas dbor 'dren byas te rim bzhin 'dan khog tu 'byor rjes da dung g.yag 9299lhag bsdad yod/ de'i nang hre thad gtogs ru chen dang po'i g.yag 2212dang / ru chen gnyis pa'i g.yag 1401 thon 154yi g.yag 2500 thon 155yi g.yag 602 thon 156gi g.yag 922 me sgrogs ying gi g.yag 119 dmag rdzas lan dang po'i g.yag 41〈 bzo skrun lan gyi g.yag 442bcas tshud yod pas bsdoms nā yang khri bco lnga dang 'bru rigs khag gcig dbor 'dren byas/ 'char gzhir dmag dpung 'bri chu brgal ba'i rjes g.yag rnams ded nas chu bo brgal te dmag dpung gi rjes su 'brangs rgyu dang / de tsho'i dbor 'dren kha snon 'gan srung thub pa bya rgyu red/de nyin dgong mo cun myul zhib ying gi lan gnyis kyis skam thog gi byang ngos lha don (༈tsho ā+oṃkre)nas 'bri chu gsang brgal byas te dgra bo'i rgyab tu skor skyod byas/ 'on kyang skor skyod dmag dpung 'bri chu brgal ba'i rjes kha phyogs 'dzol bar brten dus thog tu gtan 'khel byas pa'i sa der slebs med pa 204

dang / mdun phyogs dmag dpung dang 'brel ba'ang chad pa red/ 1950lo'i zla 10ches 7nyin /hre 52kyi thon 154zhogs pa'i chu tshod bdun pa nas 'go btsugs te 'bri chu brgal bas snga dro tshang ma brgal tshar ba dang / de nas ri mda' dang mkhar sa (oṃ mi/ )brgyud 'ba' thang phyogs su mdun skyod byas/mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag gi sngon skyod lan de nyin chu tshod bcu gnyis tsam la nang chen du 'byor/cun myul zhib ying dang ying 'di'i 'bri chu brgal ba'i dmag 'thab kyi skor skyod dmag dpung gi lan gnyis 'brel ba chad pa'i rjes/ zhogs pa sngar gyi 'char gzhi ltar skam thog khul du dmag 'thab byed pa dang 'bri chu drag brgal byas/ ying 'di'i sngon skyod pan gnyis 'bri chu gsang brgal legs grub byung yang de rjes dmag dpung dgra bo'i me shugs kyi bkag sdom byung nas 'gro thub med/ 'bri chu brgal tshar ba'i yan lag ru khag gis 'bri chu'i nub ngos kyi chu 'gram dmag sa'i sa dbyibs rang cag la ha cang mi legs pa'i gnas tshul 'og dgra dmag dang dmag 'thab chu tshod bco lnga tsam byas pa brgyud gtso shugs dmag dpung de nyin dgong mo 'bri chu'i nub ngos su slebs/skam thog gi srung dmag nub ngos su phyir bros byas/ dmag 'thab 'di'i nang dgra dmag dgu bzung ba dang / brgyad bsad pa ma zad bco lnga rmas skyon btang / rang re'i dmag dpung gi pha'e rim pa'i las byed pa gnyis dang /dmag mi dgu grongs pa dang bcu la rmas skyon phog yod/ de min dmag mi bco lnga chu sub thebs te grongs/ rang dmag gis dgra dmag lag nas dbyin ji'i ring mda' dgu dang / mde'u brgyad stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu nga brgyad/205

bod mda' brgya tham pa/ me mda' sbag sbag lci ba gcig nas dang rtsam pa rgya ma chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu bcas 'phrog thub yod pa red/de nyin dgong mo chu tshod nyer gnyis dang phyed kar chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi lho phyogs dmag dpung thon 157nang gi ying gnyis pa 'ba' an gyi byang ngos rab kha nas 'bri chu gsang brgal byas/ thon 'di'i ying gnyis pa'i lan lnga pas 'phral rgol lan gyi 'gan 'khur/ rab kha 'dir dgra dmag sa srung mkhan med par brten 'bri chu gsang brgal legs grub thub/1950lo'i zla 10ches rdonyin/thon 157nang gi ying gnyis pa de nyin dus tshod brgyad par tshang ma 'bri chu brgal tshar/hre 52kyi thon 155ni chu tshod nyi shu rtsa bzhi la 'dan khog nas 'bri chu brgal tshar ba dang / thon 'di'i sngon skyod ying 'bri chu brgal ba'i rjes mgyogs myur nub ngos su le dbar 20mdun skyod byas/myul zhib ying gis skam thog nas thang phu'i ngos su dgra dmag 'ded rgol byas pa red/thon 157gyi ying dang pos ying gnyis pa'i rjes 'brangs te chos sde sgang (khriṣ+ka1)nas 'bri chu brgal bas chu tshod bcu gnyis tsam la yongs su brgal tshar ba red/thon 157byang lam bkod 'doms so'o yis lan bzhi pa dang / me skyogs lan gyi sne khrid de phyi dro chu tshod gsum dang phyed kar 'ba' an gyi byang phyogs chos sde sgang nas 'bri chu brgal tshar ba red/ dmag dpung 'di 'bri chu brgal ba'i skabs ko gru bed spyod btang bas gru chung ba dang gtsang po rgyugs 206
