shugs che bar brten gru res thengs rer mi gnyis gsum las 'khur thub kyi med/ gnas tshul de'i rkyen pas rang re'i dmag dpung mdun skyod bya rgyu dal 'gyangs su song ba red/1950lo'i zla 10ches 9nyin/ hre 52kyi thon 156gis 'dan khog nas 'bri chu brgal tshar te dgon mda' (zla.oṃ)phyogs su mdun skyod byas/mkha' dmag hre 12gyis 'dan khog tu mkha' thog skyel 'dren gyi tshod lta legs grub byung ba dang / hre 52kyi thon 157nang gi ying gsum pas chu tshod klad kor dang skar ma sum cur 'ba' an lho ngos kyi rkang 'khru gtsang po nas skor skyod byas/ lan bdun pas 'phral rgol lan gyi 'gan bzhes te 'bri chu gsang brgal gyi bya ba legs grub thub pa byung / lan brgyad pa yis gru ba lung nas 'bri chu btsan brgal legs grub byung rjes lam seng dgra bo'i srung dmag la phar rgol byas pa dang / dgra dmag gi sdod gnas su slebs skabs lan 'di'i lan krang gzhon pa'i mgo la me mda' phog de nas 'phrod bsten pa wu'u krung 'u yis sman ras kyis rma kha dkri ba'i brgyud rim nang dgra dmag gis khang thog nas me dma' brgyab pas khong gi mgo la phog ste gzi brjid ngang sku gshegs/ 'phrod bsten pa ho'o le yis mu mthud gog bgrod byas te sman ras dkri ba'i las 'gan sgrub dus 'jab dmag gis me mda' brgyab pas rkang par phog de nas yang 'phrod bsten pa'i pan krang khang hung gis mdun skyod byas nas sman ras dkri ba dang rmas dmag rnams skabs 'phral sman khang du bskyal/ hre 52gyi mdun skyod bkod 'doms pu'u nas 'phrod bsten pan gyi gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyi sgo nas rmas dmag skyob pa'i bya spyod la bya 207

dga' sprod rgyu'i bka' bkram pa red/ tho rengs chu tshod bdun par thon 157gyi lan bdun pa dang brgyad pas gru ba lung gi dgra bo'i srung dmag thams cad tshar gcod byas/zhi sum sgang (zlo71)gi dgra dmag rnams tho rengs tsam la phyir bros byas pa dang / thon 154yi ying gnyis pa'i lan lnga pa dang drug pa tshes brgyad nyin chos sde sgang nas 'bri chu brgal rjes spyi khre lnga stong yod pa'i tshug la ri bo (⑪sgre+o1tshe)brgal te zhi sum sgang (zlo71)phyogs su mdun skyod byas mthar de ring chu tshod bcu gnyis la zhi sum sgang nub ngos su 'byor/thon 157pa'i sku srung lan gyis chu tshod klad kor la zhi sum sgang rab khar drag rgol byed pa legs grub byung ste yul dmag khag gcig 'dzin bzung byas kyang lam seng glod 'grol btang /1rdzo50lo'i zla 10ches 10nyin/thon 157nang gi ying gsum pas gru ba lung gi srung dmag rtsa med btang rjes 'bum sa dang / lha mdun/ gna' stong bcas brgyud smar khams phyogs su mdun skyod byas/ lam bar kha 'thor ba'i dgra bo nyung shas dang dmag 'thab byas mthar de dag gtor brlag btang / grong tsho gang du slebs kyang de ga'i yul dmag gis go cha bzhag ste mgo btags zhu ba dang / yul dpon dang 'go pas sa thag ring po nas bsu ba zhu bar brten dmag dpung gi mdun skyod myur tshad ha cang mgyogs po byung /de nyin dgong mo thon 157nang gi ying dang po mdun skyod byas nas chin mo'o (༈zlakā stso)ru slebs dus mda' dpon dgu pa'i ru dpon gnyis pa dang gdong thug ste dmag 'thab byas/ mthar dgra bo gcig bsad pa dang /208

gcig gson bzung byas pa/ ring mda' grangs lnga dang rdzas mdel/ de bzhin dngos rdzas 'ga' dgra lag nas tshur 'phrog de rjes chin mo'o yi srung dmag rnams smar khams (ge+o ོrtse'i)phyogs su bros pas thon krang gzhon pa tse hung con nas ying dang po'i sne khrid de tshan gang rjes 'ded btang /1950lo'i zla 10ches 11nyin/thon 157nyin de'i dgong mo chu tshod 22dang phyed kar smar khams kyi nubakhyang gi phyugs ra'i nye 'khor du slebs/ der bca' sdod byed pa'i bod dmag mda' dpon dgu pa'i mda' dpon skal bzang dbang 'dus dang rang re'i lho phyogs dmag dpung gi bkod 'doms pu'u gnyis gros mol byas mthar bod dmag nas go mtshon 'jog rgyur mos mthun dang / 'os langs zhes pa'i ming tshig bed spyod bya rgyu'i re ba zhus/thon 155nas ya yog gsum mdo (ṣ+kaspro7lko)blangs te dgra dmag dgu tsam rtsa med bzos/hre 42kyi thon 126nang gi dmag dpung 'ga' tshwa lho'i nye 'gram du 'byor zin/1950lo'i zla 10ches 12nyin/lho nub dmag khul khang gi mdzub ston/ bod dmag mda' dpon dgu pa'i mda' dpon skal bzang dbang 'dus dngos gnas rang cag dang gros bsdur byas nas go mtshon 'jog 'dod yod na spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhu dgos pa dang 'os langs zhes pa'i ming tshig bed spyod byas te dmigs bsal gyi lta rtog byed dgos/ don der bod rigs blo mthun rnams las ka 209

dngos nang zhugs dgos/ gal srid gnad don 'di legs grub yag po byung tshe rjes su rang res chab srid thog nas 'gug thabs byed par phan pa chen po yod/de nyin tho rengs tsam la thon 157nang gi ying gsum pa smar khams nye 'gram du 'byor ba dang mda' dpon skal bzang dbang 'dus kyis dmag dpung gi sne khrid de 'os langs byas/ khyon bsdoms 'os langs byed mkhan dpon dmag mi grangs 244dang / me mda' sbag sbag grangs 6 ring mda' grangs 209 mde'u grangs 〈9207bcas yod/ de nas smar khams grong khyer bcings bkrol btang ba dang dbyin ji ba pe khā 'dzin bzung byas pa bcas so/thon 156nang gi ying dang po dgon mda'i shar 'gram du slebs skabs dgra dmag phu lung mda' dpon dang gdong thug dmag 'thab byung / rang phyogs kyi dmag dpung khag gcig gis mtho gnon btsan sa bzung ba dang /g.yas g.yon gnyis su so sor dpung khag re btang nas mtha' skor byas/dgra dmag gis kyang rang re'i mdun phyoṭa nas tshur rgol thengs gnyis tsam byas rung pham nyes su btang / de nas dgra dmag rnams nub phyogs su phyir bros byas stabs thon 156le dbar nyi shu lhag tsam mdun skyod thub pa byung /thon 126nas tshwa lho khul bzung ste dgra dmag brgya tsam dang yul dmag kha shas rtsa med du btang / de'i lhag ma rnams byang phyogs su bros pas yang thon 157nas mdun bsu rgol rdung byas/ de nas tshwa lho'i dmag 'thab yongs su mjug sgril/ thon 126dang thon 125nang gi ying gcig gis tshwa lho dang tu'u leng (ske1 lko ) man kung (/caka1)bcas kyi khul du dgra dmag lnga brgya lhag tsam rtsa med btang nas tshwa lho bcings 'grol btang /210

1950lo'i zla 10ches 12nyin/cun myul zhib ying thung phu nas thon te 'jo mda' ru slebs pa dang /dgra bo'i srung dmag rnams gcod gzhung khul du bros/ dmag 'thab nang dgra bo gsum bsad pa dang / gcig la rmas skyon phog pa/ mi gsum gson bzung byas pa/ ring mda' gsum dang mde'u chig stong lnga brgya tsam 'phrogade nas myul zhib ying gis mu mthud rjes 'ded btang / de nyin sa sros tsam la thon 155nang gi skor skyod las 'gan 'khur ba'i ying gsum pa mdun skyod byas nas srib mda'i nye 'gram du slebs skabs dgra bos chu bo'i rgyud du srung dmag bkod sgrig byas te rang dmag gi mdun skyod lam bu bkag thon 156nas mdun phyogs su phar rgol byas rung las 'gan gsal po gtan 'khel med pa dang / bkod 'doms gcig gyur med par brten thon 155nang gi ying gsum pa dgra dmag dang bar thag smi 200tsam yod sar dus yun chu tshod bcu lhag phan tshun sra 'dzin gyi gnas su gyur/ dgra dmag rnams brag rong rgyab kyi nags khrod du yib bsdad yod pas rang dmag gis gzhos/sa ngos kyi lam bu bdams te de dag rtsa med gtong thub med/ de'i phyi nyin tho rengs tsam la dgra dmag rnams nub ngos su phyir bros byas par dgra bo kha shas las shi rmas gtong thub med/ yin na'ang rang phyogs kyi mi bcu lhag tsam shi rmas byung yod/thon 157nang gi ying gnyis pas thon byang lam bkod 'doms so'o yi rjes su skyod de smar khams kyi nye 'khor du slebs pa dang / lcang ga ( 1oṃ)bzung /211

1950lo'izla 10ches 14nyin/hre 52nas thon 155dang thon 154yi ying gsum par mgyogs myur srib mda' ru phyir bros byas pa'i dgra dmag rjes 'ded gtong rgyu'i bka' phab/cun pu'u nas thon 157smar khams nas spang mda' dang dpa' shod bcas su bskyod de dgra bo'i lho nub kyi phyir bros lam bu bkag rgyu'i bka' phab/1950lo'i zla 10ches 15nyin/myul zhib ying gis 'jo mda' nas mu mthud rjes 'ded btang ste mkhar sgang nub ngos dang le dbar 20yod pa'i sar slebs dus bod dmag gi rta dmag dang thug myul zhib ying gis lam seng phar rgol byas pas dgra dmag gsum mgo btags zhus/ de nas bod dmag rnams gcor gzhung dang / chab mdo phyogs su phyir bros byas pas myul zhib ying gis mu mthud rjes 'ded btang /thon 157gyi thon krang gzhon pa tse hung con gyis thon de'i ying dang po'i sne khrid nas smar khams nas thon te ri gshis (5tusgo)dang / bkra shis mda' stod/(ā+oṃ'i.a+yoskre2) mdzo sgang / thu mdo (sh+tsalko)brgyud nyin brgyad tsam spyod nas spang mda' ru bskyod rgyu dang / de nas yang spang mda' nas nyin bzhi tsam spyad de dpa' shod du chab mdo'i dgra dmag gi lho ngos bros lam bkag rgyu'i las 'gan sgrub rgyu red/1950lo'i zla 10ches 16nyin/thon 157gyi chab srid u yon ren zhan hreng gis thon 'di'i ying 212

gnyis pa'i sne khrid de smar khams nas ying dang po'i rjes 'brangs te spang mda'i phyogs su mdun skyod byas/hre 52gyi chab srid u yon gzhon pa me'o h+phe dbyi nas mdun skyod bkod 'doms las khungs dang ying gsum pa'i sne khrid de smar khams khul gyi dgra dmag gtsang sel dang de khul gyi sa srung las 'gan 'khur/ de nas ying gsum pas lan shog cig btang ste bkra shis mda' stod (༈khyitusgo7khri༅)bzung ba dang / rdza chu'i shing zam bkag sdom byas/thon 155shing grur bsdad de bkra shis chu bo brgal nas gdong grong gru kha'i phyogs su phar rgol dpung skyod byas/thon 154dang mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag nas ri bo che phyogs su myur skyod byas/thon 156nas yi chu kha (oṃ.oṃ.oṃ)brgal te chab mdo phyogs su myur skyod byas/mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag gis mdzes me (gluyibyezhu)khul du dgra bo mi bzhi bsad pa dang / mi bcu gsum gson bzung byas/ ring mda' bcu gsum dang rdzas mdel nyis stong brgya dang nyer sum 'phrog rang phyogs kyi mi gsum la'ang rmas skyon byung / de nas rta dmag yan lag ru khag ri bo che ngos su myur skyod bya rgyu'i bka' phab/de nyin sa sros tsam la thon 156nang gi sngon skyod rta dmag myul zhib pha'e 'di wa la'i 'gram du dgra bo'i 'jab rgol phog pas myul zhib tshan mu'u krang ching lan dang / chab srid khru'u yi las don mi sna brtson 'grus rnam rgyal gnyis grongs pa dang / pha'e krang ha'e we zhun sogs la rmas skyon byung /mthar pha'e 'di'i mi gsum gyis sa de rang la dmag 'thab rgyun 'khyongs byas/213

skabs der thon 156gi rjes 'brangs dmag dpung gis me mda'i sgra thos pas myur du dpung skyod byas te wa la'i dgra dmag dang kha gtad dmag 'thab drag po byas/1rdzo50lo'i zla 10ches 17nyin/cun me skyogs ying gis wa la'i khul gyi dgra bor me skyogs 'phen pa dang phyogs mtshungs thon 156nang gi gtso shugs dmag 'u/sa phar rgol thengs gnyis byas rung dgra bos btsan bzung 'gog rgol byed par brten mdun phyogs phar rgol la nus pa thon thub med/ de nas thon 156gis gsar du legs sgrig byed skabs wa la'i dgra dmag rnams chab mdo'i phyogs su phyir bros byas/ de dus thon 156la 'bru rigs chad de nyin gcig tsam song bas skyel 'dren ru khag gis 'bru rigs kha gsab byas rjes mu mthud rjes 'ded bya rgyu'i re ba zhus/ 'om/ kyang hre 52kyis thon 156la 'bru rigs chad pa'i dka' ngal khyad bsad dang / gang la yang ma 'dzem par wa la'i dgra dmag rtsa med gtong dgos pa/ nga dung dgos nges skabs dmag dpung dang mnyam bskyod kyis rta drel bsad nas ltogs gsos byas na 'grig pa'i bka' phab/thon 156nas kyang 'khril rtswa chur btsos te ltogs gsos byas nas mu mthud rjes 'ded mdun skyod byas/tshes 16gi dgong mo mkhar sgang (rde r+sā)nas phyir bros byas pa'i dgra dmag rnams gcod gzhung du zhag sdod byas/ tshes bcu bdun gyi dgong mo'i chu tshod gsum par myul zhib ying gi gdong len dpung sdes mtshan mo mun nag la brten nas dgra dmag gi sbra gur mdun du slebs dus kho tshos shes te gang sar bros pa dang / me mda' yang gang byung du brgyab/ de nas myul zhib ying 214

gis lam sang phar rgol dmag 'thab chu tshod gcig tsam byas pa brgyud dgra dmag brgya dang bcu gcig tshar gcod thub pa byung / de'i nang nas brgya dpon gsum dang dmag mi brgyad cu gya lnga 'dzin bzung byas pa dang / brgya dpon gcig dang dmag mi bcu bzhi bsad/ da dung dmag mi brgyad la rmas skyon btang yod/ rang phyogs kyi lan gyi las byed pa gcig dang dmag mi dgu dmag 'thab nang grongs pa dang / de min mi bcu bdun la rmas skyon byung /dgra dmag gi lag nas rang res dbyin ji'i ring mda' brgya dang dgu bcu go gsum/ me mda' sbag sbag gnyis/ thung mda' drug me dma' sbag sbag lci gras gcig mde'u khri nyi shu lhag tsam/ rgyang shel gcig rta drel nyi brgya lnga bcu nga gsum/ g.yag brgya dang lnga bcu nga gnyis bcas 'phrog de 'phrod dgra dmag rnams chab mdo'i phyogs su bros pas myul zhib dang bzo skrun ying la mgyogs myur rjes 'ded gtong dgos pa dang / mā la (yīkhri)bzung ste chab mdo'i shar 'gram gyi rdza zam bkag sdom byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/thon 154yi snyan zhu/ thon 'di 'ba' thang nas mdun skyod byas rjes dmag mi so sos dngos po rgya ma bdun cu nas brgyad cu'i bar 'khur te nyin rer lam thag le dbar dgu bcu nas brgya dang bcu'i bar bskyod kyi yod pa ma zad mu mthud ri bo che phyogs su myur skyod byed kyi yod pa red/ sngar gyi 'char gzhir gzhigs na/ dmag dpung rang gis 'khur ba'i 'bru rigs zas tshar rjes skyel 'dren ru khag nas kha gsab dbor rgyu red/ 'on kyang dmag dpung ni nyin rer le dbar brgya tsam bskyod kyi yod pa dang / skyel 'dren ru khag ni nyin gcig la le dbar bcu tsam las bskyod thub kyi med/ byas tsang dmag dpung rang gis 'khur ba'i 'bru rigs zas tshar dus skyel 'dren ru khag nas kha gsab byed thabs bral ba zhig yin pa ma zad dmag dpung mtho sgang sa khul 215

du mdun skyod byed skabs gnam gshis grang ba dang / gso rlung nyung ba/ sa cha mi 'phrod pa sogs kyi rgyu rkyen la brten dmag dpung gi rjes su lus mkhan ha cang mang po yod/ yin na'ang thon pu'u nas ri bo che dang rngan mda' gnyis kyi khul du skor skyod byas te dgra dmag gi phyir bros lam bu 'gog pa'i ched/ dmag dpung gis dka' ngal sna tshogs la ma 'dzem par mu mthud mdun skyod bya rgyu dang / de nyin tho rengs la rgya gtsang kha zam par slebs rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas/ chu bo'i pha rol du dgra dmag mda' dpon bdun pa'i brgya dpon gnyis kyis 'dzing rags bzos nas brtan srung byed bzhin yod/de'i chu bo rgyugs shugs che bas brgal nas skor skyod byed thabs bral/ de nas chu tshod bco brgyad dang phyed kar rang dmag gis mdun phyogs su phar rgol byas pas dgra dmag rnams skad cig nyid du pham ste lho ngos su phyir bros byas/dmag 'thab nang dgra dmag bcu tsam shi rmas btang ba dang / 'bru rigs dang ra lug khag gcig 'phrog thub pa byung / rang phyogs kyi dmag mi gsum gshegs pa dang / mi drug la rmas skyon byung yod/mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag gis chu tshod dgu dang phyed kar ri bo che'i dgra dmag la phar rgol byas pas dgra dmag bcu bsad pa dang / bzhi gson por bzung / da dung me mda' sbag sbag gcig dang / me mda' ring thung bsdoms lnga/ mde'u khri gnyis lhag tsam/ 'bru rigs rgya ma khri gcig dang lnga stong lhag tsam bcas 'phrog thub yod/ rang phyogs kyi dmag mi gcig grongs pa dang / gcig la rmas skyon byung / ri bo che ni ri klung nags khrod song tsang dgra dmag lhag ma rnams de'i nang du yib nas bsdad yod pa red/thon 154dang mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag gnyis rngan mda' khul du shar bskyod dgos pa'i bka' phab/216

thon 155yis gdong grong gru kha bzung ste dgra dmag khag gcig tshar bcad/ de nas thon 'di nyin mtshan kun tu bskyod nas chab mdo bzung dgos pa'i bka' phab/1950lo'i zla 10ches 1shrīnyin/de nyin tho rengs mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag rngan mda' ru 'byor/ skabs der rta dmag yan lag ru khag gi rta lnga brgya lhag tsam shi rmas byung yod/ chab mdo'i srung dmag tshar gcod gtong ched dang / de dag rngan mda' nas lho rdzong nub ngos su bros pa'i 'gro lam bkag ched/ rta dmag yan lag ru khag dang hre 52kyi rta dmag myul zhib lan gyis rta bzhag ste lha sgang (ṣ+ṭha skra)zam pa'i phyogs su myur skyod byas pas dgra dmag las chu tshod bzhi yi sngon la lha sgang zam pa bzung /thon 154mdun skyod byas nas ri bo cher 'byor/ thon 'dis ying gcig sa 'di brtan srung byas te dgra dmag steng chen du bros nyen 'gog dgos pa dang thon gyi gtso shugs dmag rngan mda' phyogs su mdun skyod byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/thon 155dang / thon 156 cun myul zhib ying / bzo skrun ying bcas chab mdo phyogs la myur skyod byas/mdo spyi nas bod dmag mda' dpon gsum pa dang / brgyad pa/ bcu pa/ bzhi pa/ de bzhin spyi khyab las khungs dang srung dmag sogs bsdoms mi grangs nyis stong bdun brgya lhag tsam khrid de zhogs pa chab mdo bzhag ste rngan mda' dang ri bo che phyogs su phyir bros byas/ de nyin dgong mo phu mdo ru slebs dus gzhi nas rang dmag gis rngan mda' dang ri bo che'i bros lam 217

bkag tshar yod pa shes/ de nas yang kha phyogs sgyur te spang mda' dang /dpa' shod phyogs su phyir bros byas/lho nub dmag don chab srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi li'u po'o khreng gis 'os langs byed mkhan bod dmag mda' dpon dgu pa'i mda' dpon skal bzang dbang 'dus la btang ba'i mtshams 'dri'i glog 'phrin gyi nang don gsham gsal/sku zhabs skal bzang dbang 'dus dang mda' dpon dgu pa'i dpon dmag yongs la/khyod tshos bden don zab rtogs kyi sgo nas 'os langs kyi dar cha mthon por bsgrongs te mi dmangs kyi phyogs su langs pas smar khams zhi bde'i ngang bcings 'grol thob pa dang / mi dmangs kyi tshe srog rgyu nor la dgos med kyi shi rmas dang gyong gun byung med/ gnas tshul de thos rjes dga' spro chen po skyes te dmigs bsal gyi 'tshams 'dri'i glog 'phrin 'di btang nas mu mthud yar rgyas yong ba'i re ba dang / so so'i sngon thon bya spyod la gzhigs te bod dmag yongs krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi khyim tshang chen po'i nang yong rgyu'i 'bod skul dang / de bzhin mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la ram 'degs hur brtson byas nas rgyal kha'i ngang bod ljongs bcings 'grol btang ste bod rigs spun zla rnams snga tsam btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi gnya' gnon 'og nas thon rgyu dang / rim bzhin bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun byas nas bde skyid kyi ldum rwa lta bu chags pa byas te lho nub rgyal srung sra brtan du gtong dgos/lho nub dmag don chab srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi/ li'u po'o khreng /zla 10tshes 1/nyin/218

1950lo'i zla 10ches 19nyin/g.yas phyogs skor skyod dmag dpung mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lan ru khag dang thon 154nang gi ying gnyis kyis hre'i tshan mu'u krang li rming nas sne khrid byas pa'i hre'i myul zhib lan des sngon skyod lan byas te chab mdo'i lho ngos su phyir bros byed mkhan dgra dmag gi lam bu bkag pa dang / rdzong ya ri bo'i la nyag thams cad bzung /bod dmag mda' dpon bdun pa'i dmag mi brgya dang nyi shu lhag tsam ri bo cher rang phyogs kyi thon 154la mgo btags zhus/byang phyogs dmag dpung gi gtso shugs dmag thon 155dang thon 156nas mnyam 'brel thog chab mdo phyogs su phar rgol mdun skyod byas pa dang / hre 52kyi bkod 'doms pu'u dang cun me skyogs ying nas de yi rjes su 'brangs/ thon krang wang li h+phang gis sne khrid byas pa'i thon 156gi bde chas sngon skyod ying nas nyin bzhir 'bru rigs chad pa'i gnas tshul 'og g.yon phyogs nas mgyogs lam brgyud de nyin 'di'i chu tshod nyi shu la chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba dang / dgra dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam gson por bzung /myul zhib ying dang / bzo skrun ying / de bzhin hre 57gyi me skyogs lan bcas chu tshod nyi shu rtsa gnyis la chab mdor 'byor ba dang dgra dmag bzhi bcu lhag trem gson bzung byas/lho phyogs dmag dpung thon 157nas mdzo sgang bzung bas de'i rdzong dpon bros byol du song / dmag 'thab nas rang re'i dmag dpung gis dgra dmag lag nas 'bru rigs dang / tshwa/ ja lo khag gcig 'phrog thon 219

155de nyin dgong mo chab mdo'i shar 'gram du 'byor/1950lo'i zla 10ches 20nyin/thon 154yi gtso shugs dmag gis rngan mda' tshur blangs/mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag dang / thon 154nang gi sngon skyod dmag dpung / hre 52kyi rta dmag myul zhib lan bcas kyis rdzong ya ri bo'i la nyag gi 'gag mdo thams cad bzung / chab mdo nas bros pa'i dgra dmag rnams lho phyogs su bros rtsis byas kyang rta dmag yan lag ru khag dang hre 52kyi myul zhib lan gnyis kyis 'gog rgol byas stabs bskyar du rdzong ya ri bo'i gsham du log de nas nga phod kyis pho nya btang ste zhi bde'i ngang mes rgyal la mgo 'dogs kyi bya ba sgrub stangs skor gros mol byed par mngags/myul zhib ying gis g.yon phyogs nas rdzong ya ri bor skor skyod byas te dgra dmag sum cu so gsum bzung / de'i nang brgya dpon gsum dang /dmag mi sum cu tshud yod/ skabs der myul zhib ying dang mtsho sngon rta dmag yan lag ru khag gnyis mnyam 'dzoms byung /hre 52nas khams 'thab ang rtags lnga pa'i bka' rgya btang ste dmag dpung khag la dgra dmag gtsang bcom bya rgyu'i las 'gan bkod sgrig dang /mu mthud nub ngos su bros pa'i dgra dmag tshar gcod dgos pa'i bka' phab/1950lo'i zla 10ches 21nyin/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon/ mdo spyi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis bod dmag mda' dpon gsum pa dang / brgyad pa/ bcu pa bcas kyi dpon dmag yongs dang de bzhin mda' dpon gnyis pa dang /220

bzhi pa/ drug pa bcas kyi dpon dmag khag gcig bsdoms mi grangs nyis stong bdun brgya lhag tsam sne khrid de chab mdo'i lho ngos le dbar 50yod pa'i rdzong ya ri bo'i gru gu dgon pa ru 'di nyin gyi chu tshod nyi shu la go mtshon thams cad bzhag nas mes rgyal la mgo btags/ dus der dbyin ji'i gsang myul h+phu the 'dzin bzung byas/thon 157nang gi ying dang po thu mdo (r+ṣalko)ru slebs rjes de nyin dgong mo rang la mdun skyod byas pa ma zad spang mda' bzung / thon 'di'i smar khams srung dmag dang spang mda' phyogs su mdun skyod byed pa'i dmag dpung gnyis kyis smar khams khul dang lam bar du dgra dmag tha thor lnga bcu lhag tsam tshar gcod byas/ de nas chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed kyi gtso shugs zhi bde'i ngang mes rgyal la mgo btags par brten thon 157la dpal shod khul du mdun skyod byed mtshams bzhag ste smar khams khul du log nas sa srung dgos pa'i bka' phab/1950lo'i zla 10ches 22nyin/thon 154nang gi lan gsum pas rngan mda' khul gyi shar lho'i lung shur du dgra dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam tshar gcod byas pa dang / dgra dmag lag nas rta lnga bcu lhag tsam dang g.yag nyis brgya lhag tsam 'phrog thub pa byung /lho nub dmag khul khang nas btang ba'i bya dga'i bka' yig‘‘khyed tshos chab mdo dang / ri bo che/ 'jo mda'/ rngan mda'/ smar khams/ tshwa lho/ bu5 thog sogs kyi sa khul bcings 'grol btang nas dgra dmag lnga stong bdun brgya sum cu so brgyad tshar gcod byas pa dang / mda' 221

dpon dgu pa 'os langs kyi rlabs chen rgyal kha thob par rten 'brel zhu/ re bar mu mthud 'bad brtson byas te bod rigs spun zla dang mthun sgril dam zab sgo nas rgyal kha sngar bas che ba thob pa'i brtson len byed dgos ’zhes 'byor/1rdzo50lo'i zla 10ches 24nyin/thon 154yis chab mdo'i lho nub sa khul du dgra dmag lnga bcu lhag tsam 'dzin bzung byas pa dang / brag g.yab khul gyi yul dmag lnga brgya lhag tsam rang re'i dmag dpung la mgo btags/gtsang bcom dmag 'thab de ring nas mjug sgril bas de'i ring dgra dmag lhag ma gcig stong brgya lhag tsam tshar gcod thub pa byung / chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed 'di zla bcu pa'i tshes 6nas 'go tshugs te nyin bcu dgu'i ring dmag 'thab che chung nyi shu lhag tsam byas pa brgyud dgra dmag chab mdo'i spyi khyab dang mda' dpon gsum pa/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ dgu pa/ bcu pa sogs kyi sde khag yongs dang / mda' dpon gnyis pa/ bzhi pa/ drug pa bcas kyi nang nas khag gcig tshar gcod byas pa ste khyon bsdoms bsad rmas bzung btags kyi dgra dmag lnga stong bdun brgya lhag tsam yod/ de'i steng da dung 'os langs byed pa'i mda' dpon dgu pa mi grangs bzhi brgya bsdoms na khyon mi grangs drug stong brgya tham pa yod/ dmag 'thab nang rang res dgra lag nas u ru sus bzos pa'i me sgrogs gsum dang / me mda' sbag sbag lci ba dgu/ yang ba bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ dbyin jis bzos pa'i ring mda' sum stong / de min rang 'gul me mda' la sogs pa nyis brgya lhag tsam/ mde'u khri lnga bcu nga brgyad dang bzhi stong drug brgya bcu med gcig glog 'phrin 222

'phrul chas gnyis/ da dung dmag spyod dngos rdzas khag gcig bcas 'phrog thub pa byung yod/skabs der slebs dus chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed rgyal kha'i ngang mjug sgril ba red/(bde skyid sgrol dkar dang dbang 'dus kyis bsgyur/)

khren dbyi dang lhan du bod la bskyod pa'i nyin tho/wang dbyi krung /1rdzo56lo'i zla ba 2pa'i ches 11nyin/ gza' nyi ma/bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gong lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i zla mjug la dbu brnyes rgyu gtan 'khel byas pa de ni bod mi rigs dang mes rgyal mi rigs khag dbar/ de bzhin bod mi rigs khag nang khul dbar bcas kyi mthun sgril nyin bzhin sra brtan du phyin pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin pas de ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi lo rgyus thog sngar byung ma myong ba'i bya ba bzang po zhig yin la rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi chab srid 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bya ba bzang po zhi/ga kyang yin/ tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang sogs tshang mas de'i thad thugs khur ha cang chen po gnang zhing ched mngags tsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi yis tshogs gtso gnang ba'i rgyal yongs kyi gtso che'i mi rigs khag dang / dmangs gtso'i tang shog khag mi dmangs tshogs pa khag bcas las grub pa'i krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa bod du phebs nas tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang / de bzhin rgyal yongs mi rigs khag dang / las rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi sku tshab gnang ste bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes par rten 'brel dang bcas bod kyi rim pa khag gi mi 224

dmangs dang bod mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag de bzhin bod la yod pa'i las don mi sna bcas la 'tshams 'dri gnang rgyu red/ krung dbyang gis pa'e rigs kyi sku tshab gcig 'gro dgos pa'i gtan 'khel ltar yun nan zhing chen nas nga rang 'gro dgos pa'i thag gcod gnang /de ring zhogs pa'i chu tshod brgyad par khun min wu'u cwa rbad gnam gru thang la 'byor ba dang / chu tshod bcu dang skar ma nyi shu la khrung ching phyogs su 'phur/ gnam gru'i thog mnyam du mi dgu yod pa ste/ yun nan zhing chen gyi hrin krang sku gzhon krang khrung (dbyi rigs kyi sku tshab ) dang / zhi hrong pan nā'i ta'e rigs rang skyong kro'u yi kro'u krang kra'o tshun zhin (ta'e rigs kyi sku tshab/) hung ha'e ha nyi rigs rang skyong kro'u yi kru'u zhi li khrang zhang (ha nyi rigs kyi sku tshab/) nu'u cang gi li su'u rigs rang skyong kro'u yi kru'u zhi h+phe a chan (li su'u rigs kyi sku tshab/) rgyal thang / 'ba' lung / 'jol bcas bod rigs rang skyong kro'u yi gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gsung smon sprul sku (bod rigs kyi sku tshab/) de bzhin h+phe a chan gyi skad bsgyur 'on tshal (nā shi'i rigs/) gsung smon gyi skad bsgyur sung go kru'u dang mnyam bskyod mi sna ang u'u dang nga rang bcas bsdoms mi grangs dgu yod/nyin gung chu tshod dang por khrung ching gnam gru thang du phebs 'byor zin rjes rlangs 'khor nang bzhugs te khrung ching grong khyer phyogs su shar bskyod kyis khrung ching tshogs khang chen mor gnas bzhugs mdzad/ khrung ching tshogs khang chen mo ni rgyal yongs la skad grags yod pas ming du ‘‘a she ya shar ma'i ang dang po ri’zhes brjod kyi yod/ de ring dngos su mthong skabs de ni ming don yongs su mtshungs pa zhig 'dug tshogs khang nang log gi grub tshul yo/ngas rdzogs ni phyi gling pa'i bzo skrun gyi lugs ltar yin pa dang / mtho tshad 225

la thog brtsegs lnga yod pas mi stong phrag lnga lhag tsam shong thub kyi yod pa dang /de'i phyi ngos kyi bzo dbyibs ni mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang ldan zhing lta na sdug pa'i pho brang zhig dang mtshungs/spyi zla 4pa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' pa sangs/nam skya mda' gtong ba'i dus der rlungs 'tshub drag po'i 'ur sgras nga rang gnyid las sad byung / yar langs skabs grang ba'i tshor ba zhig byung /sge'u khung gi phyi phyogs su blta skabs shar lho'i ri steng du kha bas bkab 'dug pas gzhi nas mdang nub gangs babs pa'i rkyen gyis da nang rlung 'tshub ldang ba gsal por shes byung /zhogs zas kyi sngon la mu mthud le nyin gyi dngos gtso smra ba dang nyams myong dgag rgyag smra ba'i gsung rtsom klog pa yin/ nyin re'i gros rim gyi bkod sgrig nang phyi dro'i chu tshod dang por tā la'i dang paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyi mjal 'phrad yin zhes bkod 'dug nyin gung gi kha lag tshar ba'i rjes drung yig khru'u nas yang brda tho 'byor te phyi dro'i chu tshod dang po zhes pa de ni bod kyi dus tshod yin pas pe cin gyi dus tshod ni chu tshod gsum pa tag tag la red ces gsung gi 'dugamajal 'phrad gnang sa ni nor bu gling khar yin pas/ de ni tā la'i bla ma'i dbyar kha'i bzhugs gnas yin zhing / ming du dbyar kha'i pho brang yang zer gyi 'dug pho brang de ni bzhugs bab shin tu spro ba'i gling kha'i ldum ra zhig red/ dpyid dpal rab tu bzhad pa'i dus su gling kha'i nang kham bu'i me tog gang sar bzhad cing lcang lcug g.yu mdog can du 'gyur ba dang / 'dab chags kyi skad snyan ci rigs sgrogs pas de bas mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig 'dug226

nga yi bsam par de ni mdzes sdug ldan pa'i spyan gzigs ldum ra zhig yin pa las dben pa'i sgrub khang zhig ga la yin snyam pa'i tshor ba byung /mjal 'phrad gnang sa'i mgron khang du slebs pa'i rjes rang gi ‘‘'jig rten pa'i ’’ myong tshor der gzhi nas 'gyur ba thebs byung / mjal 'phrad gnang sa'i mgron khang ni chos khang gi nang du bkod sgrig gnang 'dugadabus su ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par dang / zhogs g.yas g.yon gnyis la sku 'dra sgrig gshom dang zhal thang spus legs bkal ba/ phyogs bzhi'i gyang ldebs su chos lugs kyi nang don ldan pa'i ldeb ris dang mtha' 'khor la ston pa'i ldebs ris kyis brgyan pa dang / mdun gyi ka ba gru bzhi ma dag la gos chen gyi thums dang ka 'phan gyis brgyan 'dug de'i nang slebs skabs zhi 'jam la rngam brjid ldan pa'i snang ba zhig ster gyi 'dug bshad srol ltar na lha khang de tsho'i nang rgyun du bud med phyin chog gi med pa red zer gyi 'dug 'on kyang de ring ni bud med sku tshab 'ga' shas mnyam du slebs yod pa ma zad da dung bud med blo mthun wu'u 'a/na gyi mngal du phru gu yang 'khor yod rung dwangs gtsang gi lha khang 'di'i nang slebs yod pa red/ de ni bsgyur bcos chen po zhig min zhes bshad na ga la 'grig byas tsang de dang de 'dra ba'i rjes lus kyi yul srol goms gshis mang po zhig ga ler mngon min gyi khrod du bsgyur bcos thub nges red/mjal 'phrad kyi go rim ni sku tshab tshogs mi rnams sngon la chos khang de'i nang sgugs sdod dgos pa dang / de nas tshogs gtso dang tshogs gtso sku gzhon gyi phebs rogs 'og tā la'i dang paṇa chen phebs skabs tshang ma yar langs nas thal mo brdab ste dga' bsu zhu ba dang / de nas tshang ma mar bsdad nas lhing 'jags pa'i rjes sku tshab tshogs mi re re bzhin gcig mjug gnyis 227

mthud kyis tā la'i dang paṇa chen la phan tshun mjal dar 'bul res byed dgos kyi yod pa dang / bod rigs sku tshab tsho ni bod rigs rang nyid kyi lugs srol ltar sku phyag kyang 'bul gyi 'dug mjal dar phul ba dang dus mtshungs phyag gtong res dang 'brel ngo sprod zhu dgos kyi 'dug de dag tshang ma mjug sgril ba'i rjes tā la'i dang paṇa chen so sos gsung bshad gnang ba dang / de nas phan tshun spyir btang gi gleng mol dang bcas khyon bsdoms chu tshod gcig dang phyed ka tsam 'gor song /zla ba 4pa'i ches 21nyin/ gza' spen pa/zhogs par sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso dang tshogs gtso sku gzhon nas bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba dang tshogs mi tsho der zhugs dgos don mi 'dug ngas nyin phyed kyi dus tshod bed spyad de li khran zhang dang / kra'o tshun zhin rnam gnyis la gsung bshad kyi zin bris bzo bcos rgyag rogs byas pa yin/phyi dro chu tshod bzhi par tā la'i bla mas nor gling ‘‘skal bzang bde 'khyil du ri’sku tshab tshogs pa yongs la sne len gsol tshigs btang gnang song / pho brang de ni tā la'i bla ma'i gsung chos gnang sa zhig yin 'dug bshad srol la khong nyid lo re'i zla brgyad pa'i zla stod nas 'go tshugs te zla phyed tsam ring der gsung chos gnang gi yod pas dgon sde che khag gi dge bshes dang bla ma che gras tshang ma gsan par phebs kyi yod lugs dang de min rgyun du pho brang der bzhugs kyi yod pa ma red zer gyi 'dugagasol tshigs la phebs mkhan gras su sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs mi phud da dung paṇa chen rin po che dang tā la'i bla ma'i yongs 'dzin gling tshang dang khri 228

byang rin po che/ paṇa chen rin po che'i yongs 'dzin rngul chu rin po che/ de bzhin bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs che khag gzhan yang chab mdo sa khul mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag gi dbu khrid dang krung gung bod kung ud/bod dmag khul khang gi dbu khrid blo mthun bcas yod/nga tsho'i sgrog tse de'i sbyin bdag gi tshul ni bka' blon zur khang dang paṇa chen rin po che'i yab mgon po tshe brtan gnyis red 'dug bod sa gnas srid gzhung 'og la dbang cha chen po bzung mkhan gyi bka' blon mi bzhi yod pa'i khrod nas zur khang ni bka' blon dang po de yin pas khong gis tā la'i sku tshab byas te srid don mtha' dag thag gcod byed kyi 'dug khong gis rgya skad kyang 'grig tsam shes kyi 'dug la gsol tshigs gtong ring gi byed lugs byed stangs la bltas na chab srid kyi nyams myong yang che tsam yod pa'i rtags mtshan 'dug paṇa chen gyi yab ni dgung lo bzhi bcu tsam la son zhing / gal te gzhan gyis ngo sprod ma byas na ha lam paṇa chen gyi gcen po min nam snyam pa zhig 'dugagasol tshigs kyi bar gseng la tā las bzhes rag smon tshig kyang gsungs song bas brjod bya gsal la brjod don lhag bsam dag pa/ mi rnams sems 'gul thebs dgos pa zhig 'dug bshad srol la khong ni snyan ngag mkhas po yod pa red zer gyi 'dug ngos nas snyan ngag shes kyi med rung khong gi byad gzugs spyod tshul la bltas na nyams mtshar po dang dngos nas shes ldan pa zhig 'dra po 'dugazla ba 4pa'i ches 22nyin/ gza' nyi ma/de ring bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su dbu 229

brnyes pa'i 'go 'dzugs tshogs chen gyi nyin mo red/zhogs pa'i nyi zer sa gzhi chen por rab tu 'phros shing skye dngos thams cad sngar bas skyes stobs 'bar ba dang mkha' rlung yang ha cang gtsang ba zhig 'dug bya bye'u yi skad ci gar sgrog pas mi rnams la zab cing rgyas pa'i dus chen gtong bar phebs dgos pa'i mgron brda btang ba dang mtshungs/gsar du bzhengs pa'i lha sa'i tshogs khang chen mo'i rgyal sgo'i mdun la tshon sna 'dra min gyi dar cha rlung gis lhab lhub tu g.yo ba dang / tshogs khang phyi ngos kyi mtha' bskor la dus chen gyi rnam pa mtshon pa'i dar cha sna tshogs btsugs yod la mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang gna' rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rnam pas khengs 'dug tshogs khang gi nang du 'dzul ma thag mi rnams kyis do snang chen po yong ba zhig ni ser skud kyi mtha' lcags btang ba'i par sgrom gsum po ste dbus su ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par chen po zhig dang / ga yas g.yon la tā la'i dang paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyi sku par cung chung ba re bkal 'dugatshogs khang g.yas g.yon gyi gyang ldebs su gzhi dmar po'i steng du ser chus bris pa'i kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang / kru'u zhi sku gzhon kru'u te/ u yon krang li'u hra'o chi/ tsung li kro'u en le bcas kyi gshis tshig sbyar 'dug ma'o kru'u zhis bris gnang ba'i shis tshig la ‘‘bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes par bkra shis bde legs zhu ’zhes dang / kru'u zhi sku gzhon kru'u te'i shis tshig tu ‘‘rgyal gces ring lugs kyi snying stobs dar spel dang mes rgyal gyi rgyal srung sra brtan du gtong dgos ’’zhes pa/ li'u u yon krang gi shis tshig la ‘‘mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la shugs snon dang krung go'i mi rigs khag dbar phan tshun mthun sgril la shugs snon brgyab ste dar rgyas dang bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs 'dzugs skrun byed ched 'bad 230

brtso na hur thag byed dbo/sa ’’zhes pa/ kro'u tsung li'i shis tshig la ‘‘mthun sgril la shugs snon dang / las byed pa gso skyong / dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun bya sa/'ag gong 'phel btang thog bod mi rigs sa khul rang skyong mngon 'gyur yong ched 'bad brtson byed dgos ’’zhes 'khod 'dug tshogs khang gi kru'u zhi stegs bu'i thog tu me tog tshon khra sna tshogs kyi bum pa 'ga' zhig dang shug pa btsugs pa'i bum pa zhig sgrig 'dug kru'u zhi stegs bu'i kha sprod kyi ngos su gzhi dmar po la gser chus bris pa'i ‘‘krung go'i mi rigs khag gi ma thun sgril chen po khri lor brtan par shog ’’ces pa'i rgya bod yig rigs sanyis kyi phred gdang sbyar tshig bkal 'dug bkod pa de dag tshang ma'i thog nas mi rnams la tshogs rwa de brjid chags ldan zhing dga' dga' spro spro'i rnam pas khengs pa'i tshor ba zhig ster gi 'dug tsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi dang /tā la'i/ paṇa chen bcas pa kru'u zhi stegs bu'i mdun gral du bzhugs yod pa de dag las mi rigs khag dang bod mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril/ de bzhin bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mdza' brtse'i mthun sgril dam zab yin pa gsal por mtshon thub/tshogs chen ni rngam brjid che ba'i rgyal glu'i khrod du 'go tshugs shing dang thog tā las tshogs chen 'go tshugs gnang rgyu'i khyab bsgrags dang 'brel 'go 'dzugs gsung bshad kyang gnang song / de'i rjes su tsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi nas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi sku tshab gnang nas bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang la tham ga gnang ba ma zad gsung bshad kyang gnang song / mjug tu glu dbyangs kyi sgra dang thal mo brdabs pa'i sgra'i khrod du dar cha phul gnang ba dang / phyi dro'i chu tshod lnga pa tag tag la tshogs 'du grol song /dgong dro g.yu thog tshogs khang nang zhabs bro'i mtshan tshogs chung ngu zhig spel 231

ba red/zla ba 4pa'i ches 2 2nyin/ gza' zla ba/de nyin ngal gso red/ zhogs pa nga tsho nyo tshong kung sir blta skor la phyin pa yin/ phyi dro chu tshod gnyis par bzhugs khri gling khar bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa'i gsol tshigs la bcar bas gsol tshigs thog tsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi dang / tā la'i/ paṇa chen sogs tshang mas yar bzhengs te rten 'brel gyi bzhes rag bkyag res gnang ba'i rnam pa ha cang 'khrug po byung song bas chu tshod lnga pa tsam la gzhi nas mjug sgril song /dgong dro sku tshab pas phyogs bsdus thog glu gar dang / khrang zhi/ rtsal rtsed sogs kyi 'khrab ston byas nas gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes par rten 'brel zhus pa dang / dgong dro chu tshod bcu gnyis tsam la gzhi nas mtshan tshogs mjug sgril song / gsung basbyo/da zin bris ma tshar ba'i rkyen gyis mtshan mo'i chu tshod bzhi pa bar bris nas sdod dgos byung /zla ba 4pa'i ches 24nyin/ gza' mig dmar/nyin gung chu tshod bcu gnyis la tshogs 'du 'tshogs song bas tā la'i dang paṇa chen gnyis nas snga rjes su snyan sgron gsung bshad gnang ste nye lam lo shas ring gi las kar phyogs bsdoms dang / phyin chad kyi las 'gan dang kha phyogs bton gnang song / de rjes spun zla mi rigs khag gi 'thus mi tshos tshogs chen thog shis tshig klog gnang song / dgong dro chu tshod bzhi par tshogs 'du grol/232

zla ba 4pa'i tshes 25nyin/ gza' lhag pa/nyin gung chu tshod bcu gnyis la tshogs 'du 'go tshugs pa dang / dang thog chab mdo sa khul bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren wang chi rmeng nas lo shas ring gi las don snyan zhu sgrog sbyang gnang / de rjes sku tshab tshogs pa'i khrod kyi dmangs gtso'i tang shog dang mang tshogs tshogs pa'i 'thus mis shis tshig klog phyi dro'i chu tshod bzhi par paṇa chen er te nis gtsug lag khang du rten 'brel gyi gsol ston zhig bshams te krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs par dga' bsu zhus/ gtsug lag khang de lha sa'i bar skor gyi nang yod tsang tā la'i dang paṇa chen mjal kha zhu mkhan mi dmangs mang tshogs dang / bla ma che khag sogs 'tshang kha shig shig byed kyi 'dug pa de'i thog nas khong rnam gnyis bod rigs mi dmangs kyi khrod du mtshan snyan chen po yod pa shes thub/ gtsug lag khang ni lha sa'i dgon pa che ba gsum gyi gras shig yin pas bod rigs tshos rgyun par ‘‘jo khang ’’zhes 'bod kyi 'dug dgon pa de'i cha shas gtso bo ni thang rgyal rabs kyi 'on shing kong jos bzo skrun 'char bkod gnang ba dang /bal bza' khri btsun gyis spyi lo 652lor bzo skrun byas pa zhig red/ bar 'khyam dag ni tā la'i sku phreng bdun pas rgya bskyed du btang gnang ba red 'dug gtsug lag khang gi nye ring gang sa nas yong ba'i chos dad pa rjos lha sar slebs rjes ang dang por mjal bar 'gro sa zhig red/ chos lugs kyi byed sgo che gras tshang ma de gar spel dgos kyi 'dug dgon pa de'i rten gyi gtso bo ni 'on shing kong jos rgya nag nas bsnams phebs pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku 'dra de red/ spyir mang tshogs khrod du bshad srol ltar na sku 'dra de ni 233

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs bzhengs pa zhig yin pa ma zad sangs rgyas sku ngo mas rab gnas gnang ba song tsang ha cang byin can zhig red ces zer gyi 'dug dgon pa'i nang da dung rgya bza' kong jo dang /btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i sku brnyan sgrig yod/ bod rigs spun zla mang po bar 'tshams med par nyin ltar yong nas chos mjal dang / phyag 'tshal skor sbyong dang kha 'don byed pa mthong rgyu 'dug gtsug lag khang gi sgo mdun lcags ri bskor ba'i nang gna' shul 'ga' zhig 'dug ste/ (1)dbon zhang mthun sgril rdo ring ngam thang bod mna' bzhag rdo ring zhes pa 'dug de ni gong ma thang mu'u tsung khrang ching lo gnyis par bzhengs pa zhig red (spyi lo raṭ+wāṃ2lor/) rdo ring gi yi ge'i nang don ni thang bod phyogs gnyis ji srid bar mthun lam yong ba dang / phan tshun btsan 'dzul byed mi chog pa sogs red/ (2)rgya lcang ngam a lce rgya bza'i lcang ma yongs grags su ‘‘jo bo'i dbu sgra ’’zhes brjod/ bshad srol la de ni rgya bza' kong jo rang gis btsugs pa yin 'dug lcang ma de dbon zhang rdo ring gi zur du yod/ ( 2)'brum skyob rdo ring de ni ching chan lung khri lo 50lo'i zla gsum pa (spyi lo 1794lo )skabs der sa khul de gar sman bcos 'phrod bsten rjes lus yin par brten lha 'brum gyi nad na mkhan dag bcos thabs med pa zhig la rtsis kyi yod pas mi shi mkhan mang po byung / ching rgyal rabs kyi bod sdod dpon gyis lha 'brum nad bcos thabs skor la dril bsgrags shugs chen byed ched rdo ring de bzhengs pa red/ rdo ring de gtsug lag khang sgo mdun rgya lcang 'og tu yod kyang lo mang rdar zad du song nas yi ge rnams mi gsal bar gyur 'dugadagong dro bod dmag khul khang gi rig rtsal tshogs pas glu gar 'khrab ston byas nas sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs mi dang de bzhin tshogs chen la zhugs 234

mkhan u yon dang zur zhugs 'thus mi tshor sne len byas song / 'khrab ston le tshan nang mang che ba ni bod rigs kyi glu gar yin pas tshang mas lta 'dod chen po byed kyi 'dug lhag par du bod kyi lha mo dang gna' bo'i zhabs bro nang ma dang / bod kyi dmangs khrod rol cha sogs la mi tshang mas de bas lta rgyur dga' po byed kyi 'dugazla ba 4pa'i tshes 26nyin/ gza' phur bu/de ring mu mthud tshogs chen gyi gtam bshad gnang rgyu red/ dang thog krung gung bod kung ukhru kyi hru'u ci blo mthun krang go hwa nas lo shas ring gi las don snyan zhu sgrog sbyang gnang ba dang / de rjes bka' shag dang / mkhan po gros tshogs thing / de bzhin chab mdo bcings bkrol u yon lhan khang gi dbu khrid nas gtam bshad gnang song / mkhan thing phyogs kyi cis 'jigs med dang paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyi rnam 'gyur ni rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig gyur yin pas yar thon gyi bsam blo mtshon zhing hur brtson ngang bcos bsgyur byed dgos lugs bton pa ma zad mkhan thing khongs gtogs su dang thog tshod lta spel rgyu'i mos mthun yang byas song /kho pa tsho'i hur brtson gyi rnam 'gyur ni yag po zhig red la dgos nges shig kyang red/ rnam 'gyur de rang gis mi gzhan yar thon yong bar skul ma thebs thub/ 'on kyang mkhan thing khyab khongs khrod du bcos bsgyur lag bstar thub dgos na nges par du bod khyon yongs kyi nang khul gyi bsam 'char gcig gyur yin dgos/ de min bod nang khul gyi mthun sgril la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs rgyu red/tshogs chen thog gtam bshad gnang mkhan gras su da dung sa skya dang /235

rnying ma/ bka' brgyud/ dge lugs bcas kyi bla ma 'dug sa skya'i khri chen ni lo bcu gnyis la son pa'i byis pa zhig yin rung de ring gi tshogs 'du'i nang gsung bshad lhug por gnang rgyu 'dug pas dngos gnas las sla po zhig ma red/krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i mi rigs khag gi 'thus mi tshos kyang shis tshig sgrog sbyang gnang song / de'i nang gsham gsal mi rigs khag gi 'thus mi tshud pa ste/ bkra shis dbang phyug (bod rigs/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi hrin krang sku gzhon pa/) kra'o tshun shin (ta'e rigs/ yun nan zhing chen zhi hrong ban nā ta'e rigs rang skyong kro'u yi kro'u krang/) wang go zhing (li rigs/ kong tung zhing chen he nan li rigs me'o rigs rang skyong kro'u yi kro'u krang /) li khrang zhang (ha nyi rigs/ yun nan zhing chen hung he ha nyi rigs rang skyong kro'u yi kru'u zhi/) lan khrang te (ya'o rigs/ kong zhi ku'e zhi krong rigs rang skyong kro'u yi kro'u krang gzhon pa/) sun yun hra'o (rgya rigs/krung dbyang sa gshis zhib 'jug so'o yi so'o krang gzhon pa/ tshan rig tshan pa'i sku tshab/) gus pa nas kyang pa'e rigs kyi sku tshab zhus nas rang mi rigs kyi skad cha'i shis tshig sgrog sbyang byas pa yin/ de ni bcings bkrol thob pa nas bzung rang mi rigs kyi skad nas gtam bshad byed thengs dang po de yin/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og la dngos nas rang mi rigs kyi skad yig bed spyod byed dgos nges shig red/ de min da dung h+phe a chan la li su'u rigs kyi sku tshab byas nas shis tshig sgrog sbyang byed rgyu bkod sgrig byas 'dug kyang khong nyid na ba'i rkyen gyis dngos su sgrog sbyang byed mi thub par yig thog nas shis tshig cig phul song / chab srid u yon than kon san nas bod dmag khul khang gi sku tshab gnang ste shis tshig sgrog sbyang gnang song / mjug tu drung yig 236

chen mo nga phod nas bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi sgrig 'dzugs sgrig srol skor la gsal bshad mdor bsdus gnang ste chu tshod drug dang phyed ka la tshogs 'du mjug sgril song /de ring drung yig khru'u nas tshogs chung gsum la khag bgos pa'i mi sna'i ming tho bkod sgrig byas te mi so so'i bsam 'char bsdu len byas song bas nga ni tshogs chung gsum pa'i nang las bgos brgyab 'dug pas mnga' ris la 'tshams 'drir 'gro rgyu red/ der brten sems nang ha cang dga' po byung /zla ba 4pa'i ches 27nyin/ gza' pa sangs/de ring nas bzung gros tshogs de tshogs chung gros bsdur byed 'go tshugs pa dang sku tshab tshogs pas 'tshams 'dri byed sgo spel rgyu 'go tshugs pa red/ sku tshab tshogs pa hril po tshogs chung gsum la bgos te dgon sde che khag tu 'tshams 'dri gnang bar phebs rgyu red/ tshogs chung gnyis pa'i tsu'u krang wang chi'i zhang (dmangs 'brel gyi sku tshab ) dang / sangs rgyas ye shes (bod rigs/ zi khron zhing chen gyi hreng krang gzhon pa/) tsu'u mi'i khongs su wang go zhin dang / u'u lan/ krang zhi/ li khrang zhang / wu'u cos than/khren tsun ru'u/ 'phrin las/ dkar srung rdo bu/ rdo rje smon mgon/ cwa khru'u ling / yan shing rmin/ kru'u te ho/ wu'u rmin ping dang nga rang bcas mi bcu gsum yod/ rdo rje smon mgon dang / cwa khu'u ling / wu'u rmin ping bcas gzugs po yag po med pa'i rkyen gyis 'gro rgyu ma byung ba red/'tshams 'dri nyin gsum gyi bkod sgrig byas pa las de ring ni 'bras spungs dgon par 'gro rgyu red/ 'bras spungs dgon pa ni lha sa'i nub phyogs hwa li nyi shu tsam gyi ri 'debs su chags 'dug dgon pa de ni tsong kha pa'i 237

slob ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas min rgyal rabs kyi thog ma'i lo (spyi lo 1416lor )bzhengs pa zhig red/ dgon pa'i nang grwa tshang che ba bzhi yod pa ste/ blo gsal gling dang / sgo mang / bde yangs/ sngags pa bcas red/dgon sde'i nang grwa pa mi grangs 7700lhag tsam yod pa'i bod kyi grags can gyi dgon gnas gras shig yin/ lo ltar lha sa smon lam che mo'i skabs kyi dge bskos de 'bras spungs dgon pa nas gtong dgos kyi yod/ 'bras spungs kyi grwa tshang ni dgon pa gzhan gyi grwa tshang las skad grags che ba yod pa red/nga tsho zhogs pa'i chu tshod bcu par thon pa dang / rlangs 'khor ri gsham du 'byor skabs phebs bsu'i ru sgrig lam g.yas g.yon la sgug nas bsdad 'dug pas rlangs 'khor gzab sbreng ru khag gi dkyil nas bskyod de mthar rgyas sgo'i mdun du rlangs 'khor las bab ste dgon pa'i bla ma che khag dang lag pa gtong res dang phan tshun mjal dar 'bul res byas pa yin/ dgon pa de ri 'debs su chags yod par brten ri 'dzegs dgos pas dka' ngal byung /de nyin gnam gshis kyang tsha ba chen po 'dug pas lam thag thung ngu zhig la'ang ngal gso thengs gnyis brgyab pa'i rjes gzhi nas dgon pa'i nang du slebs tsam byung / der snga sa nas ngal gso rgyag sa zhig gra sgrig byas tshar 'dugangal gso phran tsam brgyab rjes bod rigs blo mthun tshos tshang ma'i tshab byas te mchod thigs rgyag par phyin song / (bod rigs kyi dgon pa'i nang spyir mar gyis mchod me phul gyi yod/) nga tsho chos mjal la 'gro ba'i skabs grwa pa yongs rdzogs 'du khang nang tshogs 'tshog pa'i sgang red/ de nas zhal lag btang song ste mi rer bod ja phor pa gang dang rtsam pa phor pa gang re sprad song bas khong tsho'i 'tsho ba ni ha cang stabs bde zhig red/nyin gung chu tshod dang po dang phyed kar nga tshor dgon pa nas kha lag 238

btang song / de rjes las don mi sna khagre/ gcig nas grwa par sku 'gyed rgyag par phyin pa (grwa pa rer 'gyed nā yang gsum re gnang ba ) ma zad mi rer ma'o kru'u zhis tā la'i dang paṇa chen la mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i sku par re sprad/tshogs mi yongs dang las don mi sna khag gcig grwa tshang bzhi por blta skor du bskyod/ grwa tshang rer slebs dus nga tshos kho pa tshor phyag rtags dang mjal dar phul bas kho tsho ha cang dga' po byas te nga tshor sne len gzab rgyas byas pa ma zad tshang mas ma'o kru'u zhi dang rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tshos nga tshor thugs khur gnang bar bka' drin che zhu rgyu dang / mes rgyal mthun sgril chen po yong ba dang mes rgyal gyi spyi tshogres ring lugs 'dzugs skrun rgyal kha'i ngang legs grub yong ba'i ched nga tshos smon lam gang yong 'debs kyi yin zhes zer gyi 'dugazla ba 4pa'i tshes 2rdonyin/ gza' spen pa/de ring rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang lcags po rir 'tshams 'drir bskyod pa yin/zhogs pa chu tshod bcu par thon rjes sngon la rnam rgyal grwa tshang la bskyod pas de ni rtse pho brang gi nang du 'dug rtse pho brang ni tā la'i bzhugs gnas yin pas de ni dang thog srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus su dmar po ri'i steng bzhengs pa'i pho brang zhig yin zhing tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs su rgya bskyed du btang / de rjes tā la'i sku phreng rim byon gyi dus su bzo bcos brgyab pa zhig red/ pho brang der thog brtsegs bcu gsum yod pa dang / ri'i steng du chags yod pas brjid nyams shin tu ldan pa zhig 'dug pho brang nang tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa'i gser gdung dang / de bzhin sku 'dra dang ldeb ris 'dra min 239

sna tshogs ha cang mang po 'dug rnam rgyal grwa tshang bzhengs nas da bar lo ngo sum brgya bcu bzhi tsam 'das 'dug de'i nang grwa pa mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa tshang ma ched mngags tā la'i bla ma'i ched du zhabs rim gnang mkhan red/ der da dung tā las gsung chos gnang skabs kyi bzhugs khri yang 'dug pas bshad srol la skabs re tā las tshogs 'don dbu bzhugs su phebs kyi yod pa 'dra/ kha sang nang bzhin nga tshos 'tshams 'dri'i phyag rtags dang sku 'gyid sogs phul tshar rjes mchod khang dang / gser gdung bcas la lta skor du phyin pa yin/ bzo skrun gyi phyi'i bkod pa dang / las grwa/mdzes bzo gang gi thad nas bltas na'ang rtse pho brang de'i thog nas bod kyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi chu tshad gcig bsdus su mngon thub kyi 'dugapho brang gi yang thog la 'dzeg ste blta dus lcang gseb kyi khrod du gnas pa'i lha sa grong khyer de mig gi mdun du lham mer mthong thub la dwangs gtsang lha sa'i skyid chu de lho phyogs kyi ri gsham nas nub phyogs su rgyugs 'gro ba'ang gsal por mthong thub/ de thams cad lag bris ri mo dang 'dra bar lta bas mi ngom pa zhig 'dug pas yud tsam la lus kyi ngal ba yang gting brjed du 'gro gi 'dug gal te bod de 'dzam gling gi yang rtse red zer na lha sa ni 'dzam gling yang rtse'i steng gi me tog ldum ra zhig rang red/ pho brang gi yang thog nas mar bab rjes btsan po srong btsan sgam po dang rgya bza' kong jo'i sku brnyan/ de bzhin tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i mdzad pa'i webs ris ji ma ji bzhin bkod par lta skor byas pa yin/rtse pho brang la lta skor tshar ba'i rjes nga tsho lcags po rir lta skor la song ba dang / de ni rtse pho brang gi nub ngos su gnas yod/ tsong kha pa dang khong gi slob ma tshos ser 'bras dga' gsum phyag btab pa'i skabs grub thob thang 240

stong rgyal pos dgon pa de lcags po ri'i steng du phyag btab bo/ dgon pa de'i nang grwa pa mi grangs bdun bcu lhag tsam 'dug pa kho tshos bod sman yang bzo gi 'dug lo rgyus thog thang stong rgyal pos bod kyi sa phyogs gang sar zam pa mang po rgyab yod par brten da bar bod kyi gru kha khag nas lo ltar dgon pa der bca' khral nges gtan zhig 'jal dgos kyi 'dug bshad srol la lcags po ri dang rtse pho brang gnas sa'i dmar po ri gnyis de snga gcig tu 'brel yod rung rgyu rkyen nga/bang gis ri khag gnyis su gyes te de nas yang gyes mtshams 'brel ba'i slad mchod rten gsum bzhengs yod par grags/lcags po rir 'tshams 'dri dang sku 'gyed kyi las ka mjug sgril rjes nga tsho dang mnyam du lta skor la bskyod mkhan rtse drung gis nga tsho khong gi nang la ngal gso bar skad btang byung / khong gi gzim khang ni lcags po ri'i ri gsham du yod cing / rgya khyon chen po mi 'dug kyang khang pa'i bkod pa dang nang chas tshang ma spus legs sha stag 'dug pas de'i thog nas khong gi 'tsho ba yag po yod pa shes rtogs thub/zla ba 4pa'i ches 29nyin/ gza' nyi ma/de ring ni ngal gso yin pas shin hwa dpe tshong khang nas deb gnyis nyo bar phyin/ deb gcig ni en khe se'i (h+phe 'ar pa hā dang 'jar man gyi gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i mjug sdom 〉zhes pa dang / gzhan zhig ni si tā lin gyi 〈srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs sam yang na spyi tshogs ring lugs yin 〉zhes pa de gnyis yin/dgong dro sku tshab tshogs pas tā la'i dang paṇa chen/ bod sa gnas khag gi rim bzhi yan gyi ser skya dpon rigs dang de bzhin bod rang skyong ljongs gra 241

sgrig u yon lhan khang gi u yon/ krung gung bod kung ud dang bod dmag khul khang gi 'gan khur las byed pa brtas gdan zhu byas/zla ba 4pa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' zla ba/de ring ni bzhi sde dgon dang tshe chog gling la 'tshams 'drir bskyod pa yin/bzhi sde dgon ni lha sa grong khyer nang gi g.yu thog tshogs khang gi (da lta bod kung ud gnas sa ) rgyab phyogs su 'dug de ni tā la'i sku phreng bdun pa'i dus su bzhengs pa zhig yin pas da bar lo 2 2kyalhag tsam phyin yod/dgon pa de'i nang grwa pa grangs 105yod pa de dag gi las 'gan gtso bo ni gtsug lag khang gi sku 'dra do dam byed rgyu red/ kho pa tsho'i 'gan 'khur byed mkhan gyi ming la nor bu zer gyi 'dugatshe chog gling ni lha sa skyid chu'i lho phyogs kyi ri gsham du gnas shing mtha' bzhi lcang mas rab tu bskor nas ha cang kha khu sim po 'dug pas sgom sgrub byed sa'i gnas bzang po zhig dang tsha gdug la g.yol sa'i gnas skyid po zhig red 'duganang la slebs te gdong pa 'khrus tshar ma thag tshogs chen drung yig khru'u yi brda tho 'byor nas sku tshab tshogs pa sa gnas khag gi u yon gyi snyan zhu gsan pa'i tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos 'dug zer/ gtam bshad byas pa'i gnas tshul la bltas tshe bod sa gnas nang khul gyi 'thab rtsod ha cang rno ngar chen po 'dug 'thab rtsod gtso bo ni bcos bsgyur gyi gnad don skor red/chab mdo sa khul ni bcos bsgyur byas tshar ba zhig yin tsang rnam 'gyur ha cang gsal po 'dug gtsang khul paṇa chen gyis gtso bo gnang ba'i mkhan po thing 242

gi 'go khrid tshang mas hur brtson chen pos bcos bsgyur la srung brtsi byed pa ma zad dang thog tshod lta bya rgyu'i mos mthun yang byed kyi 'dug 'on kyang bka' shag phyogs kyi 'thus mi tshos skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma bshad par rnam 'gyur gang yang bstan gyi mi 'dug gzhan yang dgon sde che gras gsum gyi 'thus mis thad kar bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed pa dang / 'thus mi zhig gi gtam bshad nang ‘‘bcos bsgyur byas pa'i mjug 'bras la bsam gzhigs byed dgos ’zhes bshad song / de 'dra song tsang bsgyur bcos ga dus byed dang gang 'dra byas te bya rgyu'i srid jus la nges par du do snang dang / zhib phra'i las ka mang tsam/ phyogs khag gi bsam 'char gcig mthun yong rgyur brtson len bcas byas na gzhi nas las ka 'go brtsams thub/de min bod nang khul mi mthun pa'i gnas tshul thon nges red/zla ba 5pa'i tshes 1nyin/ gza' mig dmar/de ring ni ‘‘lnga gcig ’’rgyal spyi'i ngal rtsol dus chen red/ dmag dpon khren dbyi mchog nas de ga'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang bod dmag la gzigs zhib gnang song bas sku tshab tshogs pa'i khongs mi yongs dang bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs tshang ma byed sgo der bzhugs yod/zla ba 5pa'i ches 2nyin/ gza' lhag pa/de ring ni bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa'i tshogs chen rgyal kha'i ngang mjug sgril nas gsham gsal gyi don tshan khag gros 'cham byung ba ste/dang po/ tā la'i dang paṇa chen/ chab mdo bcings bkrol u yon lhan 243

khang gi kru'u ren wang chi rming dang / bod dmag khul khang gi si ling blo mthun krang go hwa bcas kyis tshogs chen thog gnang ba'i las don snyan zhu la gros 'cham byung ba/gnyis pa/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi sgrig 'dzugs srol yig la gros 'cham byung ba ma zad kru'u ren u yon tā las rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas bsko bzhag gnang ba'i tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid kyi ming tho khyab bsgrags gnang ba red/tsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi yis gal che'i bka' slob zhib phra gnang /bka' slob kyi nang don gtso bo ni mig snga'i rang rgyal gyi rgyal spyi'i gnas bab dang / de snga'i krung go'i gsar brje'i nyams myong / de bzhin phyin chad rgyal khab nyin bzhin dar rgyas bde skyid ldan pa'i mdun lam/ krung hwa mi rigs khyim tshang chen po'i khrod kyi khongs mi'i ngos nas bshad na rgyal khab la yid ches dang mes rgyal la dga' zhen/ mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril chen por shugs snon rgyag dgos pa bcas kyi skor red/mjug tu/ paṇa chen nas mjug sgril gsung bshad gnang zhing khong gis bod rigs mi dmangs rnams yar rgyas gong 'phel yong bar nges par du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur dang spyi tshogs bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa'i nan bshad gnang song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 2nyin/ gza' phur bu/nyin gung rten 'brel gyi tshogs chen skong 'tshogs byas te spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i ngang nas bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su dbu brnyes par rten 'brel zhus song /244

phyi dro bzhugs khri gling khar tshogs chen mjug sgril gyi gsol ston bshams pa dang / dgong mo sku tshab tshogs pa'i sgyu rtsal 'khrab ston byas song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 5nyin/ gza' spen pa/bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes par rten 'brel zhu ched rta rtsal 'gran bsdur byas song / de ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi dmigs bsal rtsal nus shig red/ dang thog drung 'khor rtsal rgyugs byas shing de yang le'u dang po rta thog nas mda' 'phen dang / le'u gnyis pa rta thog nas me mda' rgyag rgyu/ le'u gsum pa rta thog bstud mar mda' dang me mda' 'phen rgyu bcas so/ de tsho tshang ma tshar rjes mang tshogs kyi 'khrab ston 'go tshugs te kho tshos rta thog nas kha btags sgru ga pa la sogs pa'i rtsed mo sna tshogs rtsed song / kho tsho'i dpa' stobs dang drag rtsal ni hang sangs dgos pa zhig yod rung lus la rgyan gos mi nyung ba zhig yod tsang des rta rtsal 'don rgyur 'gog rkyen thebs kyi 'dugazla ba 5pa'i ches 7nyin/ gza' zla ba/kha sang dgong mo char drag cig bab 'dug pas de ring gi gnam gshis dwangs zhing kha rlung gtsang ma zhig 'dugaphyi dro chu tshod bzhi dang phyed ka tsam la mi rigs khag gi 'thus mi tshos skutshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso dang / tshogs gtso gzhon pa dang lhan du lha sa'i nye 'khor gyi bcings 'grol dmag la 'tshams 'dri byed par bskyod/ dmag dpung de ni cun bco brgyad pa'i khongs thon lnga bcu nga dgu pa de red/ de snga ri 'gog dmag 'khrug dang bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug nang gzi brjid kyi 245

lo rgyus skrun myong yod/ bod la 'byor ba'i rjes dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyi byas rjes dang dpa' bo'i mi sna yang mang po thon myong yod pa red/ lhag par khams bod gzhung lam bzo skrun byed pa'i skabs ‘‘krang phu'u ling pan ’’zhes pa'i sngon thon pan zhig byung ba de rgyal yongs su skad grags chen po 'dugatsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi nas gsung bshad nang kho pa tsho'i dmag dpung gi dpa' bo'i byas rjes dang gzi brjid kyi srol rgyun bzang por bsngags brjod gnang ba phud da dung kho tshor yid gzab byed dgos pa'i don tshan gnyis bton gnang ba ste/ gcig btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi lkog g.yo dang mi ngan gyi gtor bshig la nges par du ga dus yin rung dogs zon chen po byed dgos/gnyis/ bod mi rigs khag dang rim gras khag gi mi dmangs dang mthun sgril dam zab byas te mes rgyal gyi lho nub mtha' mtshams nges par du sra brtan gtong dgos/ 'tshams 'dri mjug sgril rjes da dung kho pa tsho'i nyal khang dang kho tsho rang gis btab pa'i tshal rigs la lta skor byas pa ma zad kho tsho'i lag rtsed spo lo'i 'gran bsdur la yang gzigs song /zla ba 5pa'i ches ram̐nyin/ gza' mig dmar/sku tshab tshogs pas rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang la rten 'brel zhu ba'i byed sgo re zhig mtshams 'jog byas/ sang nyin nas bzung tshogs pa gsum la khag bgos te sa gnas khag la 'tshams 'dri zhu bar 'gro rgyu red/ de ring zhogs pa chu tshod bcu par tshogs gtso khren dbyi sku ngo mas gtso skyong gnang ba'i tshogs mi yongs dang las don mi sna yongs kyi tshogs chen zhig skong 'tshogs gnang song /tshogs 'du'i thog sngon la tshogs gtso gzhon pa krang cin wu'u yis 246

phyogs sdom snyan zhu gnang song / khong gis 'das zin pa'i dus tshod nang nga tshos byas pa'i las kar grub 'bras thob cing tang krung dbyang gi gnang ba'i las 'gan phal che ba legs grub zin yod ces gsungs pa dang / pe cin du sdod ring tang krung dbyang gis nga tshor bod du bskyod rgyu'i las 'gan gtso bo ni rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes par rten 'brel zhu rgyu de yin pa'i mdzub ston gnang yod pas da cha rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa'i tshogs chen zla 5pa'i tshes 2nyin rgyal kha'i ngang mjug sgril zin pa de ni nga tsho'i las 'gan chen po zhig legs grub byung ba red ces gsungs song / rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang ni phyogs gsum gyi thog nas grub yod pa ste/ tā las dbu khrid gnang ba'i bka' shag srid gzhung dang / paṇa chen gyis dbu khrid gnang ba'i mkhan thing / de bzhin chab mdo sa khul bcings bkrol u yon lhan khang dang krung gung bod kung ud bcas so/thog mar nang khul gyi mthun sgril thad gnad don nges gtan lhag yod cing gnad don mang po'i thad phyogs khag gi bsam 'char gcig mthun mi yong ba/lhag par du bcos bsgyur gyi gnad don skor la he bag chen po byung yod/ de min khams lho dang khams byang gi zing 'khrug las mi ngan gyis dkrugs shing rgyab par brten sku tshab tshogs pa bod bskyod kyi lam bar du yongs dus nas dkrog gtam phyogs gzhir khyab ste mi sems dkrug pa'i gnas tshul shin tu dza drag po byung yod/ sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs mi yongs dang las don mi sna yongs kyi 'bad brtson dang tshogs gtso khren dbyi nas tang krung dbyang gi sku tshab gnang ste gsung bshad thengs mang gnang ba/ mi rigs khag gi 'thus mis tshogs chen thog shis tshig sgrog sbyang bcas gnang ba brgyud gzhi nas kho tsho'i de snga'i dogs 'char rim bzhin sel thub pa red/ phyogs khag gi bsam 247

'char gcig gyur byung zhing rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi sgrig 'dzugasasrol yig dang las don snyan zhu gtso che ba 'ga' 'ig la gros 'cham byung ba red/ ma gzhi nga tsho'i las don phyed tsam zhig legs grub byung ba yin na'ang da dung sa gnas khag la bgos nas mu mthud 'tshams 'dri'i las ka bya rgyu bsdad yod/ las ka de 'dra byed pa ni sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bod kyi mi rigs khag dang rim gras khag gi mi sna dang mthun sgril dam zab byed rgyu de red/ der brten phyin chad kyi las don nang do snang byed dgos pa'i gnad don gnyis te/ dang po srid jus kyi gnad don red/ de'ang tang krung dbyang gi mi rigs khag 'dra mnyam dang mthun sgril byed dgos pa dang / de bzhin chos lugs la srung skyob byed dgos pa'i srid jus nges par du mu mthud yang dag pa'i sgo nas lag bstar bya rgyu de yin/ gnyis pa spyod tshul thad la yid gzab bya rgyu'i gnad don red/ de'ang nges par du khengs skyung gzab nan dang nga rgyal 'tshab 'tshub spong ba'i spyod tshul rgyun 'khyongs/ lhag par du sa gnas so so'i tang ud dang / dmag dpung bcas dbar mthun sgril yag po yong rgyur do snang byed dgos la sku tshab tshogs pa nang khul gyi mthun sgril yang mu mthud yag po yong ba byed dgos pa de yin/thon krang gzhon pa krang lags nas da dung phyin chad las ka'i 'char gzhi sgrog sbyang gnang song / sku tshab tshogs pa de tshogs chung gsum du khag bgos byas pa ste/ 1 spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u dang tshogs chung dang po gzhis rtser tshes 9nyin thon dgos pa/ 2 tshogs chung gnyis pa dang spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u gnangs nyin tshes 10nyin chab mdor thon nas mtsho bod gzhung lam brgyud khren tur slebs rjes kha gyes dgos/ 2 tshogs chung gsum pa gnam grur bsdad nas shin cang brgyud mnga' ris su bskyod dgos so/248

tshogs gtso gzhon pa krang lags nas gsung bshad mjug sgril rjes tshogs gtso khren dbyi nas gal che'i bka' slob gnang song / khong gis dang thog nga tsho tshang ma sa gnas khag nas pe cin du gcig bsdus kyis gra sgrig gi las ka byas shing / thon khar ma'o kru'u zhi dang kro'u tsung li'i bka' slob ltar nga tsho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes par rten 'brel zhu rgyu de yin pa/ da cha rten 'brel gyi las 'gan tshang ma mjug sgril ba dang tshang ma lam sang sa gnas khag la byed sgo spel bar 'gro mkhan song tsang de ni gcig bsdus nas khag bgos byas pa zhig red/ khag bgos byas pa'i rjes tshogs chung so sos las 'gan legs grub thub pa byas te lha sar yod pa'i tshogs pa spyi'i grub 'bras rgya bskyed gtong dgos pa ma zad nga tsho tshang mas bya ba legs grub thub pa'i re ba yod/ de 'dra yong dgos na tshang mas 'go khrid kyi bka' la brtsi srung dang / sa cha de ga'i tang srid dmag gi 'go khrid dang len zhu rgyu/ gzhan yang lan kro'u ru khyab bsgrags byas pa'i sgrig srol lam lugs de dag la mu mthud srung brtsi zhu dgos zhes gsungs/nga tsho bod la 'byor ma thag pa'i skabs su gnas tshul ha cang dza drag po yod rung da cha zhi lhod du phyin song / dza drag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni khamasakhyang khul gyi ngo log zing 'khrug byung ba de'i shugs rkyen bod la thebs pas red/ da cha zhi lhod du song yod rung tshogs chung sa gnas khag tu 'gro dus 'gal zla mi yong ba zhig yong mi srid/ zhi lhod du phyin pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni dang thog tang krung dbyang gi mi rigs khag 'dra mnyam gyi srid jus dang /chos lugs rang mos kyi srid jus la srung skyob/ de bzhin zhi ba'i gros mol gyi bcos bsgyur bya thabs bcas la brten nas byung ba red/ de nas khams lho byang khul gyi ngo log zing 'khrug mgyogs myur zhi 'jags thub pa byung ba/249

gzhan yang bod kyi 'go pas krung dbyang gi srid jus shes rtogs thub pa byung nas kho tshos krung dbyang gi sku tshab tshogs par dga' sems 'khol ba'i bsu ba zhus pa red/ da dung gzhan zhig ni lo 'ga' shas ring gi las don brgyud kho tshos gung khran tang dang bcings 'grol dmag ni bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun bya rgyur rogs ram byed par yong ba zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin thub par brten rim gras khag gi mi dmangs tshor nga tsho'i las don mi sna dang bod bskyod dmag dpung gi bag chags bzang po yod stabs kho tshos sku tshab tshogs par dga' bsu zhu gi yod/ mjug tu krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa slebs pa'i rjes las ka mi nyung ba zhig byas pa des kho tshor phan thogs byung nas gnas bab kyang zhi lhod du 'gyur thub pa byung yod/sku tshab tshogs pa ni mi rigs khag las sgrub pa zhig yin pas de ni ha cang gal 'gangs che ba zhig red/ 'di khul du bod mi rigs dang mes rgyal nang sa gnyis rgyun ring 'brel ba chad pa song tsang pe cin srid gzhung ni rgya rigs kyi srid gzhung kho na yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ da res mi rigs khag gi sku tshab nas tshogs chen thog shis tshig sgrog sbyang byas te rten 'brel zhus pa des kho tshor krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab ni mi rigs khag gi khyim tshang chen po zhig yin pa de'i lta ba 'dzugs thub pa byung yod/chab srid thad nga tshos mi rigs chen po'i ring lugs la ngo rgol dang sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs la ngo rgol bya rgyu nan bshad byed dgos pa ma zad mthun sgril byed rgyu yang nan bshad byed dgos/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po las kha bral tshe btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi lag tu thebs nas bran g.yog chags rgyu rang red/mig sngar yongs su thag gcod ma thub pa'i gnad don rigs phyir log 250

slebs rjes bod kung ud dang zhib 'jug byas nas thag gcod thub pa bya rgyu ste/( 1)zog gong gi gnad don/ gang 'dra byas te zog gong brtan po yong ba byas nas khrom ra de rgyal khab kyi khrom ra zhig tu 'gyur bar byed rgyu de gnad don chen po zhig red/ ( 2) mtsho bod dang khams bod gzhung lam gnyis kyi lam bzo'i gnas tshul skor/ de min bod kyi 'dzugs skrun skor gyi gnad don/( 2)chos dad rang mos la srung skyob bya rgyu'i thad da dung las ka byed rgyu yod pa/ bla ma zhig gis chos lugs la srung skyob gnang rgyur nga tshos yid ches yod/da dung grwa pa'i 'tsho ba'i thad thugs khur gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu gi yin zhes bsam 'char 'don gyi yod pas de ni ha cang yag po zhig red/ grwa pa'i 'tsho ba ni dngos 'brel skyo po yon pas nges par du lta rtogs byed dgos/ nga'i bsam 'char la grwa pa re rer lo ltar gyon chas cha tshang gsum re dang / stod thung nang gos gnyis re sprod dgos kyi 'dug kho tshor chos yag po byed du 'jug dgos pa ma zad kho tshos chos lugs la dad pa byed pa dang dus mtshungs gung khran ring lugs la dad pa byed shugs che ru gtong dgos/ chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan yin phyin gung khran ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i nges pa med la gung khran ring lugs la dad pa byed mkhan gyis nang pa'i chos med pa bzo dgos pa'i nges pa yang med/ de gnyis po'i bar mnyam gnas kyi lam bu zhig 'tshol thub nges red/ 'gyed rgyag pa'i skabs grwa pas bshad par gzhigs na/ lo rgyus thog da res sku 'gyed mang shos shig yin pa dang / gong ma'i dus su yin yang da res nang bzhin mar dang 'bras mang po 'di 'dra med pa red ces shod kyi 'dug de'i thog nas kho tsho'i khrod nas mang che ba nga tshor brtsi bkur byed mkhan yin pa shes thub/nga tsho'i khrod nas mi 'ga' res nga tshos bod mi rigs la thugs khur chen 251

po byed kyi yod ces shod mkhan yod/ skad cha de ni ma 'grig pa zhig red/bod mi rigs ni mi rigs khag gi nang nas skyo shos shig red/ der brten nga tshos nges par du thugs khur byed dgos pa zhig yin kyang da dung thugs khur byed rgyu ldang gi med/ nga tsho'i rtsa don ni che bas chung bar thugs khur byed rgyu dang / sngon thon gyis rjes lus la thugs khur byed rgyu de red/ rgya rigs ni sa khams cha rkyen legs shos kyi sa gnas la bca' sdod byas yod pas 'tsho ba yang yag tsam yod/ der brten nges par du spun zla'i mi rigs gzhan la thugs khur byed dgos nges shig red/ mi 'ga' res bod mi rigs kyi rjes lus kyi phyogs de mthong nas kho tshor mthong chung byed kyi yod/ don dngos thog mi rigs 'di ni mdun lam chen po yod pa zhig red/ kho tshor phul byung gi rig gnasasgyu rtsal dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom rig yod pa ma zad mi dmangs rnams ni dka' ngal la 'dzem bag med cing las la brtson pa zhig red/bcos bsgyur ni nges par du byed dgos/ bcos bsgyur byas na gzhi nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro thub/ 'on kyang mig sngar mi 'ga' res ngo rgol byed kyi yod tsang phyogs tshang ma dang gros mol byed dgos/ phyogs tshang mas mos mthun byung rjes gzhi nas bcos bsgyur byed dgos/ bcos bsgyur byed skabs sku drag dang / grwa pa/ zhing bran phyogs gsum kar thugs khur byed dgos pa dang phyogs gsum kar phan 'dogs par byed dgos/ de ni gnad don gyi 'gag rtsa yin/ de ltar ma byas na rnyog gra da dung yong gi red/ sa zhing bcos bsgyur legs 'grub byung tshe bod de spyi tshogs ring lugs la bskyod rgyu'i gnad don stabs bde ru 'gro gi red/ da res nga tsho'i las ka gtso bo ni chab srid thog go skon blo 'gug thub pa byas te/ kho tshos yongs su brtsi bkur thub pa byas nas skrag snang dang dogs 'char spu tsam yang med par bzo dgos/252

thon krang khren dbyi yi bka' slob gnang tshar ba'i rjes thon krang gzhon pa wang h+phung gis da res kyi zhib phra'i las ka'i gra sgrig dang bkod sgrig gnang phyogs thad la 'os 'tsham gyi zhib bsher thengs gcig gnang song / tshogs 'du grol skabs chu tshod bcu gnyis dang phyed ka tsam la slebs 'dug dgong dro bzhugs khri gling khar tshogs mi yongs kyi lhan 'dzoms dgong tshogs shig 'tshogs pa de'ang phan tshun kha gyes kha'i dgong tshogs shig red/ mi mang pos glu gar gyi khrod du phan tshun mngags cha dang smon 'dun/ 'dra par brje res sogs byed cing nam phyed tsam bar dgong tshogs ma grol bar bsdad song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 9nyin/ gza' lhag pa/de ring nas 'go tshugs te le lag tshogs pa'i byed sgo spel 'go tshugs/rig rtsal dang rtsed rtsal tshogs pa tshang ma gzhis rtser khag bgos byas pas zhogs pa snga po nas rdog thon byas/ de min tshogs mi dang las don mi sna tshang ma brel ba'i ngang lam chas bsdu gsog rgyag gi 'dug nad gzhi lci po phog pa'i rkyen gyis nang sar phyir log byed mkhan dang nga tsho le lag gsum pa'i tshogs mi rnams dus tshod gang 'gro gtan 'khel ma byung bar brten 'tshab 'tshub med par bsdad/yun nan zhing chen gyi sku tshab tsho le lag tshogs chung so sor khag bgos kyis sang nyin kha bral mkhan yin stabs tshang ma dgong dro'i kha lag tshar rjes bzhugs khri gling khar dran rten gyi par rgyag par phyin song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 10nyin/ gza' phur bu/spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u dang / le lag tshogs chung dang po dang 253

gnyis pa de ring zhogs pa rdog thon byas song / spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u gzhis rtse dang / le lag tshogs chung dang po rgyal rtse dang gro mo/ le lag tshogs chung gnyis pa chab mdo bcas sa gnas khag la 'tshams 'dri gnang bar bskyod mkhan red/ nga tsho le lag tshogs chung gsum pa'i khongs mi dang nad gcong rgan khog khag gcig mkha' skyod tshod lta'i gnam gru sgug nas bsdad pa yin/ phyi dro chu tshod bzhi par le lag tshogs chung gsum pa'i tshogs gtso blo mthun wang zhin kang gis nga tsho gcig tu bsdus nas tshogs 'du skong tshogs gnang song / tshogs 'du'i thog khong gis dang thog gnas tshul ngo sprod rags tsam gnang don/ mig sngar chu bo 'khyags te nag chu nas mnga' ris su bskyod lam mi bde bar brten spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u nas nga tsho zhin cang brgyud mnga' ris su bskyod rgyu'i gtan 'khel gnang zhing / bskyod phyogs thad thabs shes gnyis yod pa ste/ gcig ni gnam gru mkha' bskyod tshod lta legs grub byung tshe nga tsho gnam gru der bsdad nas lan kro'u phyogs la bskyod rgyu dang /lan kro'u nas gnam grur bsdad de zhin cang gi mtha' mtshams grong khyer khā hre ru bskyod rgyu/ de nas rlangs 'khor la bsdad de mnga' ris su bskyod rgyu/(lam bar du rta bzhon nas da dung lam thag gang 'tsham zhig 'gro dgos nges yin pa red/) gzhan zhig ni mtsho bod gzhung lam brgyud gor mor bskyod nas ci'u jon la 'gro rgyu dang / de nas gnam gru la bsdad de zhin cang du shar bskyod bya rgyu de red/mnga' ris kyi mi 'bor ni khri gcig dang lnga stong nas khri gnyis lhag tsam las med/ 'on kyang sa cha'i rgya khyon shin tu che bas gcig sdud kyis tshogs chen zhig 'tshogs rgyu ha cang khag po red/ der brten khag so sor bgos nas byed sgo spel rgyu kho na las ma 'das/254

der nges par du 'gro dgos pa'i sa gnas gsum yod tsang zla ba bdun pa'i nang la ma gtogs pe cin du 'byor mi thub/ da res mnga' ris su phyin nas nges par du las 'gan gsum sgrub dgos pa ste/ gcig ni ser skya dpon rigs dang rim gras khag gi mi dmangs la 'tshams 'dri zhu rgyu dang / gnyis ni krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la 'tshams 'dri zhu rgyu/ gsum ni mtha' srung dang de min rang byung / spyi tshogs sogs kyi gnas tshul shes rtogs bya rgyu bcas red/khong gis gsungs bshad tshar ba'i rjes tshang mar da dung bsam 'char gang yod bka' 'dri gnang song yang nga tsho tshang mar bsam 'char gang yang 'don rgyu med stabs tshogs 'du mjug sgril song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 11nyin/ gza' pa sangs/zla ba gnyis kyi ring mi brgya phrag kha shas 'tsho ba dang las ka mnyam du byed pa'i brgyud rim nang dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang dus 'das par brten da cha so sor kha gyes pa'i skabs dngos nas 'jam thing thing gi tshor snang zhig yong gi 'dugazhogs zas skabs blo mthun u lan dang bka' mol zhu ba'i nang khong dang sad phu'u lā ye phu'u/ cwa ku ling / cwa kre rmin/ pe h+phung wu sogs blo mthun lnga gzugs gzhi mi bde ba gzhi nas shes byung / spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u yis mtshan mo de rang la 'phral du kho tsho lha sar skyel dgos pa'i thag gcod gnang song / de dag la bltas tshe ma gzhi sa mtho'i thog tu dus yun zla ba gcig tsam gyi sbyong brdar thebs yod rung da dung snang chung spu tsam yang byed rgyu med pa shes byung / lhag don ring min nga tsho mnga' ris su bskyod dgos 255

dus spyi khre drug stong bdun brgya lhag yod pa'i khun lun ri bo brgal dgos pa dang / rtag tu rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre bzhi stong nas lnga stong yod pa'i sar byed sgo spel dgos pas de bas kyang yid gzab byed dgos pa 'dugazla ba 5pa'i ches 14nyin/ gza' zla ba/de ring dog sde glog khang du lta skor la 'gro rgyu red/ zhogs pa chu tshod bcu dang phyed kar thon te rlangs 'khor byang ngos su gang 'tshams bskyod rjes gzhung lam rdzogs nas bye mas gang ba'i lung shur ded de mu mthud mdun bskyod byas par mthar rlangs 'khor 'gro sa med par tshang ma gom pa brgyab nas phyin pa yin/glog khang der slebs pa'i rjes sbyin bdag gis sa cha der mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre sum stong dgu brgya lnga bcu yod pa red ces gsung gi 'dug sbyin bdag gis gzhung las khang nang nga tshor sne len dang sbrags ngal gso rgyag tu bcug byung / gzhung las khang de ni rdo shing las grub pa'i khang pa nyis thog can zhig red/ sa cha de 'dra'i sgang la gzhung las khang de lta bu zhig 'dzugs skrun byed thub pa ni las sla po zhig ma red/ nga tsho glog khang de'i nang 'dzul 'gro ba'i skabs gzhon nu lag rtsal pa de tsho las ka byed bzhin 'dugami de tshos ni dngos gnas bod mi dmangs kyi don du kho pa tsho'i gzhon nu'i lang tsho legs skyes su 'bul ba dang / tha na gces pa'i tshe srog kyang legs skyes su 'bul gyi yod pa red/ja 'thung tshar ba'i rjes 'char 'god mi snas nga tshor glog khang gi gra sgrig gnas tshul ngo sprod gnang byung / khong gis dog sde glog khang ni rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas bod kyi 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag la rogs skyor gnang rgyu'i rnam 256

grangs khag gcig gi gras shig yin pa dang / sa cha der de snga glog 'don sa tshigs shig yod pa thog mar dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bzo skrun byas pa zhig yin/ de'ang las grwa'i spus tshad zhan pa'i dbang gis thengs 'ga' 'phro brlag tu song myong yod/ bcings bkrol btang ba'i rjeyoslar yang glog 'don thub pa byung yang rten gzhi'i sgrig chas rnying pa song tsang rgyun mthud thub pa zhig yong gi med/ de dang dus mtshungs chu rgyugs tshad bed spyod yag po gtong thub med pas glog 'don tshad kyang ldang nges shig med pa red/gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byas pa'i rjes sngar yod kyi rmang gzhi'i thog rgya bskyed gtong rgyu'i thag gcod byas pa red ces gsung gi 'dug dog sde chu yur gyi ring tshad la spyi lī nyi shu yod pa dang chu stod la rgyugs chu le lag khag gsum tsam 'dug de dag gi chu bo'i 'byung khungs ni rgyugs chu dang / chu mig phu chu bcas las grub pas chu bo'i 'bab rgyud la spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma lnga tsam yod la rgyugs tshad ni glog khang gi dgos mkho dang 'tsham zhing / de nas gtong ba'i glog gis lha sa grong khyer khyon la glog zhu 'bar thub pa dang / glog shugs 'phrul 'khor/ de bzhin sa zhing chu 'dren 'phrul 'khor khag gcig bod spyod bya rgyur ldang gi yodarka/ rtsad zhib thig len ru khag gis snga lo zla ba bdun pa dang brgyad par chu bo'i rgyugs tshad dang / sa gshis/ las grwa'i gnas bab bcas la brtag dpyad byas nas thog ma'i 'char 'god cig byas pa red/ 'char 'god de'i nang chu rags dang / yur bu/ lcags mdong / bzo grwa bcas tshud yod/ yur bu'i ring tshad la spyi le gnyis dang chu rags kyi kha zheng la spyi khre nyis brgya lhag tsam/ chu rags kyi mtho tshad mtho shos la spyi khre dgu dang phyed ka dang ring tshad la spyi khre drug dang grangs 257

chung bdun bcas yod/ chu rags kyi nus pa gtso bo ni chu gsog dang chu bo'i rgyugs tshad snyoms sgrig byed rgyu de red/ der 'gag sgo bdun yod pas gcig ni ri gsham gyi sa zhing la chu 'dren ched dang (ha lam mu'u nyis stong tsam/)gzhan zhig ni bye ma 'ded rgyur mkho ba yin pas de'ang chus khyer bsags byas pa'i bye ma ma 'gag pa bya rgyu de red/ de min 'gag sgo lnga po ni chu bo'i rgyugs tshad snyoms sgrig byed ched yin zhing / chu yur gyi mjug tu lcags mdong btsugs pa de bzo grwa'i nang tag tag mthud thub kyi yod/ bzo grwa'i nang du glog gtong 'phrul 'khor gsum sgrig sbyor byas yod pa de re re'i glog gtong tshad ni chan wa nyis brgya nyi shu yin pas khyon bsdoms chan wā drug brgya drug bcu yin pas lo re'i glog gtong tshad ha lam tu'u khri brgya dang bdun cu don brgyad zin gyi 'dug khyon yongs kyi gron dngul ma rtsa sgor khri dgu brgya lhag tsam gtong rgyu yin pas lo mjug la glog gtong thub pa byed rgyu red/ gnas tshul ngo sprod byas tshar ba'i rjes kho tshos nga tsho las yul dngos la sngar yod kyi glog khang der lta skor byed par khrid byung la phyin chad rgya bskyed gtong rgyu'i 'char gzhi yang ngo sprod gnang byung /glog khang la lta skor tshar rjes nga tsho lam zhor la dwangs khrag rims 'gog bzo grwa der lta skor byas pa yin/ bzo grwa de ni ched mngags phyugs nad 'gog bcos byed pa zhig red 'dugazla ba 5pa'i ches 15nyin/ gza' mig dmar/nyin gang sku drag gnyis kyi khyim tshang la lta skor phyin pa yin/zhogs pa phreng ring gi gzim shag la phyin pa yin/ nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor gzim shag de'i sgo 'gram du kha bkag dus dang thog mthong ba ni sgo'i phyi'i thang 258
