chen thog gi rta drel de tsho red/ rta drel gyi grangs 'bor thog nas khyim tshang de tshong don rgya che zhig gnyer gyi yod pa shes thub/rgyal sgor 'dzul ma thag de ga'i goms srol ltar dang thog lcam chung nas mgron por sne len gnang zhing khong gis nga tsho mi re re dang phyag gtong res gnang rjes nga tsho sgo ra'i nang sne khrid byas byung / sgo ra'i nang bod kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i khang pa gru bzhi nar mo zhig 'dug khang pa'i phyi'i bzo lta ni spyir btang gi mi ser khang pa dang khyad par chen po mi 'dug la rgya phibs kyang mi 'dug rgyu cha ni rdo shing las grub pa zhig red/ 'on kyang khra ma'i shel sgo dang khra yol spus dag bcas 'dug khang pa'i mdun phyogs su spang dang me tog ldum ra/ mtha' bzhi ru lcang ma dang sbyar pas bskor yod pa de dag dro skyid kyi nyi 'od 'og ljang thing nger gnas 'dug spang ljongs kyi steng gur dka' po zhig rgyab pa'i nang gdan bting ba dang / sgrog tse rkub stegs/ mngar zas/rtsed chas sogs sgrig gshom byas 'dug de ni sbyin bdag gis nga tshor sne len zhu sa red/ rgyun mkho'i snod chas mang po zhig la bltas na khyim tshang de phyi rgyal dang 'brel ba yod pa shes thub/sbyin bdag gi bu rgan pa dang bu mo gnyis rgya gar gyi slob grwar 'gro myong 'dug pas dbyin skad yag po rgyag gi 'dug nga tsho'i tshogs mi sku zhabs ling han tā a me ri khar slob sbyong la 'gro myong yod tsang kho tsho gsum dbyin skad thog nas skad cha shod res byas song /bod kyi lugs srol ltar mgron pos ja thengs gsum btung na gus bkur che shos yin pa mtshon gyi yod/ nga tshos ja btung tshar ba'i rjes sbyin bdag la kho tsho'i gzim khang la lta skor bya rgyu'i re ba bton pas sbyin bdag gi sne khrid 'og kho tsho'i mchod khang dang gzim chung khag la lta skor byas pa yin/259

mchodakhang nang gi sku 'dra dang mchod chas tshang ma gser dngul las grub pa song tsang tshon mdangs rnam par bkra zhing bkod mdzes rngam brjid ldan pa zhig 'dug lta skor tshar rjes yang bskyar gur nang du log nas ngal gso brgyab pa yin/ sbyin bdag nas nga tshor nyin gung zas sgo nga bag leb dang ja mngar mo gra sgrig byas 'dug nyin gung kha lag bzas rjes nga tshos sbyin bdag la 'tshams rtags 'bul ba dang mnyam du par yang brgyab rjes dgongs pa zhus pa yin/phyi dro chu tshod gsum pa tsam la tsha rong gzim shag la lta skor du phyin pa yin/ tsha rong ni bod du skad grags yod pa'i sku drag khyim tshang che gras shig yin pas khyim tshang de'i sgo ra ni phreng ring khyim tshang las rgya che zhing khor yug gi bkod pa'ang mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig 'dug g.yu mdog can gyi lcang sdong dang / 'dab chags kyi skad snyan sna tshogs/ me tog gi dri zhim sogs ldang bas mi rnams dpyid ka'i pang du blo dga' yid tshim thub kyi yod/sbyin bdag ngo ma gzhung don sgrub par phebs dgos byung 'dug pas lcam chung nas nga tshor sne len gnang byung / khong ni bka' mol gsungs skabs zhal gsang po zhig 'dug pas dngos nas rgya sgrung du 'khod pa'i spyan gzigs ldum ra'i nang gi mdzes ma wang zhi'i h+phung dang 'dra po 'dug nga tsho phyi dro'i chu tshod drug pa bar bsdad rjes gzhi nas dgongs pa zhus pa yin/sku drag khyim tshang de gnyis kyi 'tsho bar bltas na dngos nas bde skyid kyi longs spyod rang red/ de dang bsdur na mi ser gyi 'tsho ba ni ha cang skyo po zhig yin/ de gnyis bar lha yul dang dmyal ba lta bu'i khyad par yode/ gal te gsar brje ma byas pa yin na thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel ga la gtong thub/260

mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos ga la gtong thub/ yin na'ang gsar brje byas na sku drag tsho dang gros mol gang legs mi byed thabs med yin/ kho tsho mang che ba'i mos mthun byung rjes gzhi nas bcos bsgyur bde blag ngang spel thub kyi yod/zla ba 5pa'i ches 17nyin/ gza' phur bu/kha sang ngal gso yag po ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis de ring zhogs zas tshar rjes ngal dub tog tsam 'dug de ring dmigs bsal gyi las ka med pas blo mthun cin hra'o dbying khong tsho'i sar sdod par phyin pa yin/ der bod kyi gral rim 'brel ba'i skor gyi yig cha zhig mthong byung bas yig cha de gzhir bzhag bod kyi gral rim mi 'bor gyi sdur tshad ni gsham gsal/ zhing pas brgya cha 6rkyadang / 'brog pas brgya cha 20 grwa pas brgya cha 5 sku drag dang lag shes bzo las mi snas brgya cha 15bcas zin gyi yod/ sa zhing dbang ba'i gnas tshul ni/ 1 srid gzhung la dbang ba'i sa zhing ni mang shos yin zhing ming thog la sa zhing yod tshad srid gzhung la dbang ba dang sa zhing rang mos kyis nyo tshong byed mi chog pa zhig red/ 2 sku drag tsho'i sa zhing ni srid gzhung nas kho pa tshor sprad pa zhig yin pas de'ang nyo tshong byed mi chog gal te sbyin pa gtong ba dang yang na gzhan la sprod dgos byung tshe nges par du srid gzhung gi chog mchan dgos/ sku drag gis lkog rngan zas na srid gzhung nas sa zhing gzhung bzhes gtong gi yod/ 'on kyang don dngos thog mig sngar sku drag 'ga' zhig gis g.yo bzung dang / btsan bzung / phan tshun nyo tshong sogs bya thabs sna tshogs la brten nas sa zhing rang khongs su dbang gi yod/ de'ang tshong las ma rtsa'i shugs rkyen 'og sa zhing yang rnam pa 'gyur ba'i nyo tshong gi 261

'go tshugs pa red/ 2 dgon sder yang sa zhing 'bor chen dbang yod/4 zhing par dbang ba'i sa zhing ni shin tu nyung ba zhig yin/ dud tshang 'ga' rer son khal kha shas las med kyang sku drag gi khyim tshang gcig la son khal khri bcu grangs bzung yod pa red/spyir na/ bod kyi spyi tshogs ni mnga' bdag zhing bran lam lugs bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs zhig red/ zhing bran bdag po dang zhing bran gnyis ni spyi tshogs de'i nang gi kha gtad du gyur pa'i gral rim chen po gnyis yin pa de ni spyi tshogs de grub par byed pa'i gral rim gtso che shos gnyis red/'on kyang mi 'bor brgya cha 10las ma zin pa'i sku grags kyis sa zhing rmo zhing bsdoms grangs kyi brgya cha 90zin pa dang / mi 'bor brgya cha 〈0zin pa'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs dang de min ngal rtsol mi dmangs la sa zhing brgya cha brgya cha 10yas mas las zin med/ sku drag dang grwa pa'i rim gras kyis ches gdug rtsub che ba'i sgo nas bshu gzhog gtong thabs la brten te rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs dang de min ngal rtsol mi dmangs tsho'i ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu btsir len byas nas mi yul gyi longs spyod ldan pa'i 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod/ zhing 'brog mang tshogs ni dus rtag tu ngal rtsol byas rung grod pa mi rgyag pas thon skyed gong 'phel 'gro thabs ga la yod/ da dung chos lugs kyi sbrid sman dang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul/ lo rgyus rim byung nang gi log spyod dbang bsgyur pa'i mi rigs chen po'i ring lugs kyi brnyas bcos bcas pa de dag ni bod 'di rgyun ring rjes lus rang sor gnas pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo de red/mig sngar btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul phyir 'bud btang zin pa dang log spyod dbang bsgyur gral rim yang mgo rting slog zin tsang 262

'gag rtsa'i gnad don ni bod mi nigs nang khul gyi dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bya rgyu de red/ de'ang mnga' bdag bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin la dbang ba'i sa zhing lam lugs de rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs la dbang ba'i sa zhing lam lugs su bsgyur rgyu red/ de ni ma gzhi gral rim gyi gnad don zhig yin rung gnad don de thag gcod byed dgos na nges par du dang thog mi rigs kyi gnad don thog nas 'go 'dzugs dgos pa ste mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod thub na gral rim gyi 'gal zla rang bzhin gyis 'bur du thon rgyu rang red/'gag rtsa de dam bzung byas na gnad don thag gcod bya rgyu las sla po zhig yin/zla ba 5pa'i ches 19nyin/ gza' spen pa/zhogs pa'i chu tshod bcu par nga tsho sdod gnas nas thon te lha sa'i zhing las tshod lta'i ra bar lta skor la phyin pa yin/ rlangs 'khor thog spyi le bco lnga'i sar bskyod pa'i rjes gzhi nas sa cha der slebs byung /zhing ra de ni nor bu gling kha'i lho nub ngos dang / lha sa skyid chu'i byang ngos su 'dug mtha' 'khor gyi sa gshis mthong tshe khul de bye thang yin pa shes thub/ da cha bye thang gi dbus su sngo ljang can gyi rgya mtsho bzhin gang sar rgya lcang dang / nas/ gro/ sngo tshal sna tshogs sogs kyis khengs 'dug zhing ra'i sne len khang nang nga tshos kha zas za gin du de ga'i 'go khrid blo mthun la zhing ra'i gnas tshul bcar 'dri zhus pa yin/ krung dbyang grong gseb las don pu'u yi blo mthun cing hra'o dbying gis dang thog zhing ra'i 'go khrid nas nga tshor gnas tshul ngo sprod gnang rgyu dang de rjes las yul dngos la lta skor 'gro rgyu'i re ba bton gnang song / de mur khrang krang gzhon pa hu'u 263

lags nas gnas tshul ngo sprod gnang ba ste/thog mar zhing ra 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i brgyud rim dang / zhing ra gnas sa'i de snga'i ming la nor bstod gling kha zer zhing de ni sa stong zhig yin/1rdzo51lo nas 1952lo'i skabs bod bskyod dmag dpung dang las don mi sna'i sngo tshal dang za 'bru rang mkho rang thon bya rgyu'i gnad don thag gcod thub ched sa gnas srid gzhung gis las byed pa khag gcig btang nas sa der ‘‘bdun gcig mi’zhing ra 'dzugs rgyur sa stong gsar sbol byas nas thon skyed byed 'go tshugs/ thog mar las byed pa mi 'dang bas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis tshan rig las don ru khag nang dus thung 'dzin grwa zhig gnyer te dmag khongs nas las bsgyur byas pa'i blo mthun khag gcig dang / chab mdo/ gzhi rtse/ lha sa sogs sa gnas kyi bod rigs blo mthun khag gcig sgrig 'dzugs kyis kho tshor dus thung sbyong brdar byed du bcug de nas khag gcig chab mdo dang gzhis rtser btang ba dang / khag gcig 'di gar rang 'jags las ka byed du bcug pa red/ 1952lor kho tshos nyal khang dang / drod khang /tshal zhing sogs 'dzugs skrun byed 'go tshugs pa dang / 1954lo nas bzung zhib 'jug dang tshod lta bya rgyur mkho ba'i sgrig chas dang dpe deb sogs nyo sgrub byas/ da lo zhib 'jug las don khyab khongs mu mthud rgya bskyed du gtong ched sgor khri gsum yas mas kyi sgrig chas mngags nyo byas pa red/gnyis pa las ka'i gnas tshul ngo sprod rags bsdus/ 1952lor zhing ra btsugs rjes rtsa ba'i las don ni sa gnas khag nas tshal rigs dang 'bru rigs 'debs son nang 'dren bya rgyu red/ byang shar dang / hwa pe/ nub byang khul so so nas nang 'dren byas pa'i son rigs brgya cha rdo0sa de gar skyed 'tshar bzang po byung ba ma zad de dag las phyed ka lhag tsam zhig gi thon 264

'bab ni nang 'dren byed sa'i sa cha las brgal thub pa byung yod/ dper na/dpyid gro'i thon 'bab mu'u re nas rgya ma 70rkyanas shrī00bar dang / dgun gro'i thon 'bor mu'u re nas rgya ma 〈rkya0nas 90kyabar thon pa/ rgya sran mu'u re nas thon 'bab rgya ma ra00nas 900bar dang / la phug mu'u re'i thon 'bab rgya ma 17000 lan hwa pad tshal dang zhog khog mu'u re nas thon 'bab rgya ma 15000yan bcas zin gyi yod/ tshal rigs kyi ljid tshad la mtshon na kro ma kru gcig la rgya ma 1 12dang / la phug gcig la rgya ma 2razhog khog gcig la rgya ma 2 2 ha rmi kwa gcig la rgya ma 5yas mas/ so ma ra tsa'i ring tshad khre tse khatsam bcas zin gyi yod pa bcas so/de lta bu'i sa mtho'i khul la skye dngos 'tshar longs yag po byung ba dang tha na 'ga' re nang sa las kyang thon 'bab legs pa yong don gang yin skor khrang krang gzhon pa hu'u lags nas dbye zhib gnang bar/ 1 sa cha 'di gar nyi 'od phog yun ring bas skye dngos rigs 'tshar skyed legs pa/ lhag par du nyi 'od la brten na legs pa'i skye dngos de bas 'tshar skyed legs po yong thub/2 sa rgyu bye ma yin pas chu sim tshad dang chu 'bud tshad legs pa/ 2 chu'i 'byungakhungs phun sum tshogs po yod tsang char chu kho nar brten mi dgos pa/4 tshan rig la brten nas 'debs 'dzugs byed pa dang lud mang po brgyab pa bcas so/ na ning nas 'go tshugs te lo tog khag la phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi gso skyong bya thabs skor zhib 'jug byas pa dang / da lo zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i rnam grangs sngar las kyang phar snon byung yod/ shi'i kwa dang hwa rmi kwa gnyis ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog 'debs myong med pa zhig yin rung da cha tshod 'debs legs grub byung yod/ phyi rgyal gyi rgyus spel mkhas can mi chu'u ling gi gzhung lugs la gzhigs na shi'i kwa dang nan kwa 'brel sbyor byas tshe nan kwa yi 265

rtsa bas 'tsho bcud len pa de shi'i kwa 'tshar skyed bya rgyur mkho bas de dag gi skyed tshad dus tshod ni de snga las gsum cha gcig gi myur ba dang / re re'i ljid tshad la ha lam rgya ma 7nas rdobar zin gyi yod pa red/zhing ra thog mar 'dzugs pa'i skabs khyon bsdoms rmo zhing mu'u 50kyatsam yod rung dngos su bed spyod thub pa'i sa zhing mu'u rdo2las med/1kha55lo'i lo mjug la zhing ra rgya bskyed btang rjes 'phrul chas bed spyad nas 'debs kyi yod/ da cha 'drud 'then 'khor lo gnyis yod pa dang da dung kha gnyis gshol lcags dang kha lnga'i gshol lcags/ shal sgor sogs kyi 'phrul chas yod pa red/ mig sngar spyi'i rmo zhing rgya khyon mu'u 2000zin pa tshang mar lo tog 'debs 'dzugs byed kyi yod/bod kyi gnas tshul dmigs bsal song tsang / zhing ra'i las don skor na ning gzhi nas mang tshogs kyi khrod du khrom bsgrags byas pa red/ sa cha 'di de snga bye stong yin pas mtho rim mi sna dang mang tshogs tshang mas gang yang skyes mi thub pa'i sa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod stabs gsar sbol byed 'dod med/ zhing ra'i lo tog khag dang sngo tshal khag la lo legs byung ba'i rjes mi tshos gzhi nas de sngon gyi lta ba bsgyur thub pa byung ste mang tshogs rang mos kyis zhing rar yong nas son rtsa mkho sprod yong ba'i re ba 'don gyi yod/zhing ras ched mngags cha rkyen phran tsam legs pa'i dud tshang gnyis bdams te kho tshor son mkho sprod byas pa ma zad las byed mi sna btang nas gza' 'khor rer lag rtsal mdzub khrid thengs re byed kyi yod pa red/ ston bsdu'i skabs dud tshang de gnyis la lo legs byung bas sa cha 'di ga'i son rigs dang bsdur na gro brgya cha 25thon 'phar byung ba red/ zhing ras nye 'khor gyi zhing pa rnams sgrig 'dzugs kyis lta skor la khrid pas khyim tshang 20tsam nas kho tshor 266

rogs ram yong ba'i re ba bton pa red/ da lo yang cha rkyen 'tsham pa'i dud tshang lnga bdams nas kho tshor gro son mkho sprod byas pa dang / de'i nang nas dud tshang gnyis la shi'i kwa dang hwa rmi kwa 'debs rgyu'i son sprad pa red/ zhing ras da lo'i dpyid kar yang drod khang gsar pa zhig rgyab pa red/gsum pa lhag pa'i gnad don skor/ 1 gtso bo las byed mi sna mi 'dang ba/ lhag par lag rtsal mi sna nyung ba/ 2 rang byung gnod 'tshe tshabs che ba dang sgrig chas mi 'dang ba/ lo ltar zla ba bdun pa nas bcu gcig pa'i bar rlungs shugs che skabs rim pa 7nas rdobar slebs kyi yod pas skye dngos la gnod 'tshe phog sla po yod/ ser ba'i gnod 'tshe lo ltar nyung shos la thengs gnyis tsam yong gi yod pa/ 'bu'i gnod 'tshe/ dar rtse mdo nas gzhis rtse bar bse sbur ljang nag gi gnod 'tshe shin tu tshabs che bas skabs re lo tog gi rtsa bar 'bu de rigs bzhi lnga tsam 'khyud kyi yod/ 'bu des lo tog gi rtsa ba zos pas 'tshar skyed yong dka' bas zhing ra'i blo mthun nas mtshan gang 'bu de lag pas 'dzin gyi yod/ skabs re 'dzin thengs re la rgya ma 400tsam zin zhing / de ltar zla phyed tsam mtshan 'khyong gis bzung rung sgrig chas zhan pa'i rkyen gyis dka' ngal chen po 'dug 2 sa 'di drod grang mi snyoms pa dang nyin mtshan gyi drod tshad khyad par tu'u 20tsam yod pas lo tog 'tshar skyed la shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod pa bcas so/da lo rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas bod la rogs skyor 'dzugs skrun gyi rnam grangs che ba bdun yod pa de dag la ma dngul sgor khri 27rkyazin gyi yod/ chu yur bzo ched sgor khri 270dang / 'phrul chas nyo ched sgor khri ra0 zhib 'jug dang tshod lta bya rgyu'i dpyad chas nyo ched sgor khri 20bcas red/ gnas tshul ngo sprod tshar ba'i rjes nga tsho mu mthud zhing nang du lta skor la phyin pas ngo 267

sprod byas pa bzhin lo tog khag ha cang yag po skyed 'dug pu'u krang ling han tā nas lha sa khyon yongs la 'di dang 'dra bar shing tog dang sngo tshal/ lcang ma la sogs pa'i skye dngos btab ste sngo ljang can la 'gyub thub pa byung na ha cang legs po yong rgyu red/ nga yi bsam par mi ring bar re 'dun de dag mngon 'gyur yong nges red bsam gyi 'dug ces gsungs song /lta skor byas rjes tshogs gtso gzhon pa kung than ming gis tshang ma'i sku tshab gnang nas zhing ra'i gtso bo'i 'go khrid la 'tshams 'dri dang bcas thugs rje che zhes zhus gnang song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 21nyin/ gza' zla ba/zhogs par char pa sim sim babs shing mtha' 'khor gyi ri rtser smug pas sgrib pa dang / lhag pa sil sil ldang bas me tog gi dri zhim sna tshogs phyogs mtshams gang sar khyab bzhin 'dug ma gzhi dbyar dus yin rung dpyid ka dang 'dra ba'i grang ngar slebs pa 'di ni sa mtho'i gnam gshis kyi khyad chos rang red/chu tshod bcu pa'i g.yas g.yon la tshogs mi yongs rdzogs kung ud du 'dzoms nas tshogs 'du tshogs song / tshogs 'du ni tshogs gtso gzhon pa krang cing wu'u dang wang h+phung rnam gnyis kyis gtso skyong gnang ba dang / tshogs 'du'i thog gnad don gnyis la zhib 'jug byas pa las gcig ni las 'gan legs grub byung ba'i tshogs mi rnams gang 'dra byas te phyir log bya rgyu'i skor la 'gro lam khag gsum yod de/ 1 gnam grur bsdad nas 'gro rgyu/ 2 mtsho bod gzhung lam brgyud nas 'gro rgyu/ 2 khams bod gzhung lam brgyud nas 'gro rgyu/ gros bsdur byas pa'i 'bras bur blo mthun mang che bas khams bod 268

gzhung lam brgyud de 'gro rgyur mos mthun byung song / gnyis pa ni khag bgos nas byed sgo spel ring las don gyi gnas tshul phan tshun snyan seng zhu res byas pa ma zad lhag bsdad pa'i gnad don la bsam 'char dang skyon brjod kyang byas song /le lag tshogs chung gsum pa mnga' ris la bskyod rgyu'i dus tshod da dung thag gcod byas med par nga dang blo mthun 'ga' zhig bsam 'char yod rung de ring tshogs 'du 'di'i thog la shod rtsis med/ yin na'ang blo mthun we rmin gyis nga'i ming bton nas nga la bsam 'char bshad rgyu yod pa red ces zer song bas ngas ma bshad rang bshad red/nga'i bsam 'char ni ha cang stabs bde po zhig yin te mnga' ris la sems thag gtsang bcad kyis 'gro rgyu ma zad da dung mgyogs nas myur du 'gro thub pa bya rgyu de yin/ blo mthun krang cin wu'u nas mnga' ris la nges par du 'gro rgyu red ces gsungs song bas nga tsho 'dir bzhugs tshogs mi tshang ma dga' spro chen po byung /tshogs 'du grol grabs byed skabs khren dbyi sku ngo ma tshogs 'dur phebs nas bka' slob gnang song bas tshang mas kha khu sin por nyan nas bsdad/ khong gis dang thog mnga' ris la nges par du 'gro dgos gsungs pa dang nga tsho'i rnam 'gyur la rgyab skyor bstod bsngags gnang song / de rjes bod skor gyi gnad don 'ga' zhig gsung song ba ste/ dang po/ bcos bsgyur gyi gnad don thad khong gis da res nga tsho'i grub 'bras che shos ni bod kyi bcos bsgyur thad cha rkyen skrun thub pa byung yod/ rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa'i tshogs chen thog dang lha sa gzhis rtse tshang mar nga tshos bcos bsgyur skor mang po bshad pa dang / blo khog chen pos bshad pa/269

gting zab kyis bshad pa bcas byas yod pas de sngon bcos bsgyur ni bya ba ngan pa zhig yin pa'i skrag snang gi bsam pa de med pa bzo thub pa byung / da cha bod kyi sku drag tshos kyang bcos bsgyur skor shod kyi yod pa red/ mkhan po thing gi 'gan 'khur dpon rigs dang / bka' shag srid gzhung gi zur khang la sogs pa/ da dung dgon sde khag gi bla ma che khag tshang mas bcos bsgyur skor shod kyi yod/ khams lho'i don rkyen ni de snga bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed ched langs pa zhig red/ da cha 'di'i shugs rkyen thebs pa'i dbang gis da cha 'gyur ldog byung ste bcos bsgyur skor shod kyi yod pa dang bcos bsgyur la srung brtsi zhu gi yod/rgya bod mi rigs kyi 'brel ba'i ngo bo bcos bsgyur gyi gnad don de yin/nga khren dbyi dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i 'brel ba/ mi rigs khag dang rgya rigs dbar gyi 'brel ba/ dmangs gtso tang shog dang gung khran tang dbar gyi 'brel ba bcas yag po yong dgos don gang yin zer na de ni tshang ma'i 'tsho ba legs bcos gtong thub pa'i thabs shes yod pa'i rkyen gyis red/ gal te spyi tshogs ring lugs de med pa yin na mi rigs khag dbar dang / rgya rigs nang khul dbar/ dmangs gtso tang shog khag dang gung khran tang dbar bcas la phan tshun gyi brtse sems de chags mi srid/ der brten bcos bsgyur des rgya bod mi rigs dbar mthun sgril yong thub la bod mi rigs nang khul gyi 'brel ba'ang yag po yong thub/ mkhan thing nas bcos bsgyur skor la zhib phra'i bya thabs bton yod pas thabs shes de tshos sku drag tshor lta rtogs ha cang yag po byas yod rung kho pa tshos zhing par bsam shes phran bu byas yod pas de yag po red la yar thon zhig kyang red/ nga tshos 'di gar bcos bsgyur bya thabs thad nang sa dang 'dra ba'i re ba 'don mi rung zhes gsungs song /270

gnyis pa/ chos lugs kyi gnad don skor la khong gis chos dad rang mos la brtsi srung bya dgos pa dang / rang gi dmigs tshad de 'khyer nas mi gzhan la tshad bsdur bya rgyu med par mi gzhan gyi dad par brtsi bkur byed dgos/ chos dad med mkhan la'ang rang mos kyi dbang cha yod/ chos dad pas u tshugs kyis chos dad med mkhan tshor chos byed dgos zer na mi 'grig la chos dad pa de tshor yang nga tsho'i da lta'i dus rabs dang 'tsham pa byas te spyi tshogs ring lugs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu'i slob gso gtong dgos/ de 'dra byas pa yin na nga tsho dang grwa pa yongs su mthun sgril byas te thun mong thog spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed thub ces gsungs/khong gis da dung mar khe si dang en ke si gnyis kyi de snga chos lugs la skyon brjod tsha nan gnang ba de ni 'grig pa zhig red la dgos nges shig kyang red/ skabs de dus kyi chos lugs ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mi dmangs rnams rmongs su 'jug rgyu'i lag cha zhig tu rtsis kyi yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin/deng sang gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thad gcig mtshungs ma yin pas nga tshos de ltar byas nas chos lugs la ngo rgol byas na mi 'grig par nga tshos kho tsho dang mnyam las byed dgos/ nang pa'i chos rang la mi 'dang ba'i cha mang po yod pas khag gcig bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa 'dug dper na grwa pa'i 'tsho ba ha cang skyo po yin tsang legs bcos byed dgos/ de 'dra ma byas na lhag bsam zol med kyi sgo nas chos yag po zhig byed thub pa khag po red/ nang pa'i chos lugs kyi snying po dang spyi tshogs ring lugs/ 'dzam gling zhi bder srung skyob bya rgyu/ mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu bcas phyogs mang po'i thad nas gcig gyur yin pas phyogs de 'don spel byed dgos/nang pa'i dgon pa'i phyi ngos kyi 'dzugs skrun ha cang yag po 'dug271

gzi mdangs rnam par 'tsher zhing las sla po min pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig red 'dug pas deb thog bkod nas dril bsgrags byas chog 'on kyang nang log tu gcig nas btsog la gnyis nas dri ngan ldang ba dang / dkar cha ye nas med pa'i mun nag lta bu zhig 'dug de tsho bsgyur bcos byas na mi 'grig pa ga la yong / glog bzhu ni mar me las gsal ba yod/ go thos ltar na mtsho sngon gyi sku 'bum dgon pa'i mar brgya cha rdo0mchod me 'bul gyi yod pas mi la za rgyu med pa red ces zer gyi 'dug nges par du de dag bsgyur bcos byas te mar brgya cha rdo0grwa par ster dgos pa dang brgya cha 20mchod me phul na 'grig chos lugs la brtsi bkur bya rgyu de 'grig pa red/ 'on kyang brtsi bkur ji ltar byed dgos sam/ de ni mi la mgo bskor gtong byed cig ma yin/ gzhis rtser sku drag cig gis bshad pa ltar rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams chos la dad pa byed pa las sku drag khag gcig gis dad pa byed kyi med ces zer gyi 'dugade'i thog nas dad pa byed mi byed ni mi sger gyi gnad don zhig yin pa gsal po red/gsum pa/ bod rigs nang khul dbar mthun sgril gyi gnad don skor/khong gis bod rigs nang khul la 'gal ba shugs che tsam yod pa rtsa ba'i cha nas bshad na de ni sku drag lam lugs kyis bzos pa zhig red ces gsungs/bod kyi sku drag lam lugs ni khrun chi'u kran go'i dus rabs dang gcig mtshungs yin/ sa cha 'di sku drag gcig la sprad pa dang / sa cha gzhan zhig sku drag gzhan zhig la sprod kyi yod/ sku drag nang rang so so'i zhing bran yongs su bkol spyod byed chog pas dbang sgyur tshogs khag phan tshun rtag tu 'phrog res byed kyi yod/ der brten phan tshun 'khon 'dzin chen po chags kyi yod pa red/da cha thag gcod thub zin pas gtso 'dzin rnam gnyis mthun sgril yag po yod/272

gzhon nu de gnyis po khyim tshang ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi skyes khungs yin pas chung dus 'tsho ba skyo po skyel myong yod pa ma zad khong gnyis ka pe cin la'ang 'gro myong yod/ da dung ma'o kru'u zhi dang kro'u tsung li'i bka' slob kyang gsan myong ba dang / nang sar lta skor skyod myong bas bsam blo ni yar thon red/ de min dpon rigs mang che ba'ang yar thon zhig red/mig sngar bod kyi dbang sgyur tshogs khag nang gi yar thon mi sna rgyun chad med par 'phar snon yong gi yod pas de ni bod nang khul mthun sgril yong ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig red/ gzhan yang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas phyir 'bud btang zin pas btsan rgyal ring lugs pas drag shugs la brten nas bod kyi nang srid la the gtogs dang bod nang khul la rtsod gzhi slong ba bcas byed mi nus shing da cha kho pa tshos mi ngan btang nas lkog tu gsang nyul gyi byed sgo spel rgyu de trem red/de snga bod kyi tshong ra ni btsan rgyal ring lugs pas sger sdem byas shing da cha rim pas 'gyur ldog yong gi yod/ da lo'i dgun dus nas mes rgyal nang sa'i dngos zog gis tshong ra bzung thub/ 'on kyang khyim mtshes rgyal khab dbar gyi 'brel ba la'ang lta rtogs byed dgos pas rgya gar dang bal po nas tshong zog brgya cha 10yas mas nang 'dren byas chog de'ang phyogs gcig nas khyim mtshes rgyal khab dbar gyi 'brel ba yin pa dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas nga tsho'i dgos mkho yang yin pa ma zad tshong zog gi gong tshad kyang nang sa las khe ba yod/bod kyi mthun sgril ni phyogs khag gsum la brten dgos pa ste/ tā la'i dang / paṇa chen/ krang go hwa bcas kyis sku tshab byed pa'i phyogs gsum po de red/ de min da dung chab mdo phyogs khag dang / tshogs khag chung chung so so/273

rgya che'i mi ser bcas yod/ de ni mi 'bor khri 120la mthun sgril bya rgyu'i gnad don zhig yin pas tang gis lo bcu phrag nang phyogs khag la mthun sgril byas pa'i nyams myong dang / krung dbyang srid gzhung gis tang shog khag dang mi rigs khag dbar mthun sgril byas pa'i nyams myong la gzhigs te bcos bsgyur yag po zhig byed thub na rnyog gra thon srid kyi ma red/ 'on kyang gal te yag po zhig ma byung na rnyog gra thon srid/mig sngar bod nang khul du rtsa ba'i cha nas mthun sgril yin pa dang mi mang che ba ni bcos bsgyur skor gleng gi yod/ 'on te da dung mi 'ga' res bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed kyi yod pa dang nang khul gyi 'brel ba'i thad la'ang gnad don lhag bsdad yod/ da res sku tshab tshogs pa gzhis rtser bskyod skabs mi 'ga' zhig gis dkrog gtam bzos te sku tshab tshogs pa gzhis rtser bskyod pa ni bod nang khul kha bral du gtong ba dang / paṇa chen ni rdzun ma red ces zer zhing / khong ni ma'o kru'u zhi'i phru gu gsum pa red ces gang byung du shod kyi yod/go thos ltar na paṇa chen gzhis rtser phebs skabs de sngon khong gi mnga' 'og ser skya dpon rigs de tshos sne len ma byas pa ma zad tha na 'bud shing yang mkho 'don ma byas pas kha lag yang bzo thub kyi med/ de nas paṇa chen khong sku rlung bzhengs te bla ma de tshor bka' bkyon gnang ba dang / bla ma gcig la 'gram lcag kyang zhus gnang ba red/ paṇa chen gyis da dung da res lha sar phebs skabs mi 'ga' res khong gi rlangs 'khor la rdo zhus pa ma zad gtsang gtum pa zhes bshad kyi 'dug ces gsung gi 'dug de ltar phyogs gnyis kas lo bzhi bcu lhag tsam dang 'das pa'i lo brgya phrag kha shas ring 'thab rtsod byed pa'i dmigs yul ni bod kyi srid dbang 'phrog res bya rgyu de yin/der brten da dung gnad don lhag bsdad yod pas ngas kho tshor paṇa 274

chen phyogs khag la nor 'khrul yod na tā la'i dang krang go hwa rnam gnyis nas paṇa chen la gsungs dgos pa dang / paṇa chen nas thad kar phyir thon nas gsung na yag po yod/ tā la'i dang krang go hwa phyogs nas skyon cha nyung tsam brjod pa dang legs cha mang tsam brjod dgos/ de dang 'dra bar tā la'i dang krang go hwa phyogs la'ang skyon cha yod pas khong gnyis rang gis mang tsam shod pa las mi gzhan gyis skyon brjod nyung tsam byed dgos/ phyin chad bcos bsgyur byas nas mthun sgril legs po byung rjes phan tshun skyon brjod byas na 'grig ces zhus song /bzhi pa/ mdo smad brgyud kyi ngo log zing 'khrug skor la khong gis gsung don du gnad don de rtsa ba'i cha nas byas na bod kyi gnad don zhig min rung mdo smad brgyud kyi zing 'khrug des bod la shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/mig sngar gnad don de thag gcod byas zin pa red/ gnad don de lhag dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen mang po yod pa ste/ las byed pas ngang thung 'tshab 'tshub byas drags pa dang / srid jus g.yon thal che ba/ gsang nyul gyis phung dkrug slong ba/ nang sa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs bcos bsgyur gyi shugs rkyen thebs nas mang tshogs rang 'gul ngang yar langs te 'thab rtsod byas pa sogs red/ gzhis rtse'i bcings bkrol grong gsar la lta skor byas rjes mang tshogs kyis dpya khral nyung du gtong rogs zhes re ba zhu gi 'dug sku tshab tshogs pa gzhis rtser slebs rjes sku drag cig gis zhing par las ka skul bas zhing pas ma phyin pa dang / da cha bcings bkrol btang zin pas las ka mang na'ang chu tshod brgyad las byed rgyu med/ da dung gla cha yang sprod dgos zhes bshad song / de'i thog nas mang tshogs kyi re ba ni nyin bzhin mtho ru 'gro gi yod pa mthong thub/ da res mdo smad brgyud la me mda' dang po rgyag mkhan 275

ni yul dpon red/ de ni ma 'grig pa zhig red/ las byed pa phal cher 'tshab 'tshub che drags pa dang mang tshogs kyi re ba phal cher mtho drags pa'i rkyen gyis red/ bsam 'char mi 'dra ba yod tshe skyon brjod dang gsal bshad byas na 'grig me dma' rgyag dgos don gang yin nam/ da res kyi 'thab rtsod de brgyud mdo smad phyogs la de las ldog te bde blag ngang bcos bsgyur byed thub pa byung ba des bod kyi sku drag la slob gso thebs thub pa byung yod/mang tshogs kyis bcos bsgyur bya rgyu'i re ba bton pa de ni 'grig pa zhig red/phal cher sku drag nyung shas shig la lta rtog bya rgyu mi 'dang ba yod srid/ 'on kyang sku drag khag gcig ni log spyod pa yin pas de tsho tshang ma dbye mtshams gsal por 'byed dgos/khyed tsho khams bod gzhung lam brgyud de log dgos dus lam zhor du las ka 'ga' re byed dgos/ sa bdag tshor bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed rgyu med pa'i slob gso rgyag dgos pa dang / zhing par rogs ram byas nas kho tsho'i bcos bsgyur gyi bya bar rgyab skyor byed dgos pa ma zad byed phyogs thabs lam skor shod dgos zhes gsungs song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 22nyin/ gza' mig dmar/zhogs par thon krang gzhon pa krang cing wu'u nas tshogs 'du skong 'tshogs gnang ste le lag tshogs chung gsum pa'i blo mthun yongs la gsung bshad gnang / khong gis gnad don bzhi'i thad gsungs pa ste/dang po/ mnga' ris la bskyod dgos pa'i don snying / mnga' ris ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 42rkya0lhag tsam yod pa dang gnam gshis kyang ha cang grang bas sa mtho'i steng gi sa mtho yin/ der sa ma 'brog gi khul 276

yin zhing mi 'bor 27000lhag tsam yod/ mnga' ris kyi dmag dpung ni bskyod snga shos dang dka' ngal che shos shig red/ 'on kyang kho tshos dpa' ngar ldan la dka' spyad sdug rus chen pos las ka rgyun 'khyongs byed kyi yod/ sa gnas kyi las ka'ang ha cang legs po sgrub kyi yod pa red/ dmag dpung la yan lag ru khag gcig yod pa de rang so sos thon skyed byed dgos pas las 'gan ha cang ljid po yod/ 1950lo'i dgun dus su rta dmag lan gcig bskyod pas mi rta phyed lhag tsam grongs pa red/ da cha khor yug gang sar de snga las yag tu phyin yod par brten le lag tshogs chung gsum pa sgrig 'dzugs byas nas mnga' ris la bskyod rgyu de ni krung dbyang dang bod kung ud kyi shugs rkyen rgya che ru gtong ched red/ gal te da res ma phyin na dmag dpung gi bsam 'char yong nges yin pas de ni dka' tshegs che ba'i chab srid kyi las 'gan zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed dgos/ mnga' ris la phyin pa tsam gyis bod bskyod dmag dpung dang las don mi snar sems 'gul chen po thebs nges yin stabs ma phyin na mi 'grig pa zhig red/ ma'o kru'u zhis gsungs par khyed tsho ma phyin na btsan rgyal ring lugs pa 'gro 'dod yod/ dbyin jis bod la lo bcu phrag kha shas tshong gnyer byed myong yod pa red/gnyis pa/ las 'gan gtso bo/ 1 spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas bod bskyod dmag dpung dang las don mi sna/ de bzhin rgya che'i mang tshogs tshor 'tshams 'dri zhus te kho pa tsho sems lhod po'i ngang las don sgrub rgyur skul ma gtong ba las kho tsho'i las kar skyon med skyon 'tshol byed mi nyan pa ma zad kho tsho'i bsam 'char nyan 'jog byed dgos/ 2 mang tshogs la rgyal gces ring lugs kyi slob gso rgyag dgos pa dang krung dbyang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus dril bsgrags byed dgos/ 2 mnga' ris kyi dmag 277

dpung dang kung ud la mtha' mtshams dang / spyi tshogs/ tshong don sogs kyi thad gnas tshul shes rtogs thub rgyur rogs ram byed dgos/gsum pa/ las don byed phyogs/ khengs skyung gzab nan bya rgyu dang /legs cha mang tsam brjod pa las skyon cha mi brjod pa dang skyon brjod byed mi nyan/bzhi pa/ 'go khrid rtsa 'dzugs/ le lag tshogs chung gsum pa nas srid 'dzin thog thon u yon lhan khang dang / tang nang tang tshogs chung zhig sgrig 'dzugs byed dgos/ tang nang dmangs gtso gcig sdud kyi lam lugs lag bstar dang / gtso bo phan tshun rogs ram byed dgos la rang skyon rang brjod kyi snying stobs kyang dgos/ gal te rang skyon rang brjod ma byas na mi gzhan la skyon brjod bya rgyu'i dbang cha med pas las don gyi ched du mthun sgril legs po byed dgos zhes gsungs song /zhogs par chu tshod brgyad dang phyed kar zhogs zas tshar rjes nga dang blo mthun hre pang kre/ wang ro'o han rnam gnyis lha sa zam chen bar tshogs gtso gzhon pa kung than rming dang bcas tshogs mi bcu drug nang sar phyir log byed par phebs skyel du phyin pa yin/ phebs skyel zhu mkhan gras su da dung bod tang srid dmag gi dbu khrid blo mthun dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi ser skya dpon rigs/ sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso krang go hwa dang tshogs gtso gzhon pa wang h+phung / de bzhin bod bskyod las don mi sna/ gzhon nu sde tshogs/ bud med tshogs pa bcas kyi 'thus mi 'dug phyi dro lha sa grong khyer las rigs khag gi mi snas ‘‘bod zhi bas bcings bkrol bya thabs skor gyi gros mthun ’’la mtshan rtags bkod nas lo lnga 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba'i tshogs chen la zhugs pa yin/278

zla ba nipa'i ches 24nyin/ gza' phur bu/de ring ni bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga yin pas bod mi dmangs kyi gal che'i dus chen zhig red/ de nyin lha sa'i bod rigs mi dmangs rnams gzab mchor gyis brgyan te rtse bskor la phyin rjes rdzong rgyab klu khang du 'dzoms nas gling kha gtong ba dang / ko gru gtong ba/ gzhas zhabs bro rgyag pa sogs dga' spro'i rnam par rol bzhin 'dug krung dbyang 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i blo mthun tshang ma byed sgo der zhugs song /dus chen de'i 'byung khungs ni lung wang than yin zhing bod skad du ‘‘klu khang ’’zhes zer/ bshad srol la tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs rtse pho brang bzhengs dus da lta klu khang yod sa nas sa blangs pas de'i shul du rdzing bu zhig chags/ rjes su rdzing bu de'i dbus su klu khang zhig brgyab pa ni da lta'i klu khang 'di yin/ thang rgyal rabs kyi thog ma'i lor srong btsan sgam pos blon po mgar stong btsan khrang an du a lce rgya bza' bsu bar btang / skabs der lha sa'i mang tshogs tshos grong khyer byang shar ngos kyi smon grol zam pa'i nye 'gram du mgar stong btsan phebs skyel zhu bar phyin/ de nas bzung lo ltar sa cha der 'dzoms nas dran gso'i ched gling kha gtong srol yod pa de/ klu khang bzhengs pa'i rjes klu khang la spos nas klu khang nang gling kha gtong srol chags pa'o zla ba 5pa'i tshes 26nyin/ gza' spen pa/sku tshab tshogs pa bod la slebs nas byed sgo'i las 'gan rtsa ba'i cha nas legs grub zin pas nyin shas nang sku tshab tshogs pa'i khongs mi yongs rdzogs 279

lha sa nas kha gyes rgyu red/ nyin gung tā las nor bu gling khar gsol ston bshams nas nga tshor dga' skyel gnang song /dgong dro bod kung ud kyis lha sa tshogs khang chen mor rgya che'i zhabs bro'i 'du tshogs shig skong 'tshogs byas te nga tshor phebs skyel zhus byung /zla ba 5pa'i ches 27nyin/ gza' nyi ma/zhogs par char pa sim sim zhig babs pas gnam gshis ha cang sil po 'dugaspyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u nas nga tsho sang nyin mnga' ris su bskyod rgyur thag gcod gnang bas zhogs pa'i ring sdog chas rgyab nas bsdad pa yin/phyi dro bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang nas lha sa tshogs khang chen mor gsol ston bshams te sku tshab tshogs pa'i blo mthun yongs la phebs skyel zhus song / dgong dro sku tshab tshogs pa'i rig rtsal las don ru khag gis zhal gyes kyi dgong tshogs 'tshogs nas glu gar sogs 'khrab ston gnang ste ser skya dpon rigs la sne len zhus pa red/ khren dbyi dang tā la'i rnam gnyis dgong tshogs la phebs pa dang 'khrab ston la gzigs te dga' bsu tshad med gnang zhing dgyes tshor chen po gnang gi 'dug bod kung ud dang bod dmag khul khang gi blo mthun yang dgong tshogs la zhugs yod/zla ba 5pa'i ches 2ranyin/ gza' zla ba/zhogs par nam mkha' sngo zhing dwangs la sprin pa yang med pas de ni bkra shis pa'i nyin mo zhig red/ nga tshos sems bzhin par lha sa nas kha gyes te mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams sa mtho'i steng gi sa mtho mnga' ris kyi phyogs su 280

bskyod pa yin/'grokhar nga tshos tsung li gzhon pa khren dbyi la zhal gyes zhus pas khong gisakhyed tsho'i las 'gan ni dka' tshegs che la gzi brjid ldan pa zhig yin pas khyed tshos dus tshod kyi tshod 'dzin ma khel bar sa der slebs pa byas nas sa cha mang tsam la 'gro thub pa byed dgos/ de ga'i sa cha khag gcig la de snga mi slebs myong med/ khyod tshos krung dbyang gi sku tshab zhus nas 'gro ba yin pas nges par du sa cha mang tsam la 'gro thub pa byed dgos/ de 'dra byung na gzhung sger gang la'ang phan pa yod ces gsungs song /tsung li gzhon pa khren dbyi dang zhal gyes zhus tshar rjes nga tsho slar yang mgron khang du log nas sku tshab dang las don mi sna bcas dang zhal gyes zhus pa yin/ bod sa gnas kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang da dung bod kung ud dang dmag khul khang gi blo mthun tshang ma rtse pho brang gi mdun du gral star sgrig ste nga tshor phebs skyel gnang song / kho tshos nga tshor kha btags sgron gnang ba dang me tog btags gnang ba ma zad nga tsho lam bar bde grol dang las don legs grub yong ba'i smon 'dun zhus gnang byung / nga dang tshogs gtso gzhon pa wang zhin gyis blo mthun tsho'i sku tshab zhus nas khong rnam par mjal dar sgron pa yin/ de ltar nga tshos blo mthun yongs kyi thugs khur dang bod rigs mi dmangs kyi smon 'dun 'khyer nas lam thon byas/lha sa nas thon rjes mtsho bod gzhung lam brgyud de shar bskyod byas pas gzhung lam g.yas g.yon gyi yul ljongs ni nga tsho thog mar bod la yong dus dang bsdur na mi 'dra bar gyur 'dug 'khyags pa rnams yongs su bzhur nas ri rtse'i sgang la kha ba tha thor tsam las mi 'dug nga tsho yong dus zhing nang gi gro dang nas ni myu gu kha 'bud tsam las mi 'dug kyang / da cha ni snye ma thon 'dug281

'gro 'ong byed mkhan gyi rlangs 'khor nyung nyung song tsang lam bar ha cang bde po byung /phyi dro chu tshod drug pa tsam la 'dam gzhung du 'byor byung / de ga'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4200'dug pas mtshan gung drod tshad klad kor 'og gi tu'u kha shas la slebs te lha sa las grang ba 'dug nga tsho gnam gru thang du zhag sdod byas pas der gnam gru 'phur bskyod tshod lta legs grub byung bar brten 'bab thang sgang la gnam gru gsum bzhag 'dug der 'dzam gling thog sa mtho'i sgang la gnam gru 'phur ba'i zin tho gsar pa ('phur bskyod mtho tshad la spyi khre rdo000) zhig gtod yod/ dgong mo gur nang tā dbyi gyon nas nyal bas rkang pa 'khyags te gnyid khug ma byung / gur nang ni sgrog tse'i steng la le mang tho phu'i snyan ngag deb cig mthong byung bas de bltas nas gang 'tshams song rjes gzhi nas gnyid khug byung / de ring lha sa nas 'dam gzhung bar lam bar spyi le 1rdo0tsam bskyod 'dugazla ba 5pa'i ches 29nyin/ gza' mig dmar/kha sang dgong mo gnyid yag po ma khug pa'i khar da rang nam langs ma thag gnam gru mkha' bskyod tshod lta byas song bas de bas gnyid khug thabs bral song / chu tshod bdun dang phyed kar yar langs pas mig pa phran bu na ba las de min gzugs po bde po 'dugaganam gshis grang bas zhogs pa'i nyi ma ni dgun kha'i nyi ma bzhin du dro ba'i tshor snang yong gi 'dug sdog chas rgyab tshar rjes rkub stegs gcig 'khyer yong nas gur phyi'i nyi khrod du en ke se'i 〈h+phe 'ar pā ha' dang 'jar man gyi gna' bo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i mthar thug 〉ces pa klog ste bsdad pa 282

yin/'di ga'i chab srid u yon gyis de ring da dung dmangs spyod gnam gru zhig babs kyi yod pa red zer gyi 'dug yang snying nga tsho gnam gru dang rlangs 'khor gang gi thog bskyod rgyur tshogs gtso the tshom gyis phran bu'i blo mi bde bar gyur/ tshang mas rlangs 'khor thog bsdad nas 'gro rgyur mtha' skyel byas pas spyi khyab pu'u la 'bul rgyu'i snyan seng zhu yig cig bzhag ste gal srid gnam grur sdod rgyu'i gtan 'khel byung tshe lam sang tar yig thog nas brda tho gnang rogs zhus te brda lan 'byor 'phral nga tsho phyir log bya rgyu yin zhes 'khod/zhogs pa'i chu tshod dgu par thon rung lam yag po med stabs rlangs 'khor ha cang dal po gtong dgos byung / phyi dro'i chu tshod bzhi dang skar ma nyi shu tsam la gzhi nas nag chur 'byor nas yan lag kung ud du zhag sdod byas/nag chu ni bod byang thang gi chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi lte gnas shig yin/ der chu bo nag po zhig yod pas yul ming du'ang nag chu zhes btags/bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas 'dir byang spyi bkod gtong byas yod pa dang krung gung bod kung ud kyis le lag kung ud kyang btsugs yod/ grong khyer gyi mtha' 'khor la 'brog pa dud tshang 200lhag tsam dang mi 'bor 1000yas mas shig 'dug pas tshong gnyer las ka dang 'brog las byed kyi 'dug mtsho bodagazhung lam do dam cus kyis kyang der 'grul khang zhig brgyab yod pa ma zad gzhan yang yig zam cus dang / dngul khang / tshong don/ 'phrod bsten/ gnam gshis sogs kyi las khungs kyang btsugs 'dugs cha 'di sa bab mtho zhing rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4400tsam zin gyi yod stabs gnam gshis grang ngar chen po 'dug dgun kha'i drod tshad klad kor 'og gi tu'u 25la slebs kyi yod pas skye dngos 'tshar skyed yong gi med/283

yan lag kung ud kyi hru'u cis gsungs par gzhigs na sa cha de gar rgya rigs phru gu yin phyin skyes nas zla ba gsum ma phyin par shi 'gro gi yod pa dang bod rigs phru gu shi tshad kyang brgya cha 〈0zin gyi yod/ las byed pa mang po zhig sa der slebs nas lo mang phyin rung da dung 'phrod po med pas gnad don de ni yid gzab byed dgos nges shig rang red/ hru'u ci de'ang 1954lor mnga' ris la bskyod myong yod tsang khong gis nga tshor mnga' ris kyi lte gnas sa khul de sa bab 'di las dma' ba dang / gnam gshis kyang 'di las dro ba/rgya lcang mi tshad lon tsam skyes shing dbyar dus sprang ma mang po yod ces gsung gi 'dug pas skad cha de rnams nyan rjes tshang ma sems lhod po byung song /zla ba 5pa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' lhag pa/zhogs pa'i chu tshod brgyad dang phyed ka tsam la rdog thon byas pas phyi dro chu tshod gsum pa tsam la a mdor slebs byung / de gar nyin gung kha lag zas rjes mu mthud lam du bskyod pa yin/nyin phyed tsam ri bo thang lha'i mtha' bskor du bskyod mthar rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 5200lhag tsam yod pa'i la mtho po zhig rgyag dbo/sa shing bgrod lam shin tu dka' bas dgong dro chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la gzhi nas chu tshan rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs su slebs byung / lam bar spyi le 205tsam phyin 'dugachu tshan mdun gyi ri bo de ni rtag tu gangs kyis bkab pa'i thang lha'i rtse mo yin/ skabs der zla ba lnga pa yin rung ri rtse'i steng du da dung kha ba dkar pos yongs su brgyan nas 'dug sa der rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 4900yod pas de ni mtsho bod gzhung lam thog gi rlangs 'khor 'bab 284

tshugs mtho shos de red/ bshad tshul ltar na sa 'dir mi dang skye dngos sogs 'tsho bar las sla po med zer gyi 'dug mtha' bskor gyi gnas tshul la bltas tshe gcig nas mi mthong rgyu med pa dang / gnyis nas nags tshal mthong rgyu med par gang sar ri bo mthon po dang 'khyags rom gyis khengs 'dug 'on kyang gung khran tang dang bcings bkrol dmag slebs pa'i rjes 'dir 'khrug cha dod pa'i rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs zhig chags pas de ring mtshan mor rlangs 'khor bcu grangs kha shas sa der slebs 'dug sa rub pa'i rjes thang chen du glog brnyan bstan nas rlangs 'khor bzo pa dang lam bzo ba tshor 'tshams 'dri byas song / nga tsho zhag sdod byed sa'i so phag khang pa de tsho'i nang lcags kyi nyal khri yang 'dug nga'i bsam par spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bya gzhag mdun bskyod byed pa dang chabs cig sa der yang nyin bzhin dar rgyas yong gi red snyam pa byung /zla ba 5pa'i ches 21nyin/ gza' phur bu/sngon rtsis byas na de ring khru'u ma chu bor 'byor thub pa bya rgyu yin rung rlangs 'khor kha lo pas 'gro lam bde min gyi 'char gzhir 'gyur ba byung ste spyi le 205sar zhag sdod byas pa yin/ lam du thon ma thag rlangs 'khor mgyogs po bskyod dus lam bar skyel 'dren ru khag cig 'phrad nas phan tshun phyir shol yang yang rgyag dgos byung bas dus tshod mang po 'phro brlag phyin song /de rjes yang rtswa thang chen po 'ga' zhig brgyud dgos pas 'gro lam 'dam rdzab nyag nyig dang / yom yom che bas chu tshod gcig nang spyi le bcu lhag tsam las 'gro thub ma byung /phyi dro chu tshod bdun par tho tho rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs su 'byor zhing 285

nga tsho rgyab ma thag pa'i khang pa zhig gi nang bzhag byung bas tshang ma blo yid tshim po byung song / 'dir ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 4500tsam slebs yod pa dang mtha' skor ni yangs sa'i rtswa thang yin zhing rlangs 'khor 'bab tshugs kyi zhog cig nas chu bo zhig rgyugs kyi 'dug pas mkha' rlung gtsang la tshor snang yang skyid po 'dug dgong zas tshar nas nyi ma nub rir zhus mtshams su nga tsho zam pa'i sgang la 'cham 'cham dang sbrags sa mtho'i yul ljongs la lta skor la phyin pa yin/ de ring lam thag spyi le 166phyin 'dugazla ba 6pa'i ches 1nyin/ gza' pa sangs/de ring zhogs pa chu tshod brgyad par langs te thon pa yin/kha sang dgong mo lhags pa brgyab pa dang / de ring char pa ma babs rung lam bar nyin gang gnam 'thib nas nyi ma mthong rgyu mi 'dug tho tho chu bo nas thon pa'i rjes khu nu la brgal ba phud nyin gang mu mtha' med pa'i rtswa thang thog phyin pa yin/ 'on kyang rtswa thang de'i sgang la 'brog pa dang nor lug gang yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug pas gang sar mi med lung stong skyi g.ya' ba zhig 'dug lam bar 'dam rdzab mang po yod stabs nag khri the la slebs dus dgong mo'i chu tshod bcu pa zin tshar 'dug de ring lam thag ni spyi le 25〈las bskyod thub ma byung /zla ba 6pa'i ches 2nyin/ gza' spen pa/zhogs par thon skabs kha ba 'bab bzhin 'dug pas yud tsam song rjes gnam dwangs te nyi ma shar song / khu nu la'i la gsham brgyud lcags zam grol ba dang / chu bo gnyis brgal nas bskyod dus lam bar chu bo dwangs shing 286

sngo ba dang / ri klung mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba zhig 'dug pas mi sems rab tu 'phrog song /e ci li chu bo brgal rjes bye thang zhig gi thog slebs pa der gzhung lam pe cin grong khyer gyi khrang an khrom lam dang 'dra bar dkyus drang la rgya che ba zhig 'dug rlangs 'khor ni snum nag gzhung lam thog tu bskyod pa bzhin chu tshod re re la spyi le 60tsam bskyod thub kyi 'dug tshang mas de dag mthong rjes ma gros gcig mthun gyi sgo nas mtsho bod gzhung lam do dam cus kyi cus krang blo mthun mu'u hran krung la bsngags brjod byas song / gor mor slebs rjes gang sar khang pa mang po zhig 'dzugs skrun byas 'dug pas tshang mas cha rgyus mi lon pa lta bur gyur 'dug pa de'i thog nas mes rgyal gyi spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun de lta bu'i 'phel rgyas mgyogs po yod pa mthong thub/gor mor nyin gung kha lag zas nas nga tsho mu mthud mdun bskyod byas pa yin/ nyin phyed tag tag bye thang thog bskyod pas chu tshod gsum nang spyi le 150lhag tsam bskyod 'dug phyi dro chu tshod lnga dang phyed kar gzhi nas nom mur slebs byung / de sngon nga tsho yar yong dus gzhung lam do dam 'bab tshugs shig yod pa der za khang dang sdod khang 'ga' shas las med rung da cha dngul khang dang / yig zam cus/ dpe tshong khang bcas gsar pa brgyab zin 'dugazla ba 6pa'i ches 2nyin/ gza' nyi ma/zhogs pa'i chu tshod brgyad par nom mur nas thon rjes rdzong cwa dang shu'u ku'u chu bo/ tho tho ri sogs brgyud de zhang re sde la 'byor byung / der rdzong u yon lhan khang 'dug pas kha lag zas pa yin/ shang re sde zhes pa ni de sngon gyi 287

ming yin zhing da cha to lan rdzong zhes zer gyi 'dug rdzong der mi rigs khag bdun tsam yod pa las sog rigs gtso bor byas pa'i da dung bod rigs dang /ha sag khe rigs sogs mi 'bor 17000lhag tsam yod pa dang / sa zhing rgya khyon la spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma khri 2 2tsam 'dug pas kre cang zhing chen gnyis kyi rgya khyon dang mtshungs kyi yod/ de gar sa rgya che la mi nyung bas go thos la krung dbyang gis sa der gzhan nas yul mi spos te gsar sbol bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod pa red zer gyi 'dug der gnam gshis tsha grang snyoms shing chu bo yang ldang nges shig yod par brten skyes dngos sna tshogs 'tshar skyes yong sla po yod pa red/ rdzong yongs 'brog khul dang zhing khul khag gnyis su dbye yod pa dang / grong rdal nye 'gram ni sa ma 'brog red/ rdzong ud kyi hru'u cis nga tshor bcings 'grol ma btang gong lo gsum bstud mar char pa ma babs par nye lam lo shas nang gzhi nas char pa babs pa red ces gsungs kyi 'dug mang tshogs kyis ‘6ma'o kru'u zhi phebs nas gnam gshis kyang 'gyur song ri’zhes bshad kyi yod pa red/ nga'i sems par skad cha de la tshan rig gi rgyu mtshan ldan yod bsam gyi 'dug gang lags she na/ mi mang du song stabs me gtong mkhan mang du phyin nas du ba'ang mang du phyin pa dang / zhing kha'i chu bed gong 'phel song ba/ skye dngos 'debs tshad mang du song ste rang byung gi mkha' rlung snyoms sgrig dang 'gyur ba byung bas char pa babs pa red/ gnas tshul de rigs 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang mnyam du da dung 'gyur ba chen po yong gi red/nga tsho thog mar 'dir kha lag stabs bde zhig zas nas mu mthud mdun bskyod byed rtsis yod mod/ 'on kyang rdzong ud kyi blo mthun tshos sems rtsa 'khol po'i ngang nga tshor sne len gzab rgyas gnang zhing rdzong ud kyi hru'u ci rgan 288

gzhon gnyis dang / bod sog gi rdzong dpon rgan gzhon gnyis/ de bzhin las byed pa mi nyung ba zhig gis nga tshor lta skyong chen po gnang byung/ phyi dro chu tshod gsum par nga tsho mu mthud mdun bskyod byas nas tsha han 'u su'u la slebs/de nas sā le'u gatreng po dang mo'o ho'o sogs brgyud mthar tshwa kha zhes par 'byor byung / de dus nyi ma nub khar nye 'dug de ring lam bar spyi le 271phyin/zla ba 6pa'i ches 4nyin/ gza' zla ba/nam langs ma thag rgyang grags btang song bas de nas gnyid khug thabs mi 'dugayar langs nas kha lag ma btang gong nga tsho tshwa rdzing gi 'gram du lta skor la phyin pa yin/ tshwa kha zhes pa'i ming de'ang tshwa rdzing 'di las thob pa red/ tshwa 'don mkhan bzo pa tshos rdzing bu'i nang nas gsher gzugs kyi tshwa 'don pa dang / chu skam rjes tshwa chags kyi yod pa dang / yang de'i nang gi lhad skyon gtsang sel gyi las snon byas te zhun thig gi tshwa rang thon gyi 'dug tshwa rdzing gi nye 'gram du tshwa'i mdzod khang gcig dang gzhung las khang gcig 'dug de'i mtha' 'khor la tshwa ri 'ga' shas spungs nas sa phyogs gang sar dbor rgyu'i gra sgrig 'dug kho tshos bshad par gzhigs na/ tshwa rdzing yongs kyi bsags tshad ni rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis lo sum cur bed spyod byas chog pa yod zer bas de ni dngos nas rin thang che ba'i nor bu zhig red/de ring zhogs par nga tsho so so za khang la kha lag za bar phyin te chu tshod dgu dang phyed kar rdog thon byas pa yin/ lam bar du chu bo dang ri klung mang po zhig brgyud mthar zi ling la 'byor byung / der slebs rjes gzhi nas tshogs 289

gtso khren dbyi dang bcas pa de ring gnam grur bzhugs nas sa 'dir phebs 'byor zin pa shes byung bas slar yang spyi khyab pu'u yi blo mthun tsho dang mnyam 'dzoms bya rgyu yod par brten tshang ma spro snang chen po byed kyi 'dugazla ba 6pa'i ches 5nyin/ gza' mig dmar/sngar gyi 'char gzhi ltar na spyi khyab pu'u dang lhan du lan kro'u la bskyod rgyu red/ 'on kyang kho tsho de ring zi ling du ngal gso brgyab ste sang zhogs gnam grur bsdad nas lan kro'u la bskyod rgyu byas song / nga tsho ni nges par du lan kro'u la bskyod thub pa byas nas mnga' ris su 'gro rgyu'i gra sgrig las ka byed dgos/ der brten nga tsho de ring rlangasatsho'akhor la bsdad de sngon la 'gro dgos kyi 'dug zhogs zas za ba'i skabs tshogs gtso khren dbyi nas nga tshor mdang dgong kro'u tsung li'i zhal par 'byor byung bas dus tshod lo phyed tsam 'gor rung mnga' ris la nges par du 'gro dgos zhes gsungs kyi 'dug byas tsang khyed tshos sems thag gtsang bcad kyi sgo nas las 'gan legs grub thub pa byed dgos zhes gsungs song /nyin gung rmin hwa rdzong du 'byor nas de gar nga tsho kha lag za rgyu byas rung za khang gi sgo 'gram du rlangs 'khor mang po bzhag 'dug mi yang ha cang mang po 'dug pas nga tsho mu mthud mdun bskyod byed dgos byung / lam zur zhig tu ljon grib yod pa'i sa zhig brnyed na der kha lag stabs bde zhig za dgos bsam byung / 'on kyang zi ling nas thon rjes lam bar ljon grib yod pa'i sa cha skyid po zhig mthong rgyu mi 'dug mthar grong tsho chung chung zhig gi nang ngal gso tog tsam brgyab ste kha lag zas pa yin/ grong tsho 'di'i nang mang che ba ni hu'e rigs red/ lo mang ring gnod 'tshe phog rkyen yul de ga'i mi dmangs kyi 290

'tsho ba ha cang skyo po 'dug phru gu tshang mar gos thung gyon rgyu med la da dung kha shas ni gzugs po gcer bur bsdad 'dug kho tshos nga tsho shing tog dang /bag leb za ba mthong nas tshang ma tshur lta bar yong gi 'dug pas nga tshos kho tsho tshang mar re re tsam sprad pa yin/ 'on kyang mi rgan pa de tshos za ru 'jug gi mi 'dug kho tsho'i bsam par bag leb de tsho phag snum las bkrag pa yin shag byed kyi 'dug pas nga tshos phag snum min pa'i skor 'grel bshad brgyab rjes gzhi nas phru gu tshor za ru bcug song /phyi dro chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la nga tsho lan kro'u ru 'byor byung bas lan kro'u gsol sgron khang du bsdad pa yin/ nga tsho thog mar yar yong skabs de ga'i lcang ma dang me tog sogs kyi yal ga 'bud tsam yin rung da cha ni yongs su sngo ljang can du gyur 'dug de mur nga tshos dgun kha'i gyon chas dag phud nas dbyar chas brjes pa yin/ lan kro'u gsol mgron khang sgo 'gram gi khang pa 'dzugs skrun yang tshar la nye ba 'dug nga tsho'i 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag ni dus tshigs dang 'dra bar nyin bzhin 'gyur ldog 'gro bzhin yod/zla ba 6pa'i ches 6nyin/ gza' lhag pa/zhogs zas tshar rjes le lag tshogs gtso gzhon pas nga tsho tshogs 'du skong 'tshogs byas nas mnga' ris la bskyod rgyu'i gra sgrig las ka'i skor la gros bsdur byas pa yin/ tshogs 'du mjug sgril rjes tshang ma rang so so khrom gzhung la nyo cha rgyag par phyin pa dang phyi dro ngal gso rgyab ste bsdad/zla ba 6pa'i ches 7nyin/ gza' phur bu/tsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi dang lhan du shing lung ri bor spro 'cham la 291

bskyod/shing lung ri bo ni lan kro'u grong khyer dang ha lam spyi le bcu tsam yod pa'i sar 'gro dgos kyi 'dug der ri bo sngo zhing chu mo dwangs bas yul ljongs ni shin tu mdzes po yod stabs dbyar kha tsha yol byed sa'i gnas yag po zhig yin zhing / de 'dra nub byang brgyud la yod pa ni ha cang dkon po red/ khren dbyi ni shang chi'i mig mangs 'gran bsdur la sa/zigs rgyur ha cang mnyes po yod pas zhing chen 'go khrid nas lan kro'u brgyud du skad grags yod pa'i mig mangs mkhas can gdan drangs 'dug nga tsho ri rtser slebs nas ngal gso rgyag skabs mig mangs mkhas can gnyis 'gran bsdur byas song bas nga tsho tshang mas rig pa rtse gcig gis khong gnyis kyi 'gran bsdur la bltas/dran rten gyi ched du ngas khren dbyi nas sku gtso byas pa'i phebs rogs rnams la sku par mi nyung ba zhig sgron pa yin/zla ba 6pa'i ches rdonyin/ gza' pa sangs/de ring nas bzung nga tsho dang spyi khyab pu'u kha khag so sor 'gro dgos/nga tsho ni mnga' ris la 'gro dgos pa dang kho tsho ni pe cin du phyir log phebs mkhan red/ dgong dro sa gnas kyi ming thog nas dgong tshogs 'tshogs te nga tshor dga' skyel byas song /zla ba 6pa'i ches 9nyin/ gza' spen pa/ de ring chu tshod drug par gnam gru 'phur rgyu yin pa'i brda tho kha sa dgong dro nas 'byor byung bas phran yang chu tshod lnga par langs nas thon rgyu'i gra sgrig ang sar byas pa yin/ 'on kyang rdog thon ran khar glo bur du brda tho zhig 292

'byor byung bar zhin cang brgyud kyi gnam gshis yag po med rkyen de ring gnam gru 'phur thub min nges gtan mi 'dug zer bas nga tsho tshang ma sgugs nas bsdad/ mthar chu tshod drug pa yas mas tsam la nga tsho gzhi nas gnam gru thang gi phyogs su bskyod pa yin/ de nas gnam grur bsdad de chu tshod gnyis tsam 'phur rjes cu'u jon du slebs byung / nga tsho gnam gru nas babs 'phral kha lag zas pa dang ngal gso phran bu brgyab rjes mu mthud 'phur bskyod byas/de nas nga tsho ha rmi'i la bde thang ngang 'byor byung / de ni bye thang sa rgyud kyi 'bab thang zhig red/ rgyang ring la bltas tshe lcang grib khrod du gnas pa'i grong tsho 'ga' re mthong gi 'dug de las sa thag ring tsam la bltas tshe than hran ri bo'i steng gi gangs ri'i 'od mdangs 'phros pa las de min gzhan mthong rgyu gang yang mi 'dug gnam gru de than hran ri bo'i ri rgyud ded nas mya ngam thang gi bar snang sgrol rjes pe cin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod bzhi pa yas mas tsam la u rum chir slebs byung /u rum chi ni zhin cang yu gur rigs rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs u yon lhan khang gi gnas yul yin pas de ni bye thang khrod kyi yid du 'ong la dar zhing rgyas pa'i grong khyer che shos de red/ grong khyer nang gi rgya lam kha zheng che la gtsang sbra dod pa/ 'dzugs skrun de tshor mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod la su'u lan gyi bzo skrun khyad chos kyang 'dug grong khyer mtha' 'khor la rgya lcang dang me tog sna tshogs kyis khengs shing de bzhin ra lug sha shed rgyas pa'i 'brog rwa dang / 'bru sna 'dzoms pa'i sa zhing / gzhan yang gsar du skrun pa'i bzo grwa dang / slob grwa/ rig gnas pho brang / zlos gar khang sogs ha cang phun sum tshogs po 'dug de dag las grong khyer de ni gsar du dar ba'i grong khyer zhig yin pa mi rnams la gsal bshad byed thub/293

dgong zas tshar rjes sbyin bdag nas nga tsho zhin cang gi mi rigs glu gar blta bar gdan 'dren gnang byung / zhin cang gi glu gar ni bcings 'grol btang rjes rgyal yongs mi dmangs tshos blta 'dod che shos byed pa'i zlos gar gras shig yin pa ma zad/ phyi rgyal gyi grogs po tshos kyang bsngags brjod chen po byed kyi yod/ nga tshos nyi ma mgyogs tsam bzhud pa'i re ba bcangs yod kyang chu tshod bcu dang phyed kar ma gtogs sa rub ma song / chu tshod bcu gcig la gzhi nas zlos gar 'go tshugs song /'khrab ston le'u mang la nang don ha cang phun sum tshogs po 'dug pa ste/dmangs khrod kyi glu gar dang rol dbyangs/ kher gzhas/ mnyam gzhas sogs glu dang zhabs bro gangatshoyin rung skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar zhing nang don 'tsho ba dngos dang 'tsham pa/ lhag par du mi rigs kyi gyon chas dang rgyan cha la sogs lta bas mi ngom pa shin tu mdzes po zhig 'dug 'khrab ston mjug sgril skabs chu tshod dang po yas mas tsam la slebs 'dugazla ba 6pa'i ches 10nyin/ gza' nyi ma/de ring u rum chir ngal gso nyin gcig brgyab pa yin/zla ba 6pa'i ches 11nyin/ gza' zla ba/de ring gnam grur bsdad nas khā hrer bskyod pas phyi dro chu tshod dang po yas mas tsam la sa der 'byor byung / nan cang dmag khul khang gi si ling yon dang chab srid u yon sogs dbu khrid blo mthun tshang ma nga tsho bsu bar phebs byung / khā hre'i gnam gshis ni u rum chi las tsha ba che ba 'dug kyang si ling pu'u yi sgo rwa'i rgya lcang dang / kham sdong sogs shing sna mang po yod tsang ha 294

cang sil ba'i tshor ba 'dugazla ba 6pa'i ches 17nyin/ gza' nyi ma/sngon gyi 'char gzhi ltar na 'dir ngal gso nyin gnyis gsum tsam brgyab rjes mnga' ris su mu mthud bskyod rgyu red/ 'on kyang 'di nas mnga' ris yan lag ru khag la kha snon bya rgyur dmag gsar bsdus pa de dag nga tsho dang mnyam du thon rgyu byas pas kho tsho da dung sbyong brdar tshar med stabs slar yang nyin gcig sgugs nas sdod dgos byung /zla ba 6pa'i ches 1ranyin/ gza' zla ba/zhogs par rlangs 'khor nang zhugs te lam bar bye thang brgyud hra khrer slebs shing / hra khre ni sa khul u yon lhan khang gnas yul yin pas nan cang rgyud kyi khā hre las cung zad chung ba'i grong khyer zhig red/ de ring khā hre nas hra khre bar lam thag spyi le 1kha0bskyod/zla ba 6pa'i ches 19nyin/ gza' mig dmar/zhogs pa chu tshod dgu par thon nas rtse phu'u dang / yad khren/ phi'i hran brgyud sang kru'u la slebs/sang kru'u ni khu nu la'i lam gsham du gnas shing gnam gshis khā hre las cung grang ba 'dug 'dir sa rgyu gshin po yod la lo hril por gangs chu 'dren rgyu yod pas lo tog 'tshar skyed yag po yong gi yod/ gzhan yang sa 'edir nan cang 'bras shing thon khungs sa khul zhes brjod kyi 'dug mnga' ris dmag sgar gyi dmag tshugs de gar btsugs 'dug pas nga tsho der zhag sdod byas pa yin/295

de ga'i blo mthun tshos nga tshor spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas sne len byas byung / nan cang dmag khul khang nas nga tsho tshes bco brgyad nyin sa der 'byor rgyu'i brda tho btang bar brten khong tsho kha sang nyin gang nga tshor phebs bsu bya rgyu'i las brel gyis gang sar gtsang sbra byed pa dang / nga tshor phebs bsu byed mkhan gyi dmag mi'i ru sgrig dgong dro'i chu tshod bcu pa bar lam g.yas g.yon du sgugs bsdad pa dang / mtshan mo yang mi bzhag nas sgugs bcug pa bcas byas pa red zer gyi 'dug de ring yang spyi le bcu phrag 'ga'i sar nga tsho phebs bsu byed mkhan btang ba ma zad sgo 'gram gyi nag pang thog la'ang sku tshab tshogs par dga' bsu zhu rgyu'i skor gyi nang don bkod 'dugadapon dmag su 'dra zhig yin rung nga tsho 'phrad skabs gus 'dud dang 'tshams 'dri zhu ba sogs sems rtsa 'khol pos nga tshor sne len byed kyi 'dugablo pham pa zhig la nga tsho'i rig rtsal ru khag khrid med stabs nga tshos krung dbyang gi 'tshams 'dri brda sprod byas pa las nga tsho'i sems nang gi thugs rje mtshon par bya rgyu'i thabs gzhan ni gang yang ma brnyed/rus ming li zhes pa'i kran krang zhig 'dug pa khong ni lag pa gcig las med pa'i gzi ldan dmag mi zhig red/ khong gi 'dzum mdangs dang ngar shugs la bltas tshe khong ni gung khran ring lugs kyi spro snang bsam pas yongs su khengs pa zhig red 'dugazla ba 6pa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' lhag pa/zhogs zas tshar rjes blo mthun krang rmin dang lhan du khrom gzhung gcig rang yod pa der 'cham 'cham la phyin pas de ni ha cang gu dog po zhig red/'on kyang der dngul khang dang / tar khang / tshong khang bcas cha tshang yod la 296

nga/ dung yu gur rigs kyi slob chung zhig/ kyang 'dugang tsho chus u yon lhan khang der slebs rjes mnyam las can skor gyi gnas tshul shes rtogs byed dgos bsam rung chus u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid de tsho a hong gi snyan zhu gsan pa'i sgang yin pas nga tsho phyir log byed dgos byung/ phyi dro dmag tshugs nas kho rang tshos thad kar rogs ram byas te gnyer ba'i mtho rim mnyam las khang zhig la nga tsho lta skor bya rgyur bkod sgrig byas byung / mnyam las u yon lhan khang gi don gcod khang der 'dzul skabs khang pa'i nang gtsang spra ha cang yag po byas 'dug la sbyin bdag nas byi ril dang / kha zas/ tha mag sogs kyang gra sgrig byas 'dug stabs 'khel ba zhig la de ring phyi dro 'dir mnyam las u yon lhan khang gi u yon yongs kyi tshogs 'du skong 'tshogs byas 'dug pas u yon tshang ma der 'dzoms 'dugahre'i kru'u ren dang rtsis pas nga tshor mnyam las hre'i gnas tshul rags bsdus ngo sprod gnang byung /mnyam las hre de ni da lo'i dpyid kar dma' rim mnyam las hre gnyis zla sgril btang rjes mtho rim mnyam las hre zhig btsugs pa yin zhing / de ni sa khul de ga'i khongs kyi sngon thon gyi mnyam las hre zhig yin/ khyon bsdoms hre yon dud tshang 200lhag tsam dang khyon mi grangs 1000lhag tsam/ pho mo'i ngal rtsol nus shugs dang ngal rtsol nus shugs phyed tsam ldan pa bcas mi grangs 600lhag tsam yod/ de bzhin hre khyon yongs la sa zhing mu'u 2600lhag tsam yod pas mi rer cha snyoms byas na mu'u gnyis lhag tsam thob kyi yod/ sa zhing mang che ba gro zhing yin pas thon 'bor che shos skabs mu'u re las rgya ma 1100dang / thon 'bor 'bring tsam la mu'u re las rgya ma 60rkyathon gyi yod pa dang / thon 'bor zhan par mu'u re las rgya ma 200re 297

thon gyi yod pa red/ ma rmos lo tog thon 'bor che shos la mu'u re nas rgya ma 1200dang / thon 'bor 'bring tsam la mu'u re nas rgya ma ra00 thon 'bor zhan pa la mu'u re nas rgya ma 250bcas thon gyi yod pas de mes rgyal nang sa las thon 'bor che ba yod/gnas tshul ngo sprod gnang tshar rjes rtsis pa zhig gis nga tsho sa cha dngos la rtog zhib byed par khrid byung bas hre yon rnams ma rmos lo tog btab nas lud rgyag pa'i sgang red/ sa zhing nang lo tog ha cang yag po skyes 'dug gro ni mi tshad tsam lon pa dang / ma rmos lo tog ni son 'debs 'phrul 'khor gyis gtor 'debs byas tshar 'dug pas de dag la bltas na da lo yang lo legs yong rgyu rang red/ nga tshos da dung hre'i nang gi zhor las khag gcig la lta skor byas pa ste/ gro 'thag dang / snum tshags/ srin 'bu gso sa bcas red/snum tshags dang / srin 'bu gso 'gan ni mang che ba hre yon rgan khog tshos 'khur gyi 'dug kyang thon skyed lag rtsal dang do dam byed thabs tshang ma ha cang rjes lus yin pas bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa zhig 'dugazla ba 6pa'i ches 21nyin/ gza' phur bu/mnga' ris dmag tshugs la 'tshams 'dri zhu ba'i tshogs chen 'tshogs pa red/ tshogs 'du'i thog nga tsho'i tshogs gtsos tang krung dbyang dang / ma'o kru'u zhi/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung / de bzhin rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi 'tshams 'dri khyab bsgrags gnang ba ma zad spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rgyal yongs kyi rnam pa bzang po snyan seng dang / rgyal spyi'i dus bab gsal bshad bcas gnang song / me'o rigs kyi 'thus mi hre pang kre nas kyang gsung bshad gnang zhing mjug tu dmag tshugs la ma'o kru'u 298

'i'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma gnang ba'i dar cha dang dpon dmag tshang mar ma'o kru'u zhi'i dran rten rtags ma re sprad pa red/zla ba 6pa'i ches 22nyin/ gza' pa sangs/sku tshab tshogs pas dmag tshugs kyi we rim dmag dpon yan gyi blo mthun skong ste bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa red/thog mar li kran krang nas dmag tshugs btsugs pa'i brgyud rim gsungs shing / khong gis ‘‘1950lor rta dmag ru khag cig bod la bskyod pa dang kho tshos bde blag ngang dmag bskyod 'gan len thub ched rnga mong ru chen zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas nas skyel 'dren las 'gan 'khur ba red/1950lo'i zla 5pa'i nang dmag mi lan shog cig yud kran brgyud bod la bskyod pas de ni de snga mi 'gro myong med pa'i lam zhig red/ kho tshos rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre drug stong bdun stong zin pa'i gangs ri chen po 'dzegs ste yong bas mi bcu grangs kha shas shi ba dang rnga mong yang 2kyo0lhag tsam shi ba red/(rnga mong khyon bsdoms 400lhag tsam yod/) 1rdzo51lo'i zla ṭ+wāṃpar an tshan mu'u krang gis tang yon mi grangs sum cu 'dems sgrug byas rjes mi rer rta gnyis re dang / skam zas bcas 'khyer te bod du bskyod pa red/ khu nu la'i sgang la slebs dus kha ba chen po zhig babs nas rta mang che ba shi ba dang / blo mthun tsho nyin brgyad tsam phyin rung mi gcig rta gcig tsam yang mthong rgyu med/nyin dgu pa'i mtshams su rta khag gcig shor nas gang sar btsal bas gzhi nas bod mi'i sbra gur zhig brnyed/ der skad cha dris rjes hran he la slebs tshar ba shes/ de ga'i bod mi zhig de snga spyi le sum cu'i dmag sgar la rnga mong ded nas tshwa skyel bar 'gro myong yod pas 'di nas spyi le sum cu'i dmag sgar 299

bar nyin bdun tsam 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ bshad srol la sa der gna' bo'i dus su bod dang thu'u co'/ gnyis dmag 'khrug rgyag sa red ces zer gyi 'dug sa de ga'i yul mi spun zla zhig nas 'thab 'dzing par lam sne khrid de ta hung le'u thang (de snga 'om thang chen po zer )du slebs skabs gzhi nas nga tsho'i mtha' srung dmag dpung dang 'phrad byung / kho tsho tshur log yong skabs bsam grub nas 'om thang chen po brgyud bod la bskyod pa de'ang da lta'i skyel 'dren lam de rang red/ 1kha52lo'i zla 4par rnga mong skyel 'dren ru chen sa 'dir skong nas bod byang khul gyi skyel 'dren bkod 'doms pu'u sgrig 'dzugs byas/ 1954lor mnga' ris skyel 'dren bkod 'doms so'o la bsgyur ba dang / 1956lor mnga' ris dmag tshugs su ming bsgyur byas pa red/ 1952lo dang 1952lor sa khul gnyis (hre kran dang hra khre )skul slongakhyas thog bong bu gang yod mkho 'don rgyab skyor byas rung mthar bong bu yongs rdzogs shi ba red/ 1954lor rnga mong ru chen gnyis dang bong bu'i ru chen gcig sgrig 'dzugs byas/ ru chen re re la rnga mong ṭ+wāṃ00lhag tsam dang /bong bu 1000lhag tsam/ g.yag 100tsam bcas mi re nas lnga re do dam byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang / 1952lo'i rjes dmag dpung gi mkho 'don 'gan srung byed thub pa byung ba red/ bsam grub nas dgun sa'i dbar lam thag khyon bsdoms hwa le 1667yod pas rkang thang la phyin nas nyin sum cu so gnyis tsam 'gor gyi yod/ lam bar du la mang po rgyag dgos pa dang / lhag par du gangs lhags ldang zhing gnam gshis skyo ba/ sa bab mtho la rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 5000yan sha stag yin pas mi med lung stong song gshis dka' ngal chen po yod/ skyel 'dren las 'gan ni de snga lo rer tun 250yin pa dang / da lo tun 200red/ lo ltar bsam grub gyen lam 300

slebs skabs bong bu 100tsam dang / rnga mong bcu grangs shi 'gro gi yod/bong bu re re la rin gong sgor 200nas 250bar yin pas lo ltar las 'gan legs grub thub par 'gro song sgor khri 450tsam gtong dgos kyi yod pa red ’’ces gsungs/li kran krang gis mu mthud dmag dpung gi bsam blo'i gnas tshul ngo sprod gnang song / de snga mngon gsal dod shos kyi gnad don ni mtha' mtshams kyi rnga mong skyel 'dren las kar sems khral 'byung ba de red/ gsar brjer ngo rgol pa gtsang dag bzo ba dang / zhing las mnyam las can gyi slob gso'i las 'gul spel ba brgyud 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po byung yod/ de sngon mi rigs las byed pas skyel 'dren ni rgya mi'i ched du yin pa ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod rung da cha rkyel 'dren ni mes rgyal mtha' mtshams srung skyob dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du yin pa gsal por shes thub pa byung yod/ de sngon dka' ngal che sar 'gro 'dod med pa de da cha rang 'gul gyis dka' 'tshegs che sar 'gro rgyu'i re ba byed kyi yod pa dang / 'thab 'dzing pa tshang mas hur brtson ngang gzhon nu sde tshogs dang gung khran tang nang zhugs rgyu'i re ba 'don gyi yod/ dmag dpung nang mig sngar lhag bsdad pa'i gnad don gtso bo ni/ 1 rgya rigs dmag dpon nang zhin cang du rtsa ba 'dzugs rgyu'i bsam blo brtan po med pa/ 2 mdun lam dang lo tshad brgal bar bsam gzhigs kyis las bsgyur byed 'dod pa/ 2 chab srid dang rig gnas slob sbyong bya rgyur re ba kha tsha dgos gtug yod pa bcas red/dmag dpon tshos bsam 'char bshad tshar rjes sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso wang nas gsung bshad gnang song /301

zla ba 6pa'i ches 2 2nyin/ gza' spen pa/snga dro'i kha lag zas tshar rjes sdog chas brgyab nas thon rtsis byas te bsdad pa yin/ de ring ni rta la bzhon pa'i nyin dang po yin zhing thon krang gis nga tshor ru sgrig ste go rim ltar 'gro dgos pa'i bkod 'doms gnang song /mi res rta re khrid de grong nang nas thon pas dga' skyel byed mkhan ni snga sa nas grong gi mtha' la ru sgrig ste sgug bsdad 'dug nga tsho yong ba mthong skabs bkod 'doms pa zhig gis yu gur rigs kyi skad cha'i thog nas nga tsho'i thon krang la snyan seng zhus rjes khong gis nga tsho khrid de thon khar skyel ma byed mkhan dang lag pa gtong res byas pa yin/ re zhig 'bod sgra dang smon tshig bcas dga' spro'i rnam pas khengs 'dug lhag par du slob chung gi slob ma tshos nga tsho'i lag nas dam por bzung ste 'tshams 'dri dang bcas te ‘‘a khu lags/ khyed tshos nga tshor dngos po skyel gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin ’’zhes zer zhing / nga tshos kho tshor log phebs rogs gnang zhes bshad rung kho tshos nga tsho'i lag nas bzung ste bral mi phod pa lta bu byed kyi 'dug de nas nga tsho rta la bzhon te thon pas kho tshos da dung grong gi mtha' ru langs nas skad gsang mthon pos ‘‘sku tshab tshogs pa rnams 'gro lam bde po yong ba dang sku khams gsal thang yong ba shog mi’ces shod pa ma zad nga tsho'i phyogs la rgyun mi chad par lag pa g.yag bzhin 'dug pas nga tshos kyang lag pa g.yugs te gus tshul mtshon par byas/bral song / dga' gus 'os pa'i blo mthun tsho/ bral song / mdzes sdug yid 'ong gi grong tsho/de nas nga tshos rta mchog lcag gis skul nas khu nu la'i phyogs su mdun 302

skyod byas pa yin/ ri bo de brgal ma thag yongs su mu mtha' med pa'i bye thang red/ de gar nyi ma tsha la mkha' rlung ha cang skam po yod pa dang / rta'i rmig pas thal rdul bslang par brten kha yang skam por chags/ de nas yud tsam song rjes mi rta gnyis ka ngal dub che stabs thon krang nas ngal gso rgyag dgos pa'i bka' btang / de nas mu mthud mdun skyod byed skabs glo bur du rgyab phyogs nas ‘‘rta shor song / mgyogs po ded ’mices pa'i skad rgyag gi 'dug pas nga tshos phyi mig lta dus rta rgod cig bye thang thog 'ur bros byed kyi 'dugade'i rjes la mi gnyis kyis nus shugs yod rgus ded rung mthar bzung thub ma song / rta de'ang thog ma'i yong sa'i phyogs la shor stabs ched mngags mi gcig rta ded du gtong dgos byung / de min gzhan rnams mu mthud mdun skyod byas/ de sngon lha sar sdod ring bod kung ud kyi hru'u ci h+phan ming nas nga tshor ‘‘sa mtho dang mya ngam thang chen thog rta bzhon te 'gro rgyu ni ha cang dka' ngal che ba zhig yin zhing / da dung snga dgong rta 'tsho dgos pa dang zab zab ma byas na rta 'drog nas shor tshe le dbar brgya phrag kha shas sar 'tshol bar 'gro dgos ’zhes gsungs pa de gus pa'i yid la lhang lhang dran byung bas de ring tag tag gnas tshul 'di 'phrad song snyam pa byung /de nas le dbar 20tsam phyin rjes rba'o hre ca'e la slebs pa dang / der ngal gso brgyab ste nyin gung kha lag zas pa yin/ de ni ri khul nang gi grong tsho chung chung zhig yin pas mi ser dud tshang kha shas shig las min 'dug ri gsham du rgyugs chu dwangs ma zhig 'dug pa ma zad / grong tsho'i mdun la ljon pa'i bsil grib kyi g.yogs shing gang sar gsing ma sngo thing nger 'dug mya ngam thang chen thog le dbar 20tsam phyin pa brgyud yid du 'ong ba'i grong tsho 'di lta bu zhig/ mthong dus dngos nas lha yul la slebs pa'i snang ba zhig ster 303

gyi 'dugade nas yang le dbar 20tsam phyin rjes tung pā khe la slebs byung / de ga'i yul ljongs ni rba'o hre ca'e las kyang mdzes pa 'dug der ri sngo zhing chu dwangs ba ma zad gro'i ljang pa yang 'tshar skyed legs po 'dug ri shur nas lhags bsil rgyag dus gro'i snye ma rba rlabs bzhin du g.yo bas gang sar dri bsung thul bzhin 'dug li kran krang gis ‘‘sa 'di nas sgrol rjes sngo ljang can gyi yul ljongs 'di lta bu mthong rgyu med pa red ’ces gsungs song bas tshang ma 'di gar ngal gso brgyab ste bsdad/ pe cin gyi chu tshod brgyad par la gsham du 'byor bas de gar zhag sdod byas pa yin/ sa de'i sngon gyi ming la khal man hre zer gyi 'dug de tung pā khe dang bar thag le dbar 40tsam yod pa'i sar gnas shing / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 2ra50yod pas gnam gshis grang la dgong mo phyi ru drod tshad klad kor sgang gi tu'u gsum la slebs kyi yod/ dmag tshugs kyis der skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs btsugs te gur gnyis brgyab yod pa red/ 'on kyang skyel 'dren la mkho ba'i rnga mong dang bong bu/ rta drel bcas tshang ma ri shur nang btsir nas bzhag yod pa red/'thab 'dzing pa mang po zhig la gur yang phubs yas med par ras spyir btang zhig sa steng du bting nas lus la char khebs shig gyon te sdod kyi 'dug kho tshos bshad par gzhigs na/ gnam gshis tsha grang gang 'dra zhig yin rung nyin ltar 'di 'dra red zer gyi 'dug pas dngos gnas gnas mal sa steng dang bza' 'thung rlung khrod zer ba de rang red/zla ba 6pa'i ches 24nyin/ gza' nyi ma/nam langs ma thag nga tsho yar langs nas 'gro rtsis byas pa yin/ gnam 304

'thibs nas gangs sim sim du babs kyi 'dugade nas thon te tā pan la 'dzegs pas nga tsho kha shas sngon la phyin pa yin/yud tsam song rjes nga dang em rje cang lags kyi rta'i glo thag lhug tu song bas sga yang bzhud grabs byed kyi 'dug mdun gyi ri bo ni g.yang gzar la dog po yod stabs de mur nga tshos rta las babs nas sga glo dam du gtong rtsis byas pa yin/ 'on kyang de sngon rta sgar lag pa 'chang myong med par brten sga log brgyab cing rta 'drogs nas zang zing du gyur song / stabs legs pa zhig la ri shur nang song bas rta bros thub med kyang tog tsam 'khrab song bas sga gdan tshang ma sa la lhung song / de nas nga tshos ga ler rta bzung ba yin/ skabs der nga tsho'i rjes la yong mkhan tshos de dag mthong nas kho tsho'i bsam par nga tsho rtas dbyugs pa red snyam ste blo mi bde bar gyur yod pa dang / nga tsho'i tshogs gtso ni de bas sems khral chen po gnang gi 'dug mthar nga tshos gsal bshad byas pa brgyud tshang ma blo bde po byung song / 'on kyang da gin gnas tshul de 'dra byung rjes tshogs gtso nas tshang mar rta las babs ste 'gro dgos gsungs song /tā pan la'i mdun du slebs dus la de ni g.yang gzar la mtho ba dang 'gro lam dog pa/ lam gyi gzhogs gcig ni grog rong gting ring zhig yin pas bltas pa tsam gyis skrag snang skyes dgos pa zhig 'dug der brten nga tshos dmag tshugs nas gra sgrig byas pa'i bong bur bzhon pa dang / bong bu re re'i rjes su da dung grangs nyung mi rigs kyi 'thab 'dzing pa re re'i ched mngags nga tshor srung skyob byed mkhan la btang byung /kho tshos nga tshor gang ci'i thad nas srung skyob hur thag byed kyi 'dug pas nga tsho tshang ma ha cang 'tsher po yong gi 'dug305

la rtse g.yang gzar zhing mtho ba yin pas dngos gnas gom pa yang spo dka' ba zhig red/ la de 'dzegs skabs mi lta ci/ dud 'gro'ang thang chad de dbugs ring 'phyung bzhin 'dug pas mdun 'then rgyab ded byas nas ga ler skyod dgos kyi 'dug la 'dzegs bzhin du drod tshad kyang dma' ru 'gro gi 'dug de ltar chu tshod gcig tsam 'dzeg rjes gzhi nas la rtser slebs thub tsam byung / mi dang dud 'gro tshang ma ngal dub shin tu che ba byung ste rang sar ngal gso rgyag dgos byung song / 'on kyang la rtser rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 2500yod pa dang / char pa sim sim 'bab pa/ da dung lhags pa yang rgyag gi 'dug pas nga tshos ngal gsos rjes slar yang rta bzhon te mu mthud mdun du skyod pa yin/zla ba 6pa'i tshes 25nyin/ gza' zla ba/de ring ni la chen de 'dra rgyag mi dgos par la gsham brgyud phyin nas chu bo kha shas shig brgal dgos byung / nga tsho 'gro sa'i yul du slebs grabs yod skabs gzhi nas rim bzhin gyen la 'dzegs pa yin/ la rtse nas mi ring ba'i sar chu ko'u ta khe skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs kyi blo mthun tshos ru star sgrig ste nga tshor bsu ba zhu gi yod pa mthong byung / ru star gyi gzhogs la da dung bong bu khyu gcig 'dug pas de dag ni ched mngags nga tshor gra sgrig byas pa zhig red 'dug nga tsho dang skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs kyi blo mthun rnams phan tshun lag pa gtong res kyis ngo sprod dang 'tshams 'dri byas rjes bong bur bzhon nas mu mthud mdun skyod byas pa yin/skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs la 'byor skabs khang pa'i phyi nang gang sar gtsang spra legs po byas 'dug la nga tshor yang sems rtsa 'khol po'i ngang nas sne 306

len gnang byung / de'i mtha' skor gyi ri'i gangs bzhur med par brten gnam gshis ha cang grang mo 'dug da dung nga tsho slebs tsam la char rlung ldang bas phyi log gi drod tshad tu'u drug la chag song /zla ba 6pa'i ches 26nyin/ gza' mig dmar/de gar nyin shas ring bstud mar gnam 'thib nas gangs ma char yang yang babs pa red zer gyi 'dug 'on kyang de ring zhogs pa ni gnam dwangs nas nyi ma mthong rgyu byung / der brten li kran krang nas khyed tsho gang du phebs rung de gar gnam dwangs kyi 'dug pas gnam gyis kyang khyed tshor dga' bsu zhugi 'dug ces gsungs song bas tshang mas ma gros gcig mthun gyi sgo nas ‘‘bkra shis bde legs ’zhes 'bod kyi 'dugade nas thon rjes bsam grub la ru slebs byung / li kran krang nas bsam grub la ni de sngon gyi la dang mi 'dra bar 'di ni yongs su brag ri yin pa dang /sa bab mtho la g.yang gzar ba/ lo mang gangs babs nas gnam gshis ha cang grang mo yod pa red/ lo ltar la de'i steng mi dang dud 'gro mang po shi rmas byung ba dang / lhag don nyin shas bstud mar gangs btang ba song tsang 'gro lam de bas khag po yod pas tshang mas gzab gzab byed dgos pa dang /bsam blo'i thog nas gang sar dogs zon cher bskyed byed dgos lugs gsungs gnang song / — skad cha shod kyin du nga tsho hwa le 50tsam sar slebs 'dug pa de ni la de'i bang rim gnyis pa red/ der mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4250yod/ de nas 'khyug tsam zhig la gnam gshis 'gyur te sprin nag lang long du 'phyur zhing char rlung drag po 'tshub pas grang ngar shin tu che/ li 307

kran krang nas sa mtho'i gnam gshis ni 'di ltar bshad mi shes par 'gyur ldog 'gro gi red ces gsungs shing tshang mas lam sang lpags pa'i gos gyon pa dang / char khebs gyon pa/ da dung mig shel dang kha ras rgyag pa sogs byas/skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs nas kyang nga tshor bong bu bcu lhag tsam gra sgrig byas yod stabs tshang mas bong bu bzhon te phyin pa dang / nga tsho mi re re'i rgyab tu da dung mi rigs kyi 'thab 'dzing pa re re rogs ram byed par btang yod/nga tsho tshang mas dka' spyad 'bad 'thab bya rgyu'i bsam blo bcangs nas mu mthud la rtser 'dzegs pa yin/la de ni dngos gnas g.yang gzar la 'gro lam khag po zhig 'dug la rtse nas la sked bar kha bas yongs su bklubs pas dngul mdog gi 'dzam gling zhig dang mtshungs/ ri bo'i steng gi 'gro lam kyag kyog ni sbrul chen zhig 'khyud pa dang 'dra zhing / nga tshos de dag brgyud nas rim pas 'dzegs mthar la rtser slebs byung / la ga tshad mtho ba de tsam gyis gangs mthug pa 'dug la gnam gshis kyang grang ba 'dug 'khyag ri'i steng gi 'tsho ba'i bro ba myong ba ni mi tshe 'di'i nang gi thengs dang po yin pas de'ang dran rten byed 'os pa zhig red snyam nas nga rang gcig pur ru khag gi rjes su par rgyag gin yong ba yin/de nas sprin pa rim bzhin kha phye ste lho nub phyogs su 'od zer chem chem 'phro ba'i mtha' 'khor gyi ri chu dag rim bzhin gsal por mthong thub kyi 'dugal rtse nas babs skabs g.yang gzar gyi thur lam sha stag red/ der brten mdun gyi blo mthun tsho bong bu las babs te rkang thang du bskyod song /yin na'ang nga rang nas nyen khar ma 'dzem par bong bu bzhon nas phyin pa yin/lam bar mnga' ris su btang ba'i dbyin skad yig bsgyur mkhan bu mo zhig 'phrad byung ba khong ni lo na chung ba dang sa mtho'i gnam gshis 'phrod po ma 308
