byung bar brten la dug brgyab ste lam zur du em rje bsten pa'i sgang red/ngas kho tshor nad gzhi gang 'dra 'dug gam zhes skad cha dris pas tshang mas skyon che ba mi 'dug ngal gso tog tsam brgyab na drag skyes yong gi red ces zer gyi 'dug nga'i sems par yang skyon che ba yong gi ma red snyam nas phyin pa yin/ 'on kyang nga tsho la gsham du slebs nas ngal gso rgyag skabs thon krang gis em rje gnyis po gang du yod ces 'dri rtsad gnang bas zhabs zhu bas bu mo yig bsgyur mkhan nad gzhi lji tsam 'dug pas em rje gnyis mo'i sar sdod dgos byung song zhes bshad song /de nas hwa le 60tsam phyin rjes dbul skyob 'bab tshugs la 'byor byung /dang thog bshad rgyun la sa cha der gnam gshis yag po med pas nad phog sla po yod zer gyi 'dug der brten dus rgyun blo mthun tshang ma sa 'dir sdod mi nus par sog gur nang 'gro gi yod/ da res thon krang nas sdod khang gzigs rjes 'grig tsam yod pa dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad smi 2950tsam las med pa/ de bzhin sog gur yod sa'i bar da dung le dbar bcu grangs 'gro dgos par brten skabs 'phral 'char gzhir 'gyur ba btang thog sa de ga rang la zhag sdod bya rgyu'i thag gcod byas song /zla ba 6pa'i ches 27nyin/ gza' lhag pa/zhogs par gangs sim sim zhig babs rung nyin dgung mtshams su gnam yongs su dwangs song / de ring nyin gang ri khug nang bskyod dgos pas lam bar rdo hrug mang la thur lam sha stag yin gshis 'gro lam bde po zhig rtsa ba nas mi 'dug stabs legs pa zhig la lam thag ring po mi 'dug pas hwa le 40tsam song rjes zhogs pa'i chu tshod bcu gcig nas thon te nyin dgung gi 309

chu tshod gnyis pa tsam la sog gur yod sar slebs byung / dmag tshugs de gar skyel 'dren dngos po'i mdzod khang btsugs 'dug pas khang pa yag la mang ba zhig yod pa ma zad sgo rwa chen po zhig kyang 'dug de'i phyi nang gang sar 'bru rigs dang / gzan chag de bzhin mnga' ris phyogs su dbor rgyu'i dngos po bcas yod/ de gar 'byor rjes sa bab kyang dma' ru phyin pa dang /mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 2200tsam las med pas gnam gshis dro grang snyoms la khang pa'i phyi nang gi drod tshad kyang khyad par hra hre tu'u gnyis las med/sngon rtsis byas na nga tsho 'dir mnga' ris nas log yong mkhan gyi skyel 'dren ru chen sgugs te sa der nyin gcig ngal gso rgyag rgyu'i 'char gzhi red/'on kyang yi ge 'byor bar gzhigs na kho tsho ni tshwa khar phyogs sdom dang bcas nyin gnyis gsum tshur yong thub kyi med lugs la brten nga tshos sang zhogs mu mthud mdun skyod byas nas tshwa khar khong tsho dang mnyam 'dzoms byas thog nyin gcig gnyis tsam ngal gso rgyag rgyu'i thag bcad pa red/zla ba 6pa'i ches 2ṭ+wāṃnyin/ gza' phur bu/khā lā khā hre chu bo brgyud hwa le 90sar bskyod pas sa'e thu lar slebs/zhag sdod bya yul slebs la nye ba'i skabs ri ma thang mthon po zhig gi sgang la gru bzhi ngos snyoms pa'i sgar zhig bskrun yod pa dang / de dang thag nye tsam gyi sar btsan rdzong zhig kyang brgyab 'dug pas de tsho ni skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs dang mi 'dra la spyir btang gi dmag sgar dang yang 'dra po med par mkhar rdzong chung chung zhig 'dra po 'dug nang log tu 'dzul rjes skad cha dris pas lan krang gzhon pa zhig gis de dag ni rgyal srung sa thig sgang gi mtha' mtshams kyi 310

lte ba'i so lta khang dang po yin zhing / der mtha' srung spyi bde'i 'thab 'dzing pa lan shog gcig yod pas so lta khang 6srung skyob bya rgyu'i las 'gan 'khur nas bsdad yod pa dang / dmag sgar gyi rgyab phyogs ri shur de'i nub ngos su hwa le 200tsam phyin na kha che'i yul mtha' mtshams zin gyi yod ces gsungs kyi 'dug der brten de'i rgyud la gnas tshul ha cang dza drag po yod pa red/gong gi gza' 'khor gnyis nang nga tsho'i mtha' mtshams nas hwa le 40yod pa'i sar gsang brda'i me mda' rgyag mkhan byung ba dang / ho then la'ang lo shas nang lo ltar zing cha langs kyi yod pa ma zad na ning zla 10pa'i nang dbyin cis sar jag pa'i zing slong thon te gsang nyul gyis chus srid gzhung bcom 'dugangs mi su 'dra zhig gis de 'dra byas pa red dam zhes dris skabs khong gis tshang ma mang tshogs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa de 'dra red zer gyi 'dugabacos bsgyur byas rjes da dung mang tshogs mi ngan gyi mgo bskor 'og tshud dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam snyam pa byung bas ngas mu mthud 'dri rtsad k+shis sa cha de tshor bcos bsgyur byas pa red dam zhes dris pas khong gis bcos bsgyur byas tshar ba yin rung dgra bos mi rigs kyi 'brel ba dang chos lugs kyi gnad don bed spyad nas mang tshogs la dkrug shing rgyag gi yod pa red ces zer gyi 'duga.a la'e/ gnad don der thug 'dug snyam byung / nga'i bsam par 'di gar de ltar yin pa ma zad/ mtha' khul dang / rgyal srung sa khul mang che ba dper na bod dang / yun nan sogs sa khul gyi mtha' mtshams khul la'ang gnad don tshang ma mi rigs kyi gnad don dang dam por 'brel bsdad yod pa zhig yin pas/ mi rigs kyi gnad don dang chos lugs kyi gnad don ni rgyun 311

ring gi gnad don zhig yin pas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur dang spyi tshogs ring lugs bsgyur bcos byed pa ni gong gi gnad don gnyis po thag gcod bya rgyur rmang gzhi yag po zhig bting thub pa las gnad don de gnyis yongs su thag gcod thub mi srid/ gal te de dag snang chung shor te las ka'i thad zab nan mi ldang ba dang / de'i thog dgra bos dkrug shing brgyab pa yin na zing cha chen po langs nges red/ de ni mtha' mtshams srung skyob gnad don gyi rnyog dra'i rang bzhin dang rgyun ring rang bzhin red snyam byung /zla ba 6pa'i ches 29nyin/ gza' pa sangs/sa'e thu la nas thon rjes yang bye thang zhig bgrod dgos pas bye thang de ni cung chung ba'i gras shig red/ g.yas g.yon gnyis na ri mtho zhing khul 'ga' re rong khul dang 'dra la 'ga' re gshong sa'i khul dang yang 'dra ba dang / da dung dbus su rtswa thang yang 'dugaphyi dro'i chu tshod bdun pa'i yas mas tsam la rdo khang yod sar slebs byung /der rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 2650yod pa dang / lam thag spyi le 70tsam bskyod 'dug nga tsho sa 'dir slebs dus sngon la 'byor ba'i blo mthun tshos sa mtho sa zhig gi sgang la gur brgyab 'dug kyang lhags rlung shugs drag can yang yang rgyag gi 'dug pas gur yang 'khyer nas sdod thabs mi 'dug blo mthun krang rmin nas gsham gyi chu 'gram du gsing ma phran bu zhig yod pa mthong ste der tshang mas phar rub tshur rub kyis gur brgyab thub tsam byung bas blo bde por gyur/ zla ba 6pa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' spen pa/de ring yang bye thang dang rtswa thang brgyud nas 'gro dgos shing / nyin 312

dgung chu tshod gsum pa tsam nas lhags shugs je cher song ste sems can dang mi tshang ma lhags pas 'khyar 'khyor byed cing / lus la lpags pa'i gos gyon rung gdong dang lag pa 'khyags nas na zug gtong gi 'dugale dbar 〈0tsam phyin rjes tshwa khar slebs/ 'dir skyel 'dren ru chen khag gnyis kyi mi dang sems can mnga' ris nas tshur 'byor ma thag yin pas sa 'dir bsdad de las kar phyogs sdom byed bzhin 'dug mi grangs ha lam nyis brgya gsum brgya trem zhig 'dug pas kho tshos gyon chas gtsang la gra sgrig pa gyon te ru star gnyis sgrig nas lam g.yas g.yon du nga tshor dga' bsu zhu bar slebs byung / dga' bsu zhu mkhan gyi dpung khag brgyud nga tsho zhag sdod bya yul du slebs byung bas gur bcu phrag kha shas nga tsho'i mig lam du mngon/ de dag ni bye thang gi steng du khang bzang star sgrig brgyab pa dang mtshungs shing /gur gyi thog dar dmar re btsugs 'dug pas de tsho rlung gis lhab lhub tu g.yo bzhin 'dug gur gyi mdun phyogs su chu bo zhig dal po'i ngang rgyugs bzhin 'dug mi rigs 'thab 'dzing pa'i dga' spro'i glu sgra dag dmigs bsal gyi skad gsang mthon po yod pa'i tshor ba byung / 'dir mya ngam thang chen gyi 'jigs skrag las yongs su bral nas grong tsho chung chung zhig tu zhag sdod byas pa dang mtshungs/ sang zhogs 'tshams 'dri'i tshogs chen zhig 'tshog rgyu yin pas thon krang nas nga la mi rigs khag gi sku tshab zhus te gtam bshad bya rgyu'i bkod sgrig gnang byung /zla ba 7pa'i ches 1nyin/ gza' zla ba/de ring ni tang btsugs nas lo 25'khor ba'i dran rten gyi nyin mo zhig red/313

kha sa'i 'char gzhi ltar na dran rten gyi tshogs chen de phyi log tu 'tshog rgyu byas pa red/ 'on kyang zhogs pa nas char pa chad med babs pa dang /lhags pa rgyag pa/ gnam gshis grang ngar che la dgun kha dang khyad par med stabs tshogs chen de gur gyi nang log tu 'tshogs dgos byung /tshogs zhugs mi snar dmag dpon dang 'thab 'dzing pa'i sku tshab khyon bsdoms mi 20lhag tsam 'dug tshogs 'du 'go tshugs ma thag gnam dwangs nas nyi ma shar song bas gur nang ha cang tsha ba chen po yod stabs skabs shig pags pa'i gyon pa phud dgos byung / tshogs 'du'i thog dang thog wang thon krang nas gsung bshad gnang ba dang de rjes nga dang bod dmag khul khang gi sku tshab krang rmin nas gtam bshad byas pa yin/ mi rigs las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa khag gcig gis skyel 'dren las 'gan legs grub bya rgyu de rgyal khab kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun/ lho nub kyi rgyal srung brtan nying / bod mi rigs kyi mthun sgril dang yar rgyas/ gong 'phel bcas kyi thad la gal che'i don snying ldan pa shes rtogs gsal po mi thub par de dag ni rgya rigs kyi ched du dka' las brgyab pa yin pa'i nor 'khrul gyi ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ de dag la dmigs te ngas mi rigs las byed pa dang mi rigs kyi sku tshab kyi ming thog nas rgya rigs kyis nga tsho'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun nang 'bul ba'i gal che'i gtso nus dmigs su bkar nas nan bshad byas shing / tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi mdzub khrid 'og rgya rigs ba/cen pos dka' tshegs la mi 'dzem par lhag bsam zol med kyis spun zla'i mi rigs khag la rogs ram byed kyi yod/ der brten spun zla'i mi rigs khag nas nges par du rgya rigs gcen por yid ches dang brtsi bkur bcas byas thog sems chung gis kho tshor slob sbyong byed dgos zhes bshad pa 314

yin/nga tsho gsum gyi gtam bshad tshar rjes dpung sde'i khongs nas blo mthun bcu lhag tsam gyis gtam bshad gnang song / de'i nang dmag dpon gyi sku tshab dang / 'thab 'dzing pa'i sku tshab/ rgya rigs kyi dpon dmag dang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi dpon dmag bcas kyi sku tshab yod cing / gtam bshad kyi nang don spyir gcig gyur tsam yin pa de'ang sems thag gtsang bcad kyis dka' ngal khyad bsad thog tang dang mi dmangs kyis sprad pa'i las 'gan legs grub byas te tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs bcas kyi sku drin gsob thub pa bya rgyu'i rnam 'gyur mtshon pa phud/ gsham gsal gyi bsam 'char khag bton pa ste/ 1 sa mtho'i gnam gshis kyi khyad chos las lo gcig nang zla ba dgu'i ring sring bal gyi dgun chas gyon dgos pas da lta'i tshad gzhi ltar lo gnyis nang sring bal gyon pa cha tshang gcig spras pa des rtsa ba nas 'dang thabs med/ de yang zla ba dgu pa'i nang gyon pa cha tshang gcig rtsab ral rtsab nag tu 'gro gi 'dug pas de 'dra gyon thabs bral ba dang / de bzhin char khebs dang / pags zhwa/ gangs shel/ 'jur ta yu ring / nyal chas sogs tshang ma dgos mkho bskong thub kyi med pa/ 2 thag ring skyel 'dren byed skabs mi re la nyin re'i kha gsab mog tse brgyad dang skar bdun las med pa dang / nye sar skyel 'dren byed skabs mog tse bzhi las med pas lto phor pa gang za rgyu yang 'dang gi med/ der brten nges par du legs bcos dgos pa/ 2 nyin ltar dpung bskyod nyung dus chu tshod bcu gsum dang mang dus chu tshod bco lnga tsam byed dgos/ lo ltar zla ba dgu tag tag skyel 'dren gyi las 'gan 'khur dgos pa dang / de 'phros zla ba gsum nang da dung phyogs sdom dang / ngal gso dag ther/ lo rjes ma'i las ka'i gra 315

sgrig bcas byed dgos khar/ da dung slob sbyong gi las 'gul 'dra min nang du'ang zhugs dgos pas rgyun ldan las byed pa'i chab srid slob sbyong dang 'thab 'dzing pa'i rig gnas slob sbyong bya rgyu'i dus tshod nyung drags par brten tshang mas rnam pa'i 'phel phyogs dang rjes zin mi thub pas ha cang sems 'tshab byed kyi yod pa bcas yin/nyin shas ring kho tsho dang mnyam du dpung bskyod byas par gzhigs na dmag dpung de ni deng skabs rgyal yongs khyon gyi dmag dpung nang nas dka' ngal che shos yin pa shes thub/ kho tshos bton pa'i bsam 'char de tsho tshang ma dngos yod gnas tshul yin pa las sgro btags spu tsam yang byas mi 'dug pas rim gong nas thag gcod ma byas pa gang yin nam/ de ni nga tsho'i las ka'i nang gnas pa'i dpon nyams ring lugs tshabs chen dang las don la do snang ma byed pa de red/ pe cin dang grong khyer che khag gi gzhung las khang nang las ka byed mkhan mi de tshos sa mtho'i steng gi dmigs bsal gnas tshul dag bsam yul la 'char thabs bral ba song gshis 'dir srog 'ben btsugs kyis dka' sdug 'tsho ba myong mkhan dpung sder gzigs skyong ga la byed srid/ nga'i bsam par khong tsho'i bsam 'char de tsho krung dbyang dang dmag ud la zhu rgyu'i 'gan 'khri sku tshab tshogs par yod bsam gyi 'dugatshogs 'du grol skabs phyi dro'i chu tshod gsum pa tsam la slebs 'dugazla ba 7pa'i ches 2nyin/ gza' mig dmar/de ring le dbar 70tsam bskyod rjes tā 'ung li'u than la 'byor/'dir dmag mi bcu shog gcig dang kha lo ba bzhis rlangs 'khor che ba gsum dang chung ba gcig khrid nas nga tsho sgugs bsdad 'dug kho tsho 'dir slebs te 316

nyin bzhi bcu lnga bcu tsam phyin 'dug pas kho tsho'i pyon chas btsog pa chags pa dang / skra dang sma ra sogs bzhar rgyu ma byung bar ha cang ring por lus 'dug pas dngos gnas dka' ngal chen po byung 'dug de ring phan tshun dngos su thug skabs tshang mar dga' tshor dpag med skyes/zla ba 7pa'i ches rdzonyin/ gza' zla ba/zla phyed tsam ring la brgyab klung brgal dang nyi sreg tsha gdung myang ba brgyud de ring gzhi nas ru thog rdzong la 'byor rgyu yin pas tshang ma'i sems nang dga' tshor chen po skyes/ la chung zhig brgyab rjes ri khug cig tu slebs/ ri khug de ni kha rong dog cing bgrod lam du rlangs 'khor che ba gcig thar tsam las mi 'dug de nas sgrol rjes g.yu ltar sngo ba'i mtsho 'gram zhig gi mdun du slebs/ de ni ru thog rdzong khongs kyi mtsho zhig red/mnga' ris yan lag ru khag ru thog rdzong du bca' sdod mkhan gyi lan gnyis pa'i chab srid slob ston pa gzhon pas sa cha de ga'i srid gzhung gi sku tshab dang lhan du mtsho de'i khar nga tsho bsur bar phebs byung bas nga tshos de gar ngal gso dang sbrags nyin gung kha lag zas/ kho tsho'i gur nang phan tshun skad cha shod res byas pa brgyud khong tsho sa der 'byor nas gza' 'khor gcig tag tag phyin pa gzhi nas shes byung / chab srid slob ston pa gzhon pas rdzong srid gzhung dang dgon sde'i grwa pa bcas gza' pa sangs nyin rdzong gnas yul du ma slebs gong gi le dbar bcu'i sar khyed tsho phebs bsur bcar rgyu dang /de nas rdzong srid gzhung gi sgo 'gram du dga' bsu'i tshogs chen 'tshog rgyu red/der brten khyed rnams de ring rdzong srid gzhung la ma slebs gong gi le dbar nyi shu'i sar chu bo zhig yod pas der zhag stod nyin gcig byed dgos zhes 317

gsungs pas nga tshos kyang kho tsho'i bkod sgrig gzhir bzung ltar byas/nga tsho der bsdad ma thag kho tsho'i sne len tshogs chung ji/ blo mthun tshang ma 'byor song bas thon krang nas gtso skyong gnang zhing / thun mong thog sang nyin gyi byed sgo dang de bzhin ru thog rdzong la sdod ring gi nyin re'i byed sgo'i thad la gros bsdur byas mthar rdzong der nyin bzhi sdod rgyu dang nyin dang por dga' bsu'i tshogs chen nang zhugs rgyu/ nyin gnyis par ser skya dpon rigs dang dmag dpung gi dpon dmag bcas dang thug 'phrad bya rgyu/ nyin gsum par sku 'gyed 'bul rgyu dang / dmag dpung dang mnyam du ja ston tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu/ nyin bzhi par rdzong srid gzhung nas gra sgrig byas pa'i gsol ston la zhugs rgyu bcas thag gcod gnang /zla ba 7pa'i ches 10nyin/ gza' mig dmar/de ring dga' bsu'i tshogs chen 'tshog rgyu yin pas tshang ma zhogs pa nas skra bzhar ba dang gyon chas gra sgrig byas/ mi tshang mas gsar du bzos pa'i dbyar chas cha tshang brjes nas zla phyed nang gi thal rdul gyi rnam pa gtsang mar bzos/pe cin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod gnyis par rdzong srid gzhung gi las don mi snas rta bzhon te nga tsho thon dgos pa'i brda gtong bar slebs song bas nga tshos de mur go rim ltar rlangs 'khor nang 'dzul nas lam du zhugs/ sne len khang la slebs khar ser skya dpon rigs tshos lag tu kha btags 'khyer nas nga tsho sgugs bsdad 'dug nga tsho rlangs 'khor las bab ste kho tsho'i khrid la 'byor skabs kho tshos nga tshor kha btags sgron byung / de nas nga tsho gur nang 'dzul te tshang ma gdan la 'khod 'phral thon krang gis nga tsho da res yong dgos don 318

gsal bshad dang sbrags 'tshams 'dri yang gnang song / de nas rdzong de'i mi 'bor dang / g.yag lug bsdoms 'bor bcas bka' 'dri gnang bar rdzong dpon gyis rdzong khyon la mi grangs 6000tsam dang / g.yag 1500 ra khri 25 lug khri 10bcas yod gsungs/ de nas phan tshun gleng mol phran bu byas rjes tshang ma mnyam du rdzong srid gzhung gi sgo 'gram gyi spang steng du bskong 'tshogs byas pa'i dga' bsu zhu ba'i tshogs chen la zhugs/ tshogs chen la zhugs mkhan dmag mi dang mang tshogs bsdoms mi grangs 200yas mas las mi 'dug kyang tshang mas dus chen gyi gzab mchor spras shing rnga rdung dar 'phyar dang lag tu me tog 'khyer nas dga' bsu zhu ba bcas byed kyi 'dug pas ha cang 'khrug cha dod po 'dugatshogs chen thog rdzong dpon nas dga' bsu'i shis tshig sgrog sbyangs gnang ba dang / thon krang nas gsung bshad gnang rjes dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal tshogs pas 'khrab ston byas song / 'khrab ston mjug sgril rjes sa cha de ga'i lugs srol ltar 'khrab ston pa mi re rer kha btags dang / nā yang re sprod dgos kyi 'dug pas nga tsho'i thon krang nas kho tshor 'tshams 'dri dang sbrags de dag gnang song bas tshang ma dga' tshor chen po byung song /tshogs 'du grol rjes nga tsho dmag dpung gi lan pu'u la zhag sdod byas pa yin/ lan pu'u yi khang pa de tsho ni mes rgyal nang sa'i byang phyogs kyi mi ser khang pa dang ha cang 'dra bas thog gcig ma yin pa dang / nang log nyal khri'i 'og tu me mdag 'jog sa yod pa/ khang pa'i mtha' bzhi gyang mtho pos bskor zhing rgyab mdun gnyis kyi rgyal sgor 'dzing rags brgyab yod pa/ phyi ngos nas bltas tshe mkhar rdzong chung chung zhig rang red/ de yang mtha' srung dmag sgar gyi khyad chos shig yin bzo 'dug319

nga tshor sne len zhu ched khang pa'i nang log tu sgrog rtse bsgrigs shing gyang steng du ras dkar po sbyar ba ma zad/ 'khrus chas cha tshang gsar du gra sgrig byas pa dang / 'thab 'dzing pa lo chung kha shas shig ched mngags nga tshor sne len zhu mkhan la bzhag 'dugazla ba 7pa'i ches 11nyin/ gza' lhag pa/zhogs par ru thog rdzong gi ser skya dpon rigs dang mjal 'phrad byas/mjal 'phrad byed mkhan gras su rdzong dpon gnyis dang 'go pa gsum/dgon sde'i mkhan po gnyis bcas khyon bsdoms mi bcu gcig 'dugakhong tshos dang thog nga tshor kha btags dang lag btags gnang rjes tshang ma bzhugs mol gnang / thon krang gis nga tsho ni krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku tshab zhus te bod rigs mi dmangs dang ser skya dpon rigs rnams la 'tshams 'dri zhu bar bcar ba yin pas de ring ched mngags 'dir bzhugs dpon rigs rnams dang mjal 'phrad zhus shing khyed tshor dka' ngal dang re ba gsungs dgos pa gang yod rung 'dir gsungs rogs gnang zhes gsungs song bas khong tshos gsham gsal gyi gnad don khag bton byung ba ste/1 mi dang phyugs rigs la nad gzhi mang la sman pa dkon pas sman pa kha shas gtong gnang yod pa'i re ba zhu rgyu/ 'dir rgyun du mthong rgyu yod pa'i nad gzhi gtso bo chu bsags pa dang / reg dug grum bu sogs yod pa red/da lo nad gzhi de rigs kyis mi drug bdun tsam shi song / phyugs nad gtso bo ni kha tsha rmig tsha dang ol cham sogs yod/ nye lam lo gcig gnyis nang than pa btang bar brten phyugs rigs kyi nad gzhi mang po langs nas ra lug phon chen shi ba dper na/ dgon par lug 〈000yod pa las 1000shi ba dang /320

rdzong la lug 400yod pa las 200shi ba/ cha snyoms byas na ma mo mngal chags gsum gyi nang nas gcig shor 'gro gi yod pa red/2 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho rtsam pa dang ja mi 'dang ba/ rdzong yongs kyi 'bru rigs thon 'bor des mi bzhi cha gcig la ma gtogs ldeng gi med/(mi grangs 1500) sa bon khal gcig nas thon 'bab che shos la khal 20thon pa dang / dma' shos la khal 6thon gyi yod/ cha snyoms khal 1rkyatsam las bsdu thub kyi med pas/ mi 'dang ba rnams rgya gar nas nang 'dren byed kyi yod pa red/ ja khag gcig lha sa nas nyo dgos/ 'on kyang gong tshad chen po yin stabs spyir btang gi mis nyo thub thabs med pa dang khag gcig rgya gar nas nang 'dren byed kyi yod pa de dag gong tshad cung khe tsam yod pas mi ser tshang mas rgya gar gyi ja nyo gi yod/ dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho ba ni mi ser las yag pa yod pa dang / dgon pas lo ltar grwa pa re la ru pis 100re sprod kyi yod pa (mi dmangs shog sgor 22) de'i nang nas grwa pa chos yag tsam yod pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba yang yag po yod/ de'i nye 'khor la da dung slong mkhan mi grangs 17rdzoyod pa red/ kho tsho slong mo slong ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni ngal rtsol nus shugs mi 'dang ba dang phyugs zog mi 'dang ba'i rkyen gyis yin/2 bal phyir tshong byed pa'i gnas tshul skor/ lug che shos nas bal rgya ma 2re thon gyi yod pas rgya ma re la ru pis 1re byed kyi yod/ ra spu dang ri dwags kyi khu lur rin gong mtho shos yin pas ra spu rgya ma re la mi dmangs shog sgor 2 2byed kyi yod pa dang / ri dwags kyi khu lu rgya ma re la mi dmangs shog sgor 14re byed kyi yod pa red ces bshad song /kho tshos bshad tshar pa'i rjes la thon krang nas gnad don de rigs nga tshos nges par du krung dbyang la snyan seng zhus te phyis su rim pas thag gcod 321

thub rgyu red ces lan 'debs gnang ba dang / de nas mi re la phyag rtags ras dang byi ril/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i dran rten rtags ma re bcas gnang /phyi dro dmag dpung la 'tshams 'dri byed par bskyod/ thon krang gis tshogs 'du'i thog krung dbyang gi sku tshab gnang nas dmag dpung la 'tshams 'dri gnang ba phud/ da dung dmag ud kyi spyi khyab chab srid pu'u yi kru'u ren gzhon pa kan si ci yi bka' slob mdzub ston gsum brgyud bsgrags kyang gnang ba ste/ 1 rgyun du dogs zon cher bskyed kyis mtha' mtshams srung skyob kyi las don yag po sgrub dgos pa/ 2 mi rigs mthun sgril gyi las don yag po gnyer dgos/ 2 mtha' srung las don dang mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs rkyen ma thebs pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og khag gcig gis thon skyed las don gnyer te 'tsho ba legs bcos gtong dgos pa bcas red/ tshogs 'du'i thog 'thab 'dzing pa re re la ma'o kru'u zhi'i dran rten rtags ma re gnang song / bod dmag khul khang dang bod kung ud kyi sku tshab krang rmin nas dmag khul khang dang kung ud kyi tshab zhus te dpon dmag tshor 'tshams 'dri gnang ba red/zla ba 7pa'i ches 12nyin/ gza' phur bu/'dir nyin shas bsdad cing gnam gshis ha cang dro po 'dug zhogs par stod gos rkyang ma gcig rang gyon na 'grig gi 'dug pas sa mtho'i dbyar dus thengs dang po myong ba'i tshor ba byung / 'on kyang de ring gnam gshis glo bur du grang mo chags song bas bal gyi stod gos gyon rung da dung 'khyags kyi 'dug zhogs zas tshar rjes dgon par 'gyed rgyag par phyin pas dgon pa'i khang pa ni grib bsil sha stag yin stabs ngas pags pa'i gyon pa lhob gon 322

nas ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma'i gos dar ser po zhig phul ba ma zad sku 'gyed (tshad gzhi dngul nā yang 2)phul/ 'on kyang kho tsho nang khul du rim pa'i dbye ba 'dug pas bla mar 'gyed skal 5thob pa dang / 'gan 'khur bar 'gyed skal 2re/ dbu mdzad la 'gyed skal 2bcas thob kyi 'dugabatsun ma rnams 'du khang nang chos mi klog par sgo 'gram du langs nas bsdad 'dug pas nga tsho log 'gro dus kho tshor sku 'gyed phul ba yin/ btsun ma de tsho mang che ba lo bcu lhag tsam las slebs mi 'dug sku 'gyed phul tshar ba'i rjes sne len khang der slebs skabs de ring dge 'dun phebs med pa de tshor khungs so so'i sku tshab la khong tsho'i skal ba sprad pa red/nga tsho dgon pa nas kha gyes te ri gsham du slebs rjes rdzong dpon gnyis dang mjal 'phrad byas pa yin/ nga tshos khong tshor ma'o kru'u zhis gnang ba'i dar cha dang phyag rtags phul ba dang phan tshun gleng mol byas pa yin/ gleng mol phran bu gnang ba'i nang thon krang gis slob grwar lta bar 'gro rgyu'i re ba bton song bas rdzong dpon gyis de mur phar phebs mi dgos par khong tsho tshur skad btang na 'grig ces gsungs song /yud tsam nas slob chung gi slob phrug lnga lag tu byang shing re 'khyer te yi ge bris pa dag nga tshor mig bstan pa dang kho tsho'i grub 'bras nga tshor snyan seng zhus byung / phru gu de tsho che shos lo bcu gnyis bcu gsum tsam yin pa dang /chung shos lo bdun brgyad red/ kho tshos gus zhabs ldan pa'i sgo nas nga tshor thugs rje che lugs dang phyis su slob sbyong la 'bad brtson bya rgyu yin lugs sogs khral khral ngag tu skyor gyi 'dug de nas thon krang nas kho tshor slob sbyong yag po byed dgos pa'i skul lcag dang bcas yig chas cha tshang re gnang song bas kho tsho dga' spro'i ngang phyir rgyugs phyin song /324

brgyab pa yin/ dbyar khar pags pa'i gos gyon pa de'ang sa mtho'i gnam gshis kyi khyad chos shig rang red/dgon pa ni ri gzar po zhig gi steng du chags 'dug bzo dbyibs dang chags stangs ni rtse pho brang dang 'dra bas rgyang ring nas lta skabs rtse pho brang chung chung zhig rang red snyam pa 'dug ri'i sked pa nas ri rtse bar gyi 'gro lam shin tu khag po 'dug ri rtser slebs skabs 'dam ra yongs rdzogs mig gi mdun du khra lhom mer mthong ba dang / der rtswa chu bzang la gnam gshis dro grang snyoms pas sa sbol byas pa yin na zhing khul legs po zhig chags rgyu red 'dugadagon par 'byor rjes bla ma ni 'brog khul du bsod snyoms zhu bar phebs nas bzhugs min 'dug kyang dgon pa'i las snes nga tshor sno len gnang zhing sne len gyi gsol ja bsubs ma dang / mngar mo/ ja thang bcas khag gsum 'dug dus mtshungs nga tshor dgon pa'i gnas tshul ngo sprod gnang byung / dgon pa de bzhengs nas lo lnga brgya 'das shing da cha dge 'dun pa bgres gzhon bsdoms 142yod pa dang / de'i nang btsun ma bcu lhag tsam tshud yod pa/ mig sngar dge 'dun mang che ba 'brog khul du chos 'don du phebs nas dgon pa'i nang sum cu bzhi bcu tsam las bzhugs mi 'dugang tshos dgon pa'i bla ma dang las sne/ dge bskos gnyis bcas so sor phyag rtags phul rjes 'du khang nang sku 'gyed 'bul bar phyin pas dge 'dun rnams tshogs gdan steng go rim ltar bzhugs nas zhal 'don mdzad bzhin par nga tshor gzigs kyi 'dug 'gan 'khur ba des nga tsho sne khrid nas 'du khang la nang skor zhig brgyab rjes dbu mdzad la kha btags phul ba dang / de 323

nga tsho khang pa'i nang skad cha bshad nas sdod skabs phyi log tu mi ser mang po slebs 'dug pas kho tshos yar 'dzul te sku tshab tshogs par dngul gnang rogs zer gyi 'dug der brten thon krang gis blo mthun wang ro han la kho tsho mi rer dngul nā yang re sprod dgos gsungs song bas skar ma bcu tsam zhig gi nang dwo yang 〈0tsam sprad tshar 'dug de nas nga tsho mnyam du lan pu'u la 'o/ga phyin/zla ba 7pa'i ches 12nyin/ gza' pa sangs/zhogs zas tshar rjes nga tsho dang lan tud kyi dpon dmag sku tshab tsho bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs pas dang thog lan gyi chab srid khrid ston pas gtam bshad byas song / khong gis gnad don bzhi gleng ba ste/dang po/ lan tud kyi sgrig 'dzugs skor/ lan tud de ni gsar du btsugs pa zhig yin pas las ka rtsag rtsig byed mkhan mi brgya cha 60yan zin gyi yod cing slob gso brgyab pa brgyud tshang mas mi dmangs kyi ched du byas rjes 'jog dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin gcig gyur byung yod/ na ning la rgyag skabs 'thab 'dzing pa gsar pa 'gro mi thub pa'i tshe na 'thab 'dzing pa rnying pa tshos rogs ram byed res byas pa red/ da cha ru thog rdzong du 'byor nas rim gong gis gnang ba'i las 'gan ni/ 1 rgya ma khri bcu bdun gyi skyel 'dren las 'gan legs grub dgos pa/ 2 sdod khang bzo bcos rgyag dgos pa/ 2 tshal rigs rang mkho rang thon byed dgos pa bcas red/ na ning zla ba bdun pa nas skyel 'dren byed 'go tshugs pas thog mar nyams myong mi 'dang bar g.yag grangs 400yug gcig tu ded nas phyin stabs g.yag phan tshun rdung res kyis gro zhib do po mang po rdol nas rgya ma 200tsam 'phro brlag tu phyin/325

thengs gnyis par gong gi nyams myong phyogs sdom byas nas mi gnyis res g.yag grangs 20re ded de so sor bskyod pas 'phro brlag 'gro tshad nyung du phyin pa ni the ngas dang por rgya ma 200yin pa nas thengs gnyis par rgya ma 1 5las 'phro brlag phyin med/ char zhod che ba'i dus su slebs kyang gur med cing rtswa thang steng zhag sdod byed dgos par brten 'thab 'dzing pa tshos gro zhib do po sbong dogs kyis rang gi char khebs phud de g.yogs kyi yod pa dang /dgong dro rtswa med sar 'byor skabs g.yag shor phyin te zhogs pa 'thab 'dzing pa tsho spyi le bcu lhag tsam gyi sar g.yag bskong bar 'gro dgos pa dang / de nas lam sang thon dgos stabs zhogs zas ni spyir btang 'gro gin 'gro gin du za dgos shing / 'thab 'dzing pa tshos de ltar dka' ngal khyad bsad dang thabs brgya jus stong gis zla ba bcu gcig pa'i zla mjug tu las 'gan legs grub byed thub pa byung ba red/gnyis pa/ ar rgyag tshal 'debs thad thog mar lag cha med pas tshang mas rang gi lag pa 'gul nas lag cha bzos mthar khyon bsdoms khang pa khang mig 12gsar rgyag byas pa red/ deng sang lo ltar tshal rigs rgya ma 52000bsdu thub pa ma zad/ pad tshal 'ga' shas rdog re re nas rgya ma 5 6re thon gyi yod pas sang lo'i zla ba gnyis pa bar tshal rigs za rgyu 'dang gi yod/gsum pa/ de lo nas bzung tshad ldan can gyi dmag don sbyong brdar dang chab srid slob sbyong byed 'go tshugs pa/bzhi pa/ mang tshogs las don thad/ mang tshogs la ston bsdu'i skabs las rogs dang / zam pa rgyag pa sogs byed kyi yod pas ngal rtsol nus shugs shor ba'i rgan rgon de tshos lo rgan da bar gson rung de lta bu'i dmag 326

dpung yag po zhig mthong ma myong zhes bsngags brjod byed kyi yod ces gsungs/chab srid khrid ston pas gtam bshad tshar rjes lan krang gzhon pas mu mthud gtam bshad gnang / blo mthun 'di ni lo rabs lnga bcu par bod la phebs pa'i gras shig yin pa dang / lan shog gnyis pa'i khongs mi rnying pa zhig kyang red/ der brten khong gis gtso bo 'das zin pa'i lo kha shas ring gi gnas tshul gsungs shing khong gis gsungs don/ lan shog gnyis pa rnying pa de ni 1kha51lor bod du bskyod pa zhig yin zhing / skabs de dus rim gong nas nga tshor gnang ba'i las 'gan gtso bo ni jag pa rtsa med bzo rgyu de red/ der brten khyon bsdoms mi 〈rkyayod pa de dag tshogs chung bzhi ru khag bgos byas rjes jag pa rtsa med bzo thub med rung 'bri g.yag 70lhag tsam dang / ra lug 2000lhag tsam dgra lag nas 'phrog thub pa red/ de nas nyin lnga tsam dgra bo rjes 'ded btang rung gar song ma shes pa dang khong tsho'i za chas kyang rdzogs par brten tshang ma phyir log byed rtsis byed pa'i skabs der glo bur du mi ser gyis dgra bo'i gnas tshul gsang skyel byas stabs nga tshos slar yang rgol rdung byas mthar ra lug kha000lhag tsam dang / me mda' sbag sbag 5 rnga mong 1ra rta 10bcas dgra lag nas tshur 'phrog de rjes nga tshos mi ser dbul po'i khyim tshang la phyugs zog khag gcig spras pas mang tshogs tshos bcings 'grol dmag med na nga tsho snga sa nas shi tshar ba red ces shod kyi 'dug dus de nas bzung khong tshos bcings 'grol dmag mi ni rang nyid kyi bu phrug dmag la brtsi bzhin yod/ dmag dpung nyin 1ratsam mdun skyod byas mthar ru thog rdzong du 'byor thub pa byung ba red/ skabs der rdzong srid gzhung jag pas bcom zin pas nga tshor rgol lan slog rogs zhes re ba 'don 327

gyi 'dug 'on kyang dgra bo ni rgya gar sa mtshams la slebs zin 'dug der brten nga tshos nyin mo gab bsdad pa dang mtshan la phar rgol byas par brten dgra lag nas me mda' ring mda' bcu lhag tsam dang rnga mong 105'phrog thub pa byung ba red/1952lo'i las 'gan gtso bo ni ar rgyag dang thon skyed gnyer rgyu de red/ lo hril po'i las 'gan ni 'bru mu'u 150'debs dgos pa dang / da dung tshal rigs mu'u 20'debs dgos pa de red/ thog mar nyams myong med pas gyong gun chen po byung / ston bsdu'i las ka mjug sgril rjes ar rgyag 'go tshugs pas sa phag khri bdun tsam brgyab nas khang pa khang mig 22gsar rgyag byed pa'i las ka'i nang byas rjes 'jog mkhan mang po byung yod/ 1952lor sa de ga'i rmo 'debs bya thabs spyad pa dang / zhin cang nas son 'bru dbor te mu'u 200btab pa ma zad da dung tshal rigs mu'u 20tsam btab pas mi ser gyi sa zhing las legs pa skyes thub pa byung ba red/1954lor bcu shog gnyis kyis khyon bsdoms 'bru rigs rgya ma khri 1ṭ+wāṃskyel 'dren byed pa'i las 'gan legs grub byung ba dang / mang tshogs tshor ring tshad le dbar 4 5tsam gyi chu yur zhig 'drus pa/ da dung mang tshogs la ston bsdu byed rogs byas pa/ rdzong srid gzhung la rta rwa gnyis brgyab pa/ de bzhin dgon par me shing dbor rogs sogs byas pa red/grub 'bras kyi skor gleng tshar rjes khong tshos da dung lhag bsdad pa'i gnad don dang re 'dun yang bton pa ste (1)rta dmag la zan rtswa mi 'dang ba/ 1rdzo52lor lo gcig rang la rta 100lhag tsam shi ba dang / da cha rta 5rang las lhag med pas bya spyod spel bar stabs bde po med/ (2)ru thog rdzong khongs su mtha' mtshams kyi 'gag sgo gsum yod pa nas mig sngar bkra 328

shis sgang dang gom pa bcu'i 'gag sgo gnyis po de srung ba las spang sgo lug gi 'gag sgo srung mkhan med/ der brten tshong pa zhig gis 1952lo nas snga rjes su me mda' dbor tshong byas te khyon bsdoms me mda' 12rdzong srid gzhung dang 'brog par btsongs pa red/ ( 2) 'thab 'dzing pa'i nang blo mthun rgan gras dang dar ma mang po yod rung dmag zhabs thims pa'i bya thabs lag bstar byas med rkyen mi khag gcig blo bde bag phebs med/ lan shog hril por mi grangs 92yod pa'i nang 1kha46lor dmag zhugs byas pa 6dang 1947lor dmag zhugs byas pa 7 194rdolor dmag zhugs byas pa 1〈 de min tshang ma 1rdzo49lor dmag zhugs byas pa sha stag song gshis bcu dpon nang lo grangs 20brgal ba mi 27yod pa red/ (4) mkho sprod mi 'dang ba dang dus thog tu 'byor mi thub pa/ da lo'i dbyar chas da dung 'byor med pa dang lo rer sring bal gyon chas cha re sprad pa des 'dang gi med/(5)slob sbyong bya rgyur dka' ngal yod pa/ da lo'i tshags par sang lo gzhi nas lta thub tsam las yong gi med pas re bar krung go gzhon nu'i tshags par cha tshang gcig dang sgra phab 'phrul 'khor gcig mkho sprod yod pa zhu/ (6)mtshon cha ha cang skyo po yin pa/ me mda' sbag sbag 9yod pa'i nang nas gnyis gsum la skyon yod pa dang / me mda' sbag sbag lci gras 2nang nas gcig la skyon shor ba/ me mda' khrung h+phung chang 49nang nas mi nyung ba zhig la skyon yod ces gsungs/khong tsho'i gtam bshad mjug sgril rjes thon krang nas bka' mol 'ga' shas gsungs te mtshams bzhag song / zla ba 7pa'i tshes 14nyin/ gza' spen pa/de ring ru thog nas kha gyes te dgun sar bskyod/ 'dir mang tshogs 329

dang dmag dpung mang po med rung nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor lan pu'u nas thon ma thag lam bar du dpung sde dang / mang tshogs/ grwa btsun/ ser skya dpon rigs bcas kyis dga' skyel byed pas ha cang 'khrug po 'dugasngon gyi 'char gzhi ltar na chu bo gang gā'i mdun la zhag sdod byed rtsis yod stabs lam thag spyi le 140bskyod pa red/nga tsho rdog thon byed skabs pe cin chu tshod bcu dang phyed ka zin 'dug pas tshang mar mgyogs po 'gro rgyu'i sems shugs yod rung stabs mi legs pa zhig la chu tshod kha shas phyin rjes bye ri dang 'phrad nas rlangs 'khor 'gro mi thub par brten tshang mas mar babs te 'bud rgyag brgyab rogs byas/ 'on kyang gom pa kha shas shig bskyod ma thag slar yang bye phung dang 'phrad nas 'khor lo gnyis ha lam bye ma'i nang du dim/ mis nus shugs yod rgus 'bud 'ded brgyab rung phan pa ma byung / de nas 'khor lo'i khrid kyi bye sa bshangs rjes rdo rtsab brgyab pa dang rlangs 'khor chen mos mdun nas 'then pa/ mis rgyab log nas 'bud 'ded gtong ba bcas byas mthar 'don thub tsam byung / de nas mu mthud mdun skyod byed rtsis byed skabs yang mdun gyi rlangs 'khor zhig bye ma'i nang dim nas 'gro ma thub par lus 'dug mgyogs po rlangs 'khor che ba des 'then par yong rogs zhes lan 'byor/ de mur nga tsho rlangs 'khor lus pa der bskyod nas rlangs 'khor de 'then rjes mu mthud mdun skyod byas/ bde blag ngang chu tshod gnyis tsam bskyod rjes yid du 'ong ba'i 'dam rwa zhig gi mdun du slobs/ nga tsho'i bsam par da ni lam ha cang 'gro bde po zhig yong rgyu red snyam bzhin pa'i skabs der mdun gyi rlangs 'khor gnyis 'gro mi thub par gyur/ mar babs te lta dus rlangs 'khor gyi 'khor lo dag 'dam rdzab nang lhungs 'dug de nas tshang mas chu tshod gcig tsam ring 330

dka' las brgyab mthar rlangs 'khor de 'dam rdzab las 'don thub tsam byung / de nas lam phran bu'i yag tu phyin song / yang yud tsam nas rlangs 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i phyi pags brdol ba dang / yang skabs re rlangs 'khor chung chung gi 'khor lo 'gul mi thub pa/ yang chu sgrol rjes rlangs 'khor gyen du 'gro mi thub pa sogs kyi gnas tshul rgyun mi chad par thon gyi 'dug glo bur du char pa babs pa dang me shing yang rdzogs tshar 'dug pas lam bar zhag sdod mi byed dka' med la zhag sdod byed yul de'ang chu bo gang gā dang rgyang thag spyi le 50yod pa'i 'dam rwa skyid po zhig 'dug der mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4skyu50zin gyi 'dug de'i nye 'khor du 'brog pa dud tshang kha shas gnas shing / phyugs rigs dkar nag khyu dang khyu 'tsho bzhin 'dugargyang ring la bltas tshe khang pa zhig 'dug pa de rgyus mnga' yod pa'i mis rta khal gyi sa tshigs shig red zer gyi 'dug 'on kyang lam bde po med pa dang rlangs 'khor yang 'gro mi thub par brten nga tsho sa de rang du zhag sdod byed dgos byung /zla ba 7pa'i ches 16nyin/ gza' zla ba/chu bo gang gā nas kha gyes te spyi le 20song rjes rlangs 'khor dag rong sa'i nang 'gro dgos kyi 'dug rong sa'i lho ngos ni lo hril po gangs kyis bklubs pa'i ri bo he ma la ya yin pa dang / byang ngos ni brjid chags pa'i gangs te se red/ ri bo de gnyis ni 'dzam gling thog skad grags yod pa'i ri bo'i gras shig yin/nyin gung kha lag zas tshar rjes mu mthud spyi le 20yas mas bskyod mtshams mdun phyogs nas rlangs 'khor chen po zhig yong ba mthong gi 'dug331

tshang mas ma gros gcig mthun gyi sgo nas nga tsho bsu rmakhan slebs byung zhes 'bod cing gyon chas legs bcos byed pa dang / rlangs 'khor las babs te khong tsho dang thug khong tsho ni nga tsho bsu bar phebs mkhan kung ud kyi 'go khrid blo mthun dang dmag dpung gi 'go khrid blo mthun sha stag red/ blo mthun chi rmin nas nga tshor re re bzhin ngo sprod gnang ba brgyud phan tshun gleng mol zhus/ de nas kung ud kyi hru'u cis nga tshor de ring ni dgun sa'i las rigs khag gis nga tshor dga' bsu'i gra sgrig tshar 'dug pas nga tsho dgun sar 'byor ba byed dgos zhes gsungs kyi 'dug de mur thon krang nas mdun gyi chu yod sar tshang ma ngal gso dang sbrags gra sgrig rags tsam byas te dgun sar bskyod dgos gsungs/ngal gso rgyag sa'i sa cha der khang pa gog po zhig yod pa de'i nang sdod mkhan med pa dang mtha' 'khor du lci ba brtsigs 'dug pa ma zad da dung me thab gnyis 'dug nga tshos der gyon chas brjes pa dang gtsang sbra byas te mu mthud mdun skyod byas pa yin/ de nas yud tsam song rjes sne len zhu mkhan yod sar slebs byung bas sgar dpon gnyis dang (nang sa'i kron yon dang rim pa 'dra ba ) phan tshun kha btags sgron res dang bcas mjal 'phrad byung /de nas gur nang ngal gso phran bu brgyab nas dgong dro sa srib tsam la nga tsho chu brgal te kung ud dang dmag dpung gnas yul du slebs skabs gyang steng du skar lnga'i dar dmar dang gtso 'dzin gyi sku par yod pa'i dar tshon btsugs yod pa dag rlung gis lhab lhub tu g.yo zhing dga' bsu zhu mkhan gyi mi rnams lam g.yas g.yon du langs nas bsdad 'dug nga tsho rlangs 'khor nas thon ma thag bod rigs blo mthun pho mo bcu grangs kyis lag tu me tog sna tshogs 'khyer te nga tshor sprad nas 'tshams 'dri gnang ba dang / de bzhin mnga' ris 332

kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang / sprul sku/ grwa pa/ mi ser bcas kyis 'tshang kha shig shig gi sgo nas nga tshor kha btags g.yogs byung / skabs der gang sar rnga brdung dar 'phyar dang / dga' bsu zhu ba'i thal mo'i deb sgra/ glu gar gyi sgra dang dgod sgra bcas kyis khyab cing / 'dzam gling yang rtse'i 'jam thing gi rnam pa yongs su yal bar gyur/zla ba 7pa'i ches 17nyin/ gza' mig dmar/sku tshab tshogs pas dpon rigs 'go pa dang mjal 'phrad gnang / de ring sgar dpon gnyis dang 'go pa bcu lhag tsam/ de bzhin zhing 'brog gi 'thus mi bcas tshogs 'dur 'byor 'dug dang thog sgar dpon nas gsung bshad gnang song / khong gis bcings 'grol dmag mi phebs pa nas bzung nga tshor phan thogs ha cang chen po 'dug dper na/ de snga ja lor rin gong sgor 17byed kyi yod rung da cha sgor 12las sprod dgos kyi med/ de snga mang tshogs kyis dngos zog dbor ba'i gla cha ha cang dma' po red/ da cha mtho ru phyin yod pas de ring mnga' ris su 'brog pa mang che bas srid gzhung nas 'bru rigs mang tsam dbor gnang yod pa zhu zhes re ba 'don gyi yod ces gsungs/khong gi gtam bshad tshar rjes 'go pa tshos snga rjes su yar langs nas bsam 'char mang po bshad song / phyogs sgrig byas na gsham gsal gyi khag 'ga' zhig ste/1 srid gzhung nas 'bru rigs dang / ras/ ja bcas mang tsam dbor 'dren gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu rgyu/ de'ang mnga' ris kyi mang tshogs rnams phyin chad rgya gar gyi tshong pa'i lag nas de rigs nyo mi dgos pa yong rgyu/ 2 de snga rgya gar gyi tshong pa'i lag nas dngul bun g.yar dgos par brten re bar 333

phyin chad nga tsho rang gi dngul khang nas g.yar chog pa ma zad tshang mar gcig gyur gyi lta stangs 'dzin thub pa gnang rgyu/ 2 chus 'ga' re'i 'thus mis skyel 'dren las 'gan lji drags pas phran bu'i yang du gtong rgyu'i re ba bton pa ma zad sngon gyi lugs srol ltar na 'bri g.yag 10ded na gzhi nas ded mkhan mi la gla cha sprod kyi yod/ don dngos thog 'bri g.yag gnyis gsum ded kyang gang ltar mi gcig 'gro dgos pas phyin chad mi phyin tshad tshang mar gla cha gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu rgyu/ gzhan yang skyel 'dren las 'gan bgo skabs dbul phyug 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / tha na dbul por de bas lci ba yod pa de ni dbyin ji srid gzhung gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i lugs srol rnying pa zhig yin pas re bar bsgyur bcos gnang rogs zhu rgyu bcas red/gong gsal gyi bsam 'char la bltas tshe sgar dpon yod stabs 'go pa tshos bsam 'char shod skabs 'dzem zon phran bu byed kyi yod bzo 'dugade'i khar skad sgyur bas kyang cha tshang bsgyur thub yod bzo mi 'dug 'on kyang mang tshogs ni tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung la yid ches byed par brten khong tshos kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi gnad don rnams blo khog chen pos 'don gyi yod pa red/ phyogs gzhan zhig la kho tshos dbyin ji srid gzhung gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i bshu gzhog lam lugs dag bsgyur bcos gtong dgos pa'i re ba bton pa dang / de bzhin dpal 'byor thad btsan rgyal ring lugs dang 'brel ba yongs su gtsang gcod dgos pa'i re ba yang 'don gyi yod/mdor na/ gral rim gyi 'gal zla des mi rigs kyi 'gal zla'i bar mtshams yongs su gtor ba dang / btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi bsam blo yang dpal 'byor lam lugs gnyis po bsdur ba'i khrod rim bzhin go rtogs sel thub pa yong gi yod/ der brten mig sngar 'di ga'i las kar do nan gyi sgo 334

nas yar rgyas 'gro dgos pa ste/ phyogs gcig nas bcos bsgyur gyi gra sgrig dril bsgrags byed dgos pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas zhin cang nas bod dbar gyi gzhung lam dang nag chu nas mnga' ris dbar gyi gzhung lam myur bar shar gtong thub pa bya rgyu/ de bzhin tshong don dang 'phrod bsten las khungs rgya bskyed du btang ste mu methud nas tshong don dang rig slob 'phrod bsten las don khyab spel gtong dgos pa ma zad/ las ka de dag byas pa brgyud gom gang mdun spos kyis mi rigs kyi 'gal zla sel ba dang mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong / mang tshogs skul slong bcas byas te bcos bsgyur bya rgyu'i thad la cha rkyen bzang po skrun thub pa byed dgos/zla ba 7pa'i tshes 1/nyin/ gza' lhag pa/zhogs par 'tshams 'dri'i tshogs chen 'tshogs nas kung ud kyi las don mi sna yongs la 'tshams 'dri zhus pa red/phyi dro las byed pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs shing las byed pa sum cu lhag tsam gyis las rigs khag dang / rim pa khag gi mi sna'i tshab zhus te tshogs 'dur zhugs yod/ tshogs 'du'i thog gtam bshad gnang mkhan tshos 'tshang kha shig shig gis gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi dgongs 'char mang po bton gnang ba dang dus mtshungs las ka'i nang mi 'dang ba'i cha mi nyung ba zhig kyang bton gnang song /zla ba 7pa'i ches 19nyin/ gza' phur bha /zhogs par chu tshod bcu gcig yas mas tsam la 'di gar bsdad pa'i blo mthun tsho thon krang dang mnyam du 'di ga'i dngul khang dang yan lag dpung 335

sde'i 'phrod bsten so'o/ kung ud kyi 'phrod bsten so'o/ phyugs rigs sman khang / glog 'phrin cus sogs khe las dang bya gzhag las don tshan pa khag la lta skor byed par bskyod/ tshan pa de dag ni 'grim 'grul bar chad dang /las byed mi sna dkon pa/ sgrig chas zhan pa bcas kyi rkyen pas las don 'thus tshang zhig khyab spel gtong thub mi 'dugadagong dro mu mthud las byed pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du tshogs pas gtam bshad gnang mkhan de bas mang po yod pa ma zad gnad don dang bsam 'char bton pa de tsho yang kha gsal la rno ngar che ba zhig 'dug phyogs bsdus byas na gsham gsal gyi khag 'ga' zhig ste/dang po/ mdzad phyogs srid jus thad/ spyi'i cha nas bshad na 'di gar tang gi mtha' mtshams khul dang mi rigs sa khul gyi mdzad phyogs ni de bas do nan zab skyod byed dgos pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang mnga' ris sa khul du gang 'dra byas te lag bstar byed phyogs skor la zhib phra'i zhib 'jug byas med pa dang / las byed pa la'ang slob gso kha gsal gtong rgyu mi 'dang bar brten las ka'i nang 'phel med rang gnas su lus pa'i snang tshul chags yod/ 'go khrid dang las byed pas mi rigs srid jus dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las ka bcas la nan tan gyis slob sbyong bya rgyu mi 'dang ba'i rkyen gyis sgar dpon gnyis la brtsi 'jog mi byed pa dang / sems rtsa 'khol po med pa/gnad don 'phrad skabs khong tsho dang gros mol mi byed pa/ mang tshogs la gshe gshe dang nyes rdung btang ba'i gnas tshul thon yod/gnyis pa/ las byed pa'i las ka'i skor/1 bsam blo'i 'go khrid mi 'dang ba/ mdzad phyogs srid jus dang /chab srid kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs/ bsam blo'i 'du shes/ las ka'i spyod 336

tshul dang 'tsho ba'i spyod tshul sogs kyi thad la slob gso gtong rgyu mi 'dang bar brten srid jus 'khrul ba dang / las kar sems mi gnas pa/ sgrig 'dzugs sgrig lam thad mthun sgril med pa tshabs che'i rang mos ring lugs kyi lta ba gnas yod pa red/2 las byed pa gso skyong bya rgyu'i thad 'char gzhi mi 'dang ba dang las byed pa gnas spar byed phyogs thad blo khog chen po med pa/ rtsa don gzhir bzung las ka byed kyi med pa/ mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char nyan 'jog mi byed par rang gi ngo dga' phyogs shes kho na byed pa/ lhag don mi rigs las byed pa dang bud med las byed pa rnams nan tan dang ngang rgyud ring pos gso skyong mi byed pa ma zad mthong chung gi rnam pa ldan yod pa ste/ bud med las byed pa 'ga' zhig nyes med du go gnas phab pa sogs kyi gnas tshul byung yod pa red/2 mes rgyal nang sa dang lha sa bcas la re mos kyis zab sbyong byed par btang nas las byed pa'i chab srid bsam blo'i chu tshad dang ched las kyi chu tshad gong mthor gtong thub pa bya rgyu dang / gung seng lam lugs lag bstar bya rgyu/rig gnas dang rol rtsed kyi yo byad nyo rgyu bcas la shugs snon rgyag rgyu'i re ba bton pa dang / tshags par dus deb la sogs pa lo gcig phyin rjes gzhi nas cha mi tshang ba khag gcig 'byor ba tsam las de min chab srid slob sbyong bya rgyu'i rgyu cha gang yang med pa'i dka' ngal bshad song /gsum pa/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren dang dngos rdzas mkho sprod kyi skor/bod dang zhin cang dbar gyi gzhung lam dang mnga' ris dang nag chu'i dbar gyi gzhung lam gnyis mgyogs myur bzo skrun byas te las byed pa dang mang tshogs la dngos po dus thog tu mkho sprod thub pa byed dgos/ mig sngar gnad don tshabs che shos shig ni mang tshogs kyi bza' 'bru mi 'dang ba de yin 337

zhing / sa khul gnyis tsam la 'bru rigs rdzogs te mang tshogs rnams g.yag dang lug bsad nas shas grod pa rgyags pa byed kyi yod/ las byed pa khag gcig la 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dus thog tu skyel ma thub pas dgun kha dbyar chas gyon dgos pa dang dbyar kha dgun chas gyon dgos pa'i gnas tshul thon gyi yod pa red/ bza' cha'i rigs nyung la bcud mi ldang ba dang / na tsha mang ba/ tha na shog bu tsam yang nyo sa med pa/ skra bzhar khang dang 'tshem khang med stabs skra bzhar mi thub la gyon chas kyang 'tshem mi thub/bzhi pa/ dmag shugs la shugs snon brgyab ste rgyal srung gi stobs shugs che ru gtong dgos pa'i skor/mnga' ris sa khul rgyud la rgyal srung mtha' mtshams le dbar stong phrag gnyis tsam gyi sa srung las 'gan yod cing / phyi phyogs sgo mo phye ba'i 'gag sgo mang po yod pa dang / sgo mo ma phye ba'i 'gag sgo de bas mang po yod par brten gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing chen po yod/ da dung dmag shugs mi 'dang ba dang las byed pa nyung drags pa'i gnas tshul yang lhags bsdad yod pa red/lnga pa/ las khungs 'thus tshang rgya bskyed du gtong dgos pa dang dgos nges kyi las khungs gsar 'dzugs byed dgos pa'i skor/(1) sngar yod kyi dngul khang dang / tshong don/ 'phrod bsten/ phyi 'brel/ phyugs rigs sman khang sogs kyi sde tshan la las byed pa mi 'dang ba dang sgrig chas skyo ba bcas kyis rkyen pas las don mang po dngos su khyab spel gtong thabs med pa dper na/ dngul khang la cha mtshon na/ las byed pa'i dngos 'grul gtong ba dang dngul bcol/ de bzhin phyi rgyal gyi dngul brjes dang zhing 'brog khul du dngul bun gtong rgyu tsam las gzhan bya yul med pa/tshong don thad gtso bo dmag dpung dang sa gnas kyi las byed par dngos rdzas 338

khag gcig mkho sprod bya rgyu tsam yin pa dang / 'phrod bsten bya gzhag thad de bas cha rkyen zhan zhing / sman pa gcig rang las med pa dang stuglog par rgyag chas gcig kyang med/ 'dir glog 'phrin yod pa las yig zam med pas lo gnyis nang gzhi nas mes rgyal nang sa dang yig 'grul thengs re las byed thub kyi med/ mdor na/ mig sngar sde tshan de dag gis dmag dpung dang las khungs mi snar zhabs zhu bya rgyu yang yag po yong gi med pas mang tshogs la zhabs zhu zer ba ni ha cang gi rgyang thag ring po zhig red/ 'on kyang las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyis mu mthud zhabs zhu de dag yag po yong rgyu'i re sgug byed kyi yod pas phyi rol yul gyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa byas te mgyogs myur sngar yod kyi sde tshan de dag 'thus sgo tshang du gtong dgos pa ma zad rim bzhin sgrig gzhi gsar pa gsar 'dzugs byed dgos/ de'ang lte gnas grong khyer zhig 'dzugs rgyur bsam gzhigs byed dgos nges la sa cha'i gnas bab kyang sgar thog la byas na legs/ khul der dgra bor 'thab rtsod bya rgyu'i ngos nas bltas na'ang 'dra phyi phyogs tshong don byed phyogs sam 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las ka sogs (sgar dpon gnyis gnas sdod ) gang ci'i thad nas cha rkyen tshang ma sa cha gzhan las 'dzoms pa yod/(2)rdzong gtso che ba kha shas te spu hreng dang / ru thog sogs la nges par du rgyun ldan gyi las don tshogs chung 'dzugs dgos/(2)rdzong gtso che khag la slob grwa 'dzugs dgos pa dang yan lag kung ud la mi rigs las byed pa zab sbyong byed pa'i 'dzin grwa btsugs te las byed pa 'bor chen gso skyong byed dgos/(4)'brog rwa gcig gnyis shig btsugs te 'brog las kyi tshod lta'i rwa ba gnyer thub pa byas nas mang tshogs kyi zhing 'brog thon skyed la dpe ston nus 339

pa 'don thabs byed dgos pa dang / phyugs rigs sman pa'i 'gog bcos ru khag 'dzugs dgos/gong gsal gyi bsam 'char la bltas na kho bo'i bsam par sku tshab tshogs pas nges par du kung ud dang zhib 'jug gang legs byas te kung ud kyi bsam blo'i gnad don thag gcod gang thub byed thub pa zhig byung na yag po 'dug snyam pa ma zad/ tshong don dang / dngul khang / 'grim 'grul yig zam/ rig gnas slob gso 'phrod bsten/ dgra phyogs la 'thab rtsod bya thabs/ spyi tshogs bcos bsgyur bya rgyu sogs kyi gnad don thad mu mthud 'brel yod sde tshan sgrig 'dzugs kyis snyan seng dang zhib 'jug byas te bsam 'char gal chen bton nas bod kung ud la dpyad gzhir 'bul ba'am yang na krung dbyang la snyan seng zhu ba bcas byas na nga tsho da res yong ba'i dgos pa stong zad du mi 'gro snyam pa byung /zla ba 7pa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' pa sangs/zhogs par 'tshams 'dri'i tshogs chen skong tshogs kyis mnga' ris rta dmag yan lag ru khag gi dpon dmag tshor 'tshams 'dri zhus pa dang /tshogs 'du'i thog ngas mi rigs khag gi 'thus mi'i tshab zhus te gtam bshad byas/nyin gung dmag dpon dang 'thab 'dzing pa'i sku tshab pa rnams bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ tshogs zhugs sku tshab pas gsham gsal gyi bsam 'char bton pa ste/dang po/ drag chas kyi gnad don skor/1 drag chas 'dang gi med la bzo lta gcig gyur med pa dang / kha tshad 340

'dra min sna tshogs yod pa ma zad/ tshang ma rnying pa sha stag yin pa/ rdzas mdel kha gsab bya rgyur dka' ngal yod pa bcas la brten sbyong brdar byed bde po med cing / khyon yongs kyi dmag grabs la shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod/2 'phrin gtong gi yo chas mi 'dang ba/ mig sngar 'gag sgo lnga'i nang nas 'gag sgo gnyis la glog 'phrin yo chas yod pa las de min la 'dang gi med/ der brten stabs shin tu mi bde ba ma zad/ skabs 'gar 'gag sgor gnad don yod pa phyi 'brel pu'u nas tar btang yong ste rtsad zhib byed skabs dmag dpung gis da dung shes kyi med pa red/2 rta nyung drag pa/ ming du rta dmag ru khag thob pa tsam las don dngos thog rta 20tsam las med/ der yang gzan chag 'dang gi med/dgun kha rta rnams rtswa za rgyu med stabs shi sla zhing / rta med na las 'gan legs grub bya rgyur dka' ngal yod pa ma zad/ mang tshogs kyi khur po lci ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ nan cang nas rta khag gcig kha snon byas yod rung / de dag mang che ba na rgan dang gzugs po skyon can sha stag song stabs gnad don mi nyung ba zhig lhags kyi yod/4 gyon chas kha gsab dus thog tu 'byor thub kyi med la yod pa rnams kyang ha cang gzhi mtshungs med pa ste/ mi rigs kyi gyon chas dang / rta dmag gi gyon chas/ rkang dmag gi gyon chas sogs yod/ gyon chas 'byor rung zhwa mo ma 'byor ba sogs kyi gnad don lhags kyi yod pas dmag dpung gi gcig gyur la gnod pa dang / gzhan yang 'jur ta ni spyi khyab tshan mu'u pu'u yi gcig gyur dgongs don la nag po gyon dgos pa'i bka' yod kyang 'dir sprad pa tshang ma ser po sha stag yin/ gnyis pa/ mi don sgrig gzhi'i gnad don skor/341

mig snga'i rnam par bltas tshe khyon yongs nas sgrig gzhi rgya bskyed du gtong dgos/ de 'dra byung na gzhi nas las 'gan legs grub byed thub/rgyal srung gi mtha' mtshams le dbar 1000tsam dang 'gag sgo che chung 20lhag tsam yod pa nas da cha dngos su srung ba 'gag sgo 5las med/ der brten nges par du lan shog gsum tsam kha snon gsar 'dzugs byed dgos/da yod lan shog nang mi grangs gsum cha gcig tsam chad pa de dag kyang nges par du kha gsab byed dgos/gsum pa/ gang mgyogs sngon la gzhung lam shar bskyod thub pa byed dgos ste/ nag chu nas mnga' ris bar dang / zhin cang nas lan kro'u bar gyi gzhung lam dus thung nang shar bskyod thub pa byed dgos pa/bzhi pa/ mkho sprod thad zang zing gi rnam pa thon gyi yod pa/phag sha dang sran ser la sogs pa 'char gzhi med par 'bor chen dbor yong gi yod pa dang / 'char gzhi ltar gong la snyan seng zhus pa'i dngos rdzas khag gcig ni grangs tshad bzhin mkho sprod byed thub kyi med/ gal srid dngos rdzas la skyon shor tshe bzo bcos byed pa'i rin gong gzhung la rtsis rgyag sa med pa dang / gla phogs lam lugs lag bstar byas rjes zog gong he bag longs spyod bya rgyu med pa red/ gong rim gyi rgyu mtshan ni sa gnas kyi kha gsab thob thang yod tshe dngos rdzas rin gong he bag gi thob thang longs spyod bya rgyu med ces pa de yin/ re bar tshal rigs mang tsam dbor gnang yod pa zhu rgyu dang yag shos la mkho sprod 'brel ba de bod du bsgyur thub pa gnang rogs zhu rgyu/lnga pa/ dmag sgar dang mdzod khang gsar 'dzugs byed dgos/drug pa/ las byed pa dang 'thab 'dzing pa'i slob sbyong gi gnad don 342

skor/ las byed pas rigs pa'i gzhung lugs slob sbyong bya rgyu dang 'thab 'dzing pas rig gnas slob sbyong byed phyogs thad slob deb dang dge rgan mi 'dang bar brten dngos gzhi'i slob sbyong bya thabs bral/ re bar gong rim dbu khrid nas de'i thad thugs 'khur gnang ste 'char bkod nang tshud pa byas nas go rim ldan pa'i sgo nas slob sbyong byed par gtong gnang yod pa zhu rgyu ma zad/ slob deb dang dge rgan mi 'dang ba'i gnad don yang thag gcod thub pa gnang rogs zhu rgyu/bdun pa/ phyusas rigs sman pa'i gnad don skor/ mig sngar phyugs rigs sman pa gnyis las med pas nges par du kha snon rgyag dgos/ 'phrod bsten ru khag gi mi sna nyung ba dang sgrig chas zhan po yin pas re bar pe cin nas khog nad sman pa gcig dang phyi bcos sman pa gcig 'di gar dpe ston las ka byed par gtong rogs zhu rgyu/ gzhan yang / smoglog par 'phrul chas chung gras shig dang bshags bcos yo chas/ dug 'gog gdong 'bag sogs sgrig sbyor thub pa zhu rgyu/ da dung so nad sman pa zhig kyang gtong gnang yod pa zhu rgyu ma zad/ sman khang chung chung zhig 'dzugs rogs zhu rgyu/brgyad pa/ phan bde'i thob thang skor/ dmag dpon tshor gung seng lam lugs yod rung 'dir las tshab byed mkhan med rkyen gung seng gtong longs med/ de min dmag dpon rnams la za khang zhig 'dzugs rogs gnang zhu rgyu/dgu pa/ de min gnad don skor/1 skyel 'dren stobs shugs rgya cher gtong dgos/ mig sngar g.yag 70dang rnga mong 40las med/ mi re la cha snyoms byas na rta re yang thob kyi med pas bed spyod bya rgyur 'dang gi med pa red/343

2 sa gnas kyi las byed pa'i thob thang dmag dpung las ldab grenyis tsam gyi mtho ba yod/ gzhan yang dmag mi rnying pa mang po yod pas dmag zhugs thims nas nang la log rgyu'i re 'dun byed kyi yod ces bton/zla ba 7pa'i ches 25nyin/ gza' lhag pa/de ring dbyar sa nas kha gyes te dgun sar log pa dang 'gro khar grong mi yongs rdzogs bskong nas mi re la 'tshams 'dri'i dod du dngul dwo yang re sprad/thon krang nas las ka 'di nga la bkod sgrig gnang byung bas de ring 'dir 'byor ba'i khrod pho mo rgan gzhon dang tha na phru gu dmar 'byar bcas tshang ma bsdoms na mi grangs 170lhag tsam 'dug 'dir ma slebs pa tshor 'go pas tshab len byas nas do bdag la sprod rgyu byas pa red/ dngul sprad tshar rjes nad pa tshor nga tsho'i sman pas na tsha lta ba sogs byas pas mang tshogs tsho ha cang dga' po byung song /zla ba 7pa'i ches 27nyin/ gza' pa sangs/spu hreng rdzong du 'tshams 'dri byed par 'gro rgyu ni skutshotshab tshogs pa'i 'di ga'i mtha' mjug gi las 'gan de red/ rdzong der phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed par dus yun zla phyed tsam 'gor gyi yod pas thon krang wang lags sku gzugs thang po rang med pa'i rkyen gyis dgun sar rang 'jags bzhugs rgyu byas pa dang / hre pang kre dang / wang ra'o han/ nga bcas nga tsho mi gsum rdzong der bskyod rgyu byas pa yin/ rta dmag yan lag ru khag gi ru dpon dang nga tsho mnyam du bskyod rgyu red/de ring dngos su rdog thon byas nas rnga mong 10lhag tsam khrid yod 344

stabs lam bar mgyogs myur 'gro thub med/ de nas do po mngon chung la zhag sdod byas/ der mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4200tsam slebs 'dugazla ba 7pa'i ches 29nyin/ gza' nyi ma/lam thag ring zhing rnga mong rnams 'gro khag pas rnga mong ru khag zhogs pa chu tshod brgyad par thon rgyu dang / rta pa rnams chu tshod dgu par thon rgyu thag chod nas tshang ma chu tshod bdun par langs te 'gro rtsis byas/blo mthun gnyis sngon la chu sogs bskol rgyu'i gra sgrig byed par btang /'on kyang kho tsho mdun du thal drags thag chod 'dug pas rgyang thag le dbar 40sar bskyod rung da dung mthong rgyu mi 'dug par brten tshang ma bskyod mtshams bzhag ste nyin gung kha lag zas nas bsdad/kha lag zas tshar rjes yang le dbar 40tsam bskyod pas bar rir 'byor/ bar ri zhes pa'i don ni dkyil kyi don te/ de'ang spu hreng rdzong la bskyod rgyu'i lam gyi bar mtshams te dkyil tag tag la 'khel ba yin/ sa 'dir mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4450yod pa dang / rtswa chu 'dzoms shing yid du 'ong ba'i 'bros/ rwa zhig yin pas gang sar g.yag lug 'tsho ba'i mi ser mang po mthong rgyu 'dugazla ba 7pa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' zla ba/de ring le dbar rdo0tsam bskyod mthar mon tsher zhag sdod byas/ sa 'di gar mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 42kya0tsam slebs kyi 'duga'adir bong sa gnas srid gzhung gis btsugs pa'i 'grim 'grul 'bab tshugs this yod pas de ni ched mngags 'gro 'ong byed mkhan gyi dpon rigs la 345

zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan red/ de'i 'go pa ni lha sa nas btang ba zhig yin/sgar dpon gyis snga sa nas kho tshor nga tsho sa de brgyud nas 'gro gi yod pa'i brda tho btang 'dug pas 'go pa khag dang mang tshogs tsho gcig bsdus kyis sa 'dir nga tsho sgugs bsdad 'dug kho tshos nga tsho yong ba mthong skabs nga tsho'i sar yong nas sne len byas pa dang sbrags nga tshor lug gcig dang / ja bsrubs ma/ 'o ma sogs skyel byung / nga tshos kho tsho mi re la lag rtags re sprad pa ma zad da dung lug der khrom gyi gong tshad ltar dngul bzhag pa yin/dgong mo mang tshogs dbul phongs tsho mi re la dngul nā yang re sprad pa dang / blo mthun wang ra'o han nas 'tshams 'dri'i gsung bshad gnang song /zla ba 7pa'i ches 21nyin/ gza' mig dmar/mon tshe nas bar ga bar lam thag le dbar 1rkya0tsam yod pas nga tshos nyin gnyis la 'byor ba 'gro rgyu byas/ de ring lam phyed tag tag bskyod nas zhag sdod byas/ 'dir mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4500tsam 'dugazla ba rapa'i ches 1nyin/ gza' lhag pa/de ring nyin gang gangs te se'i ri gsham nas mdun bskyod byas/gangs ri 'di ni rgyang ring nas bltas tshe ri rtse ni sgor mo'i dbyibs dang 'dra zhing lo hril por gangs kyis g.yogs pa zhig yin pas bod rigs mi dmangs tshos ‘‘gangs rin po che ’’zhes gnas ri rtsa chen zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dug lo ltar bod zla 4tshes 15nas bod zla rdopa bar gnas mjal yong mkhan rdzogs med yod pa red zer gyi 'dug de'i nang mtsho sngon dang mdo khams/ sog po/ rgya gar/ bal yul sogs rgyang ring nas yong mkhan yang 346

yod pa red zer gyi 'dugale dbar rdo0sar bskyod pas bar ga ru 'byor/ bod gzhung gis sa 'dir skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs shig btsugs yod pas rang re'i rta dmag yan lag ru khag gi skyel 'dren ru khag gcig kyang sa 'dir bca' sdod byas yod/ nga tsho sa der 'byor ma thag rang re'i dmag dpung dang sa de ga'i 'go pa tshos sne len byas byung bas nga tshos sngar rgyun ltar 'go par mjal 'phrad dang / phyag rtags/ dmag dpung dang mang tshogs la 'tshams 'dri bcas byas pa yin/zla ba 〈pa'i ches 4nyin/ gza' spen pa/pe cin dus tshod kyi phyi dro chu tshod gsum par 'brel gtugs byed mkhan gyis dga' bsu'i tshogs chen gra sgrig grub song bas nga tsho lam sang phebs rogs zhes snyan seng 'byor/ nga tshos dar cha'i sne khrid 'og tshogs rwa yod sar bskyod pas yud tsam song rjes rdzong dpon dang ser skya dpon rigs tshos phebs bsur 'ong nas kha btags g.yogs gnang ba dang phan tshun phyag gtong res byas/ de nas kho tshos nga tshor gra sgrig byas pa'i rta la bzhon nas tshogs rwar 'dzul/ mang tshogs drug brgya bdun brgya tsam lam g.yas g.yon du bsdad nas nga tshor dga' bsu zhu ba dang / me tog 'bul ba/ rnga brdung dar 'phyar sogs 'khyug tsam ring tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyi dga' spro'i rnam pas khengs song /tshogs chen 'go tshugs skabs dang thog rdzong dpon nas dga' bsu'i r+shas tshig sgrogs sbyang gnang ba dang / de nas ngas kyang gtam bshad byas pa yin/ mjug tu bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi zhabs bro 'khrab ston byas song /347

tshogs 'du grol rjes mi tshang ma nga tsho 'gro sa'i lan shog 'dir rgyugs yong gi 'dug lan shog de ni ri bo'i sgang zhig la 'dug pas de nas spu hreng rdzong tshang ma mig lam du mthong gi 'dug rdzong 'di'i sa cha'i gnas bab ni rong khul yin zhing chu bo zhig dkyil nas rgyugs 'gro gi yod/ grong tsho ni ri chu'i bar la gnas yod pas mnga' ris khul gyi zhing khul gcig po de yin/ sa khul de mtha' mtshams khul du gnas yod par brten gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing chen po yod pa dang rgyal spyi'i gsang myul rgyun du sa de nas phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed kyi yod/ der da dung rgya gar dang bal yul gyi tshong rwa btsugs nas tshong las khyab khongs yongs rdzogs phyi rgyal mi'i lag tu bzung yo da/'dir phyi rgyal gyi dngul brje sa nga tsho'i dngul khang zhig dang / dmag ngangu nga gi mkho sprod 'gan len byed mkhan gyi nyo sgrub tshogs chung zhig rang las mi 'dug da lta'i rnam pa 'gyur ldog gtong bar dus tshod ring po dgos pa ma zad 'thab rtsod kyang ha cang rnyog 'dzing chen po red/ dmag sgar du 'byor skabs lan shog nas nga tshor sne len byas byung / bla ma dang rdzong dpon yang nga tsho dang mnyam du de gar sdod par slebs byung / khong tsho ni lha sa nas btang ba'i dpon rigs sha stag red/ phan tshun gleng mol byed pa'i rgyud rim nang kho tsho ni nga tsho dang mthun sgril byed mkhan zhig yin bsam rung cung blo mi bde ba 'dug rdzong dpon gyis ngo sprod byas par gzhigs na rdzong khyon yongs la mi grangs 400 0lhag tsam las med pas mes rgyal nang sa'i shang gcig gi mi grangs dang ha lam mtshungs kyi yod/ gal te mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas ma btang na sa de sa/'i mi rnams rang skye rang shi byed rgyu rang red/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 5nyin/ gza' nyi ma/ser skya dpon rigs dang 'go pa tsho skong tshogs kyis bzhugs mol 348

tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs pas tshogs zhugs mi sna bla ma dang rdzong dpon/ de bzhin 'go pa che chung bsdoms mi grangs 2 0 lhag tsam 'dug tshogs 'du'i thog kho tshos gsham gsal gyi bsam 'char dang gros gzhi bton pa ste/dang po/ gzhung lam myur skrun gyis mes rgyal nang sa'i dngos rdzas dbor 'dren byas te mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dka' nga'/ sel thub pa bya rgyu/gnyis pa/ 'dir nad gzhi mang po yod pas mgyogs myur 'phrod bsten so'o zhig 'dzus/sa rogs zhu rgyu/gsum pa/ rdo sol sngog 'don myur bar thub pa byas nas me shing gi dka' ngal sel thub pa bya rgyu/bzhi pa/ mes rgyal nang sar slob sbyong dang lta skor la bskyod rgyur skul slong bya rgyu'i thad dka' ngal chen po 'dug pas re bar de'i thad kyi las 'gan nyung du gtong gnang yod pa zhu rgyu/lnga pa/ phyugs zog nyung khar skyel 'dren gyi las 'gan lci b.ratshobarten las 'gan nyung du gtong rogs zhu rgyu dang / lhag par du dgon sde'i grwa pa ni ched mngags dgon sder zhabs zhu byed dgos kyang da cha skyel 'dren gyi las 'gan 'khur dgos pas de dag med pa bzo rogs zhu rgyu/ gzhan yang da res 'bru rigs dbor ba'i gla cha da dung sprad med pas mgyogs myur sprod rogs zhu rgyu/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 6nyin/ gza' zla ba/blo mthun hre pang kre dang yan lag ru khag gi tud krang gnyis mtha' khul 'gag sgor gzigs zhib dang de ga'i dmag dpung la 'tshams 'dri gnang bar bskyod/ nga dang blo mthun wang ra'o han de bzhin lan shog gi chab srid 349

slob ston pa bcas nas bshad 'phel gling dgon par sku 'gyed rgyag par phyin pa yin/dgon pa de ni dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin pa dang der grwa pa mi grangs 120lhag tsam yod pa ma zad de'i dgon lag bzhi lnga tsam yod pas sa cha de ga'i dgon pa che shos shig yin/ dgon pa de lha sa'i 'bras spungs dgon pa'i khongs gtogs yin pa ma zad bla ma yang 'bras spungs dgon pa nas phebs kyi yod pa red/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i tshes 7nyin/ gza' mig dmar/hre pang kre dang bcas pa mu mthud mtha' khul dmag dpung la 'tshams 'dri gnang bar phebs pa dang / nga dang wang ra'o han bcas pa 'khor chags dgon par 'gyed rgyag par bskyod pa ma zad sa de ga'i mang tshogs la'ang 'tshams 'dri zhus pa yin/dgon pa de ni spu hreng dang lam thag le dbar 45yod pa'i he ma la ya'i ri gsham gyi zhing khul du gnas shing / der zhing pa dud tshang bcu grangs shig kyang 'dug 'di khul du la gnyis 'dug pas la gcig brgyab ste nyin gcig gi sa nas rgya gar du 'byor gyi yod pa dang / la gzhan zhig brgyab ste nyin phyed kyi sa nas bal yul du 'byor gyi yod pas lam bar du nga tshor rgya gar dang bal yul gyi mi mang po 'phrad byung / kho tsho'i khrod las re 'ga' ni gnas ri mjal bar yong ba dang / re 'ga' ni tshong pa red 'duga'akhor chags dgon ni dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i dgon pa zhig red/ de'ang gzhis rtse'i ngor e wam dgon gyi dgon lag cig yin pas da cha 'dir grwa pa nyi shu tsam dang / btsun ma kha shas/ de bzhin bla 350

mar ngos 'dzin zhus ma thag pa'i byis pa lo bdun brgyad la slebs pa zhig bcas 'dug khong gi gzim khang ni dgon pa nas le dbar gcig tsam gyi sar 'dug pas nga tsho 'byor rjes khong gdan 'dren zhu bar btang song / khong gi gnang sgo tshang myo4 yongs 'dzin nas sku tshab gnang gi 'dug mang tshogs kyis khong la mjal kha zhu ba sogs gus bkur tshad med byed kyi 'dug ngas krung dbyang gi sku tshab zhus nas khong la phyag rtags phul ba dang sbrags nga tsho yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas khong nas bka' mol tshig gcig kyang mi gsungs bar tshang ma yongs 'dzin gyis sku tshab gnang song / de nas nga dang khong mnyam du dran rten gyi sku par zhig kyang sgron pa yin/zla ba rdopa'i ches rdonyin/ gza' lhag pa/mang tshogs la 'tshams 'dri dang bcas 'tsho ba skyo gras la dngul sprod par phyin pas mthar 'tsho ba dka' ngal yod med la ma bltos par tshang ma khyon bsdoms mi grangs 1000lhag tsam slebs song bas ha lam dngul ṭ+wā yang 1040tsam phyin song /dgong dro'i kha lag tshar rjes rgya gar dang bal yul gyi tshong rwa yod sar lta skor du phyin/ tshong rwa de gnyis ka chu bo'i nub ngos su chags 'dug pas bal yul gyi tshong rwa ni chu bo'i mtha' la khang pa yang med par nyin mo phan tshun tshong rgyag res byed kyi 'dug de'ang tshong ni gtso bo 'bru rigs dang nga tsho'i bal tshwa brje res byed kyi 'dug kho tsho ni chu bo'i 'gram gyi brag phug nang du sdod pa dang / gyon pa ni snam bu'i gyon pa ral pa de 'dra gon gyi 'dug rgya gar gyi tshong rwa ni bal yul gyi tshong rwa'i steng gi ri 'dabs shig tu chags yod pas der khang khyim bdun cu brgyad cu tsam yod pa ma zad/ tshong pa tshos gyon pa 351

cung legs tsam gyon 'dug pa ni mang che ba rgya gar gyi 'go snam las bzos pa red/ tshong gnyer bya rgyu'i tshong zog sna mang yod pa gtso bo ras cha dang / 'bru rigs/ ja/ bu ram/ de bzhin rgyun mkho'i rgya zog kyang mang po 'dug nga tsho'i sa nas kho tshos nyo sgrub bya rgyu ni bal dang tshwa/ tsha la dkar po bcas red/tshong pa de tsho mang che ba pha tsha bu rgyud kyis tshong las gnyer mkhan sha stag yin pas lo ltar dbyar kha dang ston ka sa 'dir tshong rgyag par yong gi yod pa dang dgun kha dang dpyid kar log 'gro gi yod pa/ yong skabs khyim tshang gi nang mi cha tshang khrid nas yong gi yod pas ha lam mi tshang mas bod skad rgyag shes kyi 'dugakho tshos nga tsho ni sku tshab tshogs pa yin pa shes rjes nga tshor 'tsher snang chen po byed kyi 'dug dus tshod sa rub la nye bar brten nga tsho tshong khang cung che ba kha shas shig la lta skor byas rjes zhag sdod byed sar log phyin pa yin/zla ba rdopa'i ches 9nyin/ gza' phur bu/zhogs par dmag dpung dang sa gnas 'a/sa byed pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du zhig skong tshogs byas nas krung dbyang sku tshab pas 'tshams 'dri zhu don brgyud bsgrags byas/ ngas dang thog tshogs 'du'i thog mig snga'i rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi rnam pa'i skor gleng ba dang dus mtshungs dmag dpung dang sa gnas las byed pa'i las 'gan gsal bshad byas pa yin/ de nas tshang ma'i bsam 'char nyan 'jog byas mthar kho tsho'i re ba ni gzhung lam mgyogs myur gsar skrun byas te mig snga'i rjes lus rnam par 'gyur ldog gtong rgyu dang /de bzhin mes rgyal nang sar slob sbyong dang lta skor la bskyod nas chab srid rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang rig gnas chu tshad gong mthor gtong rgyu bcas 352

red/tshogs 'du grol rjes nga tsho lam sang rdzong srid gzhung la bskyod nas rdzong dpon gyi gsol ston la bcar ba yin/ ja 'thung nas bsdad pa'i bar la nga dang rdzong dpon gnyis bod nang khul gyi bcos bsgyur gnad don thad la gleng mol byas pas khong gis nga rang ni nyams rgud du gyur pa'i sku drag gi gras shig yin pas sku drag gzhan tshos mthong chung bya yul zhig chags yod cing / bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs der dga' po med/ nga rang gi ngos nas bshad na bcos bsgyur la yongs su mos mthun dang brtsi bkur zhu gi yin/'on kyang 'di gar nga rang mi gcig gis mos mthun byas pa tsam gyis mi 'grig pas nges par du mi gzhan la ga ler bsam blo'i las ka byed dgos zhes gsungs kyi 'dug nga'i bsam par khong la lam lugs de ga'i mis mthong chung byed par brten tshad gzhi nges can zhig gi thog nas byas na lam lugs de dag bcos bsgyur bya rgyur mos mthun byed srid pa zhig red snyam/ de'i thog la nga tshos bcos bsgyur byed pa'i brgyud rim nang chab srid thog khong tsho'i go gnas rang 'jags dang dpal 'byor thog da lta'i 'tsho ba'i chu tshad las dma' ru mi gtong ba'i srid jus lag bstar nan tan byas na kho pa tsho'i gras yongs su brtson len byed thub srid/ kho tsho'i gras brtson len thub pa byas te log spyod mkhregs srung nyung shas grogs med kher rkyang du ba'ag nas chab srid thog mi sems phyogs thub pa'i rnam pa zhig skrun thub rgyu red snyam pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/zla ba rapa'i ches 11nyin/ gza' spen pa/de ring spu hreng nas kha gyes khar rdzong dpon dang / 'go pa/ dgon 353

sde'i sprul sku bcas nas nga tshor phebs skyel mdzad sgo 'tshogs song bas rdog thon byed skabs nyin gung pe cin chu tshod gsum pa tsam zin zhing de nas le dbar 40tsam phyin rjes dkar dung la zhag sdod byas/de ni dud tshang bdun brgyad tsam yod pa'i grong tsho chung chung zhig red/der da dung dgon pa chung chung zhig dang skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs shig 'dugang tsho 'dir rnga mong ru khag yong rgyur sgugs bsdad nas spang gi sgang la ja bskol te ja bsrubs ma 'thung ba dang spag zas nas chu tshod 'ga' zhig phyin rung rnga mong ru khag da dung yong mkhan mi 'dug de'i mtshams su glo bur du nam mkhar sprin nag 'khor zhing lhags rlung ldang ba/ 'brug skad dang glog dmar 'khyug pa bcas byed kyi 'dug pas nga tsho de mur skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs kyi khang pa'i nang du spos te char g.yol byas pa yin/nga tsho khang pa'i nang du 'dzul ma thag drag char btang song / khang pa de'i thog ni shing dang rtswa yis bkab 'dug pas thigs pa tshad med rgyag gi 'dug nga tshos dung ban 'khyer te res mos kyis thigs pa bzed nas bsdad/de mur sa rub song rung rnga mong ru khag da dung ma slebs par brten mi tshang ma 'khyags pa dang / ltogs pa/ thang chad pa bcas kyi skabs su'ang tshang mas rnga mong ru khag sgugs pa dang chabs cig lag pa 'gul te skyel 'dren 'bab tshugs nas grod zhib dang / tsong snum sogs blangs nas bag leb bzos te grod khog rgyags thabs byas/nam phyed tsam la gzhi nas rnga mong ru khag 'byor tsam byung song / kho tsho ni dang thog thon pa'i skabs su dus tshod phyi po yin pa dang / lam bar du yang lam nor thebs pa ma zad da dung char rdung 'khel ba sogs kyi rkyen pas 'di gar slebs dus ha cang phyi po chags 'dug354

zla ba rdopa'i ches 12nyin/ gza' nyi ma/rlangs 'khor ru khag dang mnyam du bar gar 'dzoms rgyu'i skad cha byas pas nga tshos nyin gcig rang la bar gar 'gro rgyu dang rnga mong ru khag de nyin gnyis la bar gar 'gro rgyur gtan 'khel/lam bar rta pho lcag gis skul te myur bar bskyod pas dgong dro'i chu tshod brgyad dang phyed kar bar gar slebs thub pa byung / lam thag le dbar 120tsam bskyod 'dug rlangs 'khor ru khag ni snga sa nas nga tsho sgugs bsdad 'dug pas tshang ma'i sems nang dga' tshor tshad med byung / de nas sman pa cang lags ru khag gi rjes su lus pa shes 'phral tshang mar sems khral chen po skyes nas lam seng sku srung ba gcig dang / las byed pa gcig khong bsu bar btang / nga tsho kha lag zas tshar ma thag khong tsho 'byor song bas gnas tshul gzhan pa gang yang byung med stabs tshang ma blo bder gyur cing tshang mas sman pa cang lags la bstan gshis bslangs nas dga' spro'i rnam pa phyogs bzhir khyab song /zla ba rdopa'i ches 12nyin/ gza' zla ba/ rnga mong ru khag sgugs ched nga tsho tshang ma 'dir mi sdod dka' med la dus tshod de dang bstun te nyin shas nang nyin tho bris rgyur lus pa dag bris pa dang /h+pha cwa ye phu'u yi bris pa'i 〈gzhon nu'i go hrag srung dmag 〉ces pa'i deb de klog bsdad pa yin/dgong dro'i chu tshod bdun pa tsam la rnga mong ru khag 'byor/ mdun phyogs chu 'gram gyi lam ni 'dam rdzob mang pos khengs shing nyin shas ring char 355

pa chen po btang bar brten 'dam nang du ha cang tshud sla ba zhig red/ kha sngon 'di gar rlangs 'khor thengs mang 'dam la shor myong yod pas nga tsho'i bsam par sang nyin yang kha sngon dang 'dra ba mi yong ngam snyam ste ca lag do po tshang ma rnga mong la bkal nas chu'i pha rol du btang ba dang / rlangs 'khor stong par gtong rgyu byas/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 14nyin/ gza' mig dmar/las 'gan mjug ma de legs grub byung ste blo mthun tshang ma log 'dod kyi bsam blo mda' mo 'phangs pa dang mtshungs pas nyin gnyis bed spyod byas te dgun sar log rgyu thag bcad/ zhogs pa chu tshod bdun pa tsam la langs nas brgyad par dngos su rdog thon byas/ lam ni 'gro shin tu khag po 'dugalhag par 'om bu thang chen brgyud nas 'gro dgos stabs rlangs 'khor yam yom che bas chu tshod gcig nang spyi le kha shas las 'gro thub mi 'dug der brten sngon gyi 'char gzhi ltar 'gro ma thub par lam bar zhag sdod byed dgos byung /zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 15nyin/ gza' lhag pa/lam ni kha sa dang 'dra bar dkar dung la 'byor dus sa rub song bas rlangs 'khor las bab ma thag blo mthun wang ho mu'u dang mjal byung bas khong gis mnga' ris nas nag chu bar gyi gzhung lam mig sngar shar bskyod thub kyi 'dug ces gsungs kyi 'dug pas tshang ma ha cang dga' po byung / nga tsho lam de brgyud nas phyir log byas na spyir gam/da don 'phrad mi srid pa zhig red/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 16nyin/ gza' phur bu/dbyar sa nas dgun sa bar gyi lam ni ha cang 'gro bde po 'dug 'on 356

kyang chu brgal nas 'gro skabs rlangs 'khor zhig 'dam la shor te thabs shes yo da rgu bton rung 'then ma thub pa ra mthar rlangs 'khor de'i nang gi mi rlangs 'khor gzhan zhig gi nang 'tshang kha brgyab nas sngon la dgun sar slebs pa byas rjes slar mi dang rlangs 'khor yong nas 'dam la shor ba'i rlangs 'khor 'don rgyu'i thag bcad pa red/dgun sar 'byor rjes thon krang nas tshogs 'du skong tshogs byas te tshes bcu dgu nyin nang sar phyir log bya rgyu'i thag gcod byas/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 17nyin/ gza' pa sangs zla ba kha shas ring tshags par gcig kyang lta rgyu ma byung bar brten dngos gnas rna cog gnyis kyis phyi rol gyi gnas tshul ma go ba dang 'dra bas blo mthun krang rmin sa nas 〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par 〉dang 〈mi dmangs tshags par 〉mang po zhig g.yar te nyin gcig tag tag bltas pa yin/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 1rdonyin/ gza' spen pa/las ka med pas nyin gang tshags par klog nas bsdad pa yin/zla ba rdopa'i ches 19nyin/ gza' nyi ma/zhogs pa'i chu tshod bcu gcig lhag tsam la nga tsho sku tshab tshogs pa'i khongs mi yongs rdzogs sa cha de ga'i sgar dpon dang 'go pa/ de bzhin dmag dpung dang sa gnas kyi las byed pa tsho'i spro sems 'khol ba'i phebs skyel 'og mnga' ris kyi lte ba'i grong dgun sa nas kha gyes te nang sar logazla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 2 0nyin/ gza' zla ba/zhogs par gnam 'thibs pas sems nang mi skyid pa'i snang ba zhig 357

ster/ nga tsho mi bcu grangs shig chu bo gang gā'i 'gram gyi 'om bu thang chen du bsdad yod rung tshor ba ni sngar bzhin 'jam thing nger red/lam de brgyud nas 'gro myong mkhan blo mthun gyis bshad par gzhigs na/ de nas nyin gnyis kyi sar slebs rjes lam bar me shing mthong rgyu med pas rlangs 'khor tshang ma'i nang me shing mang tsam 'khyer dgos zer gyi 'dugachu tshod bcu gcig tsam la nga tsho thon pa dang / lam bde po 'dug pas rlangs 'khor la skyon chag gang yang byung ma song / nyin gung chu tshod gnyis pa tsam la seng ge kha 'bab tu 'byor byung / sa der mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4600'dug bshad srol ltar na/ de nas mdun du bskyod tshe zhag sdod bya yul du ma gtogs chu med pa red zer gyi 'dug pas nga tshos sa de gar chu bskol nas kha lag zas pa yin/nyin gung kha lag tshar rjes spyi le bcu lhag tsam bskyod pas lam zur nas blo mthun zhig gis lag pa brkyangs te rlangs 'khor bkag gi 'dug nga tshos rlangs 'khor kha bkag ste bcar 'dri zhus pas 'brog khul du las ka byed mkhan gyi gzhon nu blo mthun zhig red 'dug khong ni las ka'i rkyen pas lha sar 'gro mkhan red 'dug khong gis nga tsho lam de brgyud nas yong gi yod pa shes rjes sa der sgugs nas nyin gnyis bsdad pa yin zer gyi 'dug nga tshos hang sang ba'i sgo nas khyed rang gcig pur mi med lung stong der skrag ma byung ngam zhes dris pas khong gis da cha goms 'dug ces gsungs/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyis mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun dang bod ljongs dar rgyas kyi ched du khong dang 'dra ba'i phul byung mi sna khri stong mang pos snyan grags dang khe phan la ma ltos par dka' spyad 'bad 'thab kyis rang nus yod rgu legs skyes su 'bul gyi yod pa red/358

dgong dro'i chu tshod bdun pa tsam la chu bo gang gā'i stod rgyud du 'byor/nyin kha shas char pa bstud mar babs rkyen chu bo rgyas te rlangs 'khor 'gro sa med par lus/ de nas chu 'gram du zhag sdod byas te gros mol gnang / sa der mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4250red 'dugazla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 21nyin/ gza' mig dmar/ —kha sa chu 'gram du 'byor skabs chu bo rgyas pa'i khar dus tshod kyang phyi po chags yod stabs dus thog tu chu sgrol ma thub/ mi tshang mas de ring chu bo phran bu 'jags na 'og la rdo bting nas bde blag ngang sgrol thub mi yong ngam snyam pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang don dngos ni de las ldog ste mtshan la drag char shugs chen zhig btang nas chu bo kha sa las che bar rgyas 'dug thon krang nas tshang mar dka' ngal las rgyal thub pa'i chod sems yod dam med ces skad cha dris skabs tshang mas dka' ngal gyi mdun la zhum pa med par ma gros gcig mthun gyis nga tshor nges par du dka' ngal las rgyal thub pa'i sems shugs yod ces lan btab/de nas mi tshang ma dmag 'thab nang zhugs shing 'ga' res rdo dbor ba dang 'ga' res bting ba bcas byas te nyin phyed ring tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang ngal rtsol byas mthar spyi khre gnyis gsum tsam yod pa'i lam zhig bzo thub pa byung /de rjes chu la lta zhib byed par 'gro mkhan blo mthun tshos bshad par gzhigs na/gsham ngos su chu bo gting thung la rgyugs shugs dal tsam zhig 'dug zer bas de mur thon krang gis tshang ma sne khrid nas lta bar bskyod pas sngon gyi 'di las phran bu'i lam bzo bde ba zhig 'dug dang thog nga tshos rlangs 'khor che ba zhig btang nas tshod lta byas pas gsham la tshang ma bye sa song gshis de'i nang 359
