shor song / slar rdo dbor mkhan gyi rlangs 'khor zhig btang bas de yang chu'i nang du lus song / nyin gung kha lag tshar rjes sngon gyi sa der log nas mu mthud las ka byas pas de nyin rlangs 'khor shar bgrod thub pa'i lam spyi khre 10tsam zhig bzo thub pa byung ste tshang mas dga' spro'i ngang mar khe ses ngal rtsol gyis 'jig rten gsar skrun thub pa dang / ngal rtsol gyis rang byung khams kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog gtong thub ces gsungs pa bzhin dngos gnas de 'dra rang red ces bshad/nga tshor ngar shugs slebs pa'i sgang der thon krang nas chu sne gzhan la khrid rgyu'i thabs shes shig bton pa ste/ chu bo'i gzhung der chu yur zhig drus nas chu khrid thub na chu shugs chung du 'gro gi red gsungs/ der brten dgong dro'i kha lag tshar rjes nga dang sman pa krang lags/ blo mthun wang ra'o han/de bzhin blo mthun lo na chung ba khag gcig gis lam sang chu yur chung chung zhig drus pa yin/zla ba /pa'i ches 22nyin/ gza' lhag pa/mdang nub char pa ma babs par brten de ring gnam gshis ha cang yag po 'dug nga tsho tshang mas sems shugs sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas de ring dus thog tu las kar zhugs pa ma zad hur thag 'bad thag byas mthar yang lam spyi khre 10lhag tsam zhig bzo thub pa byung song /nga tshos kha sa drus pa'i chu yur nang mtshan gang chu rgyugs te khengs 'dug pa de thon krang nas mthong rjes nga tshor yur po de gting ring tsam dang kha zheng che tsam drus te gsham gyi rgyugs chu dang 'brel thub pa byed dgos zhes gsungs kyi 'dug gzhan yang blo mthun hre pang kre sogs kyis rgyugs chu'i khrid nas 360

yur bu kha zheng che ru btang bas dngos 'brel chu bo'i rgyugs shugs chung du 'gro rgyur phan thogs chen po byung /mtshan mor yang drag char babs par brten chu bo de bas che ru song ste/tshang ma'i sems nas dngangs tshab skyes kyang gnam la ngan smras byed pa tsam las tshang ma'i dmag 'thab kyi ngar shugs ma chag par 'bad/zla ba ram̐pa'i ches 2 2nyin/ gza' phur bu/zhogs pa nas gnam 'thibs te char pa sim sim babs kyi 'dug zhogs zas tshar ba'i rjes nyi ma yod la med pa zhig shar nas slar sprin pas sgrib ste mu mthud char pa babs song bas nyin gang las ka bya thabs bral/thon krang nas de snga'i thag gcod la 'gyur ldog btang ste nga tsho tshang ma lam sang dgun sar phyir log bya rgyu'i bka' phab par tshang mas 'gro 'dod med rung thon krang gi bka' la ma brtsi na ga la 'grig sngon gyi 'char gzhir ga'igs na zhogre/sa zas tshar rjes lam sang thon rgyu yin rung da dung rlangs 'khor gcig chu'i nang du lus yod par brten kha lo ba nas nyin gcig 'gyangs rgyu'i re ba bton mthar sang zhogs thon rgyu'i thag bcad/zla ba shrīpa'i ches 24nyin/ gza' pa sangs/dgun sar slebs ska bas chu bo chen po rgyas gshis 'gro thub kyi mi 'dugadang thog sku tshab tshogs pa'i khongs mi rnams rnga mong la bzhon nas yud tsam bskyod pa dang de nas yang rta la bzhon nas bskyod/ de sngon rlangs 'khor nang bskyod skabs lam thag ring po med kyang de ring ni chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam bskyod rjes gzhi nas dmag sgar yod sar slebs tsam byung / skabs der sa 361

rub tshar yod kyang tshang mas nga tsho log yong ba shes nas thugs khur zab bzhes dang sems rtsa 'khol pos nga tshor sne len zhus byung /zla ba ram̐pa'i ches 2ranyin/ gza' mig dmar/zla phyed tsam ring sems nus yod rgu bton nas mar khaṃ se'i gsung rtsom dbyin yig par ma de klog pas mar khe se ring lugs kyi ngos 'dzin chu tshad gong mthor 'gro thub pa byung ba ma zad dbyin yig par ma'i mar khe se'i gsung rtsom lta klog bya rgyu'i nus pa'ang mngon gsal du gong mthor 'gro thub pa byung /da cha nyin ltar gung khran tang dang mnyam 'brel byed pa'i tang gi lo rgyus de shog grangs 20yas mas lta klog thub pa ma zad/ shog grangs re re'i nang cha snyoms byas na tshig gsar gsum bzhi las thon gyi mi 'dug pas rgya yig gi deb ma bltas kyang nang don cha tshang go thub tsam yong gi 'dug de ltar byas nas sang lo ( 1957)la spyi tshogs tshan rig gi gsung rtsom klog thub pa'i chu tshad la brtson len byed thub rgyu red/zla ba ṭ+wāṃpa'i ches 29nyin/ gza' lhag pa/thon krang gis bkra shis sgang dmag dpung nas tar yig 'byor gsal la nye lam mi 'ga' res dmag dpung phyogs la rdo dbyugs pa ma zad/ rgyun par lag tu gri 'khyer nas dmag dpung yod sar yong ste brnyas brko bas nges par du dogs zon cher bskyed byed dgos zhes gsungs kyi 'dugazla ba rapa'i ches 20nyin/ gza' phur bu/de ring spu hreng nas kyang tar yig 'byor gsal la/ spu hreng rdzong du log spyod kyi yig dkyur thon yod pa de'i nang don la rgya mi gung khran tang yon nas 362

da tshor gnod 'tshe ma gtogs phan thogs gang yang med pas rgya mi mtha' mtshams nas 'bud dgos zhes pa sogs red ces snyan seng 'byor/ yig dkyur ni rgya gar tshong pa'i gur nang nas thon 'dugaganas tshul de dag la bltas tshe bkra shis sgang du dgra bos bya thabs spel ba de ni khyon yongs la gtor bshig gi bya thabs spel ba'i nang gi cha shas shig yin pas nga tshos las ka yag po sgrub pa dang chab srid kyi shugs rkyen rgya bskyed du gtong thub par mang tshogs kyis brtsi bkur thob thub kyi yod/ der brten dgra bos nga tshor gtor bshig gtong nges shig red/bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa dang / krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa bod du phebs 'byor gyis bod kyi sa phyogs gang sar mtshams 'dri dang dgon sder 'gyed brgyab pa de ni bod rigs mi dmangs tshor dga' spro dpag med ster ba'i bya ba chen po zhig red/ da res kyi chab srid byed sgo de spel ba brgyud bod rigs mi dmangs ni de bas tang dang srid gzhung la yid ches dang / ma'o kru'u zhir srung brtsi yod par dogs pa rtsa ba nas byed mi dgos/ dus mtshungs krung go dang phyi rgyal gyi dgra bo rnams ha las hang sang nas gtor bshig gi byed sgo rab dang rim pa zhig spel rgyu yin pas nga tshos nges par du dogs zon chen po byas te las don khag de bas zab nan dang de bas legs por sgrub dgos/zla ba rdzopa'i ches 4nyin/ gza' mig dmar/de ring gzhi nas seng ge kha 'bab nas kha bral rgyu yin pas dga' tshor mi skyes mkhan mi gcig kyang mi 'dug zhogs pa chu tshod bcu dang phyed kar rdog thon byas/ lam bar ‘8brog pa dud tshang gcig gnyis 'phrad rgyu 'dug sa cha 363

'ig la rlangs 'khor kha bkag ste chu blug pa'i skabs mi ser kha shas lta bar rgyugs yong gi 'dug kyang kho tshos rgyang lta byed pa las mdun du bcar nus kyi min 'dug nga tshos kho tshor lag pa dbyugs pas gzhi nas nga tsho'i 'gram du slebs byung / sa der las don mi sna slebs myong med stabs kho tshos nga tsho mthong skabs skrag snang byed kyi 'dug zla ba rdzopa'i ches 7nyin/ gza' pa sangs/de ring rlangs 'khor che ba gsum la ca lag lug dgos stabs chu tshod bcu gcig la gzhi nas rdog thon byed thub tsam byung / nyin gung kha lag za sa der bod rigs mang tshogs mthong rgyu yod pa las de min lam bar du mi ser 'phrad rgyu mi 'dug kru'u khe krang gis da ni mi med thang du slebs zin pas 'di nas bkra shis gtsang po bar tshang ma gzhis rtse'i khongs gtogs yin zhing 'brog rwa khag drug tsam yod pa red ces zer gyi 'duganyin shas nang gangs ri mthong rgyu ma byung rung de ring ni gangs ri'i gsham du sdod dgos byung / yin na'ang gangs ri de'i ming la gang zer min shes mkhan min 'dug mdun gyi le dbar bcu grangs nang 'thung chu med par brten phyi dro'i chu tshod drug par zhag sdod byas/ de nyin lam thag le dbar 126tsam bskyod pa dang / 'ag sdod bya yul gyi mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4500tsam la slebs kyi 'dugazla ba 9pa'i ches 9nyin/ gza' nyi ma/snga dro'i chu tshod bcu pa tsam la thon pa dang / nyin gung zin khar ngal gso brgyab pas de dus char drag cig btang rung 'khyug tsam na/sa gnam 364

dwangs song / phyi dro'i chu tshod drug par mdzes sdug ldan pa'i mtsho 'gram zhig tu slebs nas der 'ag sdod byas/ de ring lam thag spyi le 1ṭ+wāṃ4tsam bskyod pa dang / zhag sdod bya yul gyi mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4400zin gyi 'dugamatsho chu ni dwangs shing sngo ba tsam las 'thung chu mi nyan pas gang sar chu phran 'tshol bar phyin/ glo bur du ri steng nas chu log cig rgyugs yong gi 'dug pa de ni shin tu rnyog pas de bas 'thung chu mi nyan zhing mu mthud gang sar chu 'tshol bar bskyod/ mthar dgong dro'i chu tshod bcu pa tsam la gzhi nas dgong zas rags tsam byung /zla ba 9pa'i ches 10nyin/ gza' zla ba/chu bo seng ge kha 'bab sgrol rjes nyin bdun gyi sar bskyod pas bkra shis gtsang po'i mdun du slebs/ skabs der sa rub yod par brten nga tsho chu 'gram du zhag sdod byas nas sang zhogs gtsang po brgal rgyu byas pa yin/ de gar mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 4500yod pas rlung shugs ha chang chen po yod pa dang / gnam gshis kyang ha cang grang mo 'dugazla ba 9pa'i ches 11nyin/ gza' mig dmar/nyin phyed ring tshang mas 'bad brtson chen pos ngal rtsol byas pa brgyud bkra shis gtsang po rgyal kha'i ngang brgal thub pa byung zhing rlangs 'khor mjug ma de gtsang po'i pha rol du slebs skabs tshang mas thal mo brdab ste dga' bsu byed kyi 'dugabakra shis gtsang po nas kha gyes rjes nag chu'i sa khongs su slebs pas 365

rlangs 'khor mu mthud chu tshod bzhi trem bskyod pa'i mthar tsha la mtsho ru 'byor/lam thag spyi le 1rdo4bskyod 'dugatsha la mtsho ru slebs khar nga tshos rgyang ring nas dmag mi'i gur 10tsam zhig yod pa mthong byung / kha lo bas ya mtshan chen po'i sgo nas kha sngon kho tsho der yong skabs gur mang po de 'dra mi 'dug zer gyi 'dug gur gyi mdun du slebs skabs der tshong don tshogs chung zhig dang gnam gshis sa tshigs shig btsugs yod pa gzhi nas shes byung / de min nag chu kung ud nas 'brog sa khag la krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pas gnang ba'i lag rtags dang / dngul 'gyed 'bul mkhan gyi las don tshogs chung zhig btang 'dugatshong don tshogs chung nang rgya rigs blo mthun gcig dang bod rigs blo mthun gnyis bcas khyon bsdoms mi grangs gsum 'dug pas khong tshos gur nang dngos zog sgrig shing rdo khang zhig brgyab nas nyal sa dang thab tshang mnyam spyod byed kyi 'dug kho tsho'i las 'gan ni nye 'khor gyi 'brog pa tshor nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i mkho chas mkho sprod bya rgyu dang / 'brog pa'i sa nas bal dang pags pa/ tsha la bcas nyo sgrub bya rgyu de red/ dngos zog de tsho'i gong tshad ni mes rgyal nang sa'i gong tshad kyi sgang la dngul kha snon gyis 'brog par mkho sprod byed kyi yod/ bod kyi sa khongs nang lo phyed tsam phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na krung dbyang nas gong tshad kha snon bya thabs lag bstar gnang ba de ni yongs su yang dag pa yin pa'i myong tshor byung / de 'dra byung tshe gzhi nas sa de ga'i mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos thub pa dang phyi rgyal gyi dngos zog kyang bkag 'gog byed thub/nga tsho ni tsha la dkar po mthong myong med pas tshong don gyi blo mthun tshos rdog kha shas shig 'khyer nas nga tshor mig bstan byung / kho tshos bshad par 366

gzhigs na de ni 'dzam gling thog gi tsha la dkar po yag shos yin zhing de min rgyal khab gzhan nas thon pa'i tsha la dkar po ni 'di cho nang bzhin mkhregs po dang rdog sgril po med pa dang deng skabs ni mang tshogs so sos bsngogs 'don byed kyi 'dug kyang phyin chad sa gshis sde tshan nang ched mngags mi btang ste bsngogs 'don byed kyi red ces shod kyi 'dugazla ba 9pa'i tshes 12nyin/ gza' phur bu/de ring zhogs pa ni nam mkha' sngo zhing dwangs ba zhig 'dug de ring nga tsho nag chur slebs rgyu yin pas mi tshang mas dga' tshor chen po byed kyi 'duganag chu dang lam thag spyi le 40yod pa'i sar chu bo zhig brgal rjes mtsho bod gzhung lam steng shar bskyod byas/ zla shas ring mya ngam thang kho na'i thog la bskyod pa'i nang nas de ring glo bur du gzhung lam thog bskyod skabs sems nang ha cang dga' po byung rung de'i brgyud kyi gzhung lam ni yag po med khar char zhod dang 'khel bas 'dam rdzab langs te lam ni mya ngam thang las kyang 'gro dka' ba 'duganag chur bca' sdod byed pa'i dmag dpung dang las khungs kyis gang sar 'dzugs skrun gsar gtod byas nas nag chu'i rnam pa rnying pa 'gyur ldog btang ste nga tshos ngo mi shes pa lta bur chags 'dug de yang dus kyi 'gyur ba dang lhan du mes rgyal sa phyogs gang sar bya 'phur ba lta bu'i 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin yod/nga tsho gur nang sdod rgyu'i 'tsho ba mjug sgril te 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i sne len khang nang du bsdad pa yin/367

zla ba 9pa'i ches 15nyin/ gza' spen pa/snga dro'i chu tshod bcu par nag chu nas kha gyes te dgong dro'i chu tshod bdun pa tsam la a mdor 'byor/ lam bar zam pa rgyag pa dang lam bzo dgos pa'i khar char pa sim sim gtong gi 'dug pas de sngon thengs gnyis tsam phyin pa las kyang da res 'gro dka' ba byung /nag chur dar mdo'i brgyud nas jag pa khag gcig gis nag chu'i lam rgyud la bgrod zos mi bde ba bzo gi yod pa go rgyu 'dug pas lam bar nga tshos dogs zon chen po byas pa yin/ 'on kyang lam bar du lam bzo ru khag dang ar las ru khag yod par brten de snga las 'khrug cha dod pa dang / de min gnad don gang yang byung ma song /a mdor yang 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba ste/ de sngon gur dud kha shas shig las med kyang da cha ni khang pa star pa che thag chod cig yod pa ma zad/ da dung do dam sa tshugs dang / tshong don tshogs chung / ar las ru chen bcas kyi gur bcu grangs shig kyang yod pa dang / gzhan yang gsar rgyag byed bzhin pa'i khang pa star pa 'ga' shas yod pa red/ dngos 'brel grong rdal chung chung zhig 'dra po 'dug lhag don du nga tsho slebs pa'i skabs der rgyal yongs kyi gzhon nu'i 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang por zhugs mkhan bod kyi 'thus mi rnams kyang a mdor 'byor 'dug pas tshang mar ha cang skyid pa'i snang ba zhig byung /zla ba 1kyapa'i ches 4nyin/ gza' phur bu/dus yun lo phyed tsam gyi ring nga tshos bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon 368

lhan khang dbu brnyes par brten 'brel zhu ba'i byed sgo khag bde blag ngang legs grub zin pa ma zad bod kyi rim gras khag gi mi dmangs dang / bod sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag de bzhin bod sdod las don mi sna bcas la 'tshams 'dri byas mthar de ring zhogs pa chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la khun min du phyir log byas/rtsom pa po wang dbyi krung ni spyi lo 1956lor tsung li sku gzhon khren dbyi yis tshogs gtso gnang ba'i krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i khongs mi'i gras shig yin zhing skabs der khong ni yun nan zhing chen mi dmangs u yon lhan khang gi gzhung las thing gi kru'u ren gyi thugs 'gan bzhes yod/369
